CNPRegion.description:
Geography an aggregate is keyed to.

A separate table so an absent REGION means "the source did not key by
geography", which is different from GLOBAL ("the source aggregated across
all geographies") and different again from an empty CODE.

CODE.description:
The region key, verbatim from the source in the coding scheme KIND
names. Never re-coded between schemes on ingest.

NAME.description:
Human-readable region name as the source publishes it. Joins to
$CTR for country identity when KIND is COUNTRY.

CNPProvenance.description: Where one metric came from and under what terms it may be republished.

SOURCE.description:
Name of the organization or programme publishing the underlying
measurements, carried verbatim as that publisher states it.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the dataset, endpoint or landing page.

SOURCE_DATASET.description:
Dataset, table or API path queried, verbatim, e.g. a fully qualified
warehouse table name or a REST route.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query or request that produced these numbers, so the
aggregate can be replayed rather than trusted.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description: Source's own identifier for the returned batch, when it issues one.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the raw source bytes this aggregate was computed from,
lowercase hex.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the source was queried.

METHOD.description: How the underlying observations were produced.

MEASUREMENT_SERVER.description:
Measurement server, vantage point or probe set, when the source names
one. A throughput number without a vantage is not comparable to one
with a different vantage.

LICENSE.description:
SPDX identifier when the source states one, otherwise the licence name
verbatim. EMPTY MEANS UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, and never a
grant to republish.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence text.

ATTRIBUTION.description:
Attribution string the licence requires this record and every derived
product to carry downstream.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description:
True when the licence forbids commercial use (e.g. CC BY-NC 4.0). A
consumer building a paid surface MUST honour this flag; it is carried
per-source because one $CNP may mix a CC0 lane with a CC BY-NC
cross-check.

CNPStatistic.description: One number drawn from a metric's distribution.

PERCENTILE_RANK.description:
Percentile rank in 0..100 when STATISTIC is PERCENTILE. Meaningless
otherwise and MUST NOT be set.

VALUE.description: The number, expressed in the parent metric's UNITS.

CNPMetric.description:
One aggregated quantity for the parent record's key.

A metric is a DISTRIBUTION, not a scalar. There is deliberately no
`VALUE: double` on this table: a source that publishes only a median
encodes exactly one CNPStatistic with STATISTIC MEDIAN, and a consumer can
then never mistake it for a mean.

SOURCE_METRIC_NAME.description:
The source's own name for this metric, verbatim. REQUIRED to be
non-empty when KIND is OTHER; recommended always, because it is what
makes the mapping auditable.

UNITS.description:
Units of every VALUE under STATISTICS. NORMATIVE and required: "Mbps",
"kbps", "ms", "percent", "fraction", "count". Units are never silently
converted on ingest; a source publishing kbps encodes kbps.

STATISTICS.description: The distribution. At least one entry; a metric with none is malformed.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of individual measurements aggregated. 0 means the source did
not publish a sample count — it never means zero measurements.

CLIENT_COUNT.description:
Number of distinct clients, terminals or probes contributing. 0 means
unpublished.

PROVENANCE.description: Where this metric came from and under what terms.

CNP.description:
Constellation Network Performance.

Aggregated throughput, latency and availability for one satellite
constellation's user network, keyed by CONSTELLATION, ASN, REGION and a
closed time window. Built for a broadband LEO consumer-terminal lane
(one operator ASN measured via NDT7) and shaped so any operator — another
LEO constellation, a GEO VSAT provider — or a terrestrial ASN used as a
baseline fits the same record.

KEY, NOT MEASUREMENT. One $CNP is an AGGREGATE over a window. It is not a
speed test, not a single client's result, and not a per-satellite link
state: $LKS carries the instantaneous state and data rate of ONE named
link between two endpoints, and no $LKS can express "the p50 download rate
observed by 41,000 terminals in Germany during July".

NEVER-INVENT-DATA IS ENFORCED BY THE SHAPE. A quantity exists only as a
CNPMetric, and CNPMetric carries `UNITS: string (required)` and
`PROVENANCE: CNPProvenance (required)`, so there is no encoding for a
number that does not state its unit and name its source, query,
retrieval time, method and licence. A metric the source did not publish is
ABSENT — never zero. `SOURCES` lists every provider consulted for this key,
including ones that returned nothing, so a consumer can distinguish "not
looked for" from "looked for and empty".

LICENCE RIDES PER SOURCE. `CNPProvenance.NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY` exists
because a single record may legitimately carry a CC0 open-measurement lane
beside a CC BY-NC cross-check from a restricted publisher; the restriction
attaches to the metric that inherited it, never to the record as a whole.

CONSTELLATION.description:
Constellation or network name, carried verbatim as its operator states
it. Empty when the record is a terrestrial baseline. Joins to
$LKS.CONSTELLATION and to $CAT by the same name.

OPERATOR.description: Operating company, when it differs usefully from CONSTELLATION.

AS_NAME.description: Autonomous system name as the routing registry publishes it.

SERVICE_TIER.description:
Service tier the source distinguishes, verbatim ("Residential",
"Roam", "Business", "Maritime"). Empty when the source does not
separate tiers — never guessed from the throughput.

REGION.description:
Geography this aggregate is keyed to. Absent when the source published
no geographic key at all.

WINDOW_START.description: ISO 8601 UTC inclusive start of the aggregation window.

WINDOW_STOP.description: ISO 8601 UTC exclusive end of the aggregation window.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted for this key, including those that returned no
metric.

CREATED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time of this record.

UPDATED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC last-update time of this record.

SUPERSEDES_CNP_CID.description: CID of the $CNP this record replaces when a source restates a window.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

NAME.description: Display name of the owner or source the code stands for.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer description of the owner or source.

ACTIVE.description: True while the code is in current use by the publishing catalogue.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the reference table the row was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the reference table was retrieved.

OBJECT_ID.description: International Designator (YYYY-NNNAAA)

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD Catalog Number

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Object type (Payload, Rocket body, Debris, Unknown)

RCS.description: Radar Cross Section [meters2]; blank if no data available

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type (Orbit, Landing, Impact, Docked to RSO, roundtrip)

MANEUVERABLE.description: Indicates if the object is maneuverable

SIZE.description: Size [meters]; blank if no data available

MASS.description: Mass [kilograms]; blank if no data available

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation name

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

RFSFrequencySample.description:
The material's electromagnetic properties at ONE frequency. A table of
these beats the power-law fit wherever it covers the frequency.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Frequency this sample is stated at, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention. A join to `$IQC` (hertz) converts explicitly at the join.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_REAL.description: Real part of the relative permittivity.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_IMAGINARY.description:
Imaginary part of the relative permittivity (loss term), stated as a
POSITIVE magnitude.

RELATIVE_PERMEABILITY_REAL.description:
Real and imaginary relative permeability. 1.0 and 0.0 for non-magnetic
materials — stated, not assumed.

REFLECTIVITY.description: Power reflected at normal incidence as a ratio [0-1].

REFLECTION_LOSS_DB.description: Reflection loss at normal incidence, dB (positive).

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through the material at THICKNESS_M, dB (positive).

ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M.description: Attenuation inside the material, dB per metre.

RFSReflectionEntry.description:
Reflection and transmission at one incidence angle and polarization. The
angular dependence of a real surface cannot be carried by a single
normal-incidence number.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description: Frequency this entry is stated at, megahertz.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle from the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

REFLECTION_COEFFICIENT_MAGNITUDE.description: Magnitude of the field reflection coefficient [0-1].

REFLECTION_COEFFICIENT_PHASE_DEG.description: Phase of the field reflection coefficient, degrees.

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through the material at this angle, dB (positive).

SCATTERING_LOSS_DB.description: Power removed from the specular direction by surface roughness, dB.

RFSGeometryRef.description:
Where and what this material is attached to. A material record with no
geometry describes a substance; a material record WITH geometry describes
an obstacle a solver can intersect.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity, copied VERBATIM including the byte hash so the
material can never drift onto a different revision of the mesh.

MESH_NAME.description: Mesh and primitive inside the asset.

GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME.description:
glTF material slot the properties apply to, matching the
`$OPP.OPPSurface` join fields.

FACE_INDEXES.description: Explicit face indexes, when the material covers part of a mesh.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT` identity, when the obstacle is a catalogued object. 0 when
unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID`, when the obstacle is a structure at a terrestrial site.

FEATURE_ID.description: Producer's own feature identifier for a building, wall or terrain patch.

ANALYTIC_SHAPE.description:
Primitive and its dimensions in metres, when GEOMETRY_KIND is
ANALYTIC_SHAPE. The dimension order is the primitive's own convention and
MUST be stated in SHAPE_DIMENSION_NAMES.

LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Geodetic placement of a fixed obstacle, degrees and metres. Absent for
an obstacle whose position is joined from `$CAT`, `$TBS` or `$VAM`.

HEIGHT_M.description: Height above ground of a fixed structure, metres.

NORMAL_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Orientation of the surface normal, degrees east of north and above the
horizon. A wall that faces the wrong way blocks the wrong link.

SOURCE.description:
The measurement campaign, published table or model. Required: an
unattributed permittivity is not publishable.

SOURCE_REFERENCE.description: The specific table, recommendation or dataset entry within SOURCE.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query that retrieves the source value.

MEASUREMENT_TECHNIQUE.description:
How it was measured (e.g. "free-space transmission", "coaxial probe",
"resonant cavity").

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced modelled values.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_SIGMA.description:
1-sigma uncertainty of the permittivity and conductivity values, in the
units of the quantity they qualify.

LICENSE.description:
Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a
grant to redistribute.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
Stable identifier of this material. Joined by
`$RFL.RFLObstruction.MATERIAL_ID` and `$CVP.CVPObstacleRef.MATERIAL_ID`.

NAME.description: Name as its source states it, verbatim.

DESCRIPTION.description: Free-text description of the surface, not of its vendor.

FREQUENCY_MIN_MHZ.description:
Frequency range over which this record's parameters are valid,
megahertz. A solver MUST refuse to evaluate outside it rather than
extrapolate.

REFERENCE_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Frequency the scalar values below are stated at, megahertz. Without it
they are uninterpretable.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_IMAGINARY.description: Loss term, stated as a POSITIVE magnitude.

RELATIVE_PERMEABILITY_REAL.description: 1.0 and 0.0 for non-magnetic materials — stated, not assumed.

REFLECTIVITY.description: Power reflected at normal incidence as a ratio [0-1].

REFLECTION_LOSS_DB.description: Reflection loss at normal incidence, dB (positive).

THICKNESS_M.description:
Thickness the transmission and penetration losses are stated for, metres.
A transmission loss without a thickness cannot be rescaled.

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through THICKNESS_M at normal incidence, dB (positive).

ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M.description: Attenuation inside the material, dB per metre.

ABSORPTION_COEFFICIENT.description: Fraction of incident power absorbed at normal incidence [0-1].

SURFACE_ROUGHNESS_RMS_M.description:
RMS surface roughness, metres. Roughness is what decides whether a
surface is a mirror or a scatterer at a given wavelength.

ROUGHNESS_CORRELATION_LENGTH_M.description: Correlation length of the roughness, metres.

DIFFUSE_SCATTERING_COEFFICIENT.description: Fraction of non-absorbed power leaving diffusely [0-1].

TEMPERATURE_K.description: Temperature the properties were evaluated at, kelvin.

MOISTURE_CONTENT_FRACTION.description:
Volumetric moisture content [0-1]. Wet concrete and dry concrete are
different materials at RF.

SALINITY_PSU.description: Salinity, practical salinity units, for water surfaces.

FREQUENCY_SAMPLES.description:
Per-frequency samples. Where present and covering the frequency, these
take precedence over the power law.

GEOMETRY.description:
Geometry this material is attached to. A record may attach one material
to several obstacles.

PROVENANCE.description: Provenance. Required.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM`.

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

FRMStateVector.description:
A state in a named element set at a named epoch. ELEMENTS is the element
set's own 6 values in the order documented on frmStateRepresentation.
POSITION and VELOCITY are the Cartesian projection of the same state and
are populated when REPRESENTATION is CARTESIAN or when the provider can
supply them; a consumer MUST NOT infer velocity from POSITION alone.

ELEMENTS.description: The 6 element values of REPRESENTATION, SI units and radians.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Name of the coordinate system these elements are expressed in; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this state, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter, m^3/s^2, of the origin body when the element
set requires one. Absent means the provider's default for the origin.

SOURCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the request's state is expressed in.

TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the result is required in.

SOURCE_STATE.description:
The full input state, carrying velocity as well as position. POSITION
above is position-only and remains the input for operations 1-4.

TARGET_REPRESENTATION.description: Element set the result must be expressed in.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the transform is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for every
time-dependent axis chain.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires
the provider to use. A provider that cannot honour it returns
MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than substituting another table.

TARGET_STATE.description:
The transformed state, with velocity, in TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM and
TARGET_REPRESENTATION.

ROTATION_DCM.description: Rotation from the source axes to the target axes at EPOCH.

ROTATION_DCM_RATE.description:
Time derivative of ROTATION_DCM, per second. Required for a velocity
transform between relatively rotating axis sets.

ANGULAR_VELOCITY_RAD_S.description:
Angular velocity of the target axes with respect to the source axes,
radians per second, expressed in the source axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_EPOCH.description: Epoch of the Earth-orientation data set actually used, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterRef.description:
A reference to one parameter, with the dependencies that make it evaluable.
This is what a request, a stopping condition and a report column all name.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_INDEX.description:
Component of a vector or matrix parameter, zero-based and row-major.
Negative selects the whole value.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system this evaluation is expressed in; resolves against
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME in PCEEvaluationContext.COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.
Absent means the context default.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code of the central body, when the parameter is
CENTRAL_BODY_DEPENDENT and the context default is not wanted.

SITE_ID.description: Site the parameter is evaluated from, when it is SURFACE_SITE_DEPENDENT.

SECOND_OBJECT_ID.description: Second object, when the parameter is SECOND_OBJECT_DEPENDENT.

OWNER_OBJECT_ID.description: Owning object, when the request evaluates more than one.

OWNER_HARDWARE_NAME.description:
Owning hardware item, when the owner class is THRUSTER, FUEL_TANK or a
burn.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system for an EPOCH-typed parameter, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name. Absent means the context default.

PCEParameterDescriptor.description:
One roster entry as a named publisher implements it. The catalog is the
authority a consumer resolves a name through BEFORE it asks for a value.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_UNIT_SYMBOL.description: REQUIRED when UNIT is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_COUNT.description:
Number of values for REAL_VECTOR, and rows times columns for
REAL_MATRIX. Absent or 1 for a scalar.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

REQUIRED_AXIS_TYPE.description:
The one axis set this parameter is defined for, when it is defined for
only one: planetodetic quantities require BODY_FIXED. UNSPECIFIED means
any axis set the request names.

REQUIRED_ORIGIN_KIND.description:
The one origin kind this parameter is defined for, when it is defined
for only one. UNSPECIFIED means any origin the request names.

TIME_SYSTEM_DEPENDENT.description:
The value changes with the time system it is asked for, independently of
the frame.

STATE_REPRESENTATION.description:
The element set this parameter is a member of, when it is a member of
one; UNSPECIFIED for a derived scalar that belongs to no set.

UNAVAILABLE_REASON.description:
REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DECLARED_UNAVAILABLE: what is missing,
stated as a capability, so a consumer can report the refusal.

SUPERSEDED_BY.description: REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DEPRECATED: the parameter to migrate to.

SUPPORTS_STOPPING_CONDITION.description:
The publisher can bracket and refine a root of this parameter, so it may
be used as a stopping condition or a generic event function. A parameter
that is not continuous in time MUST declare false.

IS_SETTABLE.description:
The parameter can be written as well as read, so it may be a targeting
variable.

IS_CYCLIC.description: The value wraps: a goal crossing must be tested modulo the cycle.

CYCLE_LOWER_BOUND.description:
Inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound of the cycle, REQUIRED when
IS_CYCLIC is true.

DESCRIPTION.description: One sentence, capability language, no product or organization names.

PCEParameterCatalog.description:
The roster a named publisher offers, resolved as a whole. A consumer
caches this and resolves every later name against it.

PROVIDER_ID.description: Identifier of the publisher that evaluates these parameters.

PUBLISHED_AT.description: ISO 8601 instant this catalog was published.

PCEEvaluationContext.description: Everything an evaluation needs besides the state itself.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the object the parameters are evaluated on.

HARDWARE_NAME.description: Hardware item, when the owner class names one.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the default central body.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter of the central body, m^3/s^2. Absent means the
provider's own value for CENTRAL_BODY_ID.

EQUATORIAL_RADIUS_M.description: Shape of the central body, REQUIRED for planetodetic parameters.

COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.description:
Fully specified coordinate systems, each named through
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

DEFAULT_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description: Which of COORDINATE_SYSTEMS a parameter reference falls back to.

DEFAULT_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system a parameter reference falls back to, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name.

REFERENCE_EPOCH.description: Zero of ELAPSED_DAYS and ELAPSED_SECONDS, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires.
A provider that cannot honour it returns MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than
substituting another table.

ILLUMINATING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the illuminating body for lighting parameters.

PCEEvaluationRequest.description:
Evaluate these parameters on these states. One state is a point query; a
run of states is a report or a plot series, and carries the same shape.

STATES.description:
States to evaluate at, in chronological order. Each carries its own
epoch and coordinate system name.

PCEParameterValue.description:
One parameter's value at one state. STATUS is per value: a request never
fails as a whole because one name is unavailable.

VALUE.description: Scalar, integer or boolean value. Absent for vector and matrix types.

VALUES.description:
Vector or matrix values, row-major. Absent for scalar types; a scalar is
NEVER also written here.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when the descriptor's DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

UNIT.description:
Unit the value is expressed in, restating the descriptor so a value is
self-describing when it travels without its catalog.

MESSAGE.description: Why STATUS is not OK, in capability language.

PCEParameterSample.description: The evaluated parameters at ONE epoch.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this sample, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

SAMPLES.description: One sample per requested state, in the requested order.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterCondition.description:
A predicate on a named parameter: the parameter attains GOAL_VALUE, in
DIRECTION, for the OCCURRENCE-th time. This is the ONE spelling of a
stopping condition and of a generic event function; $EVL references it
rather than minting a second one.

GOAL_VALUE.description: Value the parameter must attain, in the parameter's own SI unit.

GOAL_TOLERANCE.description:
Convergence bar on the parameter value at the reported epoch, in the
parameter's own unit. A provider that cannot meet it returns
ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED rather than reporting an unconverged root.

OCCURRENCE.description:
Which attainment satisfies the condition, one-based. 0 and 1 both mean
the first.

PCEStopRequest.description:
Propagate until a condition is attained. The propagator itself is NOT named
here: it is a port the caller supplies, per the pluggable-propagation law.
This record carries only the condition, the interval and the tolerances.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions evaluated together; the run stops at whichever is attained
first in time.

MAXIMUM_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Upper bound on the propagated interval. Reaching it without attaining a
condition is GOAL_NOT_ATTAINED, never a silent stop.

EPOCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on the stop epoch. The same scenario run at different
step sizes MUST land inside this bar.

SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS.description:
Objects propagated in step with the owner and reported at the same stop
epoch.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at the stop epoch, beyond the condition itself.

PCEStopReport.description: Where a propagate-to-condition run actually landed.

ATTAINED_CONDITION_INDEX.description:
Index into PCEStopRequest.CONDITIONS of the condition that stopped the
run; negative when none did.

EPOCH.description: Epoch the run stopped at, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Seconds of propagated time from the initial state to EPOCH; negative for
a BACKWARD run.

ACHIEVED_VALUE.description: Value the condition parameter actually had at EPOCH.

GOAL_RESIDUAL.description:
ACHIEVED_VALUE minus GOAL_VALUE, in the parameter's own unit. This is
the residual a consumer gates on; it is NOT assumed to be zero.

SYNCHRONIZED_STATES.description: States of SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS at the same epoch, in that order.

SAMPLE.description: Parameters evaluated at the stop epoch.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description: Root-refinement work actually done, for the step-independence evidence.

PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

ODR.description:
Estimation Run Report. This is the canonical estimation-family result
model. STATE_COVARIANCE is row-major with COVARIANCE_DIMENSION squared
entries and is also published as the $OCM named by OCM_CONTENT_ID. The
estimator report never substitutes a propagator name for its input port.

PLK.description:
Plugin License Key - Issued license for plugin access
Uses ECIES: both parties derive symmetric key via X25519 ECDH
Key derivation: X25519(private, peer_public) → HKDF-SHA256 → AES-256-GCM

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin ID this license is for

ISSUER_PUBKEY.description:
Issuer's X25519 public key (32 bytes)
Used with licensee's private key to derive shared secret via ECDH

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when license was issued

VALID_FROM.description: Unix timestamp when license becomes valid

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when license expires (0 = never expires)

ISSUER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the license issuer (OrbPro)

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from issuer over all fields (except SIGNATURE)

KP1.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 0000-0300 UT, multiplied by 10

KP2.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 0300-0600 UT, multiplied by 10

KP3.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 0600-0900 UT, multiplied by 10

KP4.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 0900-1200 UT, multiplied by 10

KP5.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 1200-1500 UT, multiplied by 10

KP6.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 1500-1800 UT, multiplied by 10

KP7.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 1800-2100 UT, multiplied by 10

KP8.description: Planetary 3-hour Range Index (Kp) for 2100-0000 UT, multiplied by 10

KP_SUM.description: Sum of the 8 Kp indices for the day

AP_AVG.description: Arithmetic average of the 8 Ap indices for the day

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for this instant.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: Optional TAI-UTC override in seconds for the source instant.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional caller trace/correlation identifier.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

propagatorConfig.description: Propagator configuration structure to describe propagation settings

uvwSigmas.description: UVW Sigmas (Covariance matrix in UVW frame)

VCMAtmosphericModelData.description: VCM Atmospheric and Perturbation Model Data

COVARIANCE.description:
Covariance matrix as flat array (6x6 lower triangular = 21 elements).
Order: [CX_X, CY_X, CY_Y, CZ_X, CZ_Y, CZ_Z,
CX_DOT_X, CX_DOT_Y, CX_DOT_Z, CX_DOT_X_DOT,
CY_DOT_X, CY_DOT_Y, CY_DOT_Z, CY_DOT_X_DOT, CY_DOT_Y_DOT,
CZ_DOT_X, CZ_DOT_Y, CZ_DOT_Z, CZ_DOT_X_DOT, CZ_DOT_Y_DOT, CZ_DOT_Z_DOT]
Units: position in km**2, velocity in km**2/s**2, cross in km**2/s

DTTPayloadRef.description:
Where a block of bytes lives and how it is verified. The payload lane is
CID-first: a tile record addresses its bytes so an epoch can be verified
rather than trusted, and carries them inline only when the block is small
enough that a second fetch costs more than it saves. Exactly one of CID or
BYTES is the authority for a given ref; when both are present the bytes
MUST hash to the CID.

CID.description: Content identifier of the block in the dataset lane.

BYTES.description:
The block inline. Reserved for small blocks; a tile pyramid is
distributed by CID, never by embedding megabytes per record.

SIZE_BYTES.description:
Length of the block in bytes, whether inline or referenced, so a
consumer can budget a fetch before making it.

DIGEST.description:
Multihash of the block, lowercase hexadecimal, when the publisher states
one independently of the CID.

CONTENT_ENCODING.description:
Content encoding applied to the block before hashing, verbatim, when the
bytes are stored compressed.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: Media type of the block as the publisher serves it.

DTTProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one terrain tile.

Required on every record: a redistributed elevation tile whose dataset,
epoch, and licence are unstated is not publishable. Dataset identity is
DATA: DATASET_ID, DATASET_NAME, and ATTRIBUTION carry verbatim what the
source states about itself. The standard names no dataset, mission, agency,
or vendor.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the elevation dataset this
tile was derived from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this tile was
derived from. The edition boundary, not the fetch: two tiles carrying the
same DATASET_ID and DATASET_EPOCH were cut from the same bytes.

DATASET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when the publisher
distributes one.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact tile, granule, or file selection used, so the same source
bytes can be recovered by repeating the fetch.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description:
Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display,
carried verbatim so a surface can render it without composing its own
credit line.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the granule this tile was cut from,
verbatim. The join key back to the source dataset.

GENERATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at which this tile's bytes were produced by the
publisher, as distinct from the dataset edition they were cut from.

PROCESSOR.description:
Identifier of the processing pipeline and its version that produced the
tile bytes, so two tiles from one edition but different pipelines are
distinguishable.

DTT.description:
Digital Terrain Tile

One addressable tile of a terrain elevation pyramid: its address in a
stated tiling scheme, its geographic extent, its payload encoding and where
those bytes live, the vertical datum its heights are measured from, what it
states about water cover, and the dataset edition and licence it was
redistributed under.

$DTT is the SERVED ARTIFACT of a terrain lane and is deliberately not
$TRN, which configures how a consumer uses terrain (sources, interpolation,
cache size, exaggeration) and holds no elevation; nor $TRS, which is a
radio-propagation solve over terrain heights. A terrain service publishes
$DTT records, is configured by $TRN, and its heights may be consumed by
$TRS.

Angles are decimal degrees on WGS 84 and heights are metres. Tile bytes are
referenced by content identifier by default; see DTTPayloadRef.

TILESET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for the tile pyramid (the tileset) this tile
belongs to. Tiles of one pyramid share a scheme, format, and datum.

TILESET_NAME.description: The tileset's own name, verbatim, for display.

TILING_SCHEME.description: Scheme the address below is expressed in.

LEVEL.description: Zoom level of the tile, 0 at the pyramid root.

X.description: Column index within LEVEL, increasing eastward from the scheme origin.

Y.description:
Row index within LEVEL, increasing in the scheme's own row direction;
ROW_ORIGIN_NORTH states which.

ROW_ORIGIN_NORTH.description:
Row index 0 lies at the north edge of the scheme. When false, row 0 lies
at the south edge.

WEST_DEG.description: Western extent of the tile, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

SOUTH_DEG.description: Southern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

EAST_DEG.description: Eastern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

NORTH_DEG.description: Northern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

MIN_HEIGHT_M.description:
Lowest height present in the tile, metres above VERTICAL_DATUM. Stated
so a consumer can build a bounding volume without decoding the payload.

MAX_HEIGHT_M.description: Highest height present in the tile, metres above VERTICAL_DATUM.

PAYLOAD_FORMAT_VERSION.description:
Version of PAYLOAD_FORMAT the bytes conform to, verbatim, when the
format is versioned.

GRID_WIDTH.description:
Number of height posts across the tile for gridded formats. Unset for
mesh formats, whose vertex count varies.

GRID_HEIGHT.description: Number of height posts down the tile for gridded formats.

POST_SPACING_M.description:
Nominal ground distance between adjacent height posts at the tile
centre, metres. The tile's effective resolution as served, which is not
necessarily the source dataset's native post spacing.

SOURCE_POST_SPACING_M.description:
Native post spacing of the source elevations, metres, when the tile was
resampled from a coarser or finer grid.

VERTICAL_DATUM.description: Surface the heights are measured from.

VERTICAL_DATUM_NAME.description:
The datum, geoid model, or vertical reference frame named verbatim as
its authority states it.

HORIZONTAL_DATUM_NAME.description:
Horizontal reference frame the extent is expressed in, verbatim, when it
is not WGS 84.

VERTICAL_ACCURACY_M.description:
Vertical accuracy the publisher states for this tile, metres, at the
confidence level stated in ACCURACY_CONFIDENCE.

ACCURACY_CONFIDENCE.description:
Confidence level the accuracy figures are stated at, as a fraction
between 0 and 1.

HORIZONTAL_ACCURACY_M.description: Horizontal accuracy the publisher states for this tile, metres.

DATA_COVERAGE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the tile extent covered by real measurements rather than
interpolated or filled values, between 0 and 1.

NO_DATA_VALUE.description: Height value used to mark absent samples in gridded payloads.

WATER_MASK_KIND.description: What the tile states about water cover.

WATER_MASK.description:
The per-sample water mask bytes when WATER_MASK_KIND is RASTER: one
unsigned byte per sample, 255 fully water, 0 fully land.

WATER_MASK_WIDTH.description:
Number of mask samples across and down the tile when WATER_MASK_KIND is
RASTER. Independent of GRID_WIDTH/GRID_HEIGHT: a mask is commonly
carried at a different resolution than the heights.

WATER_MASK_PROVENANCE.description:
Dataset the water mask was derived from, when it is not the elevation
dataset. A separate lineage because a mask carries its own licence.

VERTEX_NORMALS.description:
Per-sample surface normals accompanying the tile, when the publisher
serves them, so a consumer need not derive lighting from heights.

LAND_COVER.description:
Per-sample land-cover classification accompanying the tile, when the
publisher serves one.

CHILD_AVAILABILITY.description:
Availability of the four child tiles at LEVEL+1, as the low four bits:
bit 0 south-west, bit 1 south-east, bit 2 north-west, bit 3 north-east.
A set bit states the child exists in this tileset.

MAX_LEVEL.description:
The deepest level this tileset serves anywhere. A consumer stops
requesting below it rather than discovering absence by failed fetches.

SOURCE_CLASS.description: Production technique class of the source elevations.

PROVENANCE.description: Dataset lineage and redistribution terms. Required.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch the elevations represent, when the
dataset states an observation epoch distinct from its edition. Terrain
changes; a tile compared across time is compared at this epoch.

ETAG.description: Entity tag for the served bytes, verbatim, so a cache can revalidate.

EXPIRES.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp after which this tile should be revalidated.

REMARKS.description:
Free-form publisher notes about this tile. Never a substitute for a
stated field.

AGRSeries.description: One named series with parallel X and Y vectors.

AGR.description: Aggregation Result - one summary over one standard's records.

SCHEMA_NAME.description: Standard code of the records aggregated, e.g. "OMM".

SQL.description: SQL selection the aggregate was computed over, when any.

X_FIELD.description: Field on the X axis; may be a derived field the serving node computes.

Y_FIELDS.description: Fields on the Y axis, one series each.

X_IS_TIME.description: True when X values are Unix milliseconds.

X_UNIT.description: Unit of X when the standard declares one.

ROW_KEYS.description: Row keys of a pivot in display order.

COL_KEYS.description: Column keys of a pivot in display order.

SCANNED.description: Records scanned to compute the aggregate.

STORED.description: Records the serving node holds for the standard.

PARTIAL.description: True when a bounded scan returned before covering every stored record.

TRUNCATED.description: True when a category or pivot was cut to its top entries.

ELAPSED_MS.description: Milliseconds the serving node spent computing the aggregate.

AS_OF_MS.description: Unix milliseconds the serving numbers were last true.

MODULE_ID.description: Canonical module identifier

EXPIRES_AT.description: Envelope expiration time in milliseconds since epoch

PNM.description:
Publish Notification Message.

PNM is the compact network announcement for a published record, manifest, or
dataset update. For dataset updates, FILE_ID is the complete canonical
identity for the published update and CID usually points to a small DPM
manifest or digest. The DPM carries the full verification contract:
provider identity, retrieval protocol, canonical query, result hash, Merkle
roots, completeness-capable indexes, file_id partition key, and signature.
Large or paid dataset updates do not need to be published as globally
discoverable IPFS files; a PNM may instead advertise a provider-mediated SDN
query protocol. In that mode the PNM is only the announcement. The DPM is
the signed commitment, and each provider response carries records plus
Merkle proof material that the subscriber verifies against the DPM roots and
the announced FILE_ID before import.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description:
Multiformat Address
As specified by the multiaddr specification.
A universal address format for representing multiple network protocols. Examples include:
- /ip4/192.168.1.1/tcp/80 for an IPv4 address with TCP protocol
- /ip6zone/x/ip6/::1 for an IPv6 address with a zone
- /dns4/example.com for a domain name resolvable only to IPv4 addresses
- /ipfs/bafybeiccfclkdtucu6y4yc5cpr6y3yuinr67svmii46v5cfcrkp47ihehy/README.txt -IPFS address w/CID and path to `README.txt`.

PUBLISH_TIMESTAMP.description: Publish Time OF THE Publish Notification Message

CID.description:
Concatenated Content Identifier (CID)
This field is a unique ID for distributed systems (CID).
The CID provides a unique identifier within distributed systems, as
detailed in the multiformats CID specification.
For dataset-update PNMs this SHOULD identify a compact DPM manifest,
manifest digest, or other small verification object, not necessarily the
full dataset bytes.

FILE_NAME.description:
File ID
This field is the Name

FILE_ID.description:
File ID
Canonical publication/update partition identity. For dataset-update PNMs,
this MUST match DPM.FILE_ID and is the stable key used everywhere an SDN
component refers to the update: PNMs, DPMs, assets, entitlements, provider
query requests, subscriber caches, replay, audit, and completeness
verification. Provider-mediated query requests and responses MUST bind
their Merkle leaves and proof paths to this FILE_ID, and subscribers MUST
reject responses whose DPM, records, or proofs bind to a different FILE_ID.
Example: provider-slug:gp:OMM.fbs:2026-05-06T03:00:00Z.

SIGNATURE.description:
Digital Signature of the CID
This is the digital signature of the CID, signed using the specified cryptographic method.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE.description:
Timestamp Signature
Digital signature of the publish timestamp, using the specified cryptographic method for timestamp verification.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used
Specifies the type of cryptographic signature used for the SIGNATURE field, indicating the specific blockchain technology, such as Ethereum or BTC.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used for Timestamp
Specifies the type of cryptographic signature used for the TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE field, indicating the specific blockchain technology, such as Ethereum or BTC.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

NAME.description: Display name of the owner or source the code stands for.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer description of the owner or source.

ACTIVE.description: True while the code is in current use by the publishing catalogue.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the reference table the row was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the reference table was retrieved.

OBJECT_ID.description: International Designator (YYYY-NNNAAA)

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD Catalog Number

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Object type (Payload, Rocket body, Debris, Unknown)

RCS.description: Radar Cross Section [meters2]; blank if no data available

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type (Orbit, Landing, Impact, Docked to RSO, roundtrip)

MANEUVERABLE.description: Indicates if the object is maneuverable

SIZE.description: Size [meters]; blank if no data available

MASS.description: Mass [kilograms]; blank if no data available

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"compact"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM
(raw-ed25519 for ed25519, compact for secp256k1)

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

KEY_PATH.description: BIP-44 derivation path (e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0")

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description: Signature encoding format (e.g., "compact", "raw-ed25519")

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —
the EPM-record mirror of the DNS TXT wire form (which is deliberately
NON-SDS: a base64 FlatBuffer would not fit a 255-byte TXT record). The
canonical statement is 6 fixed LF-terminated lines prefixed
"sdn-domain-proof/1", and it verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim
SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof precedent) — never by JCS.

DOMAIN.description: Fully-qualified domain name the proof binds (e.g., "node.example.org")

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of the proving key. The signer is the
Ed25519 EPM/publication key at m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed, verbatim (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format. ABSENT means the canonical encoding of
ALGORITHM (raw-ed25519 for ed25519)

LEGAL_NAME.description: Common name of the entity (person or organization)

FAMILY_NAME.description: Family name or surname of the person

GIVEN_NAME.description: Given name or first name of the person

ADDITIONAL_NAME.description: Additional name or middle name of the person

HONORIFIC_PREFIX.description: Honorific prefix preceding the person's name (e.g., Mr., Dr.)

HONORIFIC_SUFFIX.description: Honorific suffix following the person's name (e.g., Jr., Sr.)

KEYS.description: Cryptographic keys associated with the entity

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Multiformat addresses associated with the entity

SIGNATURE.description:
Signature over canonical EPM content (hex), produced by the entity's
signing key under the algorithm declared in SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM
(absent declaration = Ed25519)

SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the EPM was signed

CHAIN_PROOFS.description: Chain binding proofs linking blockchain keys to the same HD wallet

ENTITY_TYPE.description: Type of entity represented by this profile

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm that produced SIGNATURE (e.g., "ed25519",
"secp256k1"). ABSENT means ed25519 — this single default is what keeps
every EPM signed before this field existed verifying unchanged, so the
field MUST NOT be made required. The signing key is the first CryptoKey
in KEYS with KEY_TYPE Signing whose ALGORITHM matches this declaration
(an absent CryptoKey.ALGORITHM likewise means ed25519)

DOMAIN_PROOFS.description:
DNS domain binding proofs linking domains to the same HD wallet —
symmetric with CHAIN_PROOFS

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference Frame in which the object position is defined

AREA_SRP.description: Area of the object solar radiation pressure

X.description: X-coordinate of the object's position in RTN coordinates

Y.description: Y-coordinate of the object's position in RTN

Z.description: Z-coordinate of the object's position in RTN

X_DOT.description: X-coordinate of the object's position in RTN coordinates

Y_DOT.description: Y-coordinate of the object's position in RTN

Z_DOT.description: Z-coordinate of the object's position in RTN

COVARIANCE.description:
Covariance matrix as flat array (9x9 lower triangular = 45 elements).
Order: [CR_R, CT_R, CT_T, CN_R, CN_T, CN_N, CRDOT_R, CRDOT_T, CRDOT_N, CRDOT_RDOT,
CTDOT_R, CTDOT_T, CTDOT_N, CTDOT_RDOT, CTDOT_TDOT,
CNDOT_R, CNDOT_T, CNDOT_N, CNDOT_RDOT, CNDOT_TDOT, CNDOT_NDOT,
CDRG_R, CDRG_T, CDRG_N, CDRG_RDOT, CDRG_TDOT, CDRG_NDOT, CDRG_DRG,
CSRP_R, CSRP_T, CSRP_N, CSRP_RDOT, CSRP_TDOT, CSRP_NDOT, CSRP_DRG, CSRP_SRP,
CTHR_R, CTHR_T, CTHR_N, CTHR_RDOT, CTHR_TDOT, CTHR_NDOT, CTHR_DRG, CTHR_SRP, CTHR_THR]

CCSDS_CDM_VERS.description: The version of the CCSDS CDM standard used

CREATION_DATE.description: The date the CDM message was created

ORIGINATOR.description: The originator of the CDM message

MESSAGE_FOR.description: The intended recipient of the CDM message

MESSAGE_ID.description: A unique identifier for the CDM message

MISS_DISTANCE.description: The miss distance between the two objects

RELATIVE_SPEED.description: The relative speed between the two objects

START_SCREEN_PERIOD.description: The start time of the screening period

STOP_SCREEN_PERIOD.description: The end time of the screening period

SCREEN_VOLUME_FRAME.description: The reference frame for the screening volume

SCREEN_VOLUME_SHAPE.description: The shape of the screening volume

SCREEN_VOLUME_X.description: The X dimension of the screening volume

SCREEN_VOLUME_Y.description: The Y dimension of the screening volume

SCREEN_VOLUME_Z.description: The Z dimension of the screening volume

SCREEN_ENTRY_TIME.description: The time the objects entered the screening volume

SCREEN_EXIT_TIME.description: The time the objects exited the screening volume

COLLISION_PROBABILITY.description: The probability of collision between the two objects

COLLISION_PROBABILITY_METHOD.description: The method used to calculate the collision probability

OBJECT1.description: The first object in the CDM message

OBJECT2.description: The second object in the CDM message

OBJECT1_DATASOURCE.description: Data Source for the positional information for Object 1

OBJECT2_DATASOURCE.description: Data Source for the positional information for Object 2

WXFGrid.description:
Regular grid the samples are laid out on. Samples are row-major with
latitude as the outer index: cell (i, j) for 0 <= i < NLAT, 0 <= j < NLON
sits at VALUES[i * NLON + j] and is centred at
(LAT0 + i * DLAT, LON0 + j * DLON). DLAT is negative when rows run north
to south. Longitudes are in [-180, 180) or [0, 360) exactly as the
producer publishes them; a consumer normalises.

LAT0.description: Latitude of the first row's cell centre, degrees north.

LON0.description: Longitude of the first column's cell centre, degrees east.

PERIODIC_LON.description: Whether the last column wraps to the first (global grid).

WXF.description:
Weather Forecast Field - One variable, level, member and valid time on a
regular grid.

FIELD_ID.description:
Stable identifier of the whole field this record belongs to; equal
across all tiles of one (producer, init, member, variable, level, lead).

INIT_TIME_MS.description: Initialisation (analysis) time of the run, Unix milliseconds UTC.

VALID_TIME_MS.description:
Time the field is valid at, Unix milliseconds UTC
(INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3.6e6).

HORIZON_HOURS.description:
Maximum lead the run was integrated to, hours (e.g. 360 for a synoptic
cycle, 48 for an interim cycle).

MEMBER_KIND.description: Ensemble realisation or statistic the field represents.

MEMBER_INDEX.description: Zero-based member index when MEMBER_KIND is Member.

ENSEMBLE_SIZE.description: Number of members in the ensemble the run produced.

PERCENTILE.description: Percentile rank in [0, 100] when MEMBER_KIND is Percentile.

THRESHOLD_VALUE.description: Threshold in UNITS when MEMBER_KIND is a probability kind.

VARIABLE_NAME.description:
Producer's native variable name (always set; authoritative when
VARIABLE is Unspecified).

UNITS.description:
Units of every cell value, UCUM or CF style (e.g. "K", "m s-1", "Pa",
"1").

LEVEL_VALUE.description: Vertical coordinate value in the unit fixed by LEVEL_KIND.

TEMPORAL_KIND.description: Temporal character of each cell value.

ACCUMULATION_HOURS.description:
Accumulation or averaging window ending at VALID_TIME_MS, hours; 0 for
Instantaneous.

GRID.description: Grid geometry of this record's samples (of this tile when tiled).

TILE_INDEX.description: Zero-based tile index within FIELD_ID; 0 for an untiled field.

TILE_COUNT.description: Number of tiles FIELD_ID was split into; 1 for an untiled field.

CHUNK_CID.description:
Content identifier of the sample chunk when VALUES_ENCODING is
ContentAddressedChunk.

CHUNK_CODECS.description:
Codec chain applied to the chunk, outermost last (e.g. "bytes",
"zstd").

VALUE_MIN.description:
Minimum sample over the field (after decoding); statistics for display
scaling without touching the chunk.

VALUE_MAX.description: Maximum sample over the field (after decoding).

MISSING_COUNT.description: Number of cells with a missing value.

ORIGIN_ID.description:
Upstream publisher the field was retrieved from, as a host name or
stable identifier.

DATASET_ID.description:
Stable dataset identifier within the origin (e.g. a bucket, collection
or table name).

SOURCE_URL.description: Upstream URL or object path the field was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds UTC when the field was retrieved from the origin.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms the field is offered under.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that ingested and published this record.

TCTRadii.description:
Wind radii by quadrant at one wind-speed threshold. Radii are kilometres
(1 nmi = 1.852 km exactly) from the centre to the outermost point at which
the threshold is reached; 0 means the threshold is not reached in that
quadrant; a negative value means not reported.

THRESHOLD_WIND_MS.description:
Wind-speed threshold, m/s, converted exactly from knots
(1 kt = 1852/3600 m/s: 34 kt = 17.49, 50 kt = 25.72, 64 kt = 32.92).

VALID_TIME_MS.description: Time the point is valid at, Unix milliseconds UTC.

LEAD_HOURS.description: Lead from INIT_TIME_MS, hours; 0 for observed tracks.

MAX_SUSTAINED_WIND_MS.description:
Maximum sustained wind over WIND_AVERAGING_PERIOD_S, m/s
(1 kt = 1852/3600 m/s).

MIN_CENTRAL_PRESSURE_PA.description: Minimum central pressure, pascal (1 hPa = 100 Pa).

RADIUS_MAX_WIND_KM.description: Radius of maximum wind, km; negative when not reported.

RADII.description: Wind radii at each reported threshold.

EXISTENCE_PROBABILITY.description:
Probability in [0, 1] that the system exists at this point; 1 for
observed tracks and unconditional forecasts.

MOTION_DIRECTION_DEG.description:
Direction of motion, degrees clockwise from north; negative when not
reported.

MOTION_SPEED_MS.description: Speed of motion, m/s; negative when not reported.

TCT.description: Tropical Cyclone Track - One realisation of one storm's track.

STORM_ID.description:
Stable storm identifier as issued by the origin (e.g. a best-track
serial identifier); equal across every member of the same storm.

STORM_NAME.description: Storm name if assigned; empty for invests and unnamed genesis events.

BASIN.description: Basin the system is tracked in.

TRACK_ORIGIN.description: Whether the system existed at initialisation.

MODEL_CLASS.description: Class of the producing model; Unspecified for observed tracks.

INIT_TIME_MS.description:
Initialisation time of the run, Unix milliseconds UTC; for observed
tracks the issue time of the track.

MEMBER_KIND.description: Ensemble realisation or statistic the track represents.

MEMBER_INDEX.description: Zero-based member index when MEMBER_KIND is Member.

ENSEMBLE_SIZE.description: Number of members in the ensemble the run produced.

WIND_AVERAGING_PERIOD_S.description: Averaging period of MAX_SUSTAINED_WIND_MS, seconds (60 or 600).

POINTS.description: Track points in ascending VALID_TIME_MS order.

ORIGIN_ID.description:
Upstream publisher the track was retrieved from, as a host name or
stable identifier.

DATASET_ID.description: Stable dataset identifier within the origin.

SOURCE_URL.description: Upstream URL or object path the track was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds UTC when the track was retrieved from the origin.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms the track is offered under.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that ingested and published this record.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

MDPEncounterStage.description:
One encounter stage of the body sequence: the set of bodies admissible at
this position in the sequence, and the epoch grid searched for it.

Bodies are named by NAIF integer ID, which is normative. SDS carries no
body enum and $GRV.CentralBody is gravity-model-scoped and incomplete, so it
must not be repurposed here. Note that a barycenter and a body center are
different objects (4 is the Mars barycenter, 499 is Mars) and the
distinction is operationally load-bearing.

STAGE_INDEX.description: Zero-based position in the ordered sequence.

ALLOWED_BODY_NAIF_IDS.description: NAIF integer IDs admissible at this stage. A single entry pins the body.

ALLOWED_BODY_NAMES.description: Advisory names, parallel to ALLOWED_BODY_NAIF_IDS when present.

EPOCH_WINDOW_START.description: Earliest and latest epoch searched at this stage, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_GRID_STEP_DAYS.description: Epoch grid step searched within the window, days.

V_INFINITY_MIN_KM_S.description: Bounds on hyperbolic excess speed at this encounter, km/s.

MIN_FLYBY_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Minimum admissible flyby altitude above the body's reference surface, km.

MAX_POWERED_FLYBY_DELTA_V_KM_S.description: Cap on powered-flyby delta-V applied at this encounter, km/s.

MDPFlightTimeBound.description:
Time-of-flight bound between two encounters. Adjacent stages give per-leg
bounds; non-adjacent stages give cumulative bounds such as
"Earth to Mars to Earth within 3 years".

FROM_STAGE_INDEX.description: Stage indices the bound spans. TO_STAGE_INDEX > FROM_STAGE_INDEX.

MIN_DAYS.description: Inclusive bounds on elapsed time between those two encounters, days.

MDP.description:
Mission Design Problem — the definition of a patched-conic broad search over
an ordered sequence of body encounters.

This is the PROBLEM, not a solution: it states what is being searched and
under what constraints. Candidate trajectories produced by solving it are
carried in $MDS. Nothing existing covers this: $LMS is a single Lambert
boundary-value problem with no body/epoch grid and no sequence, $MPE is an
Earth mean-element targeter, $MNF is an Earth manifold sweep, and $MNV is an
SSA-detected maneuver on a catalogued Earth object.

PROBLEM_ID.description: Stable identifier for this problem definition.

ENCOUNTER_STAGES.description: Ordered encounter stages. Order in this vector IS the body sequence.

MAX_TOTAL_FLIGHT_TIME_DAYS.description: Cap on total mission duration, days.

MAX_LAUNCH_C3_KM2_S2.description: Cap on launch characteristic energy C3, km^2/s^2.

MAX_TOTAL_DELTA_V_KM_S.description: Cap on total post-launch delta-V, km/s.

MAX_DSM_DELTA_V_KM_S.description: Cap on the magnitude of any single deep-space maneuver, km/s.

DSM_GRID_STEP_KM_S.description: Grid step used when searching deep-space maneuver magnitude, km/s.

MAX_REVOLUTIONS.description:
Lambert controls: maximum number of complete revolutions considered on a
leg, and the admissible transfer direction.

OUTPUT_TIME_BIN_DAYS.description:
Output decimation: width of the time bin within which only the best
candidate is retained. Zero means no decimation.

MAX_THRUST_N.description: Optional spacecraft propulsion limits constraining admissible solutions.

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Ephemeris source the search was posed against, e.g. a SPICE kernel set
identifier. Recorded so a solution set can be reproduced.

odSensorContribution.description: Sensor contribution to an orbit determination solution

SENSOR_ID.description: Sensor identifier

NUM_ACCEPTED.description: Number of accepted observations from this sensor

NUM_REJECTED.description: Number of rejected observations from this sensor

WRMS.description: Weighted RMS for this sensor's observations

START_TIME.description: OD fit start time (ISO 8601)

INITIAL_OD.description: True if this is an initial orbit determination

APRIORI_ELSET.description: A priori element set data reference

APRIORI_STATE_VECTOR.description: A priori state vector data reference

BALLISTIC_COEFF_EST.description: True if ballistic coefficient was estimated

AGOM_EST.description: True if area-to-mass ratio was estimated

ENT.description:
Entitlement - Provider subscription or account entitlement state.

This is durable operational state for a provider account, not a plugin
license key. It records the current authoritative entitlement for an SDN
account identity and can be projected into subscription, billing, and
access-control surfaces.

PEER_ID.description: Current SDN peer ID bound to the entitlement.

STATUS_TEXT.description: Original provider status string when finer detail is needed.

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the entitlement expires (0 = no expiry).

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the entitlement was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the entitlement was last updated.
