Polarization verbatim from the source: "HH", "VV", "HV", "RCRC". Empty
when the source states none.

CROSS_SECTION.description:
The cross-section itself. UNITS is "m2" or "dBsm" as the source published
it; the two are never mixed within one entry and never silently converted.

SIZE_CLASS.description:
Size bucket verbatim when a source publishes a bucket instead of a number,
such as a public catalogue's "SMALL", "MEDIUM", "LARGE". A bucket is never
turned into a number.

SENSOR.description: Sensor or facility that produced the measurement, when stated.

OPPMass.description:
Mass breakdown. Each component is independently sourced; a wet mass and a
dry mass may legitimately come from different publishers and epochs.

WET.description: Mass with propellant, at the stated epoch [kg].

LAUNCH.description: Mass at separation from the launch vehicle [kg].

PROPELLANT.description: Propellant mass at the stated epoch [kg].

PAYLOAD.description: Payload mass carried by the bus [kg].

CURRENT.description: Best current estimate of mass at the record's epoch [kg].

OPPDimensions.description:
Physical envelope. Every extent is a sourced quantity. Extents measured off
3D-asset geometry carry PROVENANCE.METHOD MODEL_DERIVED and describe the
model, not the flight article.

BODY_X.description: Extents along the object's own body axes [m].

HEIGHT.description: Envelope terms as an object database publishes them [m].

SHAPE.description:
Gross geometric shape verbatim from the source, such as a shape string
of the form "Box + 1 Pan" or "Cyl". Never parsed into geometry.

SHAPE_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of SHAPE. Present whenever SHAPE is nonempty.

OPPAreas.description: Projected areas and the ratios derived from them.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_AVERAGE.description: Average projected cross-sectional area over all aspects [m2].

AREA_TO_MASS_RATIO.description:
Area-to-mass ratio [m2/kg], only when a source publishes one directly or
the publisher derives it with PROVENANCE.METHOD DERIVED.

OPPSurface.description:
One exterior surface of the object: what it is made of, how large it is and
how it interacts with light.

$PNL carries the articulated panel model used for solar-radiation-pressure
propagation; an $OPP surface is the sourced material inventory. When both
exist, PANEL_ID joins this surface to its $PNL panel. GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME and
GLTF_MATERIAL_INDEX join it to the exact glTF material in the asset variant
named by OPP.ASSET.

ID.description: Stable identifier for this surface within the record.

MATERIAL.description:
Material name verbatim from the source, in whatever designation the
source uses: a multi-layer-insulation film, a photovoltaic cell
chemistry, an alloy temper designation. Empty when unstated.

COUNT.description:
How many identical surfaces this entry represents, such as two solar-array
wings.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of MATERIAL, MATERIAL_CLASS, KIND and COUNT. Every dimensioned
field below carries its own.

AREA.description: Area of one surface, not of COUNT surfaces [m2].

SPECULAR_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected specularly, dimensionless.

DIFFUSE_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected diffusely, dimensionless.

PANEL_ID.description:
Join key to the $PNL panel representing this surface; holds that record's
PNLPanel.PANEL_ID verbatim. Empty when no $PNL panel exists.

GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME.description:
Name of the glTF material that renders this surface, verbatim, in the
variant named by OPP.ASSET.VARIANT_ID. Empty when the surface is not
represented in the asset.

GLTF_MATERIAL_INDEX.description:
Zero-based index into the glTF materials array of that same variant.
Negative one means no glTF material corresponds to this surface.

OPPAssetRef.description:
Binding to the exact 3D asset bytes this record accompanies.

Every field is copied verbatim from the $VAM that governs the asset, so an
$OPP is valid for exactly one reviewed variant. Different bytes are a
different asset: mint a new $OPP and set SUPERSEDES_OPP_CID rather than
repointing an existing one.

VAM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact $VAM bytes.

VARIANT_ID.description: $VAMVariant.ID verbatim: the specific glTF or GLB this record describes.

ASSET_SHA256.description:
$VAMVariant.BYTE_SHA256 verbatim: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
encoding SHA-256 of the exact asset file bytes.

GEOMETRY_MATCHES_PHYSICAL.description:
True only when the asset geometry was authored or rescaled to the physical
dimensions in this record. False, the default, means the asset is
representative and its geometry is not a source of physical dimensions.

METERS_PER_ASSET_UNIT.description:
Metres per asset unit for the named variant. Restates
$VAMTransform.METERS_PER_SOURCE_UNIT for consumers that read only $OPP.

OPP.description:
Object Physical Properties - the sourced physical description of one space
object and, when one exists, of the exact 3D asset that represents it.

Division of labour with the neighbouring standards. $CAT is catalogue
identity and orbit, and its RCS, SIZE and MASS scalars are unattributed
convenience fields carried from the catalogue publisher. $BUS is the bus
DESIGN, shared by every object built on it. $VAM is the asset manifest: the
bytes, the licence, the review and the geometry metrics. $PNL is the
articulated panel model consumed by solar-radiation-pressure propagation.
$OPP is the per-object physical truth in which EVERY value names its own
source, epoch and method. $OPP never restates orbital elements and never
duplicates bus-design values; a per-object value that came from the bus
design is stated here with METHOD INFERRED_FROM_FAMILY so a consumer can see
that it is an approximation.

Joins. NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID join to $CAT. BUS_ID joins to $BUS.
ASSET joins to the exact reviewed $VAM variant. ENTITY_ID is the stable
non-catalogue key shared with $VAM for objects that have no catalogue entry.

Never-invent law, enforced by the shape rather than by prose: a physical
quantity exists only as an OPPQuantity and OPPQuantity.PROVENANCE is
required, so there is no encoding for a mass, dimension, area or
cross-section that does not name where it came from. Unknown values are
absent. A consumer that finds a field missing has learned that no admissible
source published it.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 record-format version, not a content revision.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: $CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID verbatim. Zero when the object has no catalogue number.

OBJECT_ID.description: $CAT.OBJECT_ID verbatim: the COSPAR international designator.

OBJECT_NAME.description: $CAT.OBJECT_NAME verbatim, for display only. Never a join key.

ENTITY_ID.description:
Stable non-catalogue entity key, such as an asset catalogue entity path.
MUST equal ASSET.ENTITY_ID when ASSET is present.

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the $BUS record describing this object's bus design; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. Empty when the bus is unknown or has no
$BUS record.

BUS_FAMILY.description:
Bus or platform family name verbatim from BUS_FAMILY_PROVENANCE.SOURCE,
for objects whose family is known but has no $BUS record.

BUS_FAMILY_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of BUS_FAMILY. Present whenever BUS_FAMILY is nonempty.

MANUFACTURER.description: Manufacturer or prime contractor as stated by MANUFACTURER_PROVENANCE.

MANUFACTURER_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of MANUFACTURER. Present whenever MANUFACTURER is nonempty.

RADAR_CROSS_SECTIONS.description:
One entry per band, polarization and aspect the sources publish. Empty
means no source published a radar cross-section for this object.

VISUAL_MAGNITUDE.description:
Visual magnitude, UNITS "mag", with the observing conditions in
PROVENANCE.NOTES.

ASSET.description:
Binding to the exact reviewed 3D asset this record accompanies. Absent for
an object with no asset; the physical values remain valid without it.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted while building this record, including sources that
yielded no value. Lets a consumer distinguish "not looked for" from
"looked for and not published".

CREATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
the record was created.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
the record was last updated.

SUPERSEDES_OPP_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact superseded $OPP bytes.

YEAR.description: Four-digit year identifying the model version (e.g., 1970, 2008, 2020)

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for this instant.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: Optional TAI-UTC override in seconds for the source instant.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional caller trace/correlation identifier.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

NAME.description: Display name of the owner or source the code stands for.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer description of the owner or source.

ACTIVE.description: True while the code is in current use by the publishing catalogue.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the reference table the row was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the reference table was retrieved.

OBJECT_ID.description: International Designator (YYYY-NNNAAA)

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD Catalog Number

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Object type (Payload, Rocket body, Debris, Unknown)

RCS.description: Radar Cross Section [meters2]; blank if no data available

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type (Orbit, Landing, Impact, Docked to RSO, roundtrip)

MANEUVERABLE.description: Indicates if the object is maneuverable

SIZE.description: Size [meters]; blank if no data available

MASS.description: Mass [kilograms]; blank if no data available

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ARG_PERIAPSIS.description:
Coefficients for argument of periapsis (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ANOMALY.description:
Coefficients for anomaly (degrees). See ANOMALY_TYPE for interpretation.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

MAX_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description:
Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the reference frame (e.g., EARTH, MOON, MARS).

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for position/velocity coefficients.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for all epochs in this message.

START_TIME.description: Start of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

DEFAULT_BASIS_TYPE.description:
Default polynomial basis type for all records in this message.
Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Array of position polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

ORBITAL_ELEMENT_RECORDS.description:
Array of orbital element polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Generating ephemeris source, verbatim as the generator names itself
(e.g., a planetary ephemeris series designation, a numerical propagator
name and version, or an in-house tool identifier).

NOMINAL_SEGMENT_SPAN.description:
Fit span in seconds used to generate each polynomial segment.
Informational; actual spans are in individual records.

NOMINAL_NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Nominal number of coefficients per segment.
Informational; actual counts are in individual records.

ephemerisDataLine.description:
A single ephemeris data line (for non-uniform time steps only)
Use this format when time intervals between states are irregular.
For uniform time steps, use the compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array instead.

EPOCH.description: Epoch time, in ISO 8601 UTC format (required for non-uniform steps)

CLOCK_BIAS_MICROSECONDS.description:
Satellite clock bias (offset), microseconds. SP3 position-record clock
column. The SP3 bad/absent sentinel 999999.999999 is NOT stored; omit the
field instead.

CLOCK_RATE_MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND.description:
Satellite clock rate of change, 1e-4 microseconds per second. SP3
velocity-record clock-rate column. Sentinel 999999.999999 is not stored.

CLOCK_RATE_SIGMA_PICOSECONDS_PER_SECOND.description:
Standard deviation of CLOCK_RATE_MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND,
1e-4 picoseconds per second.

X_SIGMA_EXPONENT.description:
Per-coordinate position standard-deviation EXPONENTS, SP3 base**n form:
sigma = POS_VEL_BASE**n, with the position base from the SP3 header and
the result in mm. These are the raw SP3 exponent columns, kept as
exponents so an SP3 round-trip is exact; a consumer that wants a linear
sigma raises the header base to this power.

X_DOT_SIGMA_EXPONENT.description:
Per-coordinate velocity standard-deviation exponents, result in
1e-4 mm/s. Same base**n rule.

EPOCH.description: Epoch

OBJECT.description: Satellite name for the first object

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of reference frame (EARTH, MARS, MOON, etc.)

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Name of the reference frame (TEME, EME2000, etc.)

REFERENCE_FRAME_EPOCH.description: Epoch of reference frame, if not intrinsic to the definition of the reference frame

COV_REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the covariance matrix

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for the orbit state and covariance matrix. (UTC)

START_TIME.description: Start of TOTAL time span covered by ephemeris data and covariance data (ISO 8601)

USEABLE_START_TIME.description: Optional start USEABLE time span covered by ephemeris data (ISO 8601)

USEABLE_STOP_TIME.description: Optional end of USEABLE time span covered by ephemeris data (ISO 8601)

STOP_TIME.description: End of TOTAL time span covered by ephemeris data and covariance data (ISO 8601)

INTERPOLATION.description:
Recommended interpolation method for ephemeris data.
Supported methods: Hermite, Linear, Lagrange, Chebyshev.
When set to "Chebyshev", parsers should use POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS
for high-fidelity polynomial interpolation instead of interpolating across
discrete state vectors.

INTERPOLATION_DEGREE.description: Recommended interpolation degree for ephemeris data

STEP_SIZE.description:
Time interval between ephemeris states in seconds.
If > 0: Use compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array (times are implicit).
If 0 or omitted: Use EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES with explicit epochs.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector in EPHEMERIS_DATA array.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0. Default is 6.

EPHEMERIS_DATA.description:
Compact ephemeris data as row-major array of doubles.
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0.
Layout: [x0,y0,z0,xdot0,ydot0,zdot0, x1,y1,z1,xdot1,ydot1,zdot1, ...]
Units: position in km, velocity in km/s, acceleration in km/s²
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.
Number of states = length(EPHEMERIS_DATA) / STATE_VECTOR_SIZE

EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES.description:
Array of ephemeris data lines with explicit epochs.
Only used when STEP_SIZE == 0 or omitted (non-uniform time steps).
Each line contains its own EPOCH timestamp.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Optional polynomial position records for high-fidelity interpolation.
Used when INTERPOLATION is "Chebyshev". Each record covers a time segment with
polynomial coefficients for continuous position (and optionally velocity) evaluation.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

OBJECT_NAIF_ID.description: NAIF integer code of the ephemeris target (SPK segment target).

CENTER_NAIF_ID.description:
NAIF integer code of the ephemeris centre, matching CENTER_NAME
(SPK segment centre).

CLASSIFICATION.description:
OEM Header
Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

CCSDS_OCM_VERS.description: Format version in the form of 'x.y', where 'y' is incremented for minor changes, and 'x' for major changes.

COMMENT.description: Comments (a contiguous set of one or more comment lines may be provided immediately after the version number).

CLASSIFICATION.description: User-defined free-text message classification/caveats of this OCM.

MESSAGE_ID.description: Free-text field containing an ID that uniquely identifies a message from this originator.

OBJECT_NAME.description: Free-text field containing the name of the object.

INTERNATIONAL_DESIGNATOR.description: International designator for the object as assigned by COSPAR.

CATALOG_NAME.description: Satellite catalog source from which 'OBJECT_DESIGNATOR' was obtained.

OBJECT_DESIGNATOR.description: Unique satellite identification designator from the catalog.

ALTERNATE_NAMES.description: Alternate names of this space object.

ORIGINATOR_POC.description: Originator or programmatic Point-of-Contact (PoC) for OCM.

ORIGINATOR_POSITION.description: Contact position of the originator PoC.

TECH_ORG.description: Creating agency or operator for technical contact.

TECH_POSITION.description: Contact position of the technical PoC.

PREVIOUS_MESSAGE_ID.description: ID that uniquely identifies the previous message from this originator.

NEXT_MESSAGE_ID.description: ID that uniquely identifies the next message from this originator.

ADM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Attitude Data Messages linked to this OCM.

CDM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Conjunction Data Messages linked to this OCM.

PRM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Pointing Request Messages linked to this OCM.

RDM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Reentry Data Messages linked to this OCM.

TDM_MSG_LINK.description: List of Tracking Data Messages upon which this orbit determination is based.

COUNTRY.description: Country where the space object owner is based.

CONSTELLATION.description: Name of the constellation to which this space object belongs.

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Specification of the type of object (e.g., PAYLOAD, ROCKET BODY, DEBRIS).

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for all absolute time stamps in this OCM, including EPOCH_TZERO.

EPOCH_TZERO.description: Default epoch to which all relative times are referenced in data blocks.

OPS_STATUS.description: Specification of the operational status of the space object.

ORBIT_CATEGORY.description: Specification of the type of orbit (e.g., GEO, LEO).

OCM_DATA_ELEMENTS.description: List of elements of information data blocks included in this message.

SCLK_OFFSET_AT_EPOCH.description: Number of spacecraft clock counts at EPOCH_TZERO (used if TIME_SYSTEM is SCLK).

SCLK_SEC_PER_SI_SEC.description: Number of clock seconds occurring during one SI second (used if TIME_SYSTEM is SCLK).

PREVIOUS_MESSAGE_EPOCH.description: Creation epoch of the previous message from this originator.

NEXT_MESSAGE_EPOCH.description: Anticipated (or actual) epoch of the next message from this originator.

START_TIME.description: Time of the earliest data contained in the OCM.

STOP_TIME.description: Time of the latest data contained in the OCM.

TIME_SPAN.description: Span of time that the OCM covers, measured in days.

TAIMUTC_AT_TZERO.description: Difference (TAI - UTC) in seconds at EPOCH_TZERO.

NEXT_LEAP_TAIMUTC.description: Difference (TAI - UTC) in seconds at NEXT_LEAP_EPOCH.

UT1MUTC_AT_TZERO.description: Difference (UT1 - UTC) in seconds at EPOCH_TZERO.

EOP_SOURCE.description: Source and version of Earth Orientation Parameters used.

INTERP_METHOD_EOP.description: Method used to select or interpolate sequential EOP data.

CELESTIAL_SOURCE.description: Source and version of celestial body ephemeris data used.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of the state vector.

X.description: X component of position in the specified reference frame.

COMMENT.description: Comments in the Physical Properties section.

WET_MASS.description: Wet mass of the space object.

DRY_MASS.description: Dry mass of the space object.

OEB_Q1.description: Quaternion component q1 of orientation from OEB to EME2000.

OEB_MAX.description: Maximum dimension of the object along OEB frame axes.

OEB_INT.description: Intermediate dimension along OEB frame axes.

OEB_MIN.description: Minimum dimension of the object along OEB frame axes.

SRP_CONST_AREA.description: Constant area for solar radiation pressure computations.

SRP_UNCERTAINTY.description: Uncertainty in the solar radiation pressure coefficient.

GM.description: Gravitational constant times the mass of the central body.

N_BODY_PERTURBATIONS.description: List of celestial bodies included in n-body perturbations.

FIXED_F10P7.description: Fixed F10.7 solar flux value used.

FIXED_F10P7_MEAN.description: Fixed mean F10.7 solar flux value used.

MAN_BASIS.description: Basis of the maneuver plan (e.g., planned, predicted, estimated).

MAN_REF_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the maneuver data.

MAN_FRAME_EPOCH.description: Epoch of the maneuver reference frame.

MAN_UNITS.description: Units for the maneuver data values.

OD_ID.description: Unique identifier for the orbit determination.

OD_PREV_ID.description: Identifier of the previous orbit determination.

OD_TIME_TAG.description: Time tag of the orbit determination.

OD_OBSERVATIONS_TYPE.description: Types of observations used (e.g., RANGE, DOPPLER).

OD_APRIORI_DATA.description: A priori data used for orbit determination.

OD_ESTIMATOR.description: Estimator class provenance: batch fit vs sequential filter (EKF/UKF).

OD_RESIDUAL_RMS.description: RMS of post-fit residuals for this solution.

OD_RESIDUALS_SERIES.description: Post-fit residual series, one entry per accepted observation.

OD_RESIDUAL_EPOCHS.description:
Epochs aligned with OD_RESIDUALS_SERIES (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds
since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC].

OD_BATCH_BASELINE_ID.description:
OD_ID of the batch baseline solution a filtered solution derives from and
is compared against (empty for batch solutions).

OD_BATCH_BASELINE_RMS.description:
Post-fit residual RMS of the batch baseline, for direct batch-vs-filter
comparison.

TRAJ_TYPE.description:
Trajectory state representation type.
Determines how orbit state data is parameterized in this message.
For CARTESIAN_PV/CARTESIAN_PVA, use STATE_DATA array.
For POLYNOMIAL_POS/POLYNOMIAL_OE, use the corresponding polynomial record arrays.

TRAJ_TYPE_DESCRIPTION.description:
Legacy trajectory type string for backward compatibility and extended types
(e.g., "PROPAGATED", "ESTIMATED", "FILTERED").

STATE_STEP_SIZE.description: Time interval between state vectors in seconds (required for time-series data).

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)

STATE_DATA.description:
State data as row-major array of doubles.
Layout: [X0, Y0, Z0, X_DOT0, Y_DOT0, Z_DOT0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]
Time reconstruction: epoch[i] = METADATA.START_TIME + (i * STATE_STEP_SIZE)
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

COVARIANCE_DATA.description:
Covariance data as flat array (21 elements per epoch for 6x6 lower triangular).
Time alignment matches STATE_DATA epochs.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial position records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_POS. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for X, Y, Z position (and optionally velocity).
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial orbital element records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_OE. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES.description: Physical properties of the space object.

CREATION_DATE.description: Message creation date in ISO 8601 UTC format.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used by all epochs.

START_TIME.description: Start epoch for compact trajectory and condition arrays.

STOP_TIME.description: Stop epoch for compact trajectory and condition arrays.

STEP_SIZE.description: Uniform step size in seconds. Use zero when samples are epoch-tagged elsewhere.

SOURCE_OEM.description: Source OEM ephemeris when conditions were evaluated from orbit ephemeris data.

SOURCE_OCM.description: Source OCM trajectory when conditions were evaluated from comprehensive orbit data.

ATMOSPHERE.description: Atmosphere model request used by the propagator.

ATMOSPHERE_MODEL_REVISION.description: Atmosphere model revision, data release, or configuration hash.

ATMOSPHERE_COUPLING.description: Coupling mode used between the propagator and atmosphere provider.

FLOW_REGIME.description: Flow regime classification for the sampled trajectory.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description: Number of position/velocity components per state sample.

STATE_DATA.description: Flat state array [x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, ...] in km and km/s.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description: Epochs for irregularly sampled condition arrays.

SPEED_M_PER_S.description: Inertial or relative speed samples in meters per second.

DENSITY_KG_PER_M3.description: Atmospheric density samples in kilograms per cubic meter.

SPEED_OF_SOUND_M_PER_S.description: Speed of sound samples in meters per second.

CONVECTIVE_HEAT_FLUX_W_PER_M2.description: Convective heat flux samples in watts per square meter.

RADIATIVE_HEAT_FLUX_W_PER_M2.description: Radiative heat flux samples in watts per square meter.

STAGNATION_HEAT_FLUX_W_PER_M2.description: Stagnation heat flux samples in watts per square meter.

LOAD_FACTOR_G.description: Normal load factor samples in g.

ANGLE_OF_ATTACK_DEG.description: Angle of attack samples in degrees.

REFERENCE_AREA_M2.description: Vehicle reference area in square meters.

SURFACE_TEMPERATURE_K.description: Wall or surface temperature in kelvin.

TXSProvenance.description:
Replayable provenance for ONE source's report of ONE facility, emission, or
scheduled transmission.

Every source consulted gets its own entry, including sources that returned
nothing, so a consumer can tell "not looked for" from "looked for and
returned nothing". Source identity is DATA: PROVIDER_ID and AUTHORITY carry
verbatim what that source states about itself.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the consulted source, unique
within the publisher's own source registry. Never a display name and
never a URL.

AUTHORITY.description:
The authority under which that source publishes, verbatim as the source
states it: a spectrum regulator, an international coordination register,
a licensee, a monitoring service, or an observer compilation. Never
inferred by the publisher.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query, filter, or request parameters used, so the same rows can
be recovered by repeating the fetch.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: there is no encoding for a
redistributed record whose terms are unstated. A source that publishes no
terms is recorded as publishing no terms; unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that source publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description:
The licence forbids commercial use. Rides PER SOURCE because one record
may merge an open-terms lane beside a non-commercial cross-check, and the
strictest consulted lane governs any derived product.

NATIVE_ID.description: This source's own row, record, licence or file identifier, verbatim.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
The class of authority this particular source speaks with about position.
Published per source because a record may merge a regulator lane with a
community lane; the record-level POSITION_AUTHORITY states which class the
PUBLISHED coordinate came from.

REPORTED_LATITUDE.description:
Position this source reported, in decimal degrees on WGS 84, before
reconciliation. Retained unrounded so the merge stays auditable. Absent
when the source was consulted and reported no position.

CONTRIBUTED.description:
This source's report materially contributed to the published record.
False marks a source that was consulted and either returned nothing or
was outvoted; its entry is published either way.

TXSConsensus.description:
How one facility's independent source reports were reduced to the single
published position, and how strongly those reports agreed.

Agreement is CORROBORATION and is never authority: five compilations that
copied one another agree perfectly and establish nothing. Read this table
beside POSITION_AUTHORITY, never instead of it.

PROVIDERS_CONSULTED.description:
Sources queried for this facility, including those that returned nothing.
Never fewer than the number of SOURCES entries.

PROVIDERS_AGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell within the publisher's agreement
threshold. A value of 1 means the published position rests on a single
report and was never independently corroborated.

PROVIDERS_DISAGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell OUTSIDE that threshold and were not
reconciled. Non-zero is the machine-readable form of a contested
position and is published alongside POSITION_DISPUTED.

WINNING_PROVIDER_ID.description:
PROVIDER_ID of the report the merge selected, copied verbatim from the
matching SOURCES entry. Absent when METHOD is CENTROID: a computed
position belongs to no single source.

POSITION_SPREAD_M.description:
Greatest surface distance in metres between any two agreeing reported
positions. Zero is meaningful only when PROVIDERS_AGREEING is 1.

CONFIDENCE.description:
The publisher's own confidence in the merged position, on [0,1]. Never a
source's figure and never a probability from a model this standard does
not name.

MERGED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which the merge was performed.

TXSPriorPosition.description:
A position the facility is asserted to have occupied and vacated, retained
so a relocation never silently rewrites history.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
Class of authority behind THIS coordinate, which is frequently weaker
than the authority behind the current one.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
One-sigma-equivalent horizontal envelope in metres, as the source states
it. Zero means unpublished.

VALID_FROM.description:
RFC 3339 UTC bounds over which the facility is asserted to have occupied
this position. Either bound is absent when unpublished.

PROVIDER_ID.description: PROVIDER_ID of the SOURCES entry asserting this position.

TXSEmission.description:
One documented emission of one facility: a carrier or channel the facility
is stated to radiate, with the power and antenna terms published for it.

A facility radiating many carriers carries many entries; a facility whose
frequency changes by season or hour carries the documented set here and the
time-bounded usage in `$STX`. Unknown terms are ABSENT.

EMISSION_ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this emission within its facility record.

FREQUENCY_KHZ.description:
Assigned or nominal centre frequency in kilohertz. Kilohertz is the base
unit for this family because it spans the low-frequency broadcasting
allocations to the microwave allocations without unit switching; a
consumer joining to `$RFB` or `$TBS`, which carry megahertz, or to
`$IQC`, which carries hertz, converts at the join, explicitly. Zero means
unpublished.

BANDWIDTH_KHZ.description:
Necessary or occupied bandwidth in kilohertz as the source states it.
Zero means unpublished.

EMISSION_DESIGNATOR.description:
ITU emission designator verbatim, e.g. the necessary-bandwidth and
class-of-emission string a licence record carries. Authoritative over
MODULATION whenever both are present.

SERVICE.description: Service class of THIS emission when it differs from the facility's.

TRANSMITTER_POWER_KW.description:
Transmitter output power at the antenna feed, kilowatts. Zero means
unpublished. Never derived from radiated power.

EFFECTIVE_RADIATED_POWER_KW.description:
Effective radiated power referenced to a half-wave dipole, kilowatts.
Zero means unpublished.

EIRP_KW.description:
Equivalent isotropically radiated power, kilowatts. Zero means
unpublished. Published alongside, never instead of, the dipole-referenced
figure: the two differ by the dipole gain and this standard never
converts between them.

ANTENNA_HEIGHT_AGL_M.description:
Antenna centre of radiation above ground level, metres. Zero means
unpublished.

ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Main-lobe bearing, degrees clockwise from true north. Absent for a
non-directional emission; a non-directional emission is stated by
OMNIDIRECTIONAL, never by a bearing of zero.

OMNIDIRECTIONAL.description: The emission is radiated without a preferred bearing.

BEAMWIDTH_DEG.description: Half-power beamwidth in degrees. Zero means unpublished.

ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description:
Antenna gain in decibels referenced to an isotropic radiator. Zero means
unpublished; a real 0 dBi figure is published as a source term in
provenance rather than being indistinguishable from absence.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification radiated on this emission, verbatim: a callsign, a
spoken or keyed identifier, or the identity string the source publishes.
Never synthesized.

VALID_FROM.description:
RFC 3339 UTC bounds of the authorization or documented use of this
emission. Either bound is absent when unpublished.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this facility, unique within its record
set. Never a source's own identifier and never a coordinate string.

NATIVE_ID.description:
Winning source's native facility identifier, copied verbatim from the
SOURCES entry named by CONSENSUS.WINNING_PROVIDER_ID. Never a substitute
for ID and never stable across sources.

SITE_NAME.description:
Facility or structure name verbatim when a source publishes one. Never
synthesized from coordinates, licensee, or nearest settlement.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification the facility as a whole answers to, verbatim: a
callsign, an assigned station identifier, or the identifier an observer
community records. Per-emission identity lives in
EMISSIONS[].STATION_IDENTITY.

LICENSEE.description:
Licensee, operator or responsible administration name verbatim as the
cited source states it. A display name, never an identifier: consumers
must not treat it as a stable key.

LICENSE_ID.description: Licence, assignment or authorization identifier verbatim.

SERVICE.description:
Primary service class of the facility. Individual emissions may state
their own.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.

ADMIN_AREA.description: Administrative subdivision or locality verbatim as the source states it.

LATITUDE.description:
Published facility position, decimal degrees on WGS 84, produced by the
merge described in CONSENSUS. ABSENT when no source publishes a position:
a region centroid is never substituted. Per-source positions before
reconciliation live in SOURCES[].REPORTED_LATITUDE/REPORTED_LONGITUDE and
are never overwritten by this value.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
The class of authority behind LATITUDE/LONGITUDE. A consumer that renders
a position without reading this field is rendering an unlabelled claim.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
Horizontal envelope in metres within which the facility is asserted to
lie, as the publisher states it. Zero means unpublished — never that the
position is exact.

POSITION_DISPUTED.description:
Credible consulted sources place the facility in materially different
locations, or a source states the position is contested. The published
coordinate remains the publisher's best merge; this flag forbids a
consumer from presenting it as settled.

PRIOR_POSITIONS.description: Positions the facility is asserted to have vacated, most recent first.

GROUND_ELEVATION_AMSL_M.description:
Ground elevation at the facility, metres above mean sea level as the
source states it. Zero means unpublished.

STRUCTURE_HEIGHT_AGL_M.description:
Overall height of the antenna-supporting structure above ground level,
metres. Distinct from any emission's antenna height. Zero means
unpublished.

STRUCTURE_COUNT.description:
Number of antenna-supporting structures at the facility. Zero means
unpublished.

EMISSIONS.description: Every emission the facility is documented to radiate.

FIRST_OBSERVED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond bounds of the documentation or observation
window backing the published record.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted for this facility, including sources that returned
nothing. Required: a facility with no named sources is not publishable.

CONSENSUS.description:
How the entries in SOURCES were reduced to the published position.
Required: a published position always states the rule that produced it,
including SINGLE_SOURCE.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation name

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for this instant.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: Optional TAI-UTC override in seconds for the source instant.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional caller trace/correlation identifier.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

RFLObstruction.description:
One obstacle interaction on one sample's path. SPARSE: entries exist only
where an interaction was computed, so a clear path is never encoded as a
row of zeroes.

This is the join that makes an arbitrary 3D object a first-class part of
the link budget: MATERIAL_ID names the `$RFS` record whose permittivity,
conductivity, penetration loss and roughness produced LOSS_DB, and
GEOMETRY_REF_ID names the exact mesh, face set, panel or analytic shape
inside it that was hit.

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this interaction applies to.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface that was hit. An obstruction loss with
no material is an unattributed number: a metal panel and a plasterboard
wall of the same size do entirely different things to a link.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh, when the obstacle is a
reviewed 3D asset.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the obstacle is a catalogued object (an
occulting spacecraft, a structure on another vehicle). 0 when unbound.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle between the incident ray and the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

PATH_LENGTH_IN_MATERIAL_M.description:
Path length travelled INSIDE the material, metres. With
`$RFS.ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M` this is what makes penetration loss
reproducible instead of a stated constant.

EXCESS_DELAY_S.description: Extra propagation delay of a reflected or scattered component, seconds.

FRESNEL_CLEARANCE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the first Fresnel zone still clear [0-1]. 1 means the zone is
untouched.

DISTANCE_FROM_TRANSMITTER_M.description: Distance from the transmitter to the interaction point, metres.

RFLEndpoint.description:
One endpoint of a link. Identity ONLY — position, antenna geometry and band
capability are NOT copied here; they are joined from the standard named by
ENDPOINT_KIND. A copied position silently goes stale against its source.

ENDPOINT_ID.description: Producer-stable identifier for this endpoint within the record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the endpoint is an on-orbit object. 0 when
unbound — never a placeholder catalogue number.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator, `$CAT.OBJECT_ID`.

RFB_ID.description:
`$RFB.ID` — the band specification (frequency, bandwidth, EIRP, gains,
polarization) this endpoint transmits or receives on.

RFE_ID.description: `$RFE.ID` — the parametric emitter description, when one exists.

IQC_ID.description: `$IQC` capture identifier, when the samples were derived from a recording.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel or carrier identifier within the beam.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization actually used on this link. Defaults to UNKNOWN explicitly:
`rfPolarization` ordinal 0 is LHCP, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as a real polarization.

RFLModCod.description:
One modulation-and-coding choice available to a link. The table carries
engineering capability only; catalogue or recommendation names belong in
ID / NAME and provenance data, never in the schema vocabulary.

MODCOD_ID.description: Stable identifier within the containing link's MODCOD_SET.

CODE_RATE.description: Information bits divided by coded bits, in (0,1].

REQUIRED_MARGIN_DB.description: Additional implementation margin required before this entry is selected.

MAXIMUM_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Optional ceiling imposed by framing or implementation, bits per second.

RFLLink.description: One link whose budget is sampled by this record.

LINK_ID.description:
Producer-stable link identifier. Joins `$ACI.ACIInterval.LINK_ID` and
`$LKS.ID` when the same link also has an operational-state record.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Carrier centre frequency actually used, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention, NOT the `$IQC` hertz convention. A consumer joining the two
converts explicitly at the join. Band designation is NOT duplicated here:
it is joined from `$RFB.BAND`.

MODULATION.description: Modulation as the producer states it (e.g. "QPSK", "8PSK", "16APSK").

CODING.description: Forward error correction scheme as the producer states it.

CODE_RATE.description: Code rate as a fraction (0-1].

SYMBOL_RATE_BAUD.description:
Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud — the `$RFB.BAUD`
convention.

DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Information bit rate the budget is stated for, bits per second.

THRESHOLD_TERM.description:
Required threshold this link is evaluated against. THRESHOLD_TERM,
THRESHOLD_VALUE, THRESHOLD_UNITS and THRESHOLD_COMPARISON are meaningful
only together; a LINK_MARGIN_DB column without them states a margin
against an unstated requirement and MUST be refused.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this link belongs to. Links sharing a RECEIVER_GROUP_ID
and CHANNEL_GROUP_ID are mutually interfering and MUST be evaluated
together; a producer that shards a link matrix MUST keep a group intact
within one shard.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation or network this link belongs to.

SERVICE.description: Operator-facing service or mission designation.

MODCOD_SET.description:
Ordered adaptive modulation-and-coding choices. Per-sample
SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX indexes this vector for the sample's selected link.

ACM_ENABLED.description: Whether the producer evaluated adaptive selection for this link.

RFLInterferenceContribution.description:
One interfering contribution to one sample. SPARSE: entries exist only
where a contribution was computed, so a dense matrix is never forced into
existence to say "no interference computed".

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this contribution applies to.

SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ID.description:
Endpoint identifier of the interfering emitter, when it is an endpoint of
this record.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` of the interfering emission.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Interfering object's catalogue number, 0 when unbound.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Received interfering power at the victim receiver, dBW.

TOPOCENTRIC_SEPARATION_DEG.description:
Angular separation between the wanted and interfering paths at the
victim receiver, degrees.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim's bandwidth overlapped by this emission [0-1].

POLARIZATION_ISOLATION_DB.description: Polarization isolation applied to this contribution, dB.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Discrimination applied from the victim antenna pattern, dB.

RFLModelParameter.description:
A named parameter of a model binding, with its unit stated. There is no
encoding for a parameter value without a unit.

TEXT_VALUE.description: Non-numeric parameter value, when the parameter is categorical.

RFLModelBinding.description:
Which model produced one term of the budget. A loss term without a model
binding is an unattributed number: rain attenuation from two different
recommendations differs by decibels, and a consumer must be able to tell
which one it is holding.

TERM.description: The budget term this binding produced.

MODEL_NAME.description:
Model or recommendation identifier as its publisher states it (e.g. an
ITU-R recommendation number with its revision).

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` of the module that evaluated it.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact artifact that produced the values.

RFLProvenance.description: Where this sample set came from, stated once for the record.

SOURCE.description:
The producing system, dataset or measurement campaign. Required: a
budget time series with no stated source is not publishable.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference that regenerates this set.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the propagator that produced the geometry columns. A record
whose METHOD is MODELED or HYBRID and which carries geometry columns MUST
name it: geometry is only as good as the propagator, and the propagator is
a pluggable choice, never an assumed default.

PROPAGATOR_CONFIGURATION.description: Force model or configuration identifier handed to the propagator.

SAMPLING_STEP_S.description: Uniform sampling step, seconds. Absent when SAMPLE_EPOCHS are irregular.

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description:
Weather or environment dataset the atmospheric terms were evaluated
against, when they were not evaluated against a statistical model.

TERRAIN_DATASET.description: Terrain or surface dataset the blockage terms were evaluated against.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this set was computed or recorded.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix ms the upstream inputs were retrieved.

LICENSE.description:
Licence the source imposes on redistribution. An empty LICENSE means
UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a grant to redistribute.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: True when the licence forbids commercial use of this set.

CITATION.description: Attribution the licence requires this record to carry downstream.

MODULE_ID.description:
Primary `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced this record.
MODELS remains the per-budget-term attribution surface.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact producing WASM artifact.

RFL_ID.description: Stable identifier of this sample set.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$ACI` and
`$CVP` products derived from this set.

LINKS.description: Link definitions. SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES index into this vector.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of samples. Every present metric array MUST have exactly this
many entries.

SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES.description: Index into LINKS for each sample.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description:
Sample epochs, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM. Samples
need not be uniformly spaced and need not be grouped by link, but MUST be
non-decreasing within each link.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale SAMPLE_EPOCHS are expressed in. Defaults to UTC explicitly:
`timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as sidereal time.

RANGE_RATE_M_S.description: Range rate, metres per second; positive is opening.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the receiving endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the receiving endpoint, degrees above the local horizon.

TRANSMIT_AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the transmitting endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

TRANSMIT_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the transmitting endpoint, degrees.

DOPPLER_SHIFT_HZ.description:
Doppler shift of the carrier, hertz; positive is closing. Hertz, not the
MHz used for frequencies elsewhere in this record — a shift of a few kHz
on a GHz carrier is destroyed by an MHz encoding.

EIRP_DBW.description: Effective isotropic radiated power toward the receiver, dBW.

TRANSMIT_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain in the direction of the receiver, dBi.

RECEIVE_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain in the direction of the transmitter, dBi.

GASEOUS_ABSORPTION_LOSS_DB.description: Gaseous (oxygen and water vapour) absorption, dB.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS_DB.description:
Total loss from 3D obstacles on the path, dB. The per-obstacle detail —
which object, which material, at what angle, through how much of it — is
in OBSTRUCTIONS.

TOTAL_PATH_LOSS_DB.description:
Total of all path terms actually applied, dB. Published as its own column
rather than left to the consumer to sum: a producer that applied a term
this schema has no column for MUST still report an honest total, and the
discrepancy against the itemised columns is then visible.

RECEIVED_POWER_DBW.description: Received carrier power at the receiver input, dBW.

GAIN_TO_NOISE_TEMPERATURE_DB_PER_K.description: Receiving system figure of merit G/T, dB/K.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_DB.description: Carrier-to-noise ratio C/N in the occupied bandwidth, dB.

ENERGY_PER_BIT_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Energy per bit to noise density Eb/N0, dB.

BIT_ERROR_RATE.description:
Bit error rate as a probability [0-1], NOT an exponent and NOT a
percentage. 1e-6 is encoded 1e-6.

LINK_MARGIN_DB.description:
Link margin against the link's stated threshold, dB. Meaningless without
RFLLink.THRESHOLD_TERM / THRESHOLD_VALUE / THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY_BPS.description: Achievable channel capacity, bits per second.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Aggregate received interfering power, dBW.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_PLUS_INTERFERENCE_DB.description: Carrier to noise-plus-interference ratio C/(N+I), dB.

OBSTRUCTIONS.description:
Per-interaction obstacle detail, sparse. Each entry names the `$RFS`
material it went through, reflected off or was blocked by.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS.description: The single condition that bound the link at each sample.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description required when a LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS entry is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of the whole set. Required: an unattributed budget is not
publishable.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over the size-prefixed
FlatBuffer projection with both 64-byte signature payloads zeroed while
preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over canonical JSON with IDL
field order, IDL capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both
signature fields omitted.

SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX.description:
Index into the selected link's RFLLink.MODCOD_SET for each sample.
SELECTED_MODCOD_VALID distinguishes index 0 from no selection.

SPECTRAL_EFFICIENCY_BPS_HZ.description: Spectral efficiency delivered by the selected entry, bit/s/Hz.

ACHIEVED_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Delivered information rate after adaptive selection, bits per second.

ACM_MARGIN_DB.description: Margin above the selected entry's threshold, dB.

ENERGY_PER_SYMBOL_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Symbol energy to noise spectral density, dB.

CVPEmitterRef.description:
An emitter that contributed to this geometry. Identity and the few
parameters that determine the boundary; everything else is joined from
`$RFB` and `$RFE`.

EMITTER_ID.description: Producer-stable emitter identifier within this record.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` — the band specification.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: `$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the emitter is on orbit. 0 when unbound.

OBJECT_ID.description: `$CAT.OBJECT_ID` international designator.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID` when the emitter is a terrestrial site.

ID_BEAM.description: Beam and channel within the emitter.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description: Carrier centre frequency, megahertz — the `$RFB` convention.

EIRP_DBW.description: EIRP toward boresight used in the evaluation, dBW.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization, defaulted to UNKNOWN explicitly because `rfPolarization`
ordinal 0 is LHCP.

LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Emitter position at EPOCH, when the geometry is instantaneous. Geodetic
degrees and metres. Absent means "join it from the source record" — a
stale copied position is worse than none.

CONTRIBUTION_WEIGHT.description: Weight of this emitter's contribution to a union or aggregate [0-1].

CVPReceiverRef.description:
A receiver the coverage was evaluated FOR. Coverage is never absolute: a
-110 dBW contour means one thing for a 60 cm terminal and another for a
12 m dish, so the assumed receiver is part of the record.

MIN_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Minimum elevation the receiver can work at, degrees.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this receiver belongs to, matching
`$RFL.RFLLink.RECEIVER_GROUP_ID`.

CVPObstacleRef.description:
A 3D obstacle that shaped this coverage boundary. A footprint clipped by
buildings, a spacecraft structure or terrain is a claim about those
objects; publishing the obstacle set with its `$RFS` materials is what
makes the clipped boundary reproducible.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface. Absent means the obstacle was treated
as an opaque blocker with no material physics — which a consumer is
entitled to know.

VAM_ID.description: `$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: `$CAT` identity when the obstacle is a catalogued object. 0 when unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID` when the obstacle is a structure at a terrestrial site.

INTERACTION.description: How the obstacle acted on the field.

LATITUDE_DEG.description: Geodetic placement of a fixed obstacle, degrees and metres.

CVPUncertainty.description:
How wrong this geometry can be. A contour with no uncertainty is a drawing,
not a measurement.

HORIZONTAL_POSITION_M.description:
1-sigma horizontal position uncertainty of the boundary, metres. Applies
to every vertex unless VERTEX_POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M is present.

LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY.description:
1-sigma uncertainty of the level the contour was drawn at, in
LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY_UNITS.

CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence the stated uncertainties correspond to [0-1], e.g. 0.68.

EXTRACTION_TOLERANCE.description: Tolerance the contour extractor converged to, in the metric's units.

SIMPLIFICATION_TOLERANCE_M.description:
Simplification tolerance applied to the rings, metres. A simplified ring
is not the computed boundary and MUST say so.

METHOD.description:
How the uncertainty was established (e.g. "grid resolution bound",
"Monte Carlo over emitter state covariance").

SOURCE.description: Producing system, dataset or campaign. Required.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Propagator that produced the emitter geometry. A MODELED or HYBRID
product MUST name it.

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced the rings.

MODELS.description:
Per-term model bindings for the metric that was contoured, reusing the
`$RFL` binding so a footprint and the samples behind it cite the same
models.

CONTOUR_ALGORITHM.description:
Algorithm that turned the sampled field into rings (e.g. "marching
squares", "alpha shape", "H3 cell union").

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description: Environment and terrain datasets the evaluation used.

OBSTACLE_DATASET.description: Dataset the 3D obstacles and their materials were drawn from.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms computed and retrieved.

LICENSE.description: Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS.

COVERAGE_ID.description: Stable identifier of this geometry product.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$RFL` samples
and `$ACI` intervals of the same study.

METRIC_UNITS.description: Units of the metric and of POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES.

THRESHOLD_VALUE.description: The threshold the boundary was drawn at, for a THRESHOLD_CONTOUR.

EPOCH.description:
Instantaneous epoch, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM.
Set for FOOTPRINT and other instantaneous products; NaN for aggregates.

INTERVAL_START.description:
Interval this geometry holds over, same encoding. Set for aggregated
products (union over a window, availability contour); NaN for
instantaneous ones. A product that states neither EPOCH nor an interval
is untethered in time and MUST be refused.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale all epochs in this record are expressed in. Defaults to UTC
explicitly: `timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST.

GENERATION.description:
Monotonic generation of this coverage product within its COVERAGE_ID
lineage. A streaming producer increments it per emission; a consumer
holding a higher generation MUST NOT be overwritten by a lower one.

SUPERSEDES_COVERAGE_ID.description: COVERAGE_ID this record replaces, when the lineage was re-identified.

VERTEX_LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Vertex latitudes, geodetic degrees in [-90, 90]. Same length as
VERTEX_LONGITUDE_DEG.

VERTEX_ALTITUDE_M.description:
Vertex altitudes, metres above ALTITUDE_REFERENCE. Absent when the
geometry lies on the reference surface.

FIXED_ALTITUDE_M.description: The constant altitude, metres, when ALTITUDE_REFERENCE is FIXED_ALTITUDE.

RING_OFFSETS.description: Ring start indexes; RING_COUNT + 1 entries, last equals the vertex count.

RING_POLYGON_INDEXES.description: Polygon each ring belongs to. Same length as RING_COUNT.

RING_ROLES.description: Role of each ring. Same length as RING_COUNT.

POLYGON_COUNT.description:
Number of polygons; equals max(RING_POLYGON_INDEXES) + 1 and is published
so an empty coverage field (zero polygons, zero rings) is representable
and distinguishable from an unpopulated record.

POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES.description:

TRSRequest.description:
One terrain raster solve request.

FRAMES. The analysis frame is a local East-North-Up (ENU) frame: local X
is east, Y is north, Z is up. Both grids share the same analysis-frame
bounds, anchored at (MIN_EAST_M, MIN_NORTH_M). Per-cell geodetic
coordinates are carried explicitly in GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD /
GRID_LATITUDE_RAD so a solver recomputes exact per-cell Earth-fixed
geometry instead of interpolating it.

Obstruction profile field width, cells. The profile is a FINER field
than the output raster; the line-of-sight march samples it.

SOLVER_TIER.description:
Fidelity tier requested. A solver that does not implement the tier
REFUSES; it never silently downgrades.

PROPAGATION_MODEL.description:
Propagation model requested for the per-cell loss term. A solver that
does not implement the model REFUSES; it never silently substitutes.

ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL_MASK.description:
Atmospheric attenuation terms requested, as a bitmask: 0 none,
bit 0 (1) gaseous absorption, bit 1 (2) rain attenuation, bit 2 (4)
cloud/fog attenuation. A solver that does not implement a requested
term REFUSES.

THREAD_COUNT_HINT.description:
Parallelism hint. 0 or 1 means sequential. A solver MUST produce
byte-identical layers at any value — cells are independent and a thread
writes only its own indices; determinism is part of this contract.

MIN_EAST_M.description: Analysis-frame east coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

MIN_NORTH_M.description: Analysis-frame north coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

PROFILE_SPACING_M.description: Profile sample spacing, meters; sets the line-of-sight march stride.

MINIMUM_STEP_M.description:
Minimum march step, meters. NaN means caller left it unset and the

TX_LOCAL_X_M.description:
Emitter position in the analysis ENU frame, meters (X east, Y north,
Z up).

TX_ECEF_X_M.description:
Emitter Earth-centered Earth-fixed position, meters — carried so the
solver computes exact per-cell range rather than a small-angle

Column-major 4x4 inverse of the analysis ENU frame transform (the

TX_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

RX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ARG_PERIAPSIS.description:
Coefficients for argument of periapsis (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ANOMALY.description:
Coefficients for anomaly (degrees). See ANOMALY_TYPE for interpretation.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

MAX_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description:
Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
