consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

FRMStateVector.description:
A state in a named element set at a named epoch. ELEMENTS is the element
set's own 6 values in the order documented on frmStateRepresentation.
POSITION and VELOCITY are the Cartesian projection of the same state and
are populated when REPRESENTATION is CARTESIAN or when the provider can
supply them; a consumer MUST NOT infer velocity from POSITION alone.

ELEMENTS.description: The 6 element values of REPRESENTATION, SI units and radians.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Name of the coordinate system these elements are expressed in; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this state, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter, m^3/s^2, of the origin body when the element
set requires one. Absent means the provider's default for the origin.

SOURCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the request's state is expressed in.

TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the result is required in.

SOURCE_STATE.description:
The full input state, carrying velocity as well as position. POSITION
above is position-only and remains the input for operations 1-4.

TARGET_REPRESENTATION.description: Element set the result must be expressed in.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the transform is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for every
time-dependent axis chain.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires
the provider to use. A provider that cannot honour it returns
MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than substituting another table.

TARGET_STATE.description:
The transformed state, with velocity, in TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM and
TARGET_REPRESENTATION.

ROTATION_DCM.description: Rotation from the source axes to the target axes at EPOCH.

ROTATION_DCM_RATE.description:
Time derivative of ROTATION_DCM, per second. Required for a velocity
transform between relatively rotating axis sets.

ANGULAR_VELOCITY_RAD_S.description:
Angular velocity of the target axes with respect to the source axes,
radians per second, expressed in the source axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_EPOCH.description: Epoch of the Earth-orientation data set actually used, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterRef.description:
A reference to one parameter, with the dependencies that make it evaluable.
This is what a request, a stopping condition and a report column all name.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_INDEX.description:
Component of a vector or matrix parameter, zero-based and row-major.
Negative selects the whole value.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system this evaluation is expressed in; resolves against
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME in PCEEvaluationContext.COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.
Absent means the context default.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code of the central body, when the parameter is
CENTRAL_BODY_DEPENDENT and the context default is not wanted.

SITE_ID.description: Site the parameter is evaluated from, when it is SURFACE_SITE_DEPENDENT.

SECOND_OBJECT_ID.description: Second object, when the parameter is SECOND_OBJECT_DEPENDENT.

OWNER_OBJECT_ID.description: Owning object, when the request evaluates more than one.

OWNER_HARDWARE_NAME.description:
Owning hardware item, when the owner class is THRUSTER, FUEL_TANK or a
burn.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system for an EPOCH-typed parameter, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name. Absent means the context default.

PCEParameterDescriptor.description:
One roster entry as a named publisher implements it. The catalog is the
authority a consumer resolves a name through BEFORE it asks for a value.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_UNIT_SYMBOL.description: REQUIRED when UNIT is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_COUNT.description:
Number of values for REAL_VECTOR, and rows times columns for
REAL_MATRIX. Absent or 1 for a scalar.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

REQUIRED_AXIS_TYPE.description:
The one axis set this parameter is defined for, when it is defined for
only one: planetodetic quantities require BODY_FIXED. UNSPECIFIED means
any axis set the request names.

REQUIRED_ORIGIN_KIND.description:
The one origin kind this parameter is defined for, when it is defined
for only one. UNSPECIFIED means any origin the request names.

TIME_SYSTEM_DEPENDENT.description:
The value changes with the time system it is asked for, independently of
the frame.

STATE_REPRESENTATION.description:
The element set this parameter is a member of, when it is a member of
one; UNSPECIFIED for a derived scalar that belongs to no set.

UNAVAILABLE_REASON.description:
REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DECLARED_UNAVAILABLE: what is missing,
stated as a capability, so a consumer can report the refusal.

SUPERSEDED_BY.description: REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DEPRECATED: the parameter to migrate to.

SUPPORTS_STOPPING_CONDITION.description:
The publisher can bracket and refine a root of this parameter, so it may
be used as a stopping condition or a generic event function. A parameter
that is not continuous in time MUST declare false.

IS_SETTABLE.description:
The parameter can be written as well as read, so it may be a targeting
variable.

IS_CYCLIC.description: The value wraps: a goal crossing must be tested modulo the cycle.

CYCLE_LOWER_BOUND.description:
Inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound of the cycle, REQUIRED when
IS_CYCLIC is true.

DESCRIPTION.description: One sentence, capability language, no product or organization names.

PCEParameterCatalog.description:
The roster a named publisher offers, resolved as a whole. A consumer
caches this and resolves every later name against it.

PROVIDER_ID.description: Identifier of the publisher that evaluates these parameters.

PUBLISHED_AT.description: ISO 8601 instant this catalog was published.

PCEEvaluationContext.description: Everything an evaluation needs besides the state itself.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the object the parameters are evaluated on.

HARDWARE_NAME.description: Hardware item, when the owner class names one.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the default central body.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter of the central body, m^3/s^2. Absent means the
provider's own value for CENTRAL_BODY_ID.

EQUATORIAL_RADIUS_M.description: Shape of the central body, REQUIRED for planetodetic parameters.

COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.description:
Fully specified coordinate systems, each named through
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

DEFAULT_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description: Which of COORDINATE_SYSTEMS a parameter reference falls back to.

DEFAULT_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system a parameter reference falls back to, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name.

REFERENCE_EPOCH.description: Zero of ELAPSED_DAYS and ELAPSED_SECONDS, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires.
A provider that cannot honour it returns MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than
substituting another table.

ILLUMINATING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the illuminating body for lighting parameters.

PCEEvaluationRequest.description:
Evaluate these parameters on these states. One state is a point query; a
run of states is a report or a plot series, and carries the same shape.

STATES.description:
States to evaluate at, in chronological order. Each carries its own
epoch and coordinate system name.

PCEParameterValue.description:
One parameter's value at one state. STATUS is per value: a request never
fails as a whole because one name is unavailable.

VALUE.description: Scalar, integer or boolean value. Absent for vector and matrix types.

VALUES.description:
Vector or matrix values, row-major. Absent for scalar types; a scalar is
NEVER also written here.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when the descriptor's DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

UNIT.description:
Unit the value is expressed in, restating the descriptor so a value is
self-describing when it travels without its catalog.

MESSAGE.description: Why STATUS is not OK, in capability language.

PCEParameterSample.description: The evaluated parameters at ONE epoch.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this sample, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

SAMPLES.description: One sample per requested state, in the requested order.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterCondition.description:
A predicate on a named parameter: the parameter attains GOAL_VALUE, in
DIRECTION, for the OCCURRENCE-th time. This is the ONE spelling of a
stopping condition and of a generic event function; $EVL references it
rather than minting a second one.

GOAL_VALUE.description: Value the parameter must attain, in the parameter's own SI unit.

GOAL_TOLERANCE.description:
Convergence bar on the parameter value at the reported epoch, in the
parameter's own unit. A provider that cannot meet it returns
ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED rather than reporting an unconverged root.

OCCURRENCE.description:
Which attainment satisfies the condition, one-based. 0 and 1 both mean
the first.

PCEStopRequest.description:
Propagate until a condition is attained. The propagator itself is NOT named
here: it is a port the caller supplies, per the pluggable-propagation law.
This record carries only the condition, the interval and the tolerances.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions evaluated together; the run stops at whichever is attained
first in time.

MAXIMUM_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Upper bound on the propagated interval. Reaching it without attaining a
condition is GOAL_NOT_ATTAINED, never a silent stop.

EPOCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on the stop epoch. The same scenario run at different
step sizes MUST land inside this bar.

SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS.description:
Objects propagated in step with the owner and reported at the same stop
epoch.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at the stop epoch, beyond the condition itself.

PCEStopReport.description: Where a propagate-to-condition run actually landed.

ATTAINED_CONDITION_INDEX.description:
Index into PCEStopRequest.CONDITIONS of the condition that stopped the
run; negative when none did.

EPOCH.description: Epoch the run stopped at, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Seconds of propagated time from the initial state to EPOCH; negative for
a BACKWARD run.

ACHIEVED_VALUE.description: Value the condition parameter actually had at EPOCH.

GOAL_RESIDUAL.description:
ACHIEVED_VALUE minus GOAL_VALUE, in the parameter's own unit. This is
the residual a consumer gates on; it is NOT assumed to be zero.

SYNCHRONIZED_STATES.description: States of SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS at the same epoch, in that order.

SAMPLE.description: Parameters evaluated at the stop epoch.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description: Root-refinement work actually done, for the step-independence evidence.

PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Literal Ed25519 public key, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both signature
payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON in IDL field order and capitalization,
with both signature fields omitted.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

Geometry.description: Geometry table with information about geometric properties

ID.description: Unique identifier for the site, BE_NUMBER

SITE_TYPE.description: Site type as defined in SiteType enum

CLASSIFICATION.description: Classification marking of the site

CTR_ID.description: CTR ISO 3166 Numeric code as string

CREATED_BY.description: Identifier of the user who created the site data

MODEL_URL.description: URL for the 3D model of the site

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

OPERATIONAL_STATUS.description: Operational status of the site (e.g., active, inactive, under construction)

YEAR.description: Four-digit year identifying the model version (e.g., 1970, 2008, 2020)

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for this instant.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: Optional TAI-UTC override in seconds for the source instant.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional caller trace/correlation identifier.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

NAME.description: Display name of the owner or source the code stands for.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer description of the owner or source.

ACTIVE.description: True while the code is in current use by the publishing catalogue.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the reference table the row was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the reference table was retrieved.

OBJECT_ID.description: International Designator (YYYY-NNNAAA)

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD Catalog Number

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Object type (Payload, Rocket body, Debris, Unknown)

RCS.description: Radar Cross Section [meters2]; blank if no data available

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type (Orbit, Landing, Impact, Docked to RSO, roundtrip)

MANEUVERABLE.description: Indicates if the object is maneuverable

SIZE.description: Size [meters]; blank if no data available

MASS.description: Mass [kilograms]; blank if no data available

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ARG_PERIAPSIS.description:
Coefficients for argument of periapsis (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ANOMALY.description:
Coefficients for anomaly (degrees). See ANOMALY_TYPE for interpretation.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

MAX_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description:
Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the reference frame (e.g., EARTH, MOON, MARS).

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for position/velocity coefficients.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for all epochs in this message.

START_TIME.description: Start of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

DEFAULT_BASIS_TYPE.description:
Default polynomial basis type for all records in this message.
Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Array of position polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

ORBITAL_ELEMENT_RECORDS.description:
Array of orbital element polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Generating ephemeris source, verbatim as the generator names itself
(e.g., a planetary ephemeris series designation, a numerical propagator
name and version, or an in-house tool identifier).

NOMINAL_SEGMENT_SPAN.description:
Fit span in seconds used to generate each polynomial segment.
Informational; actual spans are in individual records.

NOMINAL_NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Nominal number of coefficients per segment.
Informational; actual counts are in individual records.

ephemerisDataLine.description:
A single ephemeris data line (for non-uniform time steps only)
Use this format when time intervals between states are irregular.
For uniform time steps, use the compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array instead.

EPOCH.description: Epoch time, in ISO 8601 UTC format (required for non-uniform steps)

CLOCK_BIAS_MICROSECONDS.description:
Satellite clock bias (offset), microseconds. SP3 position-record clock
column. The SP3 bad/absent sentinel 999999.999999 is NOT stored; omit the
field instead.

CLOCK_RATE_MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND.description:
Satellite clock rate of change, 1e-4 microseconds per second. SP3
velocity-record clock-rate column. Sentinel 999999.999999 is not stored.

CLOCK_RATE_SIGMA_PICOSECONDS_PER_SECOND.description:
Standard deviation of CLOCK_RATE_MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND,
1e-4 picoseconds per second.

X_SIGMA_EXPONENT.description:
Per-coordinate position standard-deviation EXPONENTS, SP3 base**n form:
sigma = POS_VEL_BASE**n, with the position base from the SP3 header and
the result in mm. These are the raw SP3 exponent columns, kept as
exponents so an SP3 round-trip is exact; a consumer that wants a linear
sigma raises the header base to this power.

X_DOT_SIGMA_EXPONENT.description:
Per-coordinate velocity standard-deviation exponents, result in
1e-4 mm/s. Same base**n rule.

EPOCH.description: Epoch

OBJECT.description: Satellite name for the first object

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of reference frame (EARTH, MARS, MOON, etc.)

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Name of the reference frame (TEME, EME2000, etc.)

REFERENCE_FRAME_EPOCH.description: Epoch of reference frame, if not intrinsic to the definition of the reference frame

INTERPOLATION.description:
Recommended interpolation method for ephemeris data.
Supported methods: Hermite, Linear, Lagrange, Chebyshev.
When set to "Chebyshev", parsers should use POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS
for high-fidelity polynomial interpolation instead of interpolating across
discrete state vectors.

INTERPOLATION_DEGREE.description: Recommended interpolation degree for ephemeris data

STEP_SIZE.description:
Time interval between ephemeris states in seconds.
If > 0: Use compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array (times are implicit).
If 0 or omitted: Use EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES with explicit epochs.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector in EPHEMERIS_DATA array.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0. Default is 6.

EPHEMERIS_DATA.description:
Compact ephemeris data as row-major array of doubles.
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0.
Layout: [x0,y0,z0,xdot0,ydot0,zdot0, x1,y1,z1,xdot1,ydot1,zdot1, ...]
Units: position in km, velocity in km/s, acceleration in km/s²
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.
Number of states = length(EPHEMERIS_DATA) / STATE_VECTOR_SIZE

EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES.description:
Array of ephemeris data lines with explicit epochs.
Only used when STEP_SIZE == 0 or omitted (non-uniform time steps).
Each line contains its own EPOCH timestamp.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Optional polynomial position records for high-fidelity interpolation.
Used when INTERPOLATION is "Chebyshev". Each record covers a time segment with
polynomial coefficients for continuous position (and optionally velocity) evaluation.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

Number of components per state vector.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"compact"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM
(raw-ed25519 for ed25519, compact for secp256k1)

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —

canonical statement is 6 fixed LF-terminated lines prefixed
"sdn-domain-proof/1", and it verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim
SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof precedent) — never by JCS.

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

IQCGeolocation.description:
Geodetic position of the receiver at capture time.

A separate table because latitude/longitude 0,0 is a VALID coordinate: an
absent GEOLOCATION means "the source published no position", which a
zero-defaulted scalar pair could never express.

LATITUDE_DEG.description: Geodetic latitude, degrees, WGS-84, positive north.

LONGITUDE_DEG.description: Geodetic longitude, degrees, WGS-84, positive east.

ALTITUDE_M.description:
Height above the WGS-84 ellipsoid, metres. Absent in most SigMF
recordings; SigMF `core:geolocation` is a GeoJSON Point whose third
ordinate is optional.

UNCERTAINTY_M.description: Reported position uncertainty, metres, when the source states one.

METHOD.description:
How the position was obtained, verbatim from the source (e.g. "GPS",
"station registry", "author-supplied"). Never inferred.

IQCHardware.description:
Receive chain that produced the samples.

Every field is a verbatim string. SigMF `core:hw` is free text and the
non-SigMF archives publish nothing more structured; splitting free text
into a manufacturer and a model by guessing is a defect.

DESCRIPTION.description:
SigMF `core:hw` verbatim, or the source's equivalent free-text
description of the receive chain.

MANUFACTURER.description: Receiver manufacturer, only when the source names it as its own field.

MODEL.description: Receiver model, only when the source names it as its own field.

ANTENNA.description: Antenna description, only when the source names it as its own field.

RECORDER.description: SigMF `core:recorder` — the SOFTWARE that wrote the recording.

IQCSegment.description:
One SigMF capture segment: the point in the sample stream at which the
listed tuning took effect. A retuned or frequency-hopped recording has
several; a single-tune recording has one.

SAMPLE_START.description: SigMF `core:sample_start` — index of the first sample of this segment.

GLOBAL_INDEX.description:
SigMF `core:global_index` — index of this sample in the receiver's
free-running sample counter.

HEADER_BYTES.description:
SigMF `core:header_bytes` — bytes preceding this segment in the data
file.

CENTER_FREQ_HZ.description: SigMF `core:frequency` — centre frequency of this segment, HERTZ.

DATETIME.description: SigMF `core:datetime` — ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of SAMPLE_START.

IQCAnnotation.description: One labelled region of the capture in time and frequency.

SAMPLE_START.description: SigMF `core:sample_start` — first sample of the annotated region.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description: SigMF `core:sample_count` — length of the annotated region in samples.

FREQ_LOWER_EDGE_HZ.description: SigMF `core:freq_lower_edge` — lower edge of the annotated band, HERTZ.

FREQ_UPPER_EDGE_HZ.description: SigMF `core:freq_upper_edge` — upper edge of the annotated band, HERTZ.

GENERATOR.description:
SigMF `core:generator` — the tool or person that produced the
annotation. An annotation asserted by an automatic classifier and one
asserted by a human are not interchangeable evidence; this field is how
a consumer tells them apart.

UUID.description: SigMF `core:uuid` — the annotation's own identifier, when present.

IQCExtension.description: A SigMF extension namespace the upstream metadata declares.

IS_OPTIONAL.description: True when the extension is declared optional for interpretation.

IQCPayloadRef.description:
A retrievable file belonging to this capture.

The record NEVER carries sample bytes. It carries where they are, how big
they are, and what they hash to, so a consumer can decide for itself
whether to fetch 400 kB or 127 GB.

FILE_NAME.description: File name as the source publishes it.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: IANA media type when the source declares one.

BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Byte length. 0 means the source did not publish a size — it never means
an empty file.

BYTE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact bytes, lowercase hex. Populated only when computed
or published; never guessed.

BYTE_SHA512.description:
SHA-512 of the exact bytes, lowercase hex. SigMF `core:sha512` is a
SHA-512 over the dataset file, so it is carried in its own field rather
than converted or discarded.

CID.description: IPFS CIDv1 when, and only when, this SDN pinned the bytes.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time at which URL was last confirmed retrievable.

IQC.description:
RF IQ Capture Metadata.

The description of ONE raw, un-demodulated complex-baseband recording held
in a public archive — a hosted IQ-capture repository, a crowdsourced
signal-identification catalog, an institutional dataset repository, an
SDR project's capture database, a general-purpose research data archive —
normalized onto the SigMF v1 core namespace, which is the only metadata
vocabulary these archive classes share.

$IQC is a POINTER RECORD. It exists so a capture is discoverable, joinable
and verifiable without anyone mirroring its payload: the samples stay where
their publisher put them and `PAYLOADS` says where that is, how large it
is, and what it hashes to. `iqcCustody.PINNED` is a deliberate per-capture
decision for small high-value recordings, never a default.

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE AND NAMED IN EVERY FIELD. SigMF publishes frequency and
sample rate in HERTZ, so every frequency and rate field here is `_HZ` and
carries the Hz value unconverted. This standard deliberately does NOT
follow $RFB's MHz convention — silently rescaling a SigMF value on ingest
is the exact defect the suffix exists to prevent. A consumer joining $IQC
to $RFB divides by 1e6 at the join, explicitly.

LICENCE IS NEVER ASSUMED. An empty `LICENSE` means the terms are UNKNOWN.
It does not mean public domain, it does not mean permissive, and it does
not authorize redistribution. Crowdsourced catalogs and hosted repositories
both carry third-party recordings, so licence is per RECORDING, never per
archive.

Division of labour: $RFO = a sensor's astrometric/RF observation of a
tracked object (azimuth, elevation, range); $RFE = the parametric emitter
description; $RFB = the emitter's band specification in MHz; $IQC = the
archived baseband recording itself. $DPM remains the manifest under which
THIS network publishes a shard of $IQC records; it does not describe an
upstream third party's capture.

CAPTURE_ID.description: The upstream archive's own identifier for this capture, verbatim.

SOURCE_NAME.description:
Name of the archive that publishes the capture, carried verbatim as that
archive states it. A string rather than an enum so a new archive lane
never requires a schema release.

SOURCE_URL.description: Landing page for the capture at the source.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description:
Identifier of the source record this was normalized from, when the
source exposes one distinct from CAPTURE_ID.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the raw upstream metadata bytes that produced this record,
lowercase hex. Makes the normalization auditable.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the source metadata was retrieved.

SIGMF_VERSION.description:
SigMF `core:version` — the SigMF specification version the upstream
metadata declares. Empty for captures normalized from a non-SigMF
source; that emptiness is itself informative.

COLLECTION.description:
SigMF `core:collection` — identifier of the collection this recording
belongs to.

DATATYPE.description:
SigMF `core:datatype` VERBATIM, e.g. "cf32_le", "ci16_le", "ru8". Never
re-spelled, never normalized to another vocabulary. A consumer that
cannot parse the token MUST refuse the samples rather than assume a
layout.

NUM_CHANNELS.description:
SigMF `core:num_channels`. 0 means unstated; 1 is the SigMF default and
MUST be written explicitly when known.

CENTER_FREQ_HZ.description:
Centre frequency of the FIRST capture segment, HERTZ, copied here for
indexing. `SEGMENTS` is normative whenever it is present.

FREQ_LOWER_EDGE_HZ.description:
Lowest occupied frequency across the recording, HERTZ, when the source
states it or its annotations bound it.

FREQ_UPPER_EDGE_HZ.description: Highest occupied frequency across the recording, HERTZ.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Total complex samples in the recording. 0 means unstated — it is NOT to
be back-computed from BYTE_LENGTH unless DATATYPE and any header bytes
are both known.

DURATION_SECONDS.description:
Recording length in seconds, when stated or exactly derivable from
SAMPLE_COUNT and SAMPLE_RATE_HZ.

SAMPLE_OFFSET.description:
SigMF `core:offset` — index of the first sample in the recording's own
numbering.

METADATA_ONLY.description:
SigMF `core:metadata_only` — true when no dataset file accompanies the
metadata.

TRAILING_BYTES.description:
SigMF `core:trailing_bytes` — non-sample bytes at the end of the data
file.

CAPTURE_START.description:
ISO 8601 UTC start of the recording (the first segment's
`core:datetime`).

CAPTURE_STOP.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of the recording, when stated or exactly derivable.

LABELS.description:
Archive-level tags, categories or keywords, carried verbatim in whatever
vocabulary the publishing archive uses.

GEOLOCATION.description: Receiver position. Absent when the source published none.

SIGNAL_NAME.description:
Signal designation the source states, verbatim ("LoRa", "DVB-S2",
"ADS-B", "VOR"). Not an enum: these archives catalogue the whole radio
world, and $RFE's `signalModulation` is a radar-emitter vocabulary that
would force every civil waveform into UNKNOWN.

MODULATION.description: Modulation the source states, verbatim. Never inferred from the samples.

BAND.description:
Band designation the source states. Shares $RFB's `rfBandDesignation`, so
an HF or VHF capture is designated identically on both records.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalogue number of the transmitting spacecraft when the capture
is of a known space object. Joins to $CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator of the transmitting spacecraft, when known.

EMITTER_ID.description: $RFE.ID of the emitter this capture is of, when identified.

RFB_ID.description:
$RFB.ID of the band specification this capture exercises, when
identified.

LICENSE.description:
SPDX identifier when the source states one, otherwise the source's
licence name verbatim. EMPTY MEANS UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence text the source points at.

ATTRIBUTION.description:
Attribution/citation string the licence requires this record and any
derived product to carry downstream.

CREATED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time of this record.

UPDATED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC last-update time of this record.

SUPERSEDES_IQC_CID.description:
CID of the $IQC this record replaces, when the upstream capture's
metadata changed.

lambertVector3.description: Three-component vector in the request frame.

N_REVS.description: Complete revolution count for this branch. Zero for single-revolution.

ITERATIONS.description: Householder iteration count used to converge this branch.

ERROR_CODE.description: Structured error code when STATUS is ERROR.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Human-readable error message when STATUS is ERROR.

SINGLE.description: Single-revolution solution when STATUS is OK.

MULTI.description: Multi-revolution branches in ascending N_REVS order.

MAX_FEASIBLE_REVS.description: Highest revolution count that produced a feasible pair. Zero when no multi-rev branch is feasible.

FLAGS.description: Result flags reserved for future compatibility.

MODULE_ID.description: Canonical module identifier

WASM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the encrypted module artifact

MODULE_HASH.description: SHA-256 hash of the decrypted module bytes

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Structured error message

CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer
from inventing its own wording for the same code.

CODE.description: The ratified category code. This is the join key every consumer uses.

DISPLAY_NAME.description:
Canonical human-readable label, rendered verbatim. MUST equal the display
name stated in the CODE member's doc comment.

SUMMARY.description: One-sentence description shown on browse rows and category headers.

SLUG.description:
Route-safe identifier: the CODE identifier lowercased with `_` replaced by
`-`. Published explicitly rather than derived so every surface routes
identically.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer editorial description for a category landing page.

PARENT.description:
Parent category for hierarchical browse. UNSPECIFIED means this is a
top-level category. A category MUST NOT name itself as its parent.

SORT_ORDER.description:
Presentation order within its parent, ascending. Ties break on
DISPLAY_NAME.

KEYWORDS.description:
Search synonyms and alternate phrasings that resolve to this category.
Feeds type-ahead; never rendered as the category label.

ICON_KEY.description:
Key of a self-hosted icon or capsule asset for this category. A KEY, not a
URL: consuming node surfaces load zero external-origin bytes, so the
consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

CODE.description: Category being counted.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

GrantFieldStreamPolicy.description: Field-level stream policy bound into protected delivery and grants.

ProtectedDeliveryBinding.description: Immutable encrypted artifact/window metadata for protected delivery.

ProviderReputation.description: Provider reputation summary surfaced in marketplace listings.

OBJECT_IDS.description: Specific NORAD IDs or catalog numbers

MIN_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Minimum altitude in kilometers for altitude-bounded offerings

MAX_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Maximum altitude in kilometers for altitude-bounded offerings

GEO_BOUNDS.description: Bounding box as [min_lat, min_lon, max_lat, max_lon]

DataCoverage.description: Data coverage combining spatial and temporal

PRICE_AMOUNT.description: Price in smallest unit (cents, satoshis, etc.)

RATE_LIMIT.description: Rate limit in requests per hour

FEATURES.description: List of features included in this tier

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the data provider

PROVIDER_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of provider's EPM (Entity Profile Message)

DESCRIPTION.description: Detailed description of the data offering

ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED.description: Whether encryption is required for data delivery

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when listing was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when listing was last updated

ACTIVE.description: Whether the listing is currently active

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider

LISTING_KIND.description: Listing category: data stream or WASM module

SAMPLE_RECORD_COUNT.description: Number of records in sample data, when available

PROTECTED_DELIVERY.description: Protected delivery metadata for encrypted artifacts or streams

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the listing expires, or 0 for no expiry

LICENSE.description: License label or SPDX-style identifier

SOURCE_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID this listing was sourced from when discovered remotely

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified `$CCT` category this listing is shelved under, using the
same vocabulary and semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY and
APP.PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Before this field existed a listing carried no
capability category at all — only DATA_TYPES and TAGS — so a storefront
shelf and a library shelf were grouped by two unrelated systems. A
consumer MUST group listings by this field and MUST NOT re-derive a
category from DATA_TYPES, TAGS or TITLE, none of which are a controlled
vocabulary.

Distinct from LISTING_KIND, which is the delivery kind (data stream vs
module artifact), and from ACCESS_TYPE, which is the commercial access
model. UNSPECIFIED means the provider did not classify the listing; a
consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified `$CCT` category this listing belongs to, for browse,
filter and per-category counting. A listing MAY carry several. If
nonempty it MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.

RECOMMENDED_RETENTION.description:
Retention rule the publisher recommends to subscribers of a dataset
listing: ReplaceCurrent when each publication is a complete current set,
ArchiveAll when publications accumulate history.

PUR.description: Purchase Request - Request to purchase data from a storefront listing

REQUEST_ID.description: Unique identifier for this purchase request

LISTING_ID.description: ID of the listing being purchased

TIER_NAME.description: Name of the pricing tier selected

BUYER_ENCRYPTION_PUBKEY.description: Buyer's encryption public key for encrypted delivery

KEY_ALGORITHM.description: Key algorithm for buyer encryption public key

SENDER_ADDRESS.description: On-chain sender address or fiat payment source reference

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the purchase record was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the purchase record was updated

PAYMENT_DEADLINE.description: Unix timestamp when payment must be received

PAYMENT_CONFIRMED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when payment was confirmed

GRANT_ISSUED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the grant was issued

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Provider peer ID

PROVIDER_ACKNOWLEDGED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when provider acknowledged the request

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Buyer webhook URL for delivery callbacks

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

CLASSIFICATION.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

OB_TIME.description: Ob detection time in ISO 8601 UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ssssssZ), up to microsecond precision.

CORR_QUALITY.description: Correlation score of the observation when compared to a known orbit state.

ID_ON_ORBIT.description: Server will auto-populate with SAT_NO if available.

SENSOR_ID.description: Unique ID of the sensor. Must have a corresponding sensor record on the server.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: 18SDS satellite number. Only list if correlated against the 18SDS catalog.

TASK_ID.description: Identifier for the collectRequest message if the collection was in response to tasking.

TRANSACTION_ID.description: Optional identifier to track a transaction.

IMAGE_SET_ID.description: The user-defined set ID of a sequence of images.

IMAGE_SET_LENGTH.description: The number of images in an image set.

SEQUENCE_ID.description: The sequence ID of an image within an image set.

OB_POSITION.description: The position of this observation within a track (FENCE, FIRST, IN, LAST, SINGLE).

ORIG_OBJECT_ID.description: Provider maintained ID. May not be consistent with 18SDS SAT_NO.

UCT.description: Required if correlation is attempted. Indicates whether correlation succeeded.

AZIMUTH.description: Line of sight azimuth angle in degrees and topocentric frame.

AZIMUTH_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight azimuth angle, in degrees.

AZIMUTH_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight azimuth angle bias in degrees.

AZIMUTH_RATE.description: Rate of change of the line of sight azimuth in degrees per second.

ELEVATION.description: Line of sight elevation in degrees and topocentric frame.

ELEVATION_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight elevation angle, in degrees.

ELEVATION_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight elevation bias in degrees.

ELEVATION_RATE.description: Rate of change of the line of sight elevation in degrees per second.

RANGE.description: Line of sight range in km. Reported value should include all applicable corrections.

RANGE_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight range, in km.

RANGE_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight range bias in km.

RANGE_RATE.description: Range rate in km/s. Reported value should include all applicable corrections.

RANGE_RATE_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight range rate, in km/sec.

RA.description: Right ascension in degrees. Required metric reporting field for EO observations.

RA_RATE.description: Line of sight right ascension rate of change, in degrees/sec.

RA_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight right ascension angle, in degrees.

RA_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight right ascension bias in degrees.

DECLINATION.description: Declination in degrees. Required metric reporting field for EO observations.

DECLINATION_RATE.description: Line of sight declination rate of change, in degrees/sec.

DECLINATION_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight declination angle, in degrees.

DECLINATION_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight declination angle bias in degrees.

LOSX.description: X-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOSY.description: Y-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOSZ.description: Z-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOS_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line-of-sight direction vector components.

LOSXVEL.description: X-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

LOSYVEL.description: Y-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

LOSZVEL.description: Z-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

SENLAT.description: WGS-84 latitude in decimal degrees at the time of the observation.

SENLON.description: WGS-84 longitude in decimal degrees at the time of the observation.

SENALT.description: Sensor height in km relative to the WGS-84 ellipsoid at the time of the observation.

SENX.description: Cartesian X position in km at the time of the observation.

SENY.description: Cartesian Y position in km at the time of the observation.

SENZ.description: Cartesian Z position in km at the time of the observation.

FOV_COUNT.description: Total number of satellites in the field of view.

FOV_COUNT_UCTS.description: Number of uncorrelated satellites in the field of view (JCO).

EXP_DURATION.description:
Image exposure duration in seconds. For observations performed using frame stacking or synthetic tracking methods,
the exposure duration should be the total integration time. This field is highly recommended / required if the
observations are going to be used for photometric processing.

NET_OBJ_SIG_UNC.description: Net object signature uncertainty = counts uncertainty / EXP_DURATION.

MAG.description: Measure of observed brightness calibrated against the Gaia G-band.

GEOLAT.description:
Computed estimate of the latitude, positive degrees north. It should be computed based on the assumed slant range
and corresponding viewing geometry. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEOLON.description:
Computed estimate of the longitude as +/- 180 degrees east. It should be computed based on the assumed slant range
and viewing geometry. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEOALT.description: Computed estimate of satellite altitude in km at the reported location. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEORANGE.description: Computed estimate of the slant range in km. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

SKY_BKGRND.description:
Average Sky Background signal, in Magnitudes. Sky Background refers to the incoming light from an apparently
empty part of the night sky.

PRIMARY_EXTINCTION.description:
Primary Extinction Coefficient, in Magnitudes. Primary Extinction is the coefficient applied to the airmass
to determine how much the observed visual magnitude has been attenuated by the atmosphere. Extinction, in general,
describes the absorption and scattering of electromagnetic radiation by dust and gas between an emitting astronomical
object and the observer.

PRIMARY_EXTINCTION_UNC.description: Primary Extinction Coefficient Uncertainty, in Magnitudes.

SOLAR_PHASE_ANGLE.description:
The angle, in degrees, between the target-to-observer vector and the target-to-sun vector. Recommend using the
calculation listed in the EOSSA documentation, pg 106 of the EOSSA spec.

SOLAR_EQ_PHASE_ANGLE.description:
The angle, in degrees, between the projections of the target-to-observer vector and the target-to-sun vector
onto the equatorial plane. The convention used is negative when closing (i.e., before the opposition)
and positive when opening (after the opposition).

SOLAR_DEC_ANGLE.description: Angle from the sun to the equatorial plane.

RAW_FILE_URI.description: Optional URI location in the document repository of the raw file parsed by the system to produce this record.

INTENSITY.description: Intensity of the target for IR observations, in kw/sr/em.

BG_INTENSITY.description: Background intensity for IR observations, in kw/sr/um.

DESCRIPTOR.description: Optional source-provided and searchable metadata or descriptor of the data.

ORIGIN.description:
Originating system or organization which produced the data, if different from the source.
The origin may be different than the source if the source was a mediating system which forwarded
the data on behalf of the origin system. If null, the source may be assumed to be the origin.

DATA_MODE.description: Indicator of whether the data is EXERCISE, REAL, SIMULATED, or TEST.

CREATED_AT.description: Time the row was created in the database, auto-populated by the system.

CREATED_BY.description: Application user who created the row in the database, auto-populated by the system.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: EO observations are assumed to be topocentric J2000 coordinates ('J2000') as defined by the IAU, unless otherwise specified.

SEN_REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
The sensor reference frame is assumed to be the International Terrestrial Reference Frame (ITRF),
unless otherwise specified. (ITRF is equivalent to Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed (ECEF) for this purpose).
Lat / long / height values should be reported using the WGS-84 ellipsoid, where applicable.

UMBRA.description: Boolean indicating that the target object was in umbral eclipse at the time of this observation.

PENUMBRA.description:
Boolean indicating that the target object was in a penumbral eclipse at the time of this observation.
This field is highly recommended if the observations will be used for photometric processing.

ORIG_NETWORK.description: The originating source network on which this record was created, auto-populated by the system.

SOURCE_DL.description: The source from which this record was received.

AZIMUTH_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if azimuth is reported.

ELEVATION_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if elevation is reported.

RANGE_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if range is reported.

RA_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if right ascension is reported.

DECLINATION_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if declination is reported.

NIIRS.description: National Imagery Interpretability Rating Scale (NIIRS). Ranging from 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest).

METERS_PER_PIXEL.description: Ground sample distance in meters per pixel.

IMAGE_SNR.description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the image. Higher values indicate cleaner imagery.

IMAGE_WIDTH.description: Width of the image in pixels.

IMAGE_HEIGHT.description: Height of the image in pixels.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION.description: Compression type used for the image, e.g., "JPEG", "PNG", "RAW", etc.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION_RATIO.description: Compression ratio used (original size / compressed size), if applicable.

PROCESSED_IMAGE_URI.description: URI to the processed image used for this observation.

IMAGE_AUTO_ENHANCED.description: Flag indicating whether the image was auto-enhanced (e.g., contrast stretch, denoise).

MULTI_FRAME_STACKED.description: True if the observation was taken with multiple frames stacked into one image.

SYNTHETIC_TRACKING_USED.description: True if synthetic tracking was used to create the image.

IMAGE_SHARPNESS.description: Sharpness metric of the image based on the Tenengrad method or variance of Laplacian. Higher values indicate sharper images.

IMAGE_NOISE_STDDEV.description: Noise level of the image, estimated via pixel intensity variance in background regions.

IMAGE_CONTRAST.description: Contrast metric of the image, such as Michelson contrast or RMS contrast.

IMAGE_DYNAMIC_RANGE.description: Dynamic range of the image (max pixel value / min pixel value), indicating tonal spread.

PSF_FWHM.description: Estimated Point Spread Function (PSF) Full Width at Half Maximum (FWHM) in pixels. Indicates image blur or focus.

CLOUD_COVER_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of cloud cover in the image. Derived using cloud detection algorithms such as Fmask or machine learning classifiers.

CLOUD_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence score of the cloud detection result, from 0 (low confidence) to 1 (high confidence).

HAZE_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of the image obscured by haze or atmospheric scattering effects.

AEROSOL_OPTICAL_THICKNESS.description: Estimated aerosol optical thickness (AOT) at 550 nm, indicating particulate matter in the atmosphere affecting image clarity.

WATER_VAPOR_CONTENT.description: Estimated water vapor content (e.g., total column precipitable water) at the time of imaging, in mm.

SUN_ELEVATION.description: Sun elevation angle at the time of image capture, in degrees above the horizon.

SUN_AZIMUTH.description: Sun azimuth angle at the time of image capture, in degrees from true north.

VIEW_ZENITH_ANGLE.description: View zenith angle (sensor line-of-sight angle from nadir), in degrees.

VIEW_AZIMUTH_ANGLE.description: View azimuth angle (direction of sensor relative to north), in degrees.

OFF_NADIR_ANGLE.description: Off-nadir angle of the sensor at the time of image capture, in degrees.

SWATH_WIDTH_KM.description: Ground coverage width of the image swath in kilometers.

MEAN_TERRAIN_ELEVATION.description: Mean terrain elevation in the image footprint, in meters above sea level.

TERRAIN_ELEVATION_STDDEV.description: Standard deviation of terrain elevation in the image footprint, in meters.

SHADOW_COVER_PERCENT.description: Percentage of the image affected by shadows, derived via topographic or object shadow detection.

SUNGLINT_PRESENT.description: Flag indicating whether sunglint is present in the image (true if high reflectance from water surface due to sun geometry).

SUNGLINT_PERCENT.description: Percentage of image affected by sunglint.

SNOW_ICE_COVER_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of snow or ice coverage in the image footprint.

VALID_DATA_AREA_KM2.description: Total area covered by valid data (non-masked, usable imagery) in square kilometers.

RCS.description: Radar cross-section (dBsm)
