CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation or network this link belongs to.

SERVICE.description: Operator-facing service or mission designation.

MODCOD_SET.description:
Ordered adaptive modulation-and-coding choices. Per-sample
SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX indexes this vector for the sample's selected link.

ACM_ENABLED.description: Whether the producer evaluated adaptive selection for this link.

RFLInterferenceContribution.description:
One interfering contribution to one sample. SPARSE: entries exist only
where a contribution was computed, so a dense matrix is never forced into
existence to say "no interference computed".

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this contribution applies to.

SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ID.description:
Endpoint identifier of the interfering emitter, when it is an endpoint of
this record.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` of the interfering emission.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Interfering object's catalogue number, 0 when unbound.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Received interfering power at the victim receiver, dBW.

TOPOCENTRIC_SEPARATION_DEG.description:
Angular separation between the wanted and interfering paths at the
victim receiver, degrees.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim's bandwidth overlapped by this emission [0-1].

POLARIZATION_ISOLATION_DB.description: Polarization isolation applied to this contribution, dB.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Discrimination applied from the victim antenna pattern, dB.

RFLModelParameter.description:
A named parameter of a model binding, with its unit stated. There is no
encoding for a parameter value without a unit.

TEXT_VALUE.description: Non-numeric parameter value, when the parameter is categorical.

RFLModelBinding.description:
Which model produced one term of the budget. A loss term without a model
binding is an unattributed number: rain attenuation from two different
recommendations differs by decibels, and a consumer must be able to tell
which one it is holding.

TERM.description: The budget term this binding produced.

MODEL_NAME.description:
Model or recommendation identifier as its publisher states it (e.g. an
ITU-R recommendation number with its revision).

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` of the module that evaluated it.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact artifact that produced the values.

RFLProvenance.description: Where this sample set came from, stated once for the record.

SOURCE.description:
The producing system, dataset or measurement campaign. Required: a
budget time series with no stated source is not publishable.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference that regenerates this set.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the propagator that produced the geometry columns. A record
whose METHOD is MODELED or HYBRID and which carries geometry columns MUST
name it: geometry is only as good as the propagator, and the propagator is
a pluggable choice, never an assumed default.

PROPAGATOR_CONFIGURATION.description: Force model or configuration identifier handed to the propagator.

SAMPLING_STEP_S.description: Uniform sampling step, seconds. Absent when SAMPLE_EPOCHS are irregular.

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description:
Weather or environment dataset the atmospheric terms were evaluated
against, when they were not evaluated against a statistical model.

TERRAIN_DATASET.description: Terrain or surface dataset the blockage terms were evaluated against.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this set was computed or recorded.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix ms the upstream inputs were retrieved.

LICENSE.description:
Licence the source imposes on redistribution. An empty LICENSE means
UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a grant to redistribute.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: True when the licence forbids commercial use of this set.

CITATION.description: Attribution the licence requires this record to carry downstream.

MODULE_ID.description:
Primary `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced this record.
MODELS remains the per-budget-term attribution surface.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact producing WASM artifact.

RFL_ID.description: Stable identifier of this sample set.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$ACI` and
`$CVP` products derived from this set.

LINKS.description: Link definitions. SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES index into this vector.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of samples. Every present metric array MUST have exactly this
many entries.

SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES.description: Index into LINKS for each sample.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description:
Sample epochs, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM. Samples
need not be uniformly spaced and need not be grouped by link, but MUST be
non-decreasing within each link.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale SAMPLE_EPOCHS are expressed in. Defaults to UTC explicitly:
`timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as sidereal time.

RANGE_RATE_M_S.description: Range rate, metres per second; positive is opening.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the receiving endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the receiving endpoint, degrees above the local horizon.

TRANSMIT_AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the transmitting endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

TRANSMIT_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the transmitting endpoint, degrees.

DOPPLER_SHIFT_HZ.description:
Doppler shift of the carrier, hertz; positive is closing. Hertz, not the
MHz used for frequencies elsewhere in this record — a shift of a few kHz
on a GHz carrier is destroyed by an MHz encoding.

EIRP_DBW.description: Effective isotropic radiated power toward the receiver, dBW.

TRANSMIT_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain in the direction of the receiver, dBi.

RECEIVE_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain in the direction of the transmitter, dBi.

GASEOUS_ABSORPTION_LOSS_DB.description: Gaseous (oxygen and water vapour) absorption, dB.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS_DB.description:
Total loss from 3D obstacles on the path, dB. The per-obstacle detail —
which object, which material, at what angle, through how much of it — is
in OBSTRUCTIONS.

TOTAL_PATH_LOSS_DB.description:
Total of all path terms actually applied, dB. Published as its own column
rather than left to the consumer to sum: a producer that applied a term
this schema has no column for MUST still report an honest total, and the
discrepancy against the itemised columns is then visible.

RECEIVED_POWER_DBW.description: Received carrier power at the receiver input, dBW.

GAIN_TO_NOISE_TEMPERATURE_DB_PER_K.description: Receiving system figure of merit G/T, dB/K.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_DB.description: Carrier-to-noise ratio C/N in the occupied bandwidth, dB.

ENERGY_PER_BIT_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Energy per bit to noise density Eb/N0, dB.

BIT_ERROR_RATE.description:
Bit error rate as a probability [0-1], NOT an exponent and NOT a
percentage. 1e-6 is encoded 1e-6.

LINK_MARGIN_DB.description:
Link margin against the link's stated threshold, dB. Meaningless without
RFLLink.THRESHOLD_TERM / THRESHOLD_VALUE / THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY_BPS.description: Achievable channel capacity, bits per second.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Aggregate received interfering power, dBW.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_PLUS_INTERFERENCE_DB.description: Carrier to noise-plus-interference ratio C/(N+I), dB.

OBSTRUCTIONS.description:
Per-interaction obstacle detail, sparse. Each entry names the `$RFS`
material it went through, reflected off or was blocked by.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS.description: The single condition that bound the link at each sample.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description required when a LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS entry is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of the whole set. Required: an unattributed budget is not
publishable.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over the size-prefixed
FlatBuffer projection with both 64-byte signature payloads zeroed while
preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over canonical JSON with IDL
field order, IDL capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both
signature fields omitted.

SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX.description:
Index into the selected link's RFLLink.MODCOD_SET for each sample.
SELECTED_MODCOD_VALID distinguishes index 0 from no selection.

SPECTRAL_EFFICIENCY_BPS_HZ.description: Spectral efficiency delivered by the selected entry, bit/s/Hz.

ACHIEVED_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Delivered information rate after adaptive selection, bits per second.

ACM_MARGIN_DB.description: Margin above the selected entry's threshold, dB.

ENERGY_PER_SYMBOL_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Symbol energy to noise spectral density, dB.

ACIBestServer.description:
The server that served an interval best, and what it beat. Publishing the
runner-up is what makes a best-server claim auditable rather than an
assertion.

SELECTION_TERM.description: The metric the selection was made on.

SELECTION_UNITS.description:
Units of SELECTION_VALUE. Required whenever a value is published: a
selection metric with no unit cannot be re-derived or compared.

RUNNER_UP_VALUE.description: Runner-up value of SELECTION_TERM, same units.

TIE_BROKEN_BY.description: Rule applied when the metric tied (e.g. "lowest slant range").

CANDIDATES_EVALUATED.description: Number of candidate servers evaluated, including the winner.

ACIHandover.description: A transition of service between two links.

OVERLAP_S.description:
Seconds both links were usable together. Meaningful for
MAKE_BEFORE_BREAK and SOFT.

GAP_S.description: Seconds neither link was usable. Meaningful for BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE.

EXECUTED_AT.description:
Epoch of the transition, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in the
record's TIME_SYSTEM.

TRANSMIT_ENDPOINT_ID.description: Endpoints, joined from the same `$RFL` set.

ACQUISITION_TIME.description:
Acquisition of signal, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in the record's
TIME_SYSTEM. An interval with no start is not an interval: a producer that
cannot state it MUST NOT emit the entry. FlatBuffers cannot mark a scalar
required, so this is enforced by the producer, not by the wire.

LOSS_TIME.description:
Loss of signal, same encoding. NaN means the interval was still open at
WINDOW_STOP and was NOT truncated to the window — a consumer must be able
to tell an open pass from one that ended exactly at the boundary.

DURATION_S.description:
Duration in seconds. Published rather than derived so a truncated or
open-ended interval still states the span it actually covers.

THRESHOLD_SATISFIED_START.description:
Sub-interval over which the threshold was met, when it is narrower than
ACQUISITION_TIME..LOSS_TIME. Absent when the whole interval met it or
when no threshold was evaluated.

THRESHOLD_TERM.description:
The requirement this interval is stated against. A margin without these
is a margin against nothing.

MARGIN_MINIMUM_DB.description: Margin statistics across the interval, dB.

MARGIN_MINIMUM_AT.description:
Epoch of MARGIN_MINIMUM_DB, same encoding as ACQUISITION_TIME. The worst
instant of a pass is an operational fact, not a statistic.

DATA_VOLUME_BITS.description:
Data the interval could carry, bits. Bits, not bytes and not megabits:
the rate columns of `$RFL` are bits per second.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT.description: The condition that bound this interval.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description, required when LIMITING_CONSTRAINT is OTHER.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_AT.description:
Epoch at which LIMITING_CONSTRAINT bound, same encoding as
ACQUISITION_TIME.

AVAILABILITY_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the interval during which the threshold was met [0-1].

HANDOVER.description: Handover detail, when INTERVAL_KIND is HANDOVER.

RFL_SAMPLE_FIRST_INDEX.description:
Join back to the samples this interval was derived from: the inclusive
index range into the `$RFL` sample arrays named by ACI.RFL_ID.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description: Number of samples that contributed.

ACIProvenance.description: Where this interval set came from.

SOURCE.description: Producing system, dataset or campaign. Required.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Propagator that produced the geometry the boundaries were found in. A
MODELED or HYBRID interval set MUST name it: the propagator is a
pluggable choice and never an assumed default.

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that computed the intervals.

SAMPLING_STEP_S.description: Sampling step of the underlying grid, seconds.

BOUNDARY_REFINEMENT.description:
How a boundary between two samples was refined (e.g. "none", "linear",
"bisection", "brent"). "none" means the boundary IS a grid epoch.

BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_S.description:
Worst-case uncertainty of every boundary in this record, seconds. With
no refinement this equals SAMPLING_STEP_S.

MIN_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Minimum elevation applied, degrees, when a single mask governed the set.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms computed and retrieved.

LICENSE.description:
Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS — never a grant to
redistribute.

ACIDataVolumeByModCod.description:
Data carried by one modulation-and-coding choice during one interval.
Entries are explicit rows so FlatSQL and `$RPT` can group volume by link,
interval, or choice without decoding a producer-specific map.

MODCOD_ID.description: Stable RFLModCod.MODCOD_ID copied for queryability across records.

ACI_ID.description: Stable identifier of this interval set.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$RFL` samples
and `$CVP` geometry of the same study.

RFL_ID.description:
`$RFL.RFL_ID` these intervals were derived from, when they were derived
from a published sample set. Absent for measured or scheduled intervals.

WINDOW_START.description:
Analysis window, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM. An
interval set states its window so "no intervals" can be distinguished
from "not analysed".

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale all epochs in this record are expressed in. Defaults to UTC
explicitly: `timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST.

PROVENANCE.description: Provenance. Required.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over the size-prefixed
FlatBuffer projection with both 64-byte signature payloads zeroed while
preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over canonical JSON with IDL
field order, IDL capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both
signature fields omitted.

DATA_VOLUME_BY_MODCOD.description:
Per-interval delivered volume grouped by selected modulation-and-coding
entry. The sum for an interval equals ACIInterval.DATA_VOLUME_BITS.

CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer
from inventing its own wording for the same code.

CODE.description: The ratified category code. This is the join key every consumer uses.

DISPLAY_NAME.description:
Canonical human-readable label, rendered verbatim. MUST equal the display
name stated in the CODE member's doc comment.

SUMMARY.description: One-sentence description shown on browse rows and category headers.

SLUG.description:
Route-safe identifier: the CODE identifier lowercased with `_` replaced by
`-`. Published explicitly rather than derived so every surface routes
identically.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer editorial description for a category landing page.

PARENT.description:
Parent category for hierarchical browse. UNSPECIFIED means this is a
top-level category. A category MUST NOT name itself as its parent.

SORT_ORDER.description:
Presentation order within its parent, ascending. Ties break on
DISPLAY_NAME.

KEYWORDS.description:
Search synonyms and alternate phrasings that resolve to this category.
Feeds type-ahead; never rendered as the category label.

ICON_KEY.description:
Key of a self-hosted icon or capsule asset for this category. A KEY, not a
URL: consuming node surfaces load zero external-origin bytes, so the
consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

CODE.description: Category being counted.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

GrantFieldStreamPolicy.description: Field-level stream policy bound into protected delivery and grants.

ProtectedDeliveryBinding.description: Immutable encrypted artifact/window metadata for protected delivery.

ProviderReputation.description: Provider reputation summary surfaced in marketplace listings.

OBJECT_IDS.description: Specific NORAD IDs or catalog numbers

MIN_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Minimum altitude in kilometers for altitude-bounded offerings

MAX_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Maximum altitude in kilometers for altitude-bounded offerings

GEO_BOUNDS.description: Bounding box as [min_lat, min_lon, max_lat, max_lon]

DataCoverage.description: Data coverage combining spatial and temporal

PRICE_AMOUNT.description: Price in smallest unit (cents, satoshis, etc.)

RATE_LIMIT.description: Rate limit in requests per hour

FEATURES.description: List of features included in this tier

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the data provider

PROVIDER_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of provider's EPM (Entity Profile Message)

DESCRIPTION.description: Detailed description of the data offering

ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED.description: Whether encryption is required for data delivery

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when listing was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when listing was last updated

ACTIVE.description: Whether the listing is currently active

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider

LISTING_KIND.description: Listing category: data stream or WASM module

SAMPLE_RECORD_COUNT.description: Number of records in sample data, when available

PROTECTED_DELIVERY.description: Protected delivery metadata for encrypted artifacts or streams

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the listing expires, or 0 for no expiry

LICENSE.description: License label or SPDX-style identifier

SOURCE_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID this listing was sourced from when discovered remotely

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified `$CCT` category this listing is shelved under, using the
same vocabulary and semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY and
APP.PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Before this field existed a listing carried no
capability category at all — only DATA_TYPES and TAGS — so a storefront
shelf and a library shelf were grouped by two unrelated systems. A
consumer MUST group listings by this field and MUST NOT re-derive a
category from DATA_TYPES, TAGS or TITLE, none of which are a controlled
vocabulary.

Distinct from LISTING_KIND, which is the delivery kind (data stream vs
module artifact), and from ACCESS_TYPE, which is the commercial access
model. UNSPECIFIED means the provider did not classify the listing; a
consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified `$CCT` category this listing belongs to, for browse,
filter and per-category counting. A listing MAY carry several. If
nonempty it MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.

RECOMMENDED_RETENTION.description:
Retention rule the publisher recommends to subscribers of a dataset
listing: ReplaceCurrent when each publication is a complete current set,
ArchiveAll when publications accumulate history.

ACL.description: Access Control Grant - Permission to access purchased data

LISTING_ID.description: ID of the listing this grant applies to

BUYER_ENCRYPTION_PUBKEY.description: Buyer's encryption public key for encrypted delivery

TIER_NAME.description: Name of the pricing tier purchased

GRANTED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when access was granted

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when access expires (0 = never expires)

PAYMENT_TX_HASH.description: Transaction hash or reference proving payment

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider

KEY_ALGORITHM.description: Key algorithm for buyer encryption public key

TOTAL_REQUESTS.description: Total requests made under this grant

TOTAL_RECORDS.description: Total records delivered under this grant

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the grant record was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the grant record was updated

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Provider peer ID

FIELD_STREAM_POLICY.description: Field-level stream policy bound to this grant

EPOCH.description: Epoch (ISO 8601)

CP_X.description: Center of pressure X in m

CP_Y.description: Center of pressure Y in m

CP_Z.description: Center of pressure Z in m

IXX.description: Moment of inertia about X axis in kg*m^2

IYY.description: Moment of inertia about Y axis in kg*m^2

IZZ.description: Moment of inertia about Z axis in kg*m^2

IXY.description: Product of inertia XY in kg*m^2

IXZ.description: Product of inertia XZ in kg*m^2

IYZ.description: Product of inertia YZ in kg*m^2

EPOCH.description: Epoch (ISO 8601)

TOR_1.description: Torque about body X in N*m

TOR_2.description: Torque about body Y in N*m

TOR_3.description: Torque about body Z in N*m

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator

EPOCH.description: Epoch of state (ISO 8601)

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system

PRRMetadataEntry.description: String metadata key/value attached to a peer registry entry.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Known libp2p/IPFS multiaddresses for this peer.

TRUST_LEVEL.description: Trust level assigned to this peer by the local registry.

GROUPS.description: Peer group names this peer belongs to.

ADDED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this peer was added.

LAST_SEEN.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this peer was last observed.

LAST_CONNECTED.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this peer last connected.

CONNECTION_COUNT.description: Number of successful connections observed by this node.

MESSAGES_RECEIVED.description: Number of messages received from this peer.

MESSAGES_SENT.description: Number of messages sent to this peer.

BYTES_RECEIVED.description: Number of bytes received from this peer.

BYTES_SENT.description: Number of bytes sent to this peer.

EPM_DATA.description: Optional EPM.fbs bytes for the peer identity profile.

VCARD_DATA.description: Optional vCard projection for compatibility views.

METADATA.description: Additional peer metadata as string key/value entries.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this registry record was last updated.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the peer from the current registry.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the node/provider that issued this registry record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the peer registry record.

ACTKeySlot.description: One purpose-key slot of an operator.

KEY_PATH.description: Derivation path currently in use.

NEXT_PATH.description: Derivation path the next rotation will use.

ACT.description: Account Record - operator, session, challenge or external link.

XPUB.description: Extended public key the operator proves control of.

EPM_CID.description: Content identifier of the operator's identity record.

PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier the account is bound to.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds.

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix milliseconds a session or challenge expires; 0 = none.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over CHALLENGE.

EXTERNAL_CHAIN.description: External chain identifier of a linked wallet (CAIP-2 form).

EXTERNAL_ADDRESS.description: External address of a linked wallet.

LINKED.description: True when the external link has been verified.

ACWStateSample.description: Target Cartesian state sample in an Earth-fixed frame.

JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Sample epoch as Julian Date in TT.

AZIMUTH_RAD.description: Azimuth, radians in the TopocentricFrame convention.

ELEVATION_RAD.description: Minimum visible elevation at the azimuth, radians.

ACWRefractionModel.description: Atmospheric refraction model for apparent-elevation access checks.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Interval start as Julian Date in TT.

END_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Interval end as Julian Date in TT.

ACWGroundStation.description: Ground-station geodetic definition and scheduling constraints.

ALTITUDE_M.description: Height above the WGS-84 ellipsoid, meters.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY.description: Number of simultaneous contacts this station can schedule.

TARGET_STATION_ID.description: Optional target station id. Empty means all stations when supported.

MIN_ELEVATION_OVERRIDE_RAD.description: Optional caller override for minimum elevation, radians.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace/correlation identifier.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Access start as Julian Date in TT.

END_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Access end as Julian Date in TT.

MAX_ELEVATION_RAD.description: Maximum elevation sampled or interpolated during the pass, radians.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description: Number of visible input samples contributing to the window.

ACWResult.description: Result for one access-window compute request.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

attitudeDataLine.description:
A single attitude data line with an EXPLICIT epoch (non-uniform steps).

CCSDS 504.0-B-2 4.2.4 puts an epoch on EVERY AEM data line, and real AEMs
are not on a uniform grid: the published example (504.0-B-2 figure G-4)
steps 1996-11-28T21:29:07.2555 -> 22:08:03.5555 -> 22:08:04.5555, i.e.
2339 s then 1 s. Such a segment CANNOT be expressed by the compact
ATTITUDE_DATA array, whose epochs are reconstructed as
START_TIME + i * STEP_SIZE. Scenario-epoch attitude text containers have
the same irregular shape.

The populated columns are selected by the segment's ATTITUDE_TYPE exactly
as in CCSDS 504.0-B-2 table 4-4:
QUATERNION              Q1 Q2 Q3 QC
QUATERNION/DERIVATIVE   Q1 Q2 Q3 QC Q1_DOT Q2_DOT Q3_DOT QC_DOT
QUATERNION/ANGVEL       Q1 Q2 Q3 QC ANGVEL_X ANGVEL_Y ANGVEL_Z
EULER_ANGLE             ANGLE_1 ANGLE_2 ANGLE_3
EULER_ANGLE/DERIVATIVE  ANGLE_1..3 ANGLE_1_DOT ANGLE_2_DOT ANGLE_3_DOT
EULER_ANGLE/ANGVEL      ANGLE_1..3 ANGVEL_X ANGVEL_Y ANGVEL_Z
SPIN                    SPIN_ALPHA SPIN_DELTA SPIN_ANGLE SPIN_ANGLE_VEL
SPIN/NUTATION           + NUTATION NUTATION_PER NUTATION_PHASE
SPIN/NUTATION_MOM       + MOMENTUM_ALPHA MOMENTUM_DELTA NUTATION_VEL

Quaternion component order is fixed by CCSDS 504.0-B-2 (Q1, Q2, Q3, QC,
vector part first). The B-1 keyword QUATERNION_TYPE was REMOVED by B-2
(annex, change 7) and is deliberately NOT carried here.

Units per 504.0-B-2 4.2.4.6: quaternion components dimensionless;
Q*_DOT 1/s; ANGLE_*, SPIN_*, NUTATION, NUTATION_PHASE, MOMENTUM_* deg;
ANGLE_*_DOT, ANGVEL_*, SPIN_ANGLE_VEL, NUTATION_VEL deg/s;
NUTATION_PER s.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this attitude state (required for non-uniform steps).

ANGLE_1.description: Euler angle 1, deg. Sequence given by EULER_ROT_SEQ.

ANGVEL_X.description: Angular velocity X component, deg/s, expressed in ANGVEL_FRAME.

ANGVEL_Y.description: Angular velocity Y component, deg/s, expressed in ANGVEL_FRAME.

ANGVEL_Z.description: Angular velocity Z component, deg/s, expressed in ANGVEL_FRAME.

SPIN_ALPHA.description: Right ascension of the spin axis, deg.

SPIN_DELTA.description: Declination of the spin axis, deg.

SPIN_ANGLE.description: Phase of the satellite about the spin axis, deg.

SPIN_ANGLE_VEL.description: Angular velocity about the spin axis, deg/s.

MOMENTUM_ALPHA.description: Right ascension of the angular momentum vector, deg.

MOMENTUM_DELTA.description: Declination of the angular momentum vector, deg.

NUTATION_VEL.description: Angular velocity of the nutation, deg/s.

STEP_SIZE.description: Time interval between attitude states in seconds (required).

ATTITUDE_COMPONENTS.description:
Number of components per attitude state.
7 = quaternion + angular rates (Q1, Q2, Q3, QC, RATE_X, RATE_Y, RATE_Z)
4 = quaternion only (Q1, Q2, Q3, QC)

ATTITUDE_DATA.description:
Attitude data as row-major array of doubles.
Layout: [Q1_0, Q2_0, Q3_0, QC_0, RATE_X_0, RATE_Y_0, RATE_Z_0, Q1_1, ...]
Time reconstruction: epoch[i] = START_TIME + (i * STEP_SIZE)
Length must be divisible by ATTITUDE_COMPONENTS.

COMMENT.description:
Plain-text comments carried in the metadata block (504.0-B-2 table 4-3).
One entry per COMMENT line, in file order.

CENTER_NAME.description:
Origin of the reference frame, e.g. "EARTH", "MARS BARYCENTER"
(504.0-B-2 table 4-3, optional).

CLASSIFICATION.description:
Classification marking of the data in portion-marked format
(504.0-B-2 table 4-3, optional).

USEABLE_START_TIME.description: Start of the USEABLE time span covered by the data, ISO 8601.

USEABLE_STOP_TIME.description: End of the USEABLE time span covered by the data, ISO 8601.

EULER_ROT_SEQ.description:
Rotation sequence defining the REF_FRAME_A to REF_FRAME_B transformation
when ATTITUDE_TYPE is an EULER_ANGLE variant, e.g. "312", "321".

ANGVEL_FRAME.description:
Reference frame in which the ANGVEL_* components are expressed; the value
is "REF_FRAME_A" or "REF_FRAME_B" (504.0-B-2 table 4-3).
NOTE: the B-1 keyword RATE_FRAME does not exist in 504.0-B-2; ANGVEL_FRAME
is the ratified spelling and is the one carried here.

ATTITUDE_DATA_LINES.description:
Attitude data lines with EXPLICIT per-state epochs, for non-uniform steps.

VALIDATION RULES (identical in form to $OEM, schema/OEM/main.fbs):
1. If STEP_SIZE > 0, ATTITUDE_DATA is authoritative and
ATTITUDE_DATA_LINES must be empty or ignored by parsers.
2. If STEP_SIZE == 0 or is omitted, ATTITUDE_DATA_LINES is authoritative
and ATTITUDE_DATA must be empty or ignored by parsers.
3. Do NOT populate both formats simultaneously.

MESSAGE_ID.description: Unique message identifier (504.0-B-2 table 4-2, optional). Added by B-2.

COMMENT.description: Plain-text comments carried in the message header, one entry per line.

CLASSIFICATION.description: Message classification/caveats in portion-marked format.

AGRSeries.description: One named series with parallel X and Y vectors.

AGR.description: Aggregation Result - one summary over one standard's records.

SCHEMA_NAME.description: Standard code of the records aggregated, e.g. "OMM".

SQL.description: SQL selection the aggregate was computed over, when any.

X_FIELD.description: Field on the X axis; may be a derived field the serving node computes.

Y_FIELDS.description: Fields on the Y axis, one series each.

X_IS_TIME.description: True when X values are Unix milliseconds.

X_UNIT.description: Unit of X when the standard declares one.

ROW_KEYS.description: Row keys of a pivot in display order.

COL_KEYS.description: Column keys of a pivot in display order.

SCANNED.description: Records scanned to compute the aggregate.

STORED.description: Records the serving node holds for the standard.

PARTIAL.description: True when a bounded scan returned before covering every stored record.

TRUNCATED.description: True when a category or pivot was cut to its top entries.

ELAPSED_MS.description: Milliseconds the serving node spent computing the aggregate.

AS_OF_MS.description: Unix milliseconds the serving numbers were last true.

SOURCE_ID.description: Reference to source imagery (e.g., SKI, GDI, EOO)

EXCEEDANCE_PERCENT.description:
Percent of time a loss value is exceeded, in descending or ascending
order as stated by PROVENANCE. Every curve below has this length.

XPD_DB.description: Cross-polarization discrimination at each exceedance percentage, dB.

WORST_MONTH_EXCEEDANCE_PERCENT.description: Exceedance percentage used for the worst-month summary.

AVAILABILITY_PERCENT.description: Percentage of the analysis window meeting the stated link requirement.

OUTAGE_MINUTES_PER_YEAR.description: Annualized minutes not meeting the stated link requirement.

WORST_MONTH_OUTAGE_MINUTES.description: Worst-month outage minutes for the analysis window's month length.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

APPModuleRef.description:
One member WASM module of the app. References module identity; never
embeds the module artifact itself (delivery is the module-bundle lane).

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this module. Required, unique within
the manifest.

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin identifier of the module as published in its plugin listing.

CONTENT_HASH.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the module's
portable (pre-AOT, publication-trailer-stripped) WASM bytes. This is
the identity capability policies and signature policies key on.

VERSION.description: Module version expected by the app.

ROLE.description: Free-text launcher hint, for example primary, worker, or ui-host.

MAX_WALL_CLOCK_MS.description:
Per-invocation wall-clock budget override in milliseconds. Zero means
the host runtime default applies.

MAX_COST_UNITS.description:
Per-invocation execution-cost (fuel) budget override. Zero means the
host runtime default applies.

MAX_MEMORY_PAGES.description:
Linear-memory ceiling override in 64 KiB WASM pages. Zero means the
host runtime default applies.

RUNTIME_TARGET.description:
Where this module is instantiated. PAGE or BOTH means the module also
loads in the browser: the page resolves its bytes by CONTENT_HASH over
IPFS and instantiates it through the SAME isomorphic module-sdk harness
ABI the SDN nodes use (manifest + plugin_invoke_stream) — never through
a bespoke page-only loader. Defaults to NODE to preserve the prior
node-only behavior of manifests written before this field existed.

APPDataRef.description:
One SDS record type the app produces and/or consumes. Names an existing
spacedatastandards.org schema by its established code; the app manifest
defines no data schemas of its own.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this data binding. Required, unique
within the manifest.

SDS_TYPE.description: Existing SDS schema code, for example OMM, CDM, or EPM. Required.

DIRECTION.description: Data flow relative to the app.

MODULE_ID.description:
When present, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same manifest — the
member module responsible for this data binding.

APPSourceRef.description: One upstream data source the app depends on.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this source. Required, unique within
the manifest.

REF.description:
Source identifier: an APPModuleRef.ID when KIND is MODULE, otherwise a
URL or dataset identifier. Required.

APPUIPage.description:
One UI page of the app. Exactly one of the two delivery mechanisms must
be populated: inline CONTENT (with ENCODING describing its string form),
or MODULE_ID plus URL for a page served by a member module. Inline pages
must be fully self-contained — CSS and JS inlined, all assets embedded
as data URIs, zero external requests.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this page. Required, unique within the
manifest.

TITLE.description: Display title. Falls back to the app NAME when empty.

DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable summary. Falls back to the app DESCRIPTION when empty.

ICON.description: Launcher icon identifier or inline data URI.

COLOR.description: Launcher accent color, CSS color syntax.

TEXT_COLOR.description: Launcher text color, CSS color syntax.

CONTENT.description:
Inlined, self-contained page in the string form declared by ENCODING.
Empty when the page is module-served via MODULE_ID and URL.

ENCODING.description: String form of CONTENT.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: IANA media type of the decoded page bytes, for example text/html.

CONTENT_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the decoded
page bytes, so a launcher can verify inline content after decoding.

ENTRY.description:
True for the page the launcher opens first. Exactly one page in an
app must set this when UI is present.

MODULE_ID.description:
When module-served, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same
manifest — the member module that serves this page.

URL.description:
When module-served, the path or entrypoint the module serves the page
at.

APPDataflow.description:
One unit of the page's data contract: a named flow describing what data
enters or leaves the running page, the SDS standard it carries, how it is
transported, and — when applicable — the loaded module method port bound
to it. Standards-only rule: every flow payload is an SDS record (a
canonical size-prefixed FlatBuffer) or a CID pointing at one; this table
defines no data shapes of its own, it only references an existing
spacedatastandards.org schema by its established code. Locators are
content-addressed and IPFS-first.

NAME.description:
App-local stable name for this flow. Required, unique within the
manifest.

DIRECTION.description: Which way the payload crosses the page boundary at runtime.

SDS_SCHEMA.description:
Existing SDS schema code carried by this flow, for example OMM, OEM, or
PNM. Required. Mirrors APPDataRef.SDS_TYPE but named for the standard
the flow carries; the app defines no schema of its own.

TRANSPORT.description:
Transport that moves the payload. Defaults to IPFS_CID per the
content-addressed, IPFS-first rule.

LOCATOR.description:
Where to fetch or reach the payload, interpreted per TRANSPORT: a CID
for IPFS_CID, a gossip topic name for PUBSUB_TOPIC, or a same-origin
route template for GATEWAY_ROUTE.

MODULE_ID.description:
When present, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same manifest — the
loaded module that produces or consumes this flow. Binds the flow to a
specific module method port together with METHOD_ID and PORT_ID.

METHOD_ID.description:
When present, the PLG.PLGMethodManifest.METHOD_ID on MODULE_ID that
this flow is bound to.

PORT_ID.description:
When present, the PLG.PLGPortManifest.PORT_ID on METHOD_ID that this
flow is bound to.

CONTENT_ENCODING.description:
String/compression form of the payload as it crosses the channel,
reusing the page content-encoding vocabulary. For flows carrying
canonical SDS FlatBuffer bytes (or a CID string), UTF8 denotes the raw
bytes/string with no extra wrapper; BASE64, BASE64_GZIP, and
BASE64_BROTLI denote a base64 text wrapper (optionally compressed)
applied when the channel is text-only.

APP.description: Application Package Manifest — one launchable app.

ID.description: Stable app identity, unique per publisher. Required.

MODULES.description:
Member WASM modules. Referential integrity: every MODULE_ID and every
MODULE-kind REF elsewhere in the manifest must resolve into this list.

DATA.description: SDS record types produced and consumed.

SOURCES.description: Upstream sources depended on.

UI.description: UI pages. Exactly one entry page when nonempty.

CREATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the manifest was created.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the manifest was last updated.

DATAFLOW.description:
The page's declarative data contract: what data enters and leaves the
running page and how. Referential integrity: every MODULE_ID here must
resolve into MODULES, and each MODULE_ID/METHOD_ID/PORT_ID triple must
name a method port advertised by that module's PLG manifest.

RUNTIME_CLASS.description:
App-wide runtime class, reusing appRuntimeTarget. Lets a pulled manifest
self-describe where the app as a whole is meant to run, instead of that
classification being supplied externally at install time. This is the
app-level DEFAULT/DECLARATION only: an individual APPModuleRef.
RUNTIME_TARGET still governs where that specific member module loads and
may specialize away from RUNTIME_CLASS (for example a NODE-class app
with one PAGE-capable module). Defaults to NODE to preserve the prior
node-only assumption of manifests written before this field existed.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified $CCT category this app is shelved under, using the same
vocabulary and the same semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY, so a storefront
or library shelf holds apps and modules together without translating
between two classification schemes. RUNTIME_CLASS says WHERE an app runs;
PRIMARY_CATEGORY says WHAT IT DOES. They are independent: a NODE-class app
and a PAGE-class app can share a category.
UNSPECIFIED means the publisher did not classify the app; a consumer
renders it ungrouped and never infers a class.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified $CCT category this app belongs to, for browse, filter and
per-category counting. An app MAY carry several. If nonempty it MUST
include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.

EPOCH.description: Observation epoch (ISO 8601)

SENSOR_ID.description: Sensor identifier providing the observation

YEAR.description: Four-digit year identifying the model version (e.g., 1970, 2008, 2020)

AVLProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one airspace volume.

Required on every record: a redistributed volume whose dataset, epoch,
and licence are unstated is not publishable. Dataset identity is DATA;
the standard names no dataset, provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the aeronautical dataset
this volume was taken from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this
volume was decoded from — the edition boundary (e.g. an AIRAC cycle
effective date), not the fetch.

DATASET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when the publisher
distributes one.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or file selection used.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source dataset's own identifier for this volume, verbatim. The
join key back to the source; never re-minted by the publisher.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description: RFC 3339 UTC date the source last modified this volume, as it states.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this volume record. Never the source's
own identifier, which rides verbatim in SOURCE.NATIVE_ID.

DESIGNATOR.description: Published designator of the volume, verbatim (e.g. an area designator).

NAME.description: Published display name of the volume, verbatim.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.

FLOOR_VALUE.description:
Lower vertical limit, metres in FLOOR_DATUM (flight-level number when
FLOOR_DATUM is FLIGHT_LEVEL; NaN when SURFACE). NaN when unpublished.

CEILING_VALUE.description:
Upper vertical limit, metres in CEILING_DATUM (flight-level number
when FLIGHT_LEVEL; NaN when UNLIMITED). NaN when unpublished.

EFFECTIVE_FROM.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant this volume becomes effective.

EFFECTIVE_TO.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant this volume ceases. Absent for
a volume with no published end.

TIME_OF_ACTIVITY.description:
Activity schedule verbatim as the source publishes it (NOTAM-style
text). Never parsed into structure by the publisher: schedule grammar
is source-specific and coercion would invent activations.

VERTEX_LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Vertex latitudes, geodetic degrees in [-90, 90]. Same length as
VERTEX_LONGITUDE_DEG.

RING_OFFSETS.description: Ring start indexes; RING_COUNT + 1 entries, last equals vertex count.

RING_POLYGON_INDEXES.description:
Polygon each ring belongs to. One entry per ring, so its length is
RING_OFFSETS length - 1.

RING_ROLES.description:
Role of each ring. One entry per ring, so its length is RING_OFFSETS
length - 1.

POLYGON_COUNT.description:
Number of polygons; equals max(RING_POLYGON_INDEXES) + 1, published so
an empty geometry is distinguishable from an unpopulated record.

ARC_DENSIFIED.description:
The source's arc or circle boundary segments were densified into the
vertices above by the ingest.

DENSIFICATION_TOLERANCE_M.description:
Maximum deviation, metres, between a densified chord and the published
arc. Required knowledge when ARC_DENSIFIED; NaN otherwise.

BEMProvenance.description: Provenance of a deployed-beam descriptor or hop schedule.

BEMHopSlot.description: One time slice of a periodic beam-hopping plan.

BEAM_ID.description:
Beam activated in this slot. May name this BEM.ID or another beam in a
coordinated schedule.

BEMHopSchedule.description: Periodic beam-hopping schedule carried by a deployed beam descriptor.

EPOCH.description: Seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC at which slot offsets begin.

GAIN.description: Gain level in dBi at this contour

EIRP.description: EIRP at beam center in dBW

G_OVER_T.description: G/T at beam center in dB/K

HOP_SCHEDULE.description: Time-sliced activation plan for this deployed beam.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

FlatBufferTypeRef.description: Payload-schema identity for a stream frame or an accepted port type.

SCHEMA_VERSION.description: Optional semver or schema revision string.

ROOT_TYPE.description: Optional root type name within the schema.

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Optional schema hash bytes for stronger compatibility checks.

ACCEPTS_ANY_FLATBUFFER.description: True when this port/type set accepts any FlatBuffer frame.

WIRE_FORMAT.description: Logical wire format for this accepted type.

FIXED_STRING_LENGTH.description: Fixed string length for aligned-binary string fields, when applicable.

BYTE_LENGTH.description: Byte length for fixed-size aligned-binary records, when applicable.

REQUIRED_ALIGNMENT.description: Required start alignment for aligned-binary records, when applicable.

TAB.description: Typed Arena Buffer — one descriptor for a payload slot in a shared arena.

OFFSET.description: Byte offset of the payload body within the arena.

SIZE.description: Byte length of the payload body.

ALIGNMENT.description: Required start alignment of the payload body (in bytes).

FRAME_ID.description: Optional opaque frame identifier for stream bookkeeping.

PORT_ID.description:
Optional port identifier for frames that route to/from a named
input or output port on a method (maps to
`PLG.PLGPortManifest.PORT_ID`). Empty for arena frames that carry
no port routing hint.

PLGAcceptedTypeSet.description:
Accepted schema family for a port. When a port accepts multiple wire
formats (canonical FlatBuffer + aligned-binary), each ALLOWED_TYPE
entry carries its own TAB.FlatBufferTypeRef with the schema identity,
and the enclosing PLGPortManifest advertises both wire formats via
ALLOWED_WIRE_FORMATS. Per SDK contract: a port that advertises
aligned-binary MUST also advertise the canonical flatbuffer fallback
for the same schema and file identifier in the same set.

SET_ID.description: Stable type-set identifier within the port.

ALLOWED_TYPES.description: Specific FlatBuffer types accepted by the set.

ALLOWED_WIRE_FORMATS.description:
Wire formats this set accepts. If ALIGNED_BINARY is present,
FLATBUFFER MUST also be present for the same schemas.

DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable explanation of the accepted schema family.

PLGPortManifest.description: One input or output port on a method.

PORT_ID.description: Stable port identifier within the method.

DISPLAY_NAME.description: Human-readable name for UIs.

ACCEPTED_TYPE_SETS.description: Type sets accepted on this port.

MIN_STREAMS.description: Minimum number of streams that must be connected.

MAX_STREAMS.description: Maximum number of streams that may be connected.

REQUIRED.description: Whether the port must be connected for invocation.

PLGHostCapability.description: One host capability dependency (richer form of PluginCapability).

PLGTimerSpec.description: Timer entry declared by a plugin.

PLGProtocolSpec.description: Protocol handler declared by a plugin.

PLGBuildArtifact.description: Build artifact emitted by the plugin toolchain.

NAME.description: Function name as exported from WASM

PLGFlowNode.description:
One node in a composed flow graph. A degenerate flow IS a module: a leaf
module leaves the flow-graph fields on PLG empty; a composed flow populates
them. This is how flows reuse the module schema rather than a separate one.

NODE_ID.description: Stable node identifier within this flow

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin id of the module this node invokes

METHOD_ID.description: Method id invoked on the module

DISPATCH_MODEL.description:
Dispatch model: empty = linked-direct (in-wasm), "isomorphic" = an
independently instantiated signed WASM node, and "host-capability" = a
generic host adapter.

CONFIG.description: Opaque per-node configuration (FlatBuffer or raw bytes; never JSON)

CANONICAL_TYPE.description:
Canonical SDS identity carried by the edge. NOT `required`: an edge may
be opaque by design (see OPAQUE), and a signer must never be forced to
invent an identity to satisfy the schema. A contract MUST carry exactly
one of CANONICAL_TYPE or OPAQUE = true; a contract with neither, or with
both, is invalid and MUST be rejected by the compiler that signs the flow.

OPAQUE.description:
The edge carries bytes with no SDS identity BY DESIGN — an
application-blind host-capability adapter (an HTTP body, a raw file
chunk) or a timer TICK frame with no payload at all. This is a deliberate
signed assertion of opacity, which is why it is an explicit flag rather
than an absent CANONICAL_TYPE: a missing type must stay distinguishable
from a declared-opaque one. An opaque edge is ineligible for the aligned
route, so ALIGNED_ELIGIBLE MUST be false when OPAQUE is true.

PLGFlowEdge.description: One directed edge wiring a producer output port to a consumer input port.

CONTRACT.description:
Exact identity/layout and compile-time representation policy. NOT
`required`: marking a NEW field of an EXISTING table required makes the
FlatBuffers verifier reject every $PLG buffer written before 1.0.13,
which is a breaking change to a ratified standard. Presence is enforced
where it belongs — the flow compiler MUST refuse to SIGN a flow whose
edges lack a CONTRACT, and a verifier MUST reject a signed flow edge
without one. Buffers predating 1.0.13 stay readable and stay unsigned.

PLGFlowTrigger.description: One flow trigger (e.g. a host timer or HTTP route) that starts a drain.

DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS.description: Default firing interval in milliseconds (timer triggers)

PLGFlowTriggerBinding.description: Binds a trigger to the node + input port it delivers its frame to.

PLG.description: Plugin Manifest - canonical signed storefront and WASM distribution record

TAGLINE.description: Short marketing summary shown in storefront listings

SUPPORT_URL.description: Support or helpdesk URL for this plugin

TAGS.description: Search and categorization tags for discovery

FEATURES.description: Short feature bullets highlighted in storefront listings

SCREENSHOT_URLS.description: Screenshot URLs showing the plugin in use

BANNER_URL.description: Optional hero/banner image URL for the listing

WASM_HASH.description: SHA256 hash of the decrypted WASM binary

WASM_SIZE.description: Size of decrypted WASM binary in bytes

WASM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the encrypted WASM binary

ENCRYPTED_WASM_HASH.description: SHA256 hash of the encrypted delivery artifact bytes

ENCRYPTED_WASM_SIZE.description: Size of the encrypted delivery artifact in bytes

ENTRY_FUNCTIONS.description: Entry point functions exported by the plugin

REQUIRED_SCHEMAS.description: FlatBuffer schemas required by this plugin

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the plugin provider

PROVIDER_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of provider's EPM (Entity Profile Message)

ENCRYPTED.description: Whether the WASM binary is encrypted

REQUIRED_SCOPE.description: Canonical required scope for grant issuance

KEY_ID.description: Provider-local identifier for the module content key

MAX_GRANT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum grant timeout allowed for this module publication

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when plugin was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when plugin was last updated

CHANGELOG_URL.description: URL to plugin changelog or release notes

LICENSE.description: License identifier (SPDX format)

PAYMENT_MODEL.description: Commercial model used for storefront purchase flows

PRICE_USD_CENTS.description: Price in USD cents for one-time purchase or subscription period

SUBSCRIPTION_PERIOD_DAYS.description: Subscription billing period length in days

LISTING_STATUS.description: Storefront publication state for this manifest version

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider over manifest

INVOKE_SURFACES.description:
Canonical invoke surfaces this artifact exposes. A single plugin
MAY list both DIRECT and COMMAND when it supports both.

METHODS.description:
Rich per-method invoke manifests (port shape, drain semantics,
accepted wire formats). ENTRY_FUNCTIONS retains the slim
name+input_schemas+output_schema summary; METHODS carries the full
invoke-surface detail including aligned-binary advertisement.

HOST_CAPABILITIES.description:
Enum-typed host capability dependencies (richer than CAPABILITIES,
which is string-tagged metadata).

SCHEMAS_USED.description: FlatBuffer schemas this plugin depends on at the invoke surface.

BUILD_ARTIFACTS.description: Build artifacts emitted by the toolchain (WASM, bindings, etc.).

ALLOWED_XPUBS.description:
Allowed requester xpub identities (BIP-32 account xpubs) for module grants:
a requester whose verified EPM binds an xpub in this list is granted (PKI
identity authorization). Empty list = no xpub allowlist gate.

FLOW_NODES.description:
Composition graph (a degenerate flow is a module): the nodes this flow
invokes. Empty for a leaf module; populated for a composed flow. The flow
definition is this PLG FlatBuffer, not a bespoke JSON graph.

FLOW_EDGES.description: Composition-graph edges wiring node output ports to input ports.

FLOW_TRIGGERS.description: Flow triggers (timer/http) that start a drain.

FLOW_TRIGGER_BINDINGS.description: Bindings from triggers to the node + input port they deliver to.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified $CCT category this module is shelved under. This is the
category a storefront capsule, a library shelf and a breadcrumb show when
exactly one must be chosen. UNSPECIFIED means the publisher did not
classify the module; a consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

This supersedes PLUGIN_TYPE for all storefront, library and search
surfaces. PLUGIN_TYPE remains on the wire and is not removed, but its
`pluginCategory` vocabulary mixes capability families with node-internal
plumbing, carries a legacy vendor-derived member, holds a real family at
ordinal 0, and admits only one value. Canonical migration, applied by a
publisher rewriting an old manifest:
Sensor->SENSORS_AND_COVERAGE, Propagator->PROPAGATION,
Renderer->VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING,
Analysis->MISSION_DESIGN_AND_ANALYSIS,
DataSource->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST, EW->ELECTRONIC_WARFARE,
Comms->RF_AND_COMMUNICATIONS, Physics->SPACE_ENVIRONMENT,
Shader->VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING, Parser->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST,
Validator->DATA_VALIDATION_AND_QUALITY, Interpolator->PROPAGATION,
Exporter->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST, Foundation->FOUNDATION_AND_MATH,
Infrastructure->NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE, Licensing->COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING,
Storefront->COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING, Publisher->NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE,
Basilisk->PROPAGATION, Maneuver->MANEUVER_PLANNING,
Flow->FLOW_AND_COMPOSITION, Unspecified->UNSPECIFIED.
The mapping is one-way: PRIMARY_CATEGORY is never back-derived into
PLUGIN_TYPE.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified $CCT category this module belongs to, for browse, filter
and per-category counting. A module MAY carry several. If nonempty it
MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat. An empty list with
a set PRIMARY_CATEGORY means the module belongs to that one category.

BPFPart.description:
One variable part of the build template and whether this profile embeds
it.

PART_ID.description:
Template slot identifier this entry configures, as published by the
template's part manifest. Required, unique within the profile.

INCLUDED.description: True when the part is embedded in the produced artifact.

CONTENT_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the part's
bytes as published by the template, so a composed artifact can be
verified against the profile that produced it.

BYTE_LENGTH.description: Size of the part's bytes in octets, as published by the template.

BPFModule.description:
One module selected into the build and the tier its payload is protected
at.

MODULE_ID.description: Canonical module identifier. Required, unique within the profile.

INCLUDED.description: True when the module is embedded in the produced artifact.

PROTECTION.description: Protection tier applied to this module's payload.

CONTENT_HASH.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the module's
portable (pre-AOT, publication-trailer-stripped) bytes. This is the
identity a capability or signature policy keys on.

MODULE_DESCRIPTOR.description:
Published module descriptor, carried when the authoring context holds
it. Advisory: `MODULE_ID` and `CONTENT_HASH` are the identity, and a
consumer MUST NOT prefer a carried descriptor over the module's own
published manifest.

BPFRuntimeLock.description:
The runtime restriction the produced artifact enforces on itself.

AUTHORIZATION. A host is authorized when it equals an `ALLOWED_DOMAINS`
entry, OR ends with an `ALLOWED_TLDS` entry, OR equals a `DEV_DOMAINS`
entry. Suffix rules are DOT-ANCHORED: `.mil` admits `x.mil` and `a.b.mil`
and admits neither `mil` nor `evilmil`; a suffix rule never matches a
host that merely contains it (`x.mil.example` is refused).

UNLOCKED IS EXPLICIT. `ALLOWED_DOMAINS` empty AND `ALLOWED_TLDS` empty
means every host is authorized. This is a stated, allowed configuration,
which is why this table is required on `BPF`: an absent lock is never
read as an unlocked one.

EXPIRY IS INDEPENDENT of authorization: an unlocked profile still
expires. There is deliberately no stored expiry instant — expiry is
`COMPILED_AT_MS + TTL_DAYS * 86400000` and a second, storable copy of it
could disagree with the two values that produce it.

ALLOWED_DOMAINS.description:
Exact hostnames authorized to run the produced artifact. Empty
together with `ALLOWED_TLDS` means unrestricted.

ALLOWED_TLDS.description:
Dot-anchored hostname suffix rules, each written with its leading dot,
for example `.gov`. Empty together with `ALLOWED_DOMAINS` means
unrestricted.

DEV_DOMAINS.description:
Development hosts authorized in addition to the rules above, so a
locked profile remains runnable in a development context. Kept
separate from `ALLOWED_DOMAINS` because a development exemption and a
deployment authorization are different facts: folded together, a
development host would be indistinguishable from a deployment grant
and would silently persist into a locked artifact.

TTL_DAYS.description:
Lifetime of the produced artifact in days from `COMPILED_AT_MS`.
Normative range 1 through 365 inclusive; 180 when unstated. A value of
0 or above 365 is invalid and MUST be rejected, never clamped.

COMPILED_AT_MS.description:
Milliseconds since the Unix epoch at which the artifact was composed.
0 means the profile has not been used to compose an artifact yet and
carries no expiry; the composing step stamps it.

BPFAttestation.description:
The publisher's attestation over this profile, in BOTH ratified forms.

PRESENCE IS THE STATEMENT. A profile is SIGNED if and only if this table
is present; a profile whose `ATTESTATION` is absent is UNSIGNED, and a
consumer marks it as such. There is deliberately no boolean saying so: a
self-asserted "signed" flag is attacker-controlled and proves nothing,
while presence of the table is checkable.

FAIL CLOSED. When this table is present, every field below MUST be
present and BOTH signatures MUST verify independently against
`SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY`. A profile whose attestation is incomplete, or
whose either signature fails, is REJECTED — it is NEVER downgraded to
"unsigned and therefore acceptable", which would let stripping one
signature launder a tampered profile past an importer that admits
unsigned input.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
The signer's LITERAL Ed25519 public key, 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters. A derivation ancestor is structurally absent from this
standard: publishing one lets any holder of a child key walk the
signer's whole key tree. Rotation is republication.

SIGNED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
at which the attestation was produced.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

BPF.description:
Build Profile — one saved, portable build configuration.

PORTABILITY. The export unit is a `$REC` collection carrying this record
and, optionally, an `$APP` manifest that names it through an `APPDataRef`
with `SDS_TYPE: "BPF"`. The `$APP` wrapper is launcher metadata and
carries no authority; all authority over a profile lives in
`ATTESTATION`. A bare size-prefixed `$BPF` buffer is also a complete,
valid export.

PROFILE_ID.description: Stable profile identity, unique per author. Required.

NAME.description: Display name of the profile. Required.

CREATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the profile was created.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the profile was last updated.

TEMPLATE_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the build
template this profile was authored against. Required: a profile that
does not say which template it configures cannot be validated against
one. A consumer holding a different template MAY still import the
profile but MUST mark it as authored against another template and MUST
NOT silently re-map its parts.

PARTS.description:
Template slots and their inclusion decisions. A slot the template
exposes and this vector omits is NOT included.

MODULES.description: Modules selected into the build and their protection tiers.

RUNTIME_LOCK.description:
The runtime restriction the produced artifact enforces. Required, so
that an unlocked build is a stated configuration rather than a missing
one.

LICENSE_MODE.description: Distribution-control mode of the produced artifact.

ATTESTATION.description:
Publisher attestation. Absent means the profile is unsigned; see
`BPFAttestation` for the fail-closed rule when it is present.

BSPVector3Series.description: Three coordinate arrays sharing one time vector.

T.description: Sample or waypoint time tags in seconds.

WAYPOINTS.description: Waypoint times and coordinates. T, X1, X2, and X3 must have equal length.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description: Number of equally spaced output samples.

POLYNOMIAL_ORDER.description: Polynomial order of the B-spline basis.

HAS_X_DOT_0.description: Whether X_DOT_0 contains the first derivative at the first waypoint.

X_DOT_0.description: Optional first derivative at the first waypoint, length 3.

HAS_X_DOT_N.description: Whether X_DOT_N contains the first derivative at the last waypoint.

X_DOT_N.description: Optional first derivative at the last waypoint, length 3.

HAS_X_D_DOT_0.description: Whether X_D_DOT_0 contains the second derivative at the first waypoint.

X_D_DOT_0.description: Optional second derivative at the first waypoint, length 3.

HAS_X_D_DOT_N.description: Whether X_D_DOT_N contains the second derivative at the last waypoint.

X_D_DOT_N.description: Optional second derivative at the last waypoint, length 3.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace/correlation identifier.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

XD1.description: First derivative of coordinate 1 at each output sample.

XD2.description: First derivative of coordinate 2 at each output sample.

XD3.description: First derivative of coordinate 3 at each output sample.

XDD1.description: Second derivative of coordinate 1 at each output sample.

XDD2.description: Second derivative of coordinate 2 at each output sample.

XDD3.description: Second derivative of coordinate 3 at each output sample.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

SIZE.description: Bus size category

WET_MASS.description: Maximum wet mass (with propellant) in kg

ETM.description:
Entity Metadata — generic queryable metadata for a host-local entity.
Participates in shared FlatSQL/WASM runtimes where multiple plugins
cross-query the same entity collection.

NAME.description: Human-readable entity name used for shared query/search surfaces.

SUBTYPE.description: More specific runtime subtype or class name.

PARENT_ENTITY_ID.description: Optional parent entity id for hierarchy / linkage queries.

WASM_HANDLE.description: Collection-scoped WASM handle used for batch visibility application.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Optional NORAD catalog id for standards-backed entities.

OBJECT_NAME.description: Primary object name surfaced by attached standards metadata.

OBJECT_ID.description: Primary international / object designator surfaced by attached standards metadata.

CAT_OBJECT_NAME.description: Secondary CAT object name when different from the primary object name.

CAT_OBJECT_ID.description: Secondary CAT object id when different from the primary object id.

FACILITY_TYPE.description: Ground / facility subtype metadata for non-space entity search.

SEARCH_TEXT.description: Pre-normalized phrase-search text for collection-wide shared queries.

LAUNCH_YEAR.description: Launch year derived from launch date.

MEAN_MOTION.description: Mean motion in revolutions per day.

HAS_GP.description: Whether GP / OMM state is present for the entity.

QUERY.description: Host-specific query string (for example a FlatSQL or DSL expression).

MAX_COUNT.description: Upper bound on the number of rows / indices to return (0 = unbounded).

ENTITY_COUNT.description:
Expected number of entities in the catalog at the time the request was
issued, used to size visibility masks.

MASK.description: Populated when KIND == VISIBILITY_MASK (one byte per entity).

VISIBLE_COUNT.description: Number of visible (masked-in) entities in MASK.

ROW.description: Single matched row when KIND == CATALOG_ROW.

CAQ.description: Catalog query envelope — carries either a request or a result payload.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

NAME.description: Display name of the owner or source the code stands for.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer description of the owner or source.

ACTIVE.description: True while the code is in current use by the publishing catalogue.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the reference table the row was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the reference table was retrieved.

OBJECT_ID.description: International Designator (YYYY-NNNAAA)

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD Catalog Number

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Object type (Payload, Rocket body, Debris, Unknown)

RCS.description: Radar Cross Section [meters2]; blank if no data available

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type (Orbit, Landing, Impact, Docked to RSO, roundtrip)

MANEUVERABLE.description: Indicates if the object is maneuverable

SIZE.description: Size [meters]; blank if no data available

MASS.description: Mass [kilograms]; blank if no data available

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

PNM.description:
Publish Notification Message.

PNM is the compact network announcement for a published record, manifest, or
dataset update. For dataset updates, FILE_ID is the complete canonical
identity for the published update and CID usually points to a small DPM
manifest or digest. The DPM carries the full verification contract:
provider identity, retrieval protocol, canonical query, result hash, Merkle
roots, completeness-capable indexes, file_id partition key, and signature.
Large or paid dataset updates do not need to be published as globally
discoverable IPFS files; a PNM may instead advertise a provider-mediated SDN
query protocol. In that mode the PNM is only the announcement. The DPM is
the signed commitment, and each provider response carries records plus
Merkle proof material that the subscriber verifies against the DPM roots and
the announced FILE_ID before import.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description:
Multiformat Address
As specified by the multiaddr specification.
A universal address format for representing multiple network protocols. Examples include:
- /ip4/192.168.1.1/tcp/80 for an IPv4 address with TCP protocol
- /ip6zone/x/ip6/::1 for an IPv6 address with a zone
- /dns4/example.com for a domain name resolvable only to IPv4 addresses
- /ipfs/bafybeiccfclkdtucu6y4yc5cpr6y3yuinr67svmii46v5cfcrkp47ihehy/README.txt -IPFS address w/CID and path to `README.txt`.

PUBLISH_TIMESTAMP.description: Publish Time OF THE Publish Notification Message

CID.description:
Concatenated Content Identifier (CID)
This field is a unique ID for distributed systems (CID).
The CID provides a unique identifier within distributed systems, as
detailed in the multiformats CID specification.
For dataset-update PNMs this SHOULD identify a compact DPM manifest,
manifest digest, or other small verification object, not necessarily the
full dataset bytes.

FILE_NAME.description:
File ID
This field is the Name

FILE_ID.description:
File ID
Canonical publication/update partition identity. For dataset-update PNMs,
this MUST match DPM.FILE_ID and is the stable key used everywhere an SDN
component refers to the update: PNMs, DPMs, assets, entitlements, provider
query requests, subscriber caches, replay, audit, and completeness
verification. Provider-mediated query requests and responses MUST bind
their Merkle leaves and proof paths to this FILE_ID, and subscribers MUST
reject responses whose DPM, records, or proofs bind to a different FILE_ID.
Example: provider-slug:gp:OMM.fbs:2026-05-06T03:00:00Z.

SIGNATURE.description:
Digital Signature of the CID
This is the digital signature of the CID, signed using the specified cryptographic method.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE.description:
Timestamp Signature
Digital signature of the publish timestamp, using the specified cryptographic method for timestamp verification.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used
Specifies the type of cryptographic signature used for the SIGNATURE field, indicating the specific blockchain technology, such as Ethereum or BTC.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used for Timestamp
Specifies the type of cryptographic signature used for the TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE field, indicating the specific blockchain technology, such as Ethereum or BTC.

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"compact"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM
(raw-ed25519 for ed25519, compact for secp256k1)

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

KEY_PATH.description: BIP-44 derivation path (e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0")

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description: Signature encoding format (e.g., "compact", "raw-ed25519")

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —
