OB_TIME.description: Ob detection time in ISO 8601 UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ssssssZ), up to microsecond precision.

CORR_QUALITY.description: Correlation score of the observation when compared to a known orbit state.

ID_ON_ORBIT.description: Server will auto-populate with SAT_NO if available.

SENSOR_ID.description: Unique ID of the sensor. Must have a corresponding sensor record on the server.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: 18SDS satellite number. Only list if correlated against the 18SDS catalog.

TASK_ID.description: Identifier for the collectRequest message if the collection was in response to tasking.

TRANSACTION_ID.description: Optional identifier to track a transaction.

IMAGE_SET_ID.description: The user-defined set ID of a sequence of images.

IMAGE_SET_LENGTH.description: The number of images in an image set.

SEQUENCE_ID.description: The sequence ID of an image within an image set.

OB_POSITION.description: The position of this observation within a track (FENCE, FIRST, IN, LAST, SINGLE).

ORIG_OBJECT_ID.description: Provider maintained ID. May not be consistent with 18SDS SAT_NO.

UCT.description: Required if correlation is attempted. Indicates whether correlation succeeded.

AZIMUTH.description: Line of sight azimuth angle in degrees and topocentric frame.

AZIMUTH_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight azimuth angle, in degrees.

AZIMUTH_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight azimuth angle bias in degrees.

AZIMUTH_RATE.description: Rate of change of the line of sight azimuth in degrees per second.

ELEVATION.description: Line of sight elevation in degrees and topocentric frame.

ELEVATION_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight elevation angle, in degrees.

ELEVATION_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight elevation bias in degrees.

ELEVATION_RATE.description: Rate of change of the line of sight elevation in degrees per second.

RANGE.description: Line of sight range in km. Reported value should include all applicable corrections.

RANGE_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight range, in km.

RANGE_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight range bias in km.

RANGE_RATE.description: Range rate in km/s. Reported value should include all applicable corrections.

RANGE_RATE_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight range rate, in km/sec.

RA.description: Right ascension in degrees. Required metric reporting field for EO observations.

RA_RATE.description: Line of sight right ascension rate of change, in degrees/sec.

RA_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight right ascension angle, in degrees.

RA_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight right ascension bias in degrees.

DECLINATION.description: Declination in degrees. Required metric reporting field for EO observations.

DECLINATION_RATE.description: Line of sight declination rate of change, in degrees/sec.

DECLINATION_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight declination angle, in degrees.

DECLINATION_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight declination angle bias in degrees.

LOSX.description: X-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOSY.description: Y-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOSZ.description: Z-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOS_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line-of-sight direction vector components.

LOSXVEL.description: X-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

LOSYVEL.description: Y-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

LOSZVEL.description: Z-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

SENLAT.description: WGS-84 latitude in decimal degrees at the time of the observation.

SENLON.description: WGS-84 longitude in decimal degrees at the time of the observation.

SENALT.description: Sensor height in km relative to the WGS-84 ellipsoid at the time of the observation.

SENX.description: Cartesian X position in km at the time of the observation.

SENY.description: Cartesian Y position in km at the time of the observation.

SENZ.description: Cartesian Z position in km at the time of the observation.

FOV_COUNT.description: Total number of satellites in the field of view.

FOV_COUNT_UCTS.description: Number of uncorrelated satellites in the field of view (JCO).

EXP_DURATION.description:
Image exposure duration in seconds. For observations performed using frame stacking or synthetic tracking methods,
the exposure duration should be the total integration time. This field is highly recommended / required if the
observations are going to be used for photometric processing.

NET_OBJ_SIG_UNC.description: Net object signature uncertainty = counts uncertainty / EXP_DURATION.

MAG.description: Measure of observed brightness calibrated against the Gaia G-band.

GEOLAT.description:
Computed estimate of the latitude, positive degrees north. It should be computed based on the assumed slant range
and corresponding viewing geometry. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEOLON.description:
Computed estimate of the longitude as +/- 180 degrees east. It should be computed based on the assumed slant range
and viewing geometry. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEOALT.description: Computed estimate of satellite altitude in km at the reported location. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEORANGE.description: Computed estimate of the slant range in km. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

SKY_BKGRND.description:
Average Sky Background signal, in Magnitudes. Sky Background refers to the incoming light from an apparently
empty part of the night sky.

PRIMARY_EXTINCTION.description:
Primary Extinction Coefficient, in Magnitudes. Primary Extinction is the coefficient applied to the airmass
to determine how much the observed visual magnitude has been attenuated by the atmosphere. Extinction, in general,
describes the absorption and scattering of electromagnetic radiation by dust and gas between an emitting astronomical
object and the observer.

PRIMARY_EXTINCTION_UNC.description: Primary Extinction Coefficient Uncertainty, in Magnitudes.

SOLAR_PHASE_ANGLE.description:
The angle, in degrees, between the target-to-observer vector and the target-to-sun vector. Recommend using the
calculation listed in the EOSSA documentation, pg 106 of the EOSSA spec.

SOLAR_EQ_PHASE_ANGLE.description:
The angle, in degrees, between the projections of the target-to-observer vector and the target-to-sun vector
onto the equatorial plane. The convention used is negative when closing (i.e., before the opposition)
and positive when opening (after the opposition).

SOLAR_DEC_ANGLE.description: Angle from the sun to the equatorial plane.

RAW_FILE_URI.description: Optional URI location in the document repository of the raw file parsed by the system to produce this record.

INTENSITY.description: Intensity of the target for IR observations, in kw/sr/em.

BG_INTENSITY.description: Background intensity for IR observations, in kw/sr/um.

DESCRIPTOR.description: Optional source-provided and searchable metadata or descriptor of the data.

ORIGIN.description:
Originating system or organization which produced the data, if different from the source.
The origin may be different than the source if the source was a mediating system which forwarded
the data on behalf of the origin system. If null, the source may be assumed to be the origin.

DATA_MODE.description: Indicator of whether the data is EXERCISE, REAL, SIMULATED, or TEST.

CREATED_AT.description: Time the row was created in the database, auto-populated by the system.

CREATED_BY.description: Application user who created the row in the database, auto-populated by the system.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: EO observations are assumed to be topocentric J2000 coordinates ('J2000') as defined by the IAU, unless otherwise specified.

SEN_REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
The sensor reference frame is assumed to be the International Terrestrial Reference Frame (ITRF),
unless otherwise specified. (ITRF is equivalent to Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed (ECEF) for this purpose).
Lat / long / height values should be reported using the WGS-84 ellipsoid, where applicable.

UMBRA.description: Boolean indicating that the target object was in umbral eclipse at the time of this observation.

PENUMBRA.description:
Boolean indicating that the target object was in a penumbral eclipse at the time of this observation.
This field is highly recommended if the observations will be used for photometric processing.

ORIG_NETWORK.description: The originating source network on which this record was created, auto-populated by the system.

SOURCE_DL.description: The source from which this record was received.

AZIMUTH_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if azimuth is reported.

ELEVATION_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if elevation is reported.

RANGE_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if range is reported.

RANGERATE_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if range-rate is reported.

RA_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if right ascension is reported.

DECLINATION_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if declination is reported.

NIIRS.description: National Imagery Interpretability Rating Scale (NIIRS). Ranging from 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest).

METERS_PER_PIXEL.description: Ground sample distance in meters per pixel.

IMAGE_SNR.description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the image. Higher values indicate cleaner imagery.

IMAGE_WIDTH.description: Width of the image in pixels.

IMAGE_HEIGHT.description: Height of the image in pixels.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION.description: Compression type used for the image, e.g., "JPEG", "PNG", "RAW", etc.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION_RATIO.description: Compression ratio used (original size / compressed size), if applicable.

PROCESSED_IMAGE_URI.description: URI to the processed image used for this observation.

IMAGE_AUTO_ENHANCED.description: Flag indicating whether the image was auto-enhanced (e.g., contrast stretch, denoise).

MULTI_FRAME_STACKED.description: True if the observation was taken with multiple frames stacked into one image.

SYNTHETIC_TRACKING_USED.description: True if synthetic tracking was used to create the image.

IMAGE_SHARPNESS.description: Sharpness metric of the image based on the Tenengrad method or variance of Laplacian. Higher values indicate sharper images.

IMAGE_NOISE_STDDEV.description: Noise level of the image, estimated via pixel intensity variance in background regions.

IMAGE_CONTRAST.description: Contrast metric of the image, such as Michelson contrast or RMS contrast.

IMAGE_DYNAMIC_RANGE.description: Dynamic range of the image (max pixel value / min pixel value), indicating tonal spread.

IMAGE_ENTROPY.description: Entropy of the image, representing the richness of information content. Higher entropy suggests higher texture detail.

BACKGROUND_UNIFORMITY.description: Background uniformity metric (e.g., mean gradient in background areas). Lower values indicate more uniform background.

BACKGROUND_MEAN_LEVEL.description: Mean background level, computed from non-object regions in pixel units.

SATURATED_PIXEL_PERCENT.description: Percentage of saturated pixels in the image. Indicates overexposure when high.

DEAD_PIXEL_PERCENT.description: Percentage of dead or zero-value pixels in the image. Indicates sensor defects or underexposure.

PSF_FWHM.description: Estimated Point Spread Function (PSF) Full Width at Half Maximum (FWHM) in pixels. Indicates image blur or focus.

CLOUD_COVER_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of cloud cover in the image. Derived using cloud detection algorithms such as Fmask or machine learning classifiers.

CLOUD_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence score of the cloud detection result, from 0 (low confidence) to 1 (high confidence).

HAZE_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of the image obscured by haze or atmospheric scattering effects.

AEROSOL_OPTICAL_THICKNESS.description: Estimated aerosol optical thickness (AOT) at 550 nm, indicating particulate matter in the atmosphere affecting image clarity.

WATER_VAPOR_CONTENT.description: Estimated water vapor content (e.g., total column precipitable water) at the time of imaging, in mm.

SUN_ELEVATION.description: Sun elevation angle at the time of image capture, in degrees above the horizon.

SUN_AZIMUTH.description: Sun azimuth angle at the time of image capture, in degrees from true north.

VIEW_ZENITH_ANGLE.description: View zenith angle (sensor line-of-sight angle from nadir), in degrees.

VIEW_AZIMUTH_ANGLE.description: View azimuth angle (direction of sensor relative to north), in degrees.

OFF_NADIR_ANGLE.description: Off-nadir angle of the sensor at the time of image capture, in degrees.

SWATH_WIDTH_KM.description: Ground coverage width of the image swath in kilometers.

MEAN_TERRAIN_ELEVATION.description: Mean terrain elevation in the image footprint, in meters above sea level.

TERRAIN_ELEVATION_STDDEV.description: Standard deviation of terrain elevation in the image footprint, in meters.

SHADOW_COVER_PERCENT.description: Percentage of the image affected by shadows, derived via topographic or object shadow detection.

SUNGLINT_PRESENT.description: Flag indicating whether sunglint is present in the image (true if high reflectance from water surface due to sun geometry).

SUNGLINT_PERCENT.description: Percentage of image affected by sunglint.

SNOW_ICE_COVER_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of snow or ice coverage in the image footprint.

VALID_DATA_AREA_KM2.description: Total area covered by valid data (non-masked, usable imagery) in square kilometers.

MJD.description: Modified Julian Date in UTC, e.g., 58119

X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS.description: x component of Pole Wander in radians, e.g., 2.872908911518888E-7

Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS.description: y component of Pole Wander in radians, e.g., 1.2003259523750447E-6

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS.description: x component of Celestial Pole Offset in radians, e.g., 5.720801437092525E-10

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS.description: y component of Celestial Pole Offset in radians, e.g., -8.484239419416879E-10

UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: UT1 minus UTC in seconds, e.g., 0.2163567

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: TAI minus UTC in seconds, e.g., 37

LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS.description: Correction to Length of Day in seconds, e.g., 8.094E-4

SERIES.description:
Published series this row was taken from. Rows from different series are
NOT interchangeable at the microarcsecond level and must not be merged
without recording which series each row came from.

IAU_CONVENTION.description:
Precession-nutation model the celestial pole offsets are expressed
against. X_/Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS are CIP offsets in the GCRS
(dX, dY) under the IAU 2000/2006 conventions; a consumer cannot apply
them correctly without knowing which model produced them.

X_POLE_WANDER_UNCERTAINTY_RADIANS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in x Pole Wander, radians.

Y_POLE_WANDER_UNCERTAINTY_RADIANS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in y Pole Wander, radians.

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_UNCERTAINTY_RADI.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the x Celestial Pole Offset, radians.

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_UNCERTAINTY_RADI.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the y Celestial Pole Offset, radians.

UT1_MINUS_UTC_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in UT1 minus UTC, seconds.

LENGTH_OF_DAY_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the Length of Day correction, seconds.

X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS_HP.description:
x component of Pole Wander in radians, double precision. Authoritative
over X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS when present.

Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS_HP.description:
y component of Pole Wander in radians, double precision. Authoritative
over Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS when present.

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS_HP.description:
x component of the Celestial Pole Offset in radians, double precision.
Authoritative over X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS when present.

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS_HP.description:
y component of the Celestial Pole Offset in radians, double precision.
Authoritative over Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS when present.

UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS_HP.description:
UT1 minus UTC in seconds, double precision. Authoritative over
UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS when present.

LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS_HP.description:
Correction to Length of Day in seconds, double precision. Authoritative
over LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS when present.

DATA_SET_EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the data set this row was published in, ISO 8601 UTC. Identifies
WHICH issue of the series a consumer is holding; two rows for the same
MJD from different data-set epochs are different values, not duplicates.

DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the complete published data set this row was taken
from. Every frames consumer that must agree bit-for-bit records this so
the source is provable rather than assumed.

NUTATION_DPSI_RADIANS.description:
Nutation correction in longitude (dPsi) against the IAU 1980 model,
radians, as published beside the CIP offsets by combined rapid-service
series.

NUTATION_DEPS_RADIANS.description:
Nutation correction in obliquity (dEps) against the IAU 1980 model,
radians.

EPFContributor.description: One source's contribution to one sample.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Pattern discrimination applied in the victim direction, dB.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim measurement bandwidth overlapped [0-1].

EPFVerdict.description: FlatSQL-queryable compliance verdict consumed directly by `$RPT`.

MARGIN_DB.description: Worst margin to the applicable limit, dB. Positive means compliant.

SAMPLE_MARGIN_DB.description: Positive means the sample complies with its limit.

CDF_VALUES.description:
Empirical distribution values and their percent-time exceedance. Arrays
are index-aligned and ordered as stated by provenance.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

ESL.description:
Entity / Standards Link — join-table row connecting a host-local entity
metadata record to a standards record index row, enabling cascade-safe
mutation and cross-plugin query ownership.

LINK_KEY.description: Stable local link key for one entity / record association.

ENTITY_ID.description: Stable host-local entity id on the entity side of the association.

ENTITY_RECORD_KEY.description: Stable local entity metadata record key (for example `ENTITY:<id>`).

ENTITY_ROWID.description: FlatSQL row id for the linked entity metadata row when known.

RECORD_KEY.description: Stable local standards record key on the record side of the association.

SCHEMA_NAME.description: SDS schema family for the linked record (`OMM`, `CAT`, `OEM`, `CDM`, etc.).

RECORD_ROWID.description: FlatSQL row id for the linked standards record row when known.

CASCADE_DELETE.description: Whether entity deletion should cascade to the linked standards record.

UPDATED_AT_MS.description: Milliseconds since epoch when the association was last refreshed.

FRMStateVector.description:
A state in a named element set at a named epoch. ELEMENTS is the element
set's own 6 values in the order documented on frmStateRepresentation.
POSITION and VELOCITY are the Cartesian projection of the same state and
are populated when REPRESENTATION is CARTESIAN or when the provider can
supply them; a consumer MUST NOT infer velocity from POSITION alone.

ELEMENTS.description: The 6 element values of REPRESENTATION, SI units and radians.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Name of the coordinate system these elements are expressed in; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this state, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter, m^3/s^2, of the origin body when the element
set requires one. Absent means the provider's default for the origin.

SOURCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the request's state is expressed in.

TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the result is required in.

SOURCE_STATE.description:
The full input state, carrying velocity as well as position. POSITION
above is position-only and remains the input for operations 1-4.

TARGET_REPRESENTATION.description: Element set the result must be expressed in.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the transform is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for every
time-dependent axis chain.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires
the provider to use. A provider that cannot honour it returns
MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than substituting another table.

TARGET_STATE.description:
The transformed state, with velocity, in TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM and
TARGET_REPRESENTATION.

ROTATION_DCM.description: Rotation from the source axes to the target axes at EPOCH.

ROTATION_DCM_RATE.description:
Time derivative of ROTATION_DCM, per second. Required for a velocity
transform between relatively rotating axis sets.

ANGULAR_VELOCITY_RAD_S.description:
Angular velocity of the target axes with respect to the source axes,
radians per second, expressed in the source axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_EPOCH.description: Epoch of the Earth-orientation data set actually used, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterRef.description:
A reference to one parameter, with the dependencies that make it evaluable.
This is what a request, a stopping condition and a report column all name.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_INDEX.description:
Component of a vector or matrix parameter, zero-based and row-major.
Negative selects the whole value.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system this evaluation is expressed in; resolves against
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME in PCEEvaluationContext.COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.
Absent means the context default.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code of the central body, when the parameter is
CENTRAL_BODY_DEPENDENT and the context default is not wanted.

SITE_ID.description: Site the parameter is evaluated from, when it is SURFACE_SITE_DEPENDENT.

SECOND_OBJECT_ID.description: Second object, when the parameter is SECOND_OBJECT_DEPENDENT.

OWNER_OBJECT_ID.description: Owning object, when the request evaluates more than one.

OWNER_HARDWARE_NAME.description:
Owning hardware item, when the owner class is THRUSTER, FUEL_TANK or a
burn.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system for an EPOCH-typed parameter, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name. Absent means the context default.

PCEParameterDescriptor.description:
One roster entry as a named publisher implements it. The catalog is the
authority a consumer resolves a name through BEFORE it asks for a value.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_UNIT_SYMBOL.description: REQUIRED when UNIT is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_COUNT.description:
Number of values for REAL_VECTOR, and rows times columns for
REAL_MATRIX. Absent or 1 for a scalar.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

REQUIRED_AXIS_TYPE.description:
The one axis set this parameter is defined for, when it is defined for
only one: planetodetic quantities require BODY_FIXED. UNSPECIFIED means
any axis set the request names.

REQUIRED_ORIGIN_KIND.description:
The one origin kind this parameter is defined for, when it is defined
for only one. UNSPECIFIED means any origin the request names.

TIME_SYSTEM_DEPENDENT.description:
The value changes with the time system it is asked for, independently of
the frame.

STATE_REPRESENTATION.description:
The element set this parameter is a member of, when it is a member of
one; UNSPECIFIED for a derived scalar that belongs to no set.

UNAVAILABLE_REASON.description:
REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DECLARED_UNAVAILABLE: what is missing,
stated as a capability, so a consumer can report the refusal.

SUPERSEDED_BY.description: REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DEPRECATED: the parameter to migrate to.

SUPPORTS_STOPPING_CONDITION.description:
The publisher can bracket and refine a root of this parameter, so it may
be used as a stopping condition or a generic event function. A parameter
that is not continuous in time MUST declare false.

IS_SETTABLE.description:
The parameter can be written as well as read, so it may be a targeting
variable.

IS_CYCLIC.description: The value wraps: a goal crossing must be tested modulo the cycle.

CYCLE_LOWER_BOUND.description:
Inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound of the cycle, REQUIRED when
IS_CYCLIC is true.

DESCRIPTION.description: One sentence, capability language, no product or organization names.

PCEParameterCatalog.description:
The roster a named publisher offers, resolved as a whole. A consumer
caches this and resolves every later name against it.

PROVIDER_ID.description: Identifier of the publisher that evaluates these parameters.

PUBLISHED_AT.description: ISO 8601 instant this catalog was published.

PCEEvaluationContext.description: Everything an evaluation needs besides the state itself.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the object the parameters are evaluated on.

HARDWARE_NAME.description: Hardware item, when the owner class names one.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the default central body.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter of the central body, m^3/s^2. Absent means the
provider's own value for CENTRAL_BODY_ID.

EQUATORIAL_RADIUS_M.description: Shape of the central body, REQUIRED for planetodetic parameters.

COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.description:
Fully specified coordinate systems, each named through
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

DEFAULT_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description: Which of COORDINATE_SYSTEMS a parameter reference falls back to.

DEFAULT_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system a parameter reference falls back to, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name.

REFERENCE_EPOCH.description: Zero of ELAPSED_DAYS and ELAPSED_SECONDS, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires.
A provider that cannot honour it returns MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than
substituting another table.

ILLUMINATING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the illuminating body for lighting parameters.

PCEEvaluationRequest.description:
Evaluate these parameters on these states. One state is a point query; a
run of states is a report or a plot series, and carries the same shape.

STATES.description:
States to evaluate at, in chronological order. Each carries its own
epoch and coordinate system name.

PCEParameterValue.description:
One parameter's value at one state. STATUS is per value: a request never
fails as a whole because one name is unavailable.

VALUE.description: Scalar, integer or boolean value. Absent for vector and matrix types.

VALUES.description:
Vector or matrix values, row-major. Absent for scalar types; a scalar is
NEVER also written here.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when the descriptor's DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

UNIT.description:
Unit the value is expressed in, restating the descriptor so a value is
self-describing when it travels without its catalog.

MESSAGE.description: Why STATUS is not OK, in capability language.

PCEParameterSample.description: The evaluated parameters at ONE epoch.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this sample, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

SAMPLES.description: One sample per requested state, in the requested order.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterCondition.description:
A predicate on a named parameter: the parameter attains GOAL_VALUE, in
DIRECTION, for the OCCURRENCE-th time. This is the ONE spelling of a
stopping condition and of a generic event function; $EVL references it
rather than minting a second one.

GOAL_VALUE.description: Value the parameter must attain, in the parameter's own SI unit.

GOAL_TOLERANCE.description:
Convergence bar on the parameter value at the reported epoch, in the
parameter's own unit. A provider that cannot meet it returns
ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED rather than reporting an unconverged root.

OCCURRENCE.description:
Which attainment satisfies the condition, one-based. 0 and 1 both mean
the first.

PCEStopRequest.description:
Propagate until a condition is attained. The propagator itself is NOT named
here: it is a port the caller supplies, per the pluggable-propagation law.
This record carries only the condition, the interval and the tolerances.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions evaluated together; the run stops at whichever is attained
first in time.

MAXIMUM_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Upper bound on the propagated interval. Reaching it without attaining a
condition is GOAL_NOT_ATTAINED, never a silent stop.

EPOCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on the stop epoch. The same scenario run at different
step sizes MUST land inside this bar.

SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS.description:
Objects propagated in step with the owner and reported at the same stop
epoch.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at the stop epoch, beyond the condition itself.

PCEStopReport.description: Where a propagate-to-condition run actually landed.

ATTAINED_CONDITION_INDEX.description:
Index into PCEStopRequest.CONDITIONS of the condition that stopped the
run; negative when none did.

EPOCH.description: Epoch the run stopped at, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Seconds of propagated time from the initial state to EPOCH; negative for
a BACKWARD run.

ACHIEVED_VALUE.description: Value the condition parameter actually had at EPOCH.

GOAL_RESIDUAL.description:
ACHIEVED_VALUE minus GOAL_VALUE, in the parameter's own unit. This is
the residual a consumer gates on; it is NOT assumed to be zero.

SYNCHRONIZED_STATES.description: States of SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS at the same epoch, in that order.

SAMPLE.description: Parameters evaluated at the stop epoch.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description: Root-refinement work actually done, for the step-independence evidence.

PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

OCCULTING_BODY_IDS.description:
Ephemeris body codes of the bodies allowed to occult, in the order they
are tested. More than one is normal.

ILLUMINATING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the illuminating body.

REPORT_UMBRA.description:
Which shadow regions to report. A model that cannot distinguish a region
MUST refuse the request rather than fold it into a neighbour.

MINIMUM_DURATION_SECONDS.description: Events shorter than this are not reported. 0 reports every event.

ABERRATION_CORRECTION.description: Correct the illuminating-body direction for signal travel time.

OBSERVER.description: The observing point, normally a GROUND_SITE origin.

SENSOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the observing site or sensor; resolves against $SEN.ID
when the observer is an instrumented site.

MINIMUM_ELEVATION_RAD.description: Elevation the target must exceed, radians, when no mask is supplied.

AZIMUTH_ELEVATION_MASK_RAD.description:
Horizon mask as azimuth and minimum-elevation pairs, radians, in
ascending azimuth: [az0, el0, az1, el1, ...]. Present, it supersedes
MINIMUM_ELEVATION_RAD. An odd length is INVALID_INPUT.

OCCULTING_BODY_IDS.description: Bodies allowed to block the line of sight.

MINIMUM_DURATION_SECONDS.description: Events shorter than this are not reported.

SENSOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the sensor whose field of view is tested; resolves against
$SEN.ID. The sensor's site data is NOT restated here.

BORESIGHT_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system BORESIGHT is expressed in; resolves against
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME on the request context.

CONE_HALF_ANGLE_RAD.description: Half-angle of a CONIC field of view, radians.

RECTANGULAR_HALF_ANGLE_X_RAD.description: Half-angles of a RECTANGULAR field of view about the boresight, radians.

CUSTOM_MASK_RAD.description:
Boundary of a CUSTOM_MASK field of view as clock and cone angle pairs
about the boresight, radians: [clock0, cone0, clock1, cone1, ...]. An
odd length is INVALID_INPUT.

INTRUDING_BODY_IDS.description: Ephemeris body codes of the bodies tested for intrusion.

INTRUDING_OBJECT_IDS.description: Identifiers of the tracked objects tested for intrusion.

USE_APPARENT_BODY_RADIUS.description:
Test the intruder's apparent disc rather than its centre, so an event
begins when the limb enters the field of view.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code the radius is measured from. The apsis is the root
of the RADIAL_VELOCITY parameter about this body, NOT an extremum of
geodetic height; the two differ by tens of degrees of true anomaly on an
oblate body.

REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system whose reference plane defines the node line; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME on the request context.

EVLParameterConditionConfiguration.description: Configuration for PARAMETER_CONDITION, the generic locator.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions on $PCE catalog parameters. The predicate vocabulary is
PCEParameterCondition and is NOT restated here.

REPORT_AS_INTERVAL.description:
True reports the interval BETWEEN a satisfying crossing and the next
unsatisfying one; false reports each crossing as an instantaneous event
with equal start and stop epochs.

EVLEventSample.description: Parameter values captured at one instant inside an event.

EVLEvent.description:
One located event. An instantaneous event has STOP_EPOCH equal to
START_EPOCH and DURATION_SECONDS equal to 0.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of the epochs, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

DURATION_SECONDS.description:
STOP_EPOCH minus START_EPOCH in seconds. Carried because it is the
reported quantity of an event report and MUST agree with the epochs.

TARGET_OBJECT_ID.description: The object the event happened to.

OCCULTING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body that occulted or intruded, when one did.

OBSERVER_ID.description: Identifier of the observing site or sensor, when the class has one.

OBSERVED_OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the observed body or object, when the class has one.

EXTREMUM_EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the event's extremum, ISO 8601: deepest obscuration, peak
elevation, closest approach. Absent when the class has no extremum.

EXTREMUM_VALUE.description: Value at EXTREMUM_EPOCH, in the unit of EXTREMUM_PARAMETER.

EXTREMUM_PARAMETER.description: Which catalog parameter EXTREMUM_VALUE is a value of.

CONDITION_INDEX.description:
Index into EVLEventLocationRequest.PARAMETER_CONDITION_CONFIGURATION's
CONDITIONS for a generic event; negative for every other class.

SAMPLES.description: Requested parameters, evaluated at the instants of this event.

EVLEventLocationRequest.description: Locate events of one class over one interval.

TARGET_OBJECT_ID.description: Object the events are located for.

CONTEXT.description:
Bodies, coordinate systems, epoch reference and Earth-orientation data
set the geometry is evaluated in. The state source itself is a port the
caller supplies and is NOT named here.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system of the interval, named by the $TIM timingStandard member
name.

SCAN_STEP_SECONDS.description:
Coarse step the event function is sampled at before refinement. A
provider MAY choose its own step when this is absent, and the located
epochs MUST NOT depend on it beyond REFINEMENT_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.

REFINEMENT_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on a located epoch. A provider that cannot meet it
returns ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED.

MAXIMUM_EVENTS.description: Upper bound on reported events. 0 means no bound.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at each event's instants.

ECLIPSE_CONFIGURATION.description:
Exactly the configuration matching LOCATOR_CLASS is present; any other
combination is MISSING_CONFIGURATION.

EVLEventReport.description: The events found, and the interval they were actually searched over.

SCAN_START_EPOCH.description:
Interval actually searched, ISO 8601. A BUDGET_EXCEEDED run reports the
interval it reached, not the interval it was asked for.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of the epochs, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EVENTS.description: Events in chronological order of START_EPOCH.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description:
Event-function evaluations actually performed, for step-independence
evidence.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

EVL.description:
Event Locator

One request and one report for every class of located event: shadow
passage, site visibility, sensor-field-of-view intrusion, apsis passage,
node crossing, and the generic condition on any $PCE catalog parameter.
Every class is the same pair of an event function and a refined root, so a
new class is a configuration table and a vocabulary member, never a new
record. Entry and exit epochs, duration, the occulting or observed body and
the parameter values captured at each event's instants are reported in one
shape, and the predicate of the generic class is $PCE's
PCEParameterCondition rather than a second spelling of the same idea.

Angles are radians, durations seconds, epochs ISO 8601 in a named time
system.

weightedEdge.description: Weighted directed edge (16 bytes, 8-byte aligned for zero-copy ingestion).

VERTEX_COUNT.description: Number of vertices in the graph.
Optional vertex capacity for implicit graph creation.

BUILD_GRAPH.description: Build a CSR representation after ingest.

VERTEX_COUNT.description: Number of vertices in the graph.
Number of vertices in the solved graph.

PREDECESSORS.description: Predecessor array (length == VERTEX_COUNT; UINT32_MAX means none / source).

SOURCE.description: Source vertex index from the latest SSSP solve.

REACHABLE.description: Whether a path exists from SOURCE to TARGET.

DISTANCE.description: Total distance from SOURCE to TARGET (Infinity if unreachable).

PATH.description: Vertex sequence from SOURCE to TARGET.

FPC.description:
Fastest Path Compute — envelope message for weighted graph ingestion and
single-source shortest path execution.

FSB.description:
FlatSQL Byte Stream — a bounded, typed chunk used for append/query and
opaque snapshot/WAL persistence. DATA carries at most one MiB so larger
inputs and snapshots are delivered as ordered chunks. The host may persist
canonical FSB bytes but must not interpret DATA as tables, rows, or SQL.

FSOTableBinding.description:
One canonical SDS file-identifier to FlatSQL table binding. A configured
node rebuilds these bindings before replaying durable record bytes.

FSO.description:
FlatSQL Operation — generic control, policy, and status record for the
independently packaged FlatSQL WASM node.

Bulk records, query results, snapshots, and WAL chunks travel separately as
FSB frames so operations remain streamable and no host needs to interpret a
database payload. SCHEMA_IDL is canonical SDS/FlatBuffers IDL supplied to
the node for schema-derived table/index construction.

SCHEMA_IDL.description:
UTF-8 FlatBuffers IDL bytes. A byte vector is used because the aligned
compiler intentionally limits fixed inline strings to 255 bytes.

GELObservationRef.description: Trace from a solution row back to one `$DOA` observation or `$IQC` capture.

DOA_ID.description:
At least one of DOA_ID or IQC_ID is required. When both are present, the
`$DOA` observation must have been derived from the named `$IQC` capture.

GELConvergenceDiagnostics.description: Numerical convergence diagnostics for the fused estimator.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

LONGITUDE_MIN.description: Western longitude boundary of slot (degrees east)

LONGITUDE_MAX.description: Eastern longitude boundary of slot (degrees east)

LOST_FLAG.description: True if object is lost/not tracked

EPOCH.description: Epoch of status (ISO 8601)

GJNPosition.description: A single position (longitude, latitude, optional altitude)

ALTITUDE.description: Altitude in meters above WGS84 ellipsoid (optional)

HAS_ALTITUDE.description: True if altitude was explicitly provided (distinguishes 0 from absent)

GJNLinearRing.description: A linear ring is a closed LineString with 4+ positions (first = last)

GJNPolygonRings.description: A polygon represented as an array of rings (outer boundary + holes)

RINGS.description: Rings: first is outer boundary, rest are holes
Array of position arrays (for MultiLineString, Polygon rings)

POLYGON_RINGS.description: Array of polygons each as array of rings (for MultiPolygon)

GJNProperty.description: A key-value property entry for Feature properties

NUM_VALUE.description: Property value as number (use if numeric)

IS_NUMERIC.description: True if NUM_VALUE should be used instead of VALUE

IS_BOOL.description: True if this property value is a boolean

BOOL_VALUE.description: Boolean value (use when IS_BOOL is true)

IS_NULL.description: True if this property value is JSON null

JSON_VALUE.description: Raw JSON string for complex values (objects, arrays)

NUM_ID.description: Numeric feature identifier (use when ID_IS_NUMERIC is true)

ID_IS_NUMERIC.description: True if the feature id is numeric rather than string

HAS_GEOMETRY.description: True if the feature has a geometry (false means geometry was JSON null)

PROPERTIES_IS_NULL.description: True if properties was JSON null (vs empty object)

GJNBoundingBox.description: GeoJSON Bounding Box [west, south, east, north] or [west, south, min-alt, east, north, max-alt]

HAS_ALTITUDE.description: True if the bbox includes altitude (6 values vs 4)

SIGNAL.description: Signal type code (e.g., L1C, L2P, L5Q, E1B)

VALUE.description: Observation value (units depend on type: m, cycles, Hz, dB-Hz)

GNSS_SAT_ID.description: GNSS satellite identifier (e.g., G01, R24, E05, C03)

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation

EPOCH.description: Observation epoch (ISO 8601)

ALTITUDE.description: Receiver altitude in meters above WGS-84

GNPName.description:
One name a place is known by, beside its primary NAME. Every attribute is
carried as the gazetteer publishes it; a consumer choosing a display name
applies its own policy over these flags and never has the choice baked in
by the publisher.

NAME.description: The alternate name verbatim, in its own script, unnormalized.

LANGUAGE.description:
ISO 639 language tag when the gazetteer states one. A gazetteer may also
state a non-language tag for a link or a postal, IATA, ICAO, or similar
coded name; that token is carried verbatim rather than discarded.

IS_PREFERRED.description: The gazetteer marks this as the preferred name for its language.

IS_SHORT.description: The gazetteer marks this as a short form.

IS_COLLOQUIAL.description: The gazetteer marks this as colloquial or unofficial.

IS_HISTORIC.description: The gazetteer marks this name as no longer in use.

VALID_FROM.description:
Period the name was in use, verbatim as the gazetteer states it. Not
normalized to RFC 3339: gazetteers publish partial and era-qualified
dates here, and coercion would invent precision.

GNPProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one gazetteer place.

Required on every record: a redistributed place whose dataset, epoch, and
licence are unstated is not publishable. Dataset identity is DATA:
DATASET_ID, DATASET_NAME, and ATTRIBUTION carry verbatim what the gazetteer
states about itself. The standard names no gazetteer, dataset, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the gazetteer this place was
taken from, unique within the publisher's own dataset registry. Never a
display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this place
was decoded from. The edition boundary, not the fetch: two records
carrying the same DATASET_ID and DATASET_EPOCH were cut from the same
bytes and are directly comparable.

DATASET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when the publisher
distributes one, so an epoch can be verified rather than trusted.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query, filter, or file selection used, so the same rows can be
recovered by repeating the fetch.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: there is no encoding for a
redistributed place whose terms are unstated. A dataset that publishes no
terms is recorded as publishing no terms; unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description:
Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.
Required whenever the terms are attribution-bearing, which is the common
case for open gazetteers, and carried verbatim so a downstream surface
can render it without composing its own credit line.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
This gazetteer's own row identifier for the place, verbatim. The join key
back to the source dataset; never re-minted by the publisher.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC date on which the gazetteer last modified this row, as the
gazetteer states it. Distinct from DATASET_EPOCH: an unchanged row keeps
its modification date across editions, which is what makes incremental
sync possible.

GNP.description:
Gazetteer Named Place

One named geographic place as a gazetteer publishes it: its names, its
position on WGS 84, its feature classification, its administrative
containment, and the dataset edition and licence it was redistributed
under. The record is a NAME-TO-PLACE lookup surface — place search,
geocoding, and administrative resolution — and is deliberately not a
facility, station, or emitter record: $SIT carries an operational
facility, $GST a geodetic tracking station, $TBS a terrestrial base-station
site. A place gains meaning from those records by being joined to, never by
being conflated with them.

Positions are decimal degrees on WGS 84 and elevations are metres,
unconverted. A consumer needing other units converts at the join,
explicitly.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this place record. Never the gazetteer's
own row identifier, which rides verbatim in SOURCE.NATIVE_ID.

NAME.description: Primary name of the place, verbatim in its own script, unnormalized.

ASCII_NAME.description:
Plain-ASCII rendering of NAME when the gazetteer publishes one. A search
and sort convenience, never a substitute for NAME.

ALTERNATE_NAMES.description: Every other name the gazetteer publishes for this place.

LATITUDE.description: Latitude in decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive north.

LONGITUDE.description: Longitude in decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive east.

ELEVATION_M.description:
Elevation in metres above the WGS 84 ellipsoid-referenced vertical datum
the gazetteer states, as published. Zero means unpublished, never sea
level; a place at sea level is distinguished by ELEVATION_PUBLISHED.

ELEVATION_PUBLISHED.description:
ELEVATION_M carries a published value. False marks a gazetteer that
publishes no elevation for this place.

DEM_ELEVATION_M.description:
Elevation in metres sampled from a digital elevation model, when the
gazetteer publishes a model-derived value beside or instead of a surveyed
one. Kept separate: a model sample is not a survey and the two must never
silently substitute for one another.

DEM_MODEL.description:
Name of the digital elevation model DEM_ELEVATION_M was sampled from,
verbatim as the gazetteer states it.

FEATURE_CLASS.description: Broad feature class this gazetteer assigns.

FEATURE_CLASS_CODE.description:
The gazetteer's own class token, verbatim, so a class outside
gnpFeatureClass survives a round trip.

FEATURE_CODE.description: The gazetteer's fine-grained feature code, verbatim.

FEATURE_NAME.description:
Human-readable expansion of FEATURE_CODE, as the gazetteer publishes it.
A display string, never a key.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the gazetteer states it.

COUNTRY_NAME.description:
Country name as the gazetteer publishes it. A display name, never a key:
consumers key on COUNTRY_CODE.

ALTERNATE_COUNTRY_CODES.description:
Further ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for places the gazetteer reports as
spanning or being disputed between several countries. Order carries no
precedence and no sovereignty claim.

ADMIN1_CODE.description: First-order administrative division code within COUNTRY_CODE, verbatim.

ADMIN1_NAME.description:
Resolved name of that division. Carried beside the code so a consumer
need not hold the division tables to render a place.

ADMIN3_CODE.description:
Third- and fourth-order division codes, verbatim. Gazetteers publish
these as codes only; a name is carried when one is published.

POPULATION.description:
Population as the gazetteer publishes it. Zero means unpublished, never
uninhabited.

TIME_ZONE_ID.description: IANA time zone identifier for the place, verbatim.

TIME_ZONE_UTC_OFFSET_H.description:
Offset from UTC in hours the gazetteer states for that zone outside
daylight saving, and under it. Carried as published; a consumer needing
an instant-correct offset resolves TIME_ZONE_ID against a current tz
database rather than trusting these.

TIME_ZONE_DST_OFFSET_H.description: Offset from UTC in hours under daylight saving.

SOURCE.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms. Required: a place with no named
dataset, epoch, and licence is not publishable.

GPXLink.description: GPX link to an external resource

GPXWaypoint.description: A waypoint, point of interest, or named feature

ELEVATION.description: Elevation in meters above WGS84 ellipsoid

GEOID_HEIGHT.description: Height of geoid above WGS84 ellipsoid in meters

SAT.description: Number of satellites used for fix

AGE_OF_DGPS_DATA.description: Age of DGPS data in seconds

GPXTrackSegment.description: Track segment (continuous span of track points)

POINTS.description: Ordered track points in this segment

GPXRoute.description: Route (ordered list of waypoints for navigation)

AUTHOR_NAME.description: Person or organization who created the file

GST.description:
Ground/Tracking Station Definition — the geodetic identity and geometry of
one tracking station, sufficient to reduce a radiometric or laser
observation taken from it.

This is deliberately NOT $SEN. $SEN describes an SSA sensor site by
latitude/longitude/altitude with tasking plans and statistics; it carries no
terrestrial frame realization, no station velocity, no reference epoch, and
no antenna axis geometry. Station coordinates without a frame realization
and an epoch cannot be propagated for plate motion and are therefore not
usable for orbit determination.

STATION_ID.description: Stable station identifier as used by the operating network, e.g. "DSS-63".

DOMES_NUMBER.description: IERS DOMES number, when the station has one.

CDP_NUMBER.description: NASA CDP / SLR site number, when the station has one.

FRAME_REALIZATION.description: Terrestrial reference frame realization of POSITION_* and VELOCITY_*.

FRAME_REALIZATION_NAME.description: Free-text realization name, required when FRAME_REALIZATION is OTHER.

REFERENCE_EPOCH.description:
Epoch at which POSITION_* is valid, ISO 8601. Positions MUST be
propagated to the observation epoch with VELOCITY_* before use.

POSITION_X.description: Station position in the stated realization, metres.

VELOCITY_X.description:
Station velocity (plate motion) in the stated realization, metres per
year. Zero is a claim that the station does not move, not a default.

AXIS_OFFSET_M.description:
Distance between the two mount axes, metres. Zero for an intersecting-axis
mount.

ECCENTRICITY_X.description: Vector from the monument marker to the antenna reference point, metres.

ECCENTRICITY_FRAME.description:
Frame the eccentricity vector is expressed in, e.g. "XYZ" (geocentric
Cartesian) or "NEU" (local north-east-up).

TRANSMIT_BANDS.description: Uplink bands the station can transmit, e.g. ["S", "X", "Ka"].

RECEIVE_BANDS.description: Downlink bands the station can receive.

CLOCK_OFFSET_S.description: Station clock offset from the stated time scale, seconds.

CLOCK_RATE_S_PER_S.description: Station clock rate, seconds per second.

CLOCK_TIME_SCALE.description: Time scale the clock terms are referenced to, e.g. "UTC", "TAI".

VALID_FROM.description: Start of the interval over which this definition applies, ISO 8601.

VALID_TO.description: End of the interval over which this definition applies, ISO 8601.

SOURCE.description:
Provenance of these coordinates, e.g. "DSN 810-005 rev. E", an ILRS SINEX
file name, or a VLBI station catalogue identifier.

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ARG_PERIAPSIS.description:
Coefficients for argument of periapsis (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ANOMALY.description:
Coefficients for anomaly (degrees). See ANOMALY_TYPE for interpretation.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

MAX_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description:
Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the reference frame (e.g., EARTH, MOON, MARS).

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for position/velocity coefficients.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for all epochs in this message.

START_TIME.description: Start of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

DEFAULT_BASIS_TYPE.description:
Default polynomial basis type for all records in this message.
Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Array of position polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

ORBITAL_ELEMENT_RECORDS.description:
Array of orbital element polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Generating ephemeris source, verbatim as the generator names itself
(e.g., a planetary ephemeris series designation, a numerical propagator
name and version, or an in-house tool identifier).

NOMINAL_SEGMENT_SPAN.description:
Fit span in seconds used to generate each polynomial segment.
Informational; actual spans are in individual records.

NOMINAL_NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Nominal number of coefficients per segment.
Informational; actual counts are in individual records.

ephemerisDataLine.description:
A single ephemeris data line (for non-uniform time steps only)
Use this format when time intervals between states are irregular.
For uniform time steps, use the compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array instead.

EPOCH.description: Epoch time, in ISO 8601 UTC format (required for non-uniform steps)

CLOCK_BIAS_MICROSECONDS.description:
Satellite clock bias (offset), microseconds. SP3 position-record clock
column. The SP3 bad/absent sentinel 999999.999999 is NOT stored; omit the
field instead.

CLOCK_RATE_MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND.description:
Satellite clock rate of change, 1e-4 microseconds per second. SP3
velocity-record clock-rate column. Sentinel 999999.999999 is not stored.

CLOCK_RATE_SIGMA_PICOSECONDS_PER_SECOND.description:
Standard deviation of CLOCK_RATE_MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND,
1e-4 picoseconds per second.

X_SIGMA_EXPONENT.description:
Per-coordinate position standard-deviation EXPONENTS, SP3 base**n form:
sigma = POS_VEL_BASE**n, with the position base from the SP3 header and
the result in mm. These are the raw SP3 exponent columns, kept as
exponents so an SP3 round-trip is exact; a consumer that wants a linear
sigma raises the header base to this power.

X_DOT_SIGMA_EXPONENT.description:
Per-coordinate velocity standard-deviation exponents, result in
1e-4 mm/s. Same base**n rule.

EPOCH.description: Epoch

OBJECT.description: Satellite name for the first object

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of reference frame (EARTH, MARS, MOON, etc.)

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Name of the reference frame (TEME, EME2000, etc.)

REFERENCE_FRAME_EPOCH.description: Epoch of reference frame, if not intrinsic to the definition of the reference frame

COV_REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the covariance matrix

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for the orbit state and covariance matrix. (UTC)

START_TIME.description: Start of TOTAL time span covered by ephemeris data and covariance data (ISO 8601)

USEABLE_START_TIME.description: Optional start USEABLE time span covered by ephemeris data (ISO 8601)

USEABLE_STOP_TIME.description: Optional end of USEABLE time span covered by ephemeris data (ISO 8601)

STOP_TIME.description: End of TOTAL time span covered by ephemeris data and covariance data (ISO 8601)

INTERPOLATION.description:
Recommended interpolation method for ephemeris data.
Supported methods: Hermite, Linear, Lagrange, Chebyshev.
When set to "Chebyshev", parsers should use POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS
for high-fidelity polynomial interpolation instead of interpolating across
discrete state vectors.

INTERPOLATION_DEGREE.description: Recommended interpolation degree for ephemeris data

STEP_SIZE.description:
Time interval between ephemeris states in seconds.
If > 0: Use compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array (times are implicit).
If 0 or omitted: Use EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES with explicit epochs.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector in EPHEMERIS_DATA array.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0. Default is 6.

EPHEMERIS_DATA.description:
Compact ephemeris data as row-major array of doubles.
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0.
Layout: [x0,y0,z0,xdot0,ydot0,zdot0, x1,y1,z1,xdot1,ydot1,zdot1, ...]
Units: position in km, velocity in km/s, acceleration in km/s²
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.
Number of states = length(EPHEMERIS_DATA) / STATE_VECTOR_SIZE

EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES.description:
Array of ephemeris data lines with explicit epochs.
Only used when STEP_SIZE == 0 or omitted (non-uniform time steps).
Each line contains its own EPOCH timestamp.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Optional polynomial position records for high-fidelity interpolation.
Used when INTERPOLATION is "Chebyshev". Each record covers a time segment with
polynomial coefficients for continuous position (and optionally velocity) evaluation.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

OBJECT_NAIF_ID.description: NAIF integer code of the ephemeris target (SPK segment target).

CENTER_NAIF_ID.description:
NAIF integer code of the ephemeris centre, matching CENTER_NAME
(SPK segment centre).

CLASSIFICATION.description:
OEM Header
Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

CCSDS_OCM_VERS.description: Format version in the form of 'x.y', where 'y' is incremented for minor changes, and 'x' for major changes.

COMMENT.description: Comments (a contiguous set of one or more comment lines may be provided immediately after the version number).

CLASSIFICATION.description: User-defined free-text message classification/caveats of this OCM.

MESSAGE_ID.description: Free-text field containing an ID that uniquely identifies a message from this originator.

OBJECT_NAME.description: Free-text field containing the name of the object.

INTERNATIONAL_DESIGNATOR.description: International designator for the object as assigned by COSPAR.

CATALOG_NAME.description: Satellite catalog source from which 'OBJECT_DESIGNATOR' was obtained.

OBJECT_DESIGNATOR.description: Unique satellite identification designator from the catalog.

ALTERNATE_NAMES.description: Alternate names of this space object.

ORIGINATOR_POC.description: Originator or programmatic Point-of-Contact (PoC) for OCM.

ORIGINATOR_POSITION.description: Contact position of the originator PoC.

TECH_ORG.description: Creating agency or operator for technical contact.

TECH_POSITION.description: Contact position of the technical PoC.

PREVIOUS_MESSAGE_ID.description: ID that uniquely identifies the previous message from this originator.

NEXT_MESSAGE_ID.description: ID that uniquely identifies the next message from this originator.

ADM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Attitude Data Messages linked to this OCM.

CDM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Conjunction Data Messages linked to this OCM.

PRM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Pointing Request Messages linked to this OCM.

RDM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Reentry Data Messages linked to this OCM.

TDM_MSG_LINK.description: List of Tracking Data Messages upon which this orbit determination is based.

COUNTRY.description: Country where the space object owner is based.

CONSTELLATION.description: Name of the constellation to which this space object belongs.

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Specification of the type of object (e.g., PAYLOAD, ROCKET BODY, DEBRIS).

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for all absolute time stamps in this OCM, including EPOCH_TZERO.

OPS_STATUS.description: Specification of the operational status of the space object.

ORBIT_CATEGORY.description: Specification of the type of orbit (e.g., GEO, LEO).

OCM_DATA_ELEMENTS.description: List of elements of information data blocks included in this message.

FIXED_F10P7.description: Fixed F10.7 solar flux value used.

FIXED_F10P7_MEAN.description: Fixed mean F10.7 solar flux value used.

MAN_BASIS.description: Basis of the maneuver plan (e.g., planned, predicted, estimated).

OD_TIME_TAG.description: Time tag of the orbit determination.

OD_OBSERVATIONS_TYPE.description: Types of observations used (e.g., RANGE, DOPPLER).

OD_APRIORI_DATA.description: A priori data used for orbit determination.

OD_ESTIMATOR.description: Estimator class provenance: batch fit vs sequential filter (EKF/UKF).

OD_RESIDUAL_RMS.description: RMS of post-fit residuals for this solution.

OD_RESIDUALS_SERIES.description: Post-fit residual series, one entry per accepted observation.

OD_RESIDUAL_EPOCHS.description:
Epochs aligned with OD_RESIDUALS_SERIES (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds

OD_BATCH_BASELINE_ID.description:
OD_ID of the batch baseline solution a filtered solution derives from and

OD_BATCH_BASELINE_RMS.description:
Post-fit residual RMS of the batch baseline, for direct batch-vs-filter

TRAJ_TYPE.description:
Trajectory state representation type.
Determines how orbit state data is parameterized in this message.
For CARTESIAN_PV/CARTESIAN_PVA, use STATE_DATA array.
For POLYNOMIAL_POS/POLYNOMIAL_OE, use the corresponding polynomial record arrays.

TRAJ_TYPE_DESCRIPTION.description:
Legacy trajectory type string for backward compatibility and extended types
(e.g., "PROPAGATED", "ESTIMATED", "FILTERED").

STATE_STEP_SIZE.description: Time interval between state vectors in seconds (required for time-series data).

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)

STATE_DATA.description:
State data as row-major array of doubles.
Layout: [X0, Y0, Z0, X_DOT0, Y_DOT0, Z_DOT0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]
Time reconstruction: epoch[i] = METADATA.START_TIME + (i * STATE_STEP_SIZE)
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

COVARIANCE_DATA.description:
Covariance data as flat array (21 elements per epoch for 6x6 lower triangular).
Time alignment matches STATE_DATA epochs.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial position records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_POS. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for X, Y, Z position (and optionally velocity).
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial orbital element records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_OE. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES.description: Physical properties of the space object.

CREATION_DATE.description: Message creation date in ISO 8601 UTC format.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used by all epochs.

START_TIME.description: Start epoch for compact trajectory and condition arrays.

STOP_TIME.description: Stop epoch for compact trajectory and condition arrays.

STEP_SIZE.description: Uniform step size in seconds. Use zero when samples are epoch-tagged elsewhere.

SOURCE_OEM.description: Source OEM ephemeris when conditions were evaluated from orbit ephemeris data.

SOURCE_OCM.description: Source OCM trajectory when conditions were evaluated from comprehensive orbit data.

ATMOSPHERE.description: Atmosphere model request used by the propagator.

ATMOSPHERE_COUPLING.description: Coupling mode used between the propagator and atmosphere provider.

FLOW_REGIME.description: Flow regime classification for the sampled trajectory.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description: Number of position/velocity components per state sample.

STATE_DATA.description: Flat state array [x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, ...] in km and km/s.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description: Epochs for irregularly sampled condition arrays.

SPEED_M_PER_S.description: Inertial or relative speed samples in meters per second.

DENSITY_KG_PER_M3.description: Atmospheric density samples in kilograms per cubic meter.

SPEED_OF_SOUND_M_PER_S.description: Speed of sound samples in meters per second.

CONVECTIVE_HEAT_FLUX_W_PER_M2.description: Convective heat flux samples in watts per square meter.

RADIATIVE_HEAT_FLUX_W_PER_M2.description: Radiative heat flux samples in watts per square meter.

STAGNATION_HEAT_FLUX_W_PER_M2.description: Stagnation heat flux samples in watts per square meter.

LOAD_FACTOR_G.description: Normal load factor samples in g.

ANGLE_OF_ATTACK_DEG.description: Angle of attack samples in degrees.

REFERENCE_AREA_M2.description: Vehicle reference area in square meters.

SURFACE_TEMPERATURE_K.description: Wall or surface temperature in kelvin.

ROW_INDICATORS.description: Row indicators for the hypothesis matrix

COL_INDICATORS.description: Column indicators for the hypothesis matrix

MATRIX.description: Matrix data as a boolean array in row major format; if overflow, adds additional rows

ANALYSIS_METHOD.description: Analysis methodology used to form the hypothesis

POST_INGEST_ACTION.description: Disposition of a source file after verified ingest.

Observation epoch (ISO 8601)
