be recovered by repeating the fetch.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: there is no encoding for a
redistributed record whose terms are unstated. A source that publishes no
terms is recorded as publishing no terms; unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that source publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description:
The licence forbids commercial use. Rides PER SOURCE because one record
may merge an open-terms lane beside a non-commercial cross-check, and the
strictest consulted lane governs any derived product.

NATIVE_ID.description: This source's own row, record, licence or file identifier, verbatim.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
The class of authority this particular source speaks with about position.
Published per source because a record may merge a regulator lane with a
community lane; the record-level POSITION_AUTHORITY states which class the
PUBLISHED coordinate came from.

REPORTED_LATITUDE.description:
Position this source reported, in decimal degrees on WGS 84, before
reconciliation. Retained unrounded so the merge stays auditable. Absent
when the source was consulted and reported no position.

CONTRIBUTED.description:
This source's report materially contributed to the published record.
False marks a source that was consulted and either returned nothing or
was outvoted; its entry is published either way.

TXSConsensus.description:
How one facility's independent source reports were reduced to the single
published position, and how strongly those reports agreed.

Agreement is CORROBORATION and is never authority: five compilations that
copied one another agree perfectly and establish nothing. Read this table
beside POSITION_AUTHORITY, never instead of it.

PROVIDERS_CONSULTED.description:
Sources queried for this facility, including those that returned nothing.
Never fewer than the number of SOURCES entries.

PROVIDERS_AGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell within the publisher's agreement
threshold. A value of 1 means the published position rests on a single
report and was never independently corroborated.

PROVIDERS_DISAGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell OUTSIDE that threshold and were not
reconciled. Non-zero is the machine-readable form of a contested
position and is published alongside POSITION_DISPUTED.

WINNING_PROVIDER_ID.description:
PROVIDER_ID of the report the merge selected, copied verbatim from the
matching SOURCES entry. Absent when METHOD is CENTROID: a computed
position belongs to no single source.

POSITION_SPREAD_M.description:
Greatest surface distance in metres between any two agreeing reported
positions. Zero is meaningful only when PROVIDERS_AGREEING is 1.

CONFIDENCE.description:
The publisher's own confidence in the merged position, on [0,1]. Never a
source's figure and never a probability from a model this standard does
not name.

MERGED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which the merge was performed.

TXSPriorPosition.description:
A position the facility is asserted to have occupied and vacated, retained
so a relocation never silently rewrites history.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
Class of authority behind THIS coordinate, which is frequently weaker
than the authority behind the current one.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
One-sigma-equivalent horizontal envelope in metres, as the source states
it. Zero means unpublished.

VALID_FROM.description:
RFC 3339 UTC bounds over which the facility is asserted to have occupied
this position. Either bound is absent when unpublished.

PROVIDER_ID.description: PROVIDER_ID of the SOURCES entry asserting this position.

TXSEmission.description:
One documented emission of one facility: a carrier or channel the facility
is stated to radiate, with the power and antenna terms published for it.

A facility radiating many carriers carries many entries; a facility whose
frequency changes by season or hour carries the documented set here and the
time-bounded usage in `$STX`. Unknown terms are ABSENT.

EMISSION_ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this emission within its facility record.

FREQUENCY_KHZ.description:
Assigned or nominal centre frequency in kilohertz. Kilohertz is the base
unit for this family because it spans the low-frequency broadcasting
allocations to the microwave allocations without unit switching; a
consumer joining to `$RFB` or `$TBS`, which carry megahertz, or to
`$IQC`, which carries hertz, converts at the join, explicitly. Zero means
unpublished.

BANDWIDTH_KHZ.description:
Necessary or occupied bandwidth in kilohertz as the source states it.
Zero means unpublished.

EMISSION_DESIGNATOR.description:
ITU emission designator verbatim, e.g. the necessary-bandwidth and
class-of-emission string a licence record carries. Authoritative over
MODULATION whenever both are present.

SERVICE.description: Service class of THIS emission when it differs from the facility's.

TRANSMITTER_POWER_KW.description:
Transmitter output power at the antenna feed, kilowatts. Zero means
unpublished. Never derived from radiated power.

EFFECTIVE_RADIATED_POWER_KW.description:
Effective radiated power referenced to a half-wave dipole, kilowatts.
Zero means unpublished.

EIRP_KW.description:
Equivalent isotropically radiated power, kilowatts. Zero means
unpublished. Published alongside, never instead of, the dipole-referenced
figure: the two differ by the dipole gain and this standard never
converts between them.

ANTENNA_HEIGHT_AGL_M.description:
Antenna centre of radiation above ground level, metres. Zero means
unpublished.

ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Main-lobe bearing, degrees clockwise from true north. Absent for a
non-directional emission; a non-directional emission is stated by
OMNIDIRECTIONAL, never by a bearing of zero.

OMNIDIRECTIONAL.description: The emission is radiated without a preferred bearing.

BEAMWIDTH_DEG.description: Half-power beamwidth in degrees. Zero means unpublished.

ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description:
Antenna gain in decibels referenced to an isotropic radiator. Zero means
unpublished; a real 0 dBi figure is published as a source term in
provenance rather than being indistinguishable from absence.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification radiated on this emission, verbatim: a callsign, a
spoken or keyed identifier, or the identity string the source publishes.
Never synthesized.

VALID_FROM.description:
RFC 3339 UTC bounds of the authorization or documented use of this
emission. Either bound is absent when unpublished.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this facility, unique within its record
set. Never a source's own identifier and never a coordinate string.

NATIVE_ID.description:
Winning source's native facility identifier, copied verbatim from the
SOURCES entry named by CONSENSUS.WINNING_PROVIDER_ID. Never a substitute
for ID and never stable across sources.

SITE_NAME.description:
Facility or structure name verbatim when a source publishes one. Never
synthesized from coordinates, licensee, or nearest settlement.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification the facility as a whole answers to, verbatim: a
callsign, an assigned station identifier, or the identifier an observer
community records. Per-emission identity lives in
EMISSIONS[].STATION_IDENTITY.

LICENSEE.description:
Licensee, operator or responsible administration name verbatim as the
cited source states it. A display name, never an identifier: consumers
must not treat it as a stable key.

LICENSE_ID.description: Licence, assignment or authorization identifier verbatim.

SERVICE.description:
Primary service class of the facility. Individual emissions may state
their own.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.

ADMIN_AREA.description: Administrative subdivision or locality verbatim as the source states it.

LATITUDE.description:
Published facility position, decimal degrees on WGS 84, produced by the
merge described in CONSENSUS. ABSENT when no source publishes a position:
a region centroid is never substituted. Per-source positions before
reconciliation live in SOURCES[].REPORTED_LATITUDE/REPORTED_LONGITUDE and
are never overwritten by this value.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
The class of authority behind LATITUDE/LONGITUDE. A consumer that renders
a position without reading this field is rendering an unlabelled claim.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
Horizontal envelope in metres within which the facility is asserted to
lie, as the publisher states it. Zero means unpublished — never that the
position is exact.

POSITION_DISPUTED.description:
Credible consulted sources place the facility in materially different
locations, or a source states the position is contested. The published
coordinate remains the publisher's best merge; this flag forbids a
consumer from presenting it as settled.

PRIOR_POSITIONS.description: Positions the facility is asserted to have vacated, most recent first.

GROUND_ELEVATION_AMSL_M.description:
Ground elevation at the facility, metres above mean sea level as the
source states it. Zero means unpublished.

STRUCTURE_HEIGHT_AGL_M.description:
Overall height of the antenna-supporting structure above ground level,
metres. Distinct from any emission's antenna height. Zero means
unpublished.

STRUCTURE_COUNT.description:
Number of antenna-supporting structures at the facility. Zero means
unpublished.

EMISSIONS.description: Every emission the facility is documented to radiate.

FIRST_OBSERVED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond bounds of the documentation or observation
window backing the published record.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted for this facility, including sources that returned
nothing. Required: a facility with no named sources is not publishable.

CONSENSUS.description:
How the entries in SOURCES were reduced to the published position.
Required: a published position always states the rule that produced it,
including SINGLE_SOURCE.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this schedule row, unique within its
record set.

SITE_ID.description:
`$TXS`.ID of the facility radiating this transmission. ABSENT when the
originating facility is unidentified or disputed; a row is publishable
without one and a consumer must not fabricate a join.

SITE_NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the transmitting facility, verbatim —
a register site code or a compilation's site abbreviation. Retained so a
row whose SITE_ID could not be resolved is still traceable.

STATION_NAME.description:
Station or service name verbatim as the source states it. A display name,
never an identifier.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification radiated on this transmission, verbatim: a
callsign, a keyed or spoken identifier, or the identity string the source
publishes. Never synthesized and never inferred from frequency.

FREQUENCY_KHZ.description:
Assigned frequency in kilohertz, following the `$TXS` convention. Zero
means unpublished; a row whose frequency is unpublished is a facility
record, not a schedule row.

BANDWIDTH_KHZ.description:
Necessary or occupied bandwidth in kilohertz when the source states one
for this transmission. Zero means unpublished.

EMISSION_DESIGNATOR.description:
ITU emission designator verbatim. Authoritative over MODULATION whenever
both are present.

TIME_START_UTC.description:
Daily on-air window in Coordinated Universal Time, as four decimal digits
"HHMM". A window whose stop is not later than its start crosses midnight
and is read as continuing into the following day. Strings because the
register form is four digits with significant leading zeros and no date;
an integer would invite a consumer to treat 0000 as absence.

DAYS.description:
Days on which the window runs. An unset field means the source publishes
no day pattern.

IRREGULAR.description:
The transmission runs without a fixed daily window — as required, on
occurrence, or continuously. TIME_START_UTC and TIME_STOP_UTC are absent
in that case and are never filled with 0000/2400 to stand in for it.

VALID_FROM.description:
RFC 3339 UTC bounds over which this row is valid — the seasonal or
licence period. Either bound is absent when unpublished.

SEASON.description:
The source's own name for the validity period, verbatim: a season code, a
schedule edition, or a period label. Never parsed into VALID_FROM by this
standard.

TARGET_AREA.description:
Target area verbatim as the source states it, including its own zone or
region notation.

TARGET_ZONES.description:
Individual target zone identifiers verbatim when the source publishes a
list, one entry per zone, in source order.

TRANSMITTER_POWER_KW.description:
Transmitter output power for this transmission, kilowatts. Zero means
unpublished.

ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Main-lobe bearing for this transmission, degrees clockwise from true
north. Absent for a non-directional transmission, which is stated by
OMNIDIRECTIONAL and never by a bearing of zero.

ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_SECONDARY_DEG.description:
Secondary lobe bearing when the source publishes a slewed or dual-beam
antenna, degrees clockwise from true north.

OMNIDIRECTIONAL.description: The transmission is radiated without a preferred bearing.

ANTENNA_DESIGNATION.description:
Antenna designation verbatim as the source states it — a curtain-array
code, an antenna number, or a pattern identifier.

EMISSION_ID.description:
`$TXS`.EMISSIONS[].EMISSION_ID this row exercises, when the facility
record enumerates it.

FIRST_OBSERVED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond bounds of the observation window backing
the row, when observers rather than a register established it.

OBSERVATION_COUNT.description:
Independent observation reports behind the row. Zero means the source
publishes no count, never that the transmission was never heard.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted for this row, including sources that returned
nothing. Required: a schedule row with no named sources is not
publishable. The provenance table is the one this family already
publishes in `$TXS`; a schedule row and a facility carry provenance of
the same shape and are frequently reconciled from the same fetch.

CHAIN_SETTLEMENT.description: Settlement descriptor (chain, splitter, token) that charges each period

AMOUNT_PER_PERIOD.description: Charge per period in the smallest unit of CURRENCY

NEXT_CHARGE_AT.description: Unix ms of the next scheduled charge

MAX_PERIODS.description: Maximum number of periods; 0 = until cancelled

SIGNATURE.description: Buyer's Ed25519 authorization signature over the terms

TBSProvenance.description:
Replayable provenance for ONE provider's report of ONE site.

Every provider consulted gets its own entry, including providers that
returned nothing, so a consumer can tell "not looked for" from "looked for
and returned nothing". Provider identity is DATA: PROVIDER_ID and AUTHORITY
carry verbatim what that provider states about itself. The standard names
no provider, dataset, or site.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the consulted provider,
unique within the publisher's own provider registry. Never a display
name and never a URL.

AUTHORITY.description:
The authority under which that provider publishes, verbatim as the
provider states it: a spectrum regulator, a network operator, a
crowd-sourced observation programme, or a research dataset. Never
inferred by the publisher.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query, filter, or request parameters used, so the same rows can
be recovered by repeating the fetch.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: there is no encoding for a
redistributed site whose terms are unstated. A provider that publishes no
terms is recorded as publishing no terms; unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that provider publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description:
The licence forbids commercial use. Rides PER SOURCE because one record
may merge an open-terms lane beside a non-commercial cross-check, and the
strictest consulted lane governs any derived product.

NATIVE_ID.description: This provider's own row, cell, or site identifier, verbatim.

REPORTED_LATITUDE.description:
Position this provider reported, in decimal degrees on WGS 84, before
reconciliation. Retained unrounded so the merge stays auditable. Absent
when the provider was consulted and reported no position.

CONTRIBUTED.description:
This provider's report materially contributed to the published CONSENSUS
position. False marks a provider that was consulted and either returned
nothing or was outvoted; its entry is published either way.

TBSConsensus.description:
How one site's independent provider reports were reduced to the single
published position, and how strongly those reports agreed.

PROVIDERS_CONSULTED.description:
Providers queried for this site, including those that returned nothing.
Never fewer than the number of SOURCES entries.

PROVIDERS_AGREEING.description:
Providers whose reported position fell within the publisher's agreement
threshold. A value of 1 means the published position rests on a single
report and was never independently corroborated.

WINNING_PROVIDER_ID.description:
PROVIDER_ID of the report the merge selected, copied verbatim from the
matching SOURCES entry. Absent when METHOD is CENTROID: a computed
position belongs to no single provider.

POSITION_SPREAD_M.description:
Greatest surface distance in metres between any two agreeing reported
positions. Zero is meaningful only when PROVIDERS_AGREEING is 1.

CONFIDENCE.description:
The publisher's own confidence in the merged position, on [0,1]. Never a
provider's figure and never a probability from a model this standard does
not name.

MERGED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which the merge was performed.

TBS.description:
Terrestrial Base Station Site.

One record describes ONE terrestrial cellular base-station site as
reconciled from every provider the publisher consulted. It is the wire
record for terrestrial mobile-network infrastructure, and it is not an
emitter model ($RFE), a band specification ($RFB), a geodetic tracking
station ($GST), a satellite ground station ($SIT), or an observation.

A site cannot be re-serialized unattributed. SOURCES and CONSENSUS are both
required, so every published position carries the providers it came from and
the rule that reconciled them; a consumer that strips attribution has to
leave the standard to do it. Unknown values are ABSENT — never zero, never a
placeholder, never carried across from a neighbouring site.

Identity is ID, the publisher's own. The network addressing fields are the
mobile network's, are assigned by its operator, and are reused worldwide;
none of them is a global key on its own.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this site, unique within its record set.
Recommended form: "<mcc>-<mnc>-<area-code>-<cell-id>".

NATIVE_ID.description:
Winning provider's native site identifier, copied verbatim from the
SOURCES entry named by CONSENSUS.WINNING_PROVIDER_ID. Never a substitute
for ID and never stable across providers.

MCC.description:
Mobile country code from the international mobile-subscriber identity
numbering plan. Zero means the source published none.

MNC.description:
Mobile network code within MCC. Carried as an integer, so decimal leading
zeros are NOT preserved: a two- versus three-digit network code is
distinguished by the numbering plan of MCC, and the source's own text is
retained verbatim in TBSProvenance.NATIVE_ID. Zero means unpublished.

LAC.description:
Location area code, used by GSM-, CDMA- and UMTS-class access. Zero means
unpublished. A site published with a location area code does not also
carry a tracking area code; publishing both asserts two access
generations for one cell.

TAC.description:
Tracking area code, used by LTE- and NR-class access. Zero means
unpublished.

CELL_ID.description:
Cell identity verbatim from the source. A string because width, radix and
leading zeros are significant and differ by access class: a 16-bit cell
identity, a 28-bit evolved cell identity and a 36-bit new-radio cell
identity are not interchangeable integers, and this field never converts
between them.

LATITUDE.description:
Reconciled site position in decimal degrees on WGS 84, produced by the
merge described in CONSENSUS. Per-provider positions before
reconciliation live in SOURCES[].REPORTED_LATITUDE/REPORTED_LONGITUDE and
are never overwritten by this value.

RANGE_M.description:
Radius in metres of the area within which the site's observations were
collected — a positional-uncertainty envelope, not a transmission range,
not a coverage guarantee, and never converted from another unit. Zero
means unpublished.

SAMPLES.description:
Independent observations behind the winning report. Zero means the source
publishes no observation count, never that the site was never observed.

AVERAGE_SIGNAL_DBM.description:
Mean received signal strength in dBm across those observations, as the
source publishes it. Carried in dBm unconverted; a consumer needing watts
converts at the join, explicitly. Zero means unpublished.

FIRST_OBSERVED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond bounds of the observation window backing
the winning report.

OPERATOR.description:
Network operator name verbatim as the cited source states it. A display
name, never an identifier: consumers must not treat it as a stable key.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Operating centre frequency in MHz, following the $RFB convention. A
consumer joining to $IQC, which carries hertz, converts at the join,
explicitly. Zero means unpublished.

SITE_NAME.description:
Site or structure name verbatim when the source publishes one. Never
synthesized from coordinates, operator, or cell identity.

COUNTRY_CODE.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.
Derived from MCC only when the source itself derives it.

SOURCES.description:
Every provider consulted for this site, including providers that returned
nothing. Required: a site with no named sources is not publishable.

CONSENSUS.description:
How the entries in SOURCES were reduced to LATITUDE/LONGITUDE. Required:
a published position always states the rule that produced it, including
SINGLE_SOURCE.

WXFGrid.description:
Regular grid the samples are laid out on. Samples are row-major with
latitude as the outer index: cell (i, j) for 0 <= i < NLAT, 0 <= j < NLON
sits at VALUES[i * NLON + j] and is centred at
(LAT0 + i * DLAT, LON0 + j * DLON). DLAT is negative when rows run north
to south. Longitudes are in [-180, 180) or [0, 360) exactly as the
producer publishes them; a consumer normalises.

LAT0.description: Latitude of the first row's cell centre, degrees north.

LON0.description: Longitude of the first column's cell centre, degrees east.

PERIODIC_LON.description: Whether the last column wraps to the first (global grid).

WXF.description:
Weather Forecast Field - One variable, level, member and valid time on a
regular grid.

FIELD_ID.description:
Stable identifier of the whole field this record belongs to; equal
across all tiles of one (producer, init, member, variable, level, lead).

INIT_TIME_MS.description: Initialisation (analysis) time of the run, Unix milliseconds UTC.

VALID_TIME_MS.description:
Time the field is valid at, Unix milliseconds UTC
(INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3.6e6).

HORIZON_HOURS.description:
Maximum lead the run was integrated to, hours (e.g. 360 for a synoptic
cycle, 48 for an interim cycle).

MEMBER_KIND.description: Ensemble realisation or statistic the field represents.

MEMBER_INDEX.description: Zero-based member index when MEMBER_KIND is Member.

ENSEMBLE_SIZE.description: Number of members in the ensemble the run produced.

PERCENTILE.description: Percentile rank in [0, 100] when MEMBER_KIND is Percentile.

THRESHOLD_VALUE.description: Threshold in UNITS when MEMBER_KIND is a probability kind.

VARIABLE_NAME.description:
Producer's native variable name (always set; authoritative when
VARIABLE is Unspecified).

UNITS.description:
Units of every cell value, UCUM or CF style (e.g. "K", "m s-1", "Pa",
"1").

LEVEL_VALUE.description: Vertical coordinate value in the unit fixed by LEVEL_KIND.

TEMPORAL_KIND.description: Temporal character of each cell value.

ACCUMULATION_HOURS.description:
Accumulation or averaging window ending at VALID_TIME_MS, hours; 0 for
Instantaneous.

GRID.description: Grid geometry of this record's samples (of this tile when tiled).

TILE_INDEX.description: Zero-based tile index within FIELD_ID; 0 for an untiled field.

TILE_COUNT.description: Number of tiles FIELD_ID was split into; 1 for an untiled field.

CHUNK_CID.description:
Content identifier of the sample chunk when VALUES_ENCODING is
ContentAddressedChunk.

CHUNK_CODECS.description:
Codec chain applied to the chunk, outermost last (e.g. "bytes",
"zstd").

VALUE_MIN.description:
Minimum sample over the field (after decoding); statistics for display
scaling without touching the chunk.

VALUE_MAX.description: Maximum sample over the field (after decoding).

MISSING_COUNT.description: Number of cells with a missing value.

ORIGIN_ID.description:
Upstream publisher the field was retrieved from, as a host name or
stable identifier.

DATASET_ID.description:
Stable dataset identifier within the origin (e.g. a bucket, collection
or table name).

SOURCE_URL.description: Upstream URL or object path the field was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds UTC when the field was retrieved from the origin.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms the field is offered under.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that ingested and published this record.

TCTRadii.description:
Wind radii by quadrant at one wind-speed threshold. Radii are kilometres
(1 nmi = 1.852 km exactly) from the centre to the outermost point at which
the threshold is reached; 0 means the threshold is not reached in that
quadrant; a negative value means not reported.

THRESHOLD_WIND_MS.description:
Wind-speed threshold, m/s, converted exactly from knots
(1 kt = 1852/3600 m/s: 34 kt = 17.49, 50 kt = 25.72, 64 kt = 32.92).

VALID_TIME_MS.description: Time the point is valid at, Unix milliseconds UTC.

LEAD_HOURS.description: Lead from INIT_TIME_MS, hours; 0 for observed tracks.

MAX_SUSTAINED_WIND_MS.description:
Maximum sustained wind over WIND_AVERAGING_PERIOD_S, m/s
(1 kt = 1852/3600 m/s).

MIN_CENTRAL_PRESSURE_PA.description: Minimum central pressure, pascal (1 hPa = 100 Pa).

RADIUS_MAX_WIND_KM.description: Radius of maximum wind, km; negative when not reported.

RADII.description: Wind radii at each reported threshold.

EXISTENCE_PROBABILITY.description:
Probability in [0, 1] that the system exists at this point; 1 for
observed tracks and unconditional forecasts.

MOTION_DIRECTION_DEG.description:
Direction of motion, degrees clockwise from north; negative when not
reported.

MOTION_SPEED_MS.description: Speed of motion, m/s; negative when not reported.

TCT.description: Tropical Cyclone Track - One realisation of one storm's track.

STORM_ID.description:
Stable storm identifier as issued by the origin (e.g. a best-track
serial identifier); equal across every member of the same storm.

STORM_NAME.description: Storm name if assigned; empty for invests and unnamed genesis events.

BASIN.description: Basin the system is tracked in.

TRACK_ORIGIN.description: Whether the system existed at initialisation.

MODEL_CLASS.description: Class of the producing model; Unspecified for observed tracks.

INIT_TIME_MS.description:
Initialisation time of the run, Unix milliseconds UTC; for observed
tracks the issue time of the track.

MEMBER_KIND.description: Ensemble realisation or statistic the track represents.

MEMBER_INDEX.description: Zero-based member index when MEMBER_KIND is Member.

ENSEMBLE_SIZE.description: Number of members in the ensemble the run produced.

WIND_AVERAGING_PERIOD_S.description: Averaging period of MAX_SUSTAINED_WIND_MS, seconds (60 or 600).

POINTS.description: Track points in ascending VALID_TIME_MS order.

ORIGIN_ID.description:
Upstream publisher the track was retrieved from, as a host name or
stable identifier.

DATASET_ID.description: Stable dataset identifier within the origin.

SOURCE_URL.description: Upstream URL or object path the track was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds UTC when the track was retrieved from the origin.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms the track is offered under.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that ingested and published this record.

TDMTransmitRamp.description:
One uplink transmitter frequency ramp applying over a closed time interval.

SDS EXTENSION beyond CCSDS 503.0-B-1: the base standard carries a single
TRANSMIT_FREQ_1 per segment, which cannot express a ramped uplink. Deep-space
radiometric archives carry an explicit ramp table and the Doppler observables
are NOT reconstructible without it. Ramps are optional; a record that omits
TRANSMIT_RAMPS is exactly a CCSDS-conformant TDM.

Frequency over the interval is the linear polynomial
f(t) = FREQUENCY_HZ + FREQUENCY_RATE_HZ_PER_S * (t - REFERENCE_TIME)
which is the common form of the two archive representations: DSN ODF
(TRK-2-18, table 3-5) supplies ramp start frequency, ramp rate, and ramp
start/end time, so REFERENCE_TIME equals START_TIME; ESA IFMS supplies a
ramp reference time with constant and linear transmission-frequency terms,
so REFERENCE_TIME is that reference time and may precede START_TIME.
Producers MUST set REFERENCE_TIME explicitly rather than letting a consumer
assume which convention was used.

START_TIME.description: Start of the interval over which this ramp applies, ISO 8601.

END_TIME.description: End of the interval over which this ramp applies, ISO 8601.

REFERENCE_TIME.description: Epoch at which FREQUENCY_HZ is the instantaneous value, ISO 8601.

FREQUENCY_RATE_HZ_PER_S.description: Constant ramp rate over the interval, Hz per second.

TRANSMITTING_STATION_ID.description:
Identifier of the transmitting station the ramp applies to. Must match
the PARTICIPANT_n naming used by the segment when both are present.

TRANSMIT_BAND.description:
Uplink band the ramp applies to, using the same vocabulary as
TRANSMIT_BAND (e.g. "S", "X", "Ka", "Ku").

TDMObservation.description:
ONE CCSDS TDM observation: a single data-section line.

A TDM data section is NOT a uniform grid. Every line in every published
example (CCSDS 503.0-B-2 Cor.1 annex E, 18 figures) has the literal form

KEYWORD = <epoch> <value>

and the epochs are chosen INDEPENDENTLY PER KEYWORD. Figure E-17 (ground
based radar tracking with RCS) is decisive: RANGE, ANGLE_1, ANGLE_2 and
CARRIER_POWER share epochs, while the final RCS line repeats the EARLIER
epoch 2011-05-11T10:26:33.7008 after a 10:26:33.9686 line. No single
OBSERVATION_START_TIME + i * OBSERVATION_STEP_SIZE grid can express that,
which is why the parallel observation arrays on the TDM root cannot
round-trip a conformant TDM.

KEYWORD is the CCSDS data keyword verbatim and case-exact, e.g. "RANGE",
"ANGLE_1", "CARRIER_POWER", "RCS", "DOPPLER_INTEGRATED", "PR_N0",
"RECEIVE_FREQ_1", "TRANSMIT_PHASE_CT_1", "VLBI_DELAY", "DOR", "MAG",
"CLOCK_BIAS", "STEC", "TROPO_DRY", "PRESSURE". Carrying the keyword rather
than a fixed field per observable is what lets this form transport the whole
503.0-B-2 data vocabulary, including keywords a future issue adds, without
a wire change and without inventing a name the standard does not define.

Units are those the standard assigns to that keyword; RANGE additionally
depends on RANGE_UNITS, which is metadata, not data.

KEYWORD.description: CCSDS data keyword, verbatim and case-exact.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this single observation, ISO 8601, in the segment TIME_SYSTEM.

TDMSegment.description:
One TDM metadata + data segment.

A TDM file may carry MANY segments, each with its own META_START/META_STOP
block and its own DATA_START/DATA_STOP block (503.0-B-2 Cor.1 annex E,
figures E-16 and E-18). The TDM root models a SINGLE segment, so a
multi-segment file cannot be represented without this vector.

COMMENT.description: Comments carried in this segment's metadata block, in file order.

OBSERVATIONS.description:
The segment's observations, in FILE ORDER. This is the authoritative
data-section representation.

TRANSMIT_RAMPS.description:
Uplink frequency ramp table applying to this segment. SDS EXTENSION;
absent (not empty) for a ramp-free, exactly CCSDS-conformant segment.

PATH.description:

MODE.description: Mode of TDM -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

PATH_1.description: First path in TDM -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

META_STOP.description: End of metadata section -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

DATA_START.description: Start of data section -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

Additional properties as required by the specific application of the TDM...

ANGLE_TYPE.description:
Type of angle data -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12
Can be AZEL, RADEC, XEYN, XSYE, or another value with provided ICD

ANGLE_1.description: First angle value -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12

ANGLE_2.description: Second angle value -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12

CORRECTION_ANGLE_2.description: Second correction angle -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12

TROPO_DRY.description: Dry component of tropospheric delay -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-14

TROPO_WET.description: Wet component of tropospheric delay -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-14

CLOCK_BIAS.description: Clock bias values -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-15

CLOCK_DRIFT.description: Clock drift values -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-15

SIGNAL_TO_NOISE.description:
SDS EXTENSION beyond CCSDS 503.0-B-1. Open-loop (non-coherent) Doppler
quality metrics, one entry per observation, parallel to the other
observation arrays and reconstructed on the same OBSERVATION_START_TIME +
i * OBSERVATION_STEP_SIZE grid.

Signal-to-noise ratio of the detection.

SPECTRAL_MAX.description: SDS EXTENSION. Normalised spectral maximum of the detection.

DOPPLER_NOISE_HZ.description:
SDS EXTENSION. 1-sigma noise on the measured Doppler frequency, Hz. The
measured sky frequency itself is carried by RECEIVE_FREQ; this is its
uncertainty, which CCSDS 503.0-B-1 has no field for.

TRANSMIT_RAMPS.description:
SDS EXTENSION beyond CCSDS 503.0-B-1. Uplink transmitter frequency ramp
table covering this segment, ordered by START_TIME and non-overlapping.
Required in practice for ramped uplinks, where TRANSMIT_FREQ_1 alone
cannot reconstruct the observables. Absent for unramped tracking, which
leaves the record exactly CCSDS-conformant.

OBSERVATIONS.description: Data-section observations for a SINGLE-segment TDM, in file order.

SEGMENTS.description: All metadata+data segments of a MULTI-segment TDM, in file order.

TRANSMIT_FREQ_2.description:
Additional transmit frequencies by participant, Hz. TRANSMIT_FREQ_1
already exists above; 2..5 had no carrier.

TRANSMIT_FREQ_RATE_1.description:
Transmit frequency rates by participant, Hz/s. A constant rate here is
the single-interval degenerate case of TRANSMIT_RAMPS.

DATA_TYPES.description: Comma-separated list of the data keywords present in the data section.

PATH.description:
Signal path through the participants as an ordered comma-separated list,
e.g. "1,2,1". Distinct from the numbered PATH_1 / PATH_2 above.

EPHEMERIS_NAME_1.description: Name of the ephemeris used to generate the data, per participant.

RANGE_UNITS.description:
Units of the RANGE observable: "km", "s" or "RU" (range units).
RANGE is meaningless without it.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
Reference frame for angle and position data, as the verbatim CCSDS
keyword value (503.0-B-2 annex B).

INTERPOLATION.description: Recommended interpolation method for the observations.

FREQ_OFFSET.description: Frequency offset applied to the observations, Hz.

RECEIVE_DELAY_1.description:
Receive delay for the first participant, s. (RECEIVE_DELAY_2 and
RECEIVE_DELAY_3 already exist on the TDM root.)

DOPPLER_COUNT_ROLLOVER.description: Whether the Doppler counter rolls over (CCSDS YES/NO).

CORRECTION_RANGE.description:
Corrections that a consumer must apply, or that were applied when
CORRECTIONS_APPLIED is "YES". Units follow the corrected observable.

TFNDesignator.description: One designator the facility answers to in a named coding system.

SCHEME.description:
Coding-system token, verbatim (the system's own name). Never a field
name and never normalized by the publisher.

VALUE.description: The designator within that system, verbatim.

TFNOperatingSurface.description:
One operating surface: the arrival/departure geometry of the facility.
A runway and a berth carry the same shape; fields a domain does not use
are absent (NaN), never zero.

SURFACE_ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier of this surface within the facility.

SURFACE_TYPE_CODE.description:
The source's own surface-kind token, verbatim, so a kind outside
tfnSurfaceKind survives a round trip.

DESIGNATOR.description:
Published designator of the surface, verbatim (runway designator,
berth number).

DEPTH_M.description: Available depth of water, metres, for a maritime surface.

SURFACE_MATERIAL.description: Surface material or construction, verbatim as the source states it.

TRUE_BEARING_DEG.description: True bearing of the surface's operating direction, degrees, [0, 360).

THRESHOLD_LATITUDE.description:
Geodetic position of the threshold or reference point of this
surface, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

TFNProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one facility record.

Required on every record: a redistributed facility whose dataset, epoch,
and licence are unstated is not publishable. The standard names no
dataset, provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the dataset this facility
was taken from, unique within the publisher's own dataset registry.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this

DATASET_CID.description: Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when one exists.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or file selection used.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this facility record.

PLACE_ID.description:
`$GNP.ID` of the gazetteer place carrying this facility's name set
and location. Location is joined, never re-published here.

Operational display name, verbatim, when it differs from the place
name in `$GNP`.

DESIGNATORS.description: Every designator the facility answers to, scheme-tagged.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.

Field or reference elevation, metres above mean sea level as the

MAGNETIC_VARIATION_DEG.description:
Magnetic variation at the facility, degrees, positive east, as the

OPERATING_SURFACES.description: The operating surfaces of the facility.

MAXIMUM_DRAFT_M.description: Maximum vessel draft the facility accepts, metres.

ANCHORAGE_DEPTH_M.description: Depth of water at the principal anchorage, metres.

HARBOR_TYPE.description: Harbor type token, verbatim as the source publishes it.

SHELTER_AFFORDED.description: Shelter afforded token, verbatim as the source publishes it.

SENSOR_ID.description: Sensor identifier

MULTI_SOURCE.description: True if fused from multiple sources

TRACK_COMPONENTS.description: Number of components per point (default 3 for X, Y, Z)

ECEF_POS.description: ECEF position as flat array [X0, Y0, Z0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]

ECEF_VEL.description: ECEF velocity as flat array [VX0, VY0, VZ0, VX1, VY1, VZ1, ...]

LC_ACC.description: Local coordinate acceleration as flat array

COV.description: Covariance data (21 elements per point for 6x6 lower triangular)

ERR_ELLP.description: Error ellipse data (6 elements per point)

TMSModelParameter.description:
One parameter of the propagation model, stated by name so a model
registry can evolve without schema change.

UNITS.description:
Units of VALUE, verbatim. Required: a unitless parameter states so
explicitly (e.g. "1").

TMSIdentifier.description: One identity the track is known by in a named identity scheme.

SCHEME.description:
Identity scheme token, verbatim (the identity system's own name).

VALUE.description: The identifier within that scheme, verbatim.

TMSProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one track model state.

Required on every record: a redistributed track whose feed, epoch, and
licence are unstated is not publishable. The standard names no feed,
provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the feed or dataset this
state was derived from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The feed or dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the feed or dataset as published.

RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition or feed

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or subscription used.

RETRIEVED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp of the observation
this state was updated from.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the track or observation stream this
state was derived from, verbatim.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC instant the source last modified or emitted the
underlying observation, as the source states it.

ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this state record.

TRACK_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of the track this state belongs to, held
constant across every state update of the same track.

ENVIRONMENT.description:
Domain the track moves in. The `$TRK` enum reused verbatim; ordinal 0
is SPACE, so a publisher MUST set this field — it is defaulted to
UNKNOWN explicitly so an unset field can never be read as SPACE.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch this state is valid at. The
propagation origin: every kinematic field below is stated at EPOCH.

LATITUDE.description: Latitude, decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive north.

LONGITUDE.description: Longitude, decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive east, in [-180, 180].

ALTITUDE_M.description:
Altitude, metres above the WGS 84 ellipsoid. NaN for a surface track
whose source publishes no altitude.

GROUND_SPEED_MPS.description: Speed over ground, metres per second.

VELOCITY_NORTH_MPS.description:
Velocity components, metres per second, local NED-derived axes:
north, east, and up. Published when the source or filter resolves
them; NaN otherwise.

HEADING_DEG.description: Heading, degrees true, [0, 360): the direction the vehicle points.

TURN_RATE_DPS.description: Turn rate, degrees per second, positive clockwise seen from above.

VERTICAL_RATE_MPS.description: Vertical rate, metres per second, positive up.

Identifier of the dead-reckoning or motion model that extrapolates
this state, a key into the publisher's model registry. Required: a
