PROPAGATION_VALID_UNTIL.description:
RFC 3339 UTC instant beyond which the publisher no longer stands
behind propagation of this state.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description: 1-sigma horizontal position uncertainty at EPOCH, metres.

INNOVATION_GATE_SIGMA.description:
Gate in standard deviations: an observation whose innovation exceeds
this many sigma of POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M breached the model and
produced this update.

INNOVATION_GATE_DISTANCE_M.description:
Gate as an absolute distance, metres, when the publisher gates on
distance rather than sigma.

TOLERANCE_M.description:
Publisher's stated tolerance, metres, within which propagation of this
state is considered to agree with truth.

TRACK_STATUS.description:
Track status. The `$TRK` enum reused verbatim; ordinal 0 is ACTIVE,
so a publisher MUST set this field on every record — an unset field
reads as ACTIVE and a consumer cannot distinguish the two.

STALE_AFTER_S.description:
Seconds after LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH at which a consumer MUST mark the
track stale.

DROP_AFTER_S.description:
Seconds after LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH at which a consumer MUST drop the
track.

LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the last source observation
that updated this track — the staleness clock origin. EPOCH may lag it
when the publisher re-emits a keepalive state.

IDENTIFIERS.description: Every identity the track is known by, scheme-tagged.

TNR.description:
Trust Node Record - Durable node membership state for an SDN trust graph.

TNR records preserve isolated trust graph nodes that do not currently have
an active trust edge. The current graph is a projection over the latest TNR
and TRE records, where deleted records are tombstones.

NODE_ID.description: Stable trust graph node identifier, normally an SDN peer ID or account id.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this node record was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this node record was last updated.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the node from the current graph.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the node/provider that issued this trust graph record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the trust node record.

TRE.description:
Trust Edge Record - Durable directed trust assertion for an SDN trust graph.

A TRE records one directed truster -> trustee assertion. The current trust
graph is a projection over the latest TRE records by EDGE_ID, with deleted
records acting as tombstones. Implementations must still validate the
projected graph for acyclicity before accepting it.

WEIGHT.description: Truster-assigned edge weight in the range [0, 1].

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this edge was last updated.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the edge from the current graph.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the node/provider that issued this trust edge record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the trust edge record.

TRH.description:
Tracking Hardware. Installations attach antennas, transmitters, receivers
and transponders to either a surface site or a tracked object. Delays are
seconds, frequencies hertz, temperatures kelvin and powers watts. JSON
projections preserve these IDL-capitalized field names exactly.

TRPAsset.description: Asset admitted by a value or token predicate.

CHAIN_ID.description:
CAIP-2 style chain identifier, e.g. "eip155:1" or
"solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp". Vendor and organization names
are forbidden; a chain is named only by its identifier.

TOKEN_ADDRESS.description: Chain-local token address, or empty for the chain's native asset.

TOKEN_SYMBOL.description: Published token symbol used for display and matching.

DECIMALS.description: Number of decimal places used by the smallest-unit integer balance.

TRPPredicate.description: One independently measurable predicate in a trust rule policy.

PREDICATE_ID.description: Stable identifier unique within the policy.

MIN_VALUE.description: Minimum qualifying value expressed as a uint64 in the smallest unit.

VALUE_CURRENCY.description: Currency or unit used to compare normalized values.

MIN_HELD_SECONDS.description: Minimum continuous holding duration in seconds.

REQUIRED_COUNT.description: X, the number of named trusters that must match.

TRUSTER_IDS.description: The N named `$TRE` trusters considered by a trusted-connections predicate.

MIN_EDGE_WEIGHT.description: Minimum accepted `$TRE.WEIGHT` for a matching trust edge.

TRPGroup.description: Recursive boolean group for a compound trust rule set.

GROUP_ID.description: Stable identifier unique within the policy.

COMBINATOR.description: Boolean operation applied across direct predicates and child groups.

PREDICATES.description: Predicates evaluated directly within this group.

GROUPS.description: Nested groups used to express compound rule sets.

TRP.description: Trust Rule Policy - Signed compound criteria for evaluating one subject.

ROOT.description: Root of the compound rule tree.

EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS.description:
Periodic evaluation cadence in milliseconds. The 10000 default is the
0.1 Hz baseline and is configurable by the policy author.

EVENT_SOURCES.description:
Event names that may trigger evaluation, e.g. "trust-edge", "trust-node",
"entity-profile", or "chain-balance".

ACTIVE.description: Whether evaluators should currently apply this policy.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this policy was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this policy was last updated.

EVALUATOR_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the evaluator that issued this policy record.

EVALUATOR_SIGNATURE.description: Evaluator signature over the policy record.

TRSRequest.description:
One terrain raster solve request.

FRAMES. The analysis frame is a local East-North-Up (ENU) frame: local X
is east, Y is north, Z is up. Both grids share the same analysis-frame
bounds, anchored at (MIN_EAST_M, MIN_NORTH_M). Per-cell geodetic
coordinates are carried explicitly in GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD /
GRID_LATITUDE_RAD so a solver recomputes exact per-cell Earth-fixed
geometry instead of interpolating it.

PROFILE_WIDTH.description:
Obstruction profile field width, cells. The profile is a FINER field
than the output raster; the line-of-sight march samples it.

SOLVER_TIER.description:
Fidelity tier requested. A solver that does not implement the tier
REFUSES; it never silently downgrades.

PROPAGATION_MODEL.description:
Propagation model requested for the per-cell loss term. A solver that
does not implement the model REFUSES; it never silently substitutes.

ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL_MASK.description:
Atmospheric attenuation terms requested, as a bitmask: 0 none,
bit 0 (1) gaseous absorption, bit 1 (2) rain attenuation, bit 2 (4)
cloud/fog attenuation. A solver that does not implement a requested
term REFUSES.

THREAD_COUNT_HINT.description:
Parallelism hint. 0 or 1 means sequential. A solver MUST produce
byte-identical layers at any value — cells are independent and a thread
writes only its own indices; determinism is part of this contract.

MIN_EAST_M.description: Analysis-frame east coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

MIN_NORTH_M.description: Analysis-frame north coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

PROFILE_SPACING_M.description: Profile sample spacing, meters; sets the line-of-sight march stride.

MINIMUM_STEP_M.description:
Minimum march step, meters. NaN means caller left it unset and the
solver applies its own documented default.

TX_LOCAL_X_M.description:
Emitter position in the analysis ENU frame, meters (X east, Y north,
Z up).

TX_ECEF_X_M.description:
Emitter Earth-centered Earth-fixed position, meters — carried so the
solver computes exact per-cell range rather than a small-angle
approximation.

TX_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT_M.description: Emitter height above the reference ellipsoid, meters.

TX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_M.description:
Terrain surface height under the emitter, meters above the ellipsoid.
Emitter height above ground = TX_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT_M −
TX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_M.

INVERSE_ENU_TRANSFORM.description:
Column-major 4x4 inverse of the analysis ENU frame transform (the
matrix that takes Earth-fixed points INTO the analysis frame). Exactly
16 entries.

TARGET_HEIGHT_M.description: Receiver height above ground at every cell, meters.

BANDWIDTH_HZ.description:
Noise bandwidth, hertz. NaN means caller left it unset and the solver
applies its own documented default.

TX_POWER_W.description: Transmit power, watts. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

TX_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

TX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:
Transmit line loss, dB (positive). NaN means unset; solver default
applies.

RX_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

RX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:
Receive line loss, dB (positive). NaN means unset; solver default
applies.

RX_NOISE_FIGURE_DB.description: Receiver noise figure, dB. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

EFFECTIVE_EARTH_RADIUS_FACTOR.description:
Effective Earth radius factor (k-factor) for curvature correction.
NaN means no curvature term is applied — NOT a default of 4/3.

GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD.description:
Geodetic longitude of every output cell, radians, row-major,
GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

GRID_LATITUDE_RAD.description:
Geodetic latitude of every output cell, radians, row-major,
GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

GROUND_HEIGHTS_M.description:
Terrain height at every output cell, meters above the ellipsoid,
row-major, GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

PROFILE_HEIGHTS_M.description:
COMPOSITE obstruction surface (terrain plus structures) at every
profile cell, meters above the ellipsoid, row-major,
PROFILE_WIDTH * PROFILE_HEIGHT entries.

PROFILE_SURFACE_Z_M.description:
The same composite surface expressed as analysis-frame Z, meters —
the frame the line-of-sight test runs in. PROFILE_WIDTH *
PROFILE_HEIGHT entries.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace/correlation identifier.

TRSResult.description:
One terrain raster solve result. On STATUS = OK every layer below is
present with exactly GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT row-major entries. On any
other STATUS the result carries NO layers — never a partial raster.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description:
On REFUSED or INVALID_INPUT: names the exact gap or defect. Empty on
OK.

GRID_WIDTH.description:
Output raster dimensions the layers are stated for, echoed from the
request.

VISIBLE_MASK.description:
1 where the geometric ray from the emitter clears the obstruction
surface, else 0.

PATH_CLASS.description:
Path classification of every cell from the dominant-edge diffraction
parameter — see trsPathClass.

PATH_LOSS_DB.description: Total path loss including every applied term, dB (positive).

EXCESS_LOSS_DB.description: Loss above free space — what the terrain cost the cell, dB.

DIFFRACTION_PARAMETER.description:
ITU-R P.526-15 eq. (29) diffraction parameter v of the dominant edge.
Exactly -10.0 where no finite v exists (an unobstructed, Fresnel-clear
path) — the layer's stated no-finite-v encoding, carried verbatim so
the FlatBuffer and aligned-binary forms stay byte-comparable.

REFLECTION_CONTRIBUTION_DB.description:
Specular ground-bounce contribution, dB. All zeros outside the
SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE tier.

TRACE_ID.description:
Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when
present.

TRVBondEvidence.description: Chain evidence supporting a value-based predicate result.

CHAIN_ID.description: Chain identifier using the same identifier-only convention as TRPAsset.

ADDRESS.description: Chain-local address whose balance was evaluated.

TOKEN_ADDRESS.description: Chain-local token address, or empty for the chain's native asset.

BALANCE.description: Observed uint64 balance expressed in the asset's smallest unit.

DECIMALS.description: Number of decimal places used by BALANCE.

VALUE_CURRENCY.description: Currency or unit used for normalized valuation.

HELD_SINCE.description:
Unix timestamp in milliseconds from which the balance is proven to have
been continuously held, established from chain history.

OBSERVED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the balance was observed.

BLOCK_REFERENCE.description: Chain-specific block identifier anchoring the observation.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or query description used to obtain the evidence.

TRVPredicateResult.description: Outcome and evidence for one policy predicate.

KIND.description: Predicate operation copied from the evaluated policy.

REQUIRED_VALUE.description: Threshold required by the evaluated predicate.

BOND_EVIDENCE.description: Chain evidence used by value and duration predicates.

TRUSTER_IDS_MATCHED.description: Named `$TRE` trusters whose qualifying edges matched.

TRV.description:
Trust Rule Verdict.

A TRV records one reproducible evaluation of a `$TRP` policy for a subject.
This record replaces ad-hoc trust status events.

SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the subject evaluated by the policy.

PREVIOUS_PASSED.description: Pass state produced by the immediately preceding evaluation.

PREVIOUS_SCORE.description: Score produced by the immediately preceding evaluation.

TRIGGER.description: Evaluation trigger: "interval" or an event source name.

EVALUATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the evaluation completed.

EVALUATOR_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the evaluator that issued this verdict.

EVALUATOR_SIGNATURE.description: Evaluator signature over the verdict record.

VAMScale3.description: Scale with identity defaults for every component.

VAMTransform.description: Transform from source coordinates into canonical meters. Absent SCALE and omitted scale components mean identity scale; translation and bounds use VAMVector3 zero defaults.

VAMAnnotation.description: Coordinate pin or general structured annotation in canonical model-meter coordinates. POSITION is absent for a general note.

VAMSource.description: Provenance and license metadata for an asset source.

OBSERVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the source was observed.

SOURCE_METADATA_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON source-metadata bytes.

VAMMetrics.description: Geometry, material, texture, and bounds measurements.

VAMValidation.description: Validation result for one asset variant.

VALIDATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when validation completed.

VAMQualityDimension.description: One named quality score and its basis.

VAMVariant.description: One source, optimized, LOD, or alternate visual representation.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: IANA media type of the exact variant bytes.

BYTE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact variant file bytes.

CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact variant file bytes.

GLTF_VERSION.description: MAJOR.MINOR glTF specification version, such as 2.0.

CONVERSION_VERSION.description: CONVERSION_VERSION is the exact version identifier reported by CONVERSION_TOOL without normalization.

INPUT_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact conversion input bytes.

RANK.description: Priority within the VAM; zero is highest priority and ranks must be unique within a VAM.

VAMApprovedAlternate.description: Exact approved alternate asset bytes and reviewed state.

CID.description: Nonempty CIDv1 identifying the exact approved alternate bytes.

BYTE_SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the exact approved alternate bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

VAMReview.description:
Signed binary-backed review decision over a specific candidate. This table exists only for a submitted decision; DECISION NONE and APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY are not accepted VAMReview evidence.
The review-envelope projection contains these uppercase schema field names in schema declaration order: REVIEWER_ID; CAPABILITY_ID when present; DECISION encoded as its unsigned enum integer; CANDIDATE_ID; CANDIDATE_CID when present; CANDIDATE_SHA256; DECIDED_AT; REASONS; COMMENT when present; SIGNATURE_TYPE; PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256 when present; REVIEWER_ROLE encoded as its unsigned enum integer; REPOSITORY; ISSUE_NUMBER; ENTITY_ID; VAM_ID; NONCE; REVIEWED_TRANSFORM when present; CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID when present; ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS; ANNOTATIONS; and APPROVED_ALTERNATES.
Projection order is descriptive; RFC 8785 sorts object keys during canonicalization.
Absent optional fields are omitted and arrays preserve order; nested VAMTransform and VAMAnnotation use uppercase schema field names and numeric enums. Nested VAMApprovedAlternate uses uppercase schema field names, numeric RANK, and transforms normalized by decoding schema defaults. A verifier reconstructs exactly this projection, applies RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), hashes the UTF-8 serialization bytes, compares the digest, then verifies SIGNATURE over the raw 32-byte digest.
Before trusting DECISION, a verifier must enforce binary decision invariants; repository, issue, entity, and VAM equality; nonce single use; role authorization; and exact candidate binding. CAPABILITY_ID, REPOSITORY, ISSUE_NUMBER, ENTITY_ID, VAM_ID, and NONCE MUST be present and nonempty for any new binary-backed signed decision and are required by the binary validation profile; their wire slots are optional only for backward compatibility.
Legacy buffers lacking those six fields remain decodable but are not valid new publication approvals. For these compatibility fields, the projection omits absent optionals only when decoding legacy records; the new validation profile rejects absence before signature trust. APPROVE requires CANDIDATE_CID; every binary decision requires exact CANDIDATE_SHA256.
Under the validation profile, when DECISION is APPROVE, CANDIDATE_CID MUST be present; REVIEWED_TRANSFORM and CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST be present; and CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST equal CANDIDATE_ID. These fields remain optional on the wire for compatibility.
The enclosing VAM.ID MUST equal VAM_ID; the enclosing VAM.ENTITY_ID MUST equal review ENTITY_ID; and the enclosing VAM.CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST equal review CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID.
The referenced VAMVariant.ID MUST equal CANDIDATE_ID; that variant CID and BYTE_SHA256 MUST equal signed CANDIDATE_CID and CANDIDATE_SHA256; and its TRANSFORM MUST be field-for-field equal to REVIEWED_TRANSFORM after decoding schema defaults.
The enclosing VAM.ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS MUST exactly equal signed review ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS, with the same IDs in the same order; empty equals empty.
Each alternate ID MUST resolve to an existing VAMVariant; alternate IDs MUST be distinct and MUST NOT equal CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID. The referenced alternates retain their signed canonical rank ordering as represented by the manifest list.
APPROVED_ALTERNATES MUST correspond one-for-one with ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS in the same order; each descriptor VARIANT_ID MUST equal the corresponding alternate ID. Empty ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS requires empty APPROVED_ALTERNATES.
Each descriptor CID, BYTE_SHA256, REVIEWED_TRANSFORM, and RANK MUST be field-for-field equal to the resolved VAMVariant. BYTE_SHA256 MUST be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and CID MUST be nonempty.
The publication validator rejects any omission or mismatch before signature trust or publication. Any alternate byte, CID, BYTE_SHA256, transform, or rank change requires a new signed review and envelope.

CANDIDATE_CID.description: Optional CIDv1 containing a multihash of exact candidate bytes; metadata-only candidates may not have a CID.

CANDIDATE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of exact candidate bytes, required for every binary-backed decision.

DECIDED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the decision was made.

ENVELOPE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS serialization of the projected review object, excluding ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the raw 32-byte SHA-256 digest represented by ENVELOPE_SHA256.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description: Signature algorithm and profile; initially Ed25519.

PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the prior projected review object's RFC 8785 JCS serialization, excluding its ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE.

REPOSITORY.description: Canonical repository identifier in owner/name form.

ISSUE_NUMBER.description: Positive base-10 issue number digits with no leading zero.

NONCE.description: Unique opaque identifier containing at least 128 bits of entropy.

VAMMetadataOnlyReview.description:
Signed metadata-only review. DECISION validation MUST equal APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY; no candidate binary or CID fields exist.
The metadata-review signed projection contains uppercase schema field names in schema declaration order: REVIEWER_ID; CAPABILITY_ID; REVIEWER_ROLE encoded as its unsigned enum integer; REPOSITORY; ISSUE_NUMBER; ENTITY_ID; VAM_ID; NONCE; DECISION encoded as its unsigned enum integer; CANDIDATE_ID; CANDIDATE_METADATA_SHA256; DECIDED_AT; REASONS; COMMENT when present; ANNOTATIONS; SIGNATURE_TYPE; and PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256 when present.
Absent optional fields are omitted and arrays preserve order. A verifier reconstructs exactly this projection, applies RFC 8785 JCS, hashes the UTF-8 serialization bytes, compares ENVELOPE_SHA256, and verifies SIGNATURE over the raw 32-byte digest. ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE are excluded from the projection.
The verifier must also enforce repository, issue, entity, and VAM equality; nonce single use; role authorization; exact metadata binding; and DECISION equal to APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY before trusting the decision.

CANDIDATE_METADATA_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON VAMSource projection using uppercase field names.
The VAMSource projection always includes SOURCE_RECORD_ID and SOURCE_URL; includes SOURCE_NAME, OBSERVED_AT, LICENSE_NAME, ATTRIBUTION, SOURCE_METADATA_SHA256, and NOTES only when present; and always includes LICENSE_CLASS, REDISTRIBUTION_PERMISSION, and DERIVATIVE_PERMISSION as unsigned enum integers. It contains no other fields.
A verifier reconstructs this projection from the candidate SOURCE and compares the digest before trusting DECISION.

VAM.description: Visual Asset Manifest — ranked visual representations for one stable entity.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 manifest-format version, not a content revision.

CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID.description: Identifies the approved canonical variant; alternate variants preserve their ranks.

VARIANTS.description: MUST be sorted ascending RANK. Ranks must be unique; tie-break bytewise ID only for invalid or legacy duplicate ranks.

CREATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the manifest was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the manifest was last updated.

SUPERSEDES_VAM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact superseded VAM bytes.

DPM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact referenced DPM bytes.

METADATA_REVIEW.description: Mutually exclusive with REVIEW; metadata-only decisions use METADATA_REVIEW.

VCFProperty.description: One emitted card property, as the publisher parsed its own output.

NAME.description: Property name verbatim and upper-case, e.g. `EMAIL`.

PARAMETERS.description:
Parameter tokens verbatim in emission order, each a single `name=value`
pair. A parameter the emitter wrote without a value is carried verbatim.

VALUE.description:
Property value with the text format's escaping REMOVED, so a consumer
reads a value rather than re-implementing an unescaper. `CARD` retains the
escaped form.

GROUP.description: Grouping prefix the property was emitted under, when the emitter used one.

ORDER.description:
Zero-based position of this property in the canonical emission order for
this FORM. Two conforming emitters agree on this number.

OCTET_LENGTH.description:
Octet length of the property's complete UNFOLDED content line, excluding
the line terminator. This is the number folding is applied against.

VCFAlias.description: One identity address row: the machine-readable half of the card.

KIND_TOKEN.description:
The row's kind label verbatim as emitted — the leftmost domain label.
Authoritative when KIND is OTHER.

LOCAL_PART.description: Everything left of the separator in the emitted address, verbatim.

DOMAIN.description:
Everything right of the separator in the emitted address, verbatim. This
is publisher data: the identity domain of the deployment that produced the
card, never a value this standard fixes.

ADDRESS.description:
The complete emitted address, `LOCAL_PART` then the separator then
`DOMAIN`, verbatim. Carried whole because it is what the importer stores
and what a consumer matches on.

ENCODING.description:
Transport encoding of LOCAL_PART verbatim and lowercase. An address
local part has a hard octet cap, so raw hexadecimal key material does not
fit and a compact binary-to-text encoding is REQUIRED for key rows.

ALGORITHM.description:
Cryptographic algorithm the row's key or signature belongs to, verbatim as
the profile states it. A key without a named algorithm is not verifiable.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
The profile's published public key value verbatim, for key rows. The SAME
bytes LOCAL_PART transport-encodes, carried in the profile's own spelling
so a consumer can join card to profile without decoding. NEVER an extended
public key and NEVER a derivation path.

CHAIN.description: Ledger token verbatim for LEDGER_ACCOUNT rows.

ON_COMPACT_CARD.description: Whether this row survives into the COMPACT form.

OCTET_LENGTH.description: Octet length of the complete UNFOLDED row as emitted.

VCFSubject.description: The profile this card projects, and the provenance that binds them.

PEER_ID.description: Network peer identifier the profile is anchored to, verbatim.

DN.description: The profile's distinguished name verbatim, as published.

PROFILE_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact, size-prefixed profile bytes projected.
With PROFILE_SHA256 this is what makes a card re-derivable.

PROFILE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of those same profile bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description:
The profile's signature timestamp as the publisher stated it, in
milliseconds since the Unix epoch. 0 means unpublished.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Literal public key that produced PROFILE_SIGNATURE, verbatim from the
profile. Never an extended public key, never a derivation path.

ENCRYPTION_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Literal public key a correspondent encrypts to, verbatim from the profile.
Never an extended public key, never a derivation path.

SOURCE_STANDARD.description:
Four-character standard code of the projected profile record, `$`
included. Carried so the projection is not silently assumed.

VCFConformance.description:
Everything needed to decide whether this card is servable, and whether two
implementations produced the same bytes.

VERSION.description: Card format version token verbatim as emitted, e.g. `3.0`.

PROFILE.description:
Identifier of the emission profile the card conforms to, verbatim, naming
the annex revision the publisher implemented.

LINE_ENDING.description: Line terminator the card text uses.

FOLD_OCTET_WIDTH.description:
Octet width beyond which a content line is folded onto continuation lines.
0 means the publisher folded nothing, which is non-canonical.

BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Octet length of `CARD` exactly as emitted, folding and terminators
included. This is the number a serving surface budgets against.

UNFOLDED_BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Octet length the same card would have with folding removed. Carried so a
folding disagreement is detectable without unfolding the text.

BYTE_BUDGET.description:
Octet ceiling of the surface this card was produced for. 0 means the
publisher states no ceiling; it never means a ceiling of zero.

WITHIN_BYTE_BUDGET.description:
Whether BYTE_LENGTH is within BYTE_BUDGET. False with a non-zero budget
means the card is a valid record that is NOT servable on that surface.

CARD_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of `CARD` as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. This is the
value two implementations compare to prove byte-identical projection.

PROPERTY_COUNT.description:
Number of property rows emitted, unfolded. Carried so a truncated card is
detectable before parsing.

CARRIES_VERIFICATION_CHAIN.description:
Whether the card carries a complete verification chain: a signing-key row,
an encryption-key row, and a profile-signature row, all present in the
UNFOLDED text. A card without all three cannot verify its own subject and
is not servable as an identity card.

CARD_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of this card. Together with the publishing key
it is the card's identity across every republication.

FORM.description: Which canonical emission form this record carries.

CARD.description:
The emitted card text VERBATIM: every octet an importer will read,
including folding and line terminators. Authoritative over PROPERTIES and
ALIASES in every disagreement.

MEDIA_TYPE.description:
Media type the card is served as, verbatim, including its charset
parameter.

SUBJECT.description: The profile this card projects and the provenance binding them.

PROPERTIES.description: The publisher's parse of `CARD`, in canonical emission order.

ALIASES.description: The identity address rows carried by `CARD`, in canonical emission order.

PHOTO_POLICY.description: How the card carries a portrait, if at all.

PHOTO_URI.description:
Locator of the portrait content under URI_REFERENCE, verbatim as emitted.
Empty under every other policy.

PHOTO_MEDIA_TYPE.description: Media type of the portrait content verbatim, when one is carried.

CONFORMANCE.description: Emission facts and the digest two implementations compare.

PRODUCER_ID.description:
Reverse-DNS identifier of the component that produced the card, so two
projectors are distinguishable when their bytes differ.

PRODUCER_VERSION.description: Build or release identifier of that component verbatim.

GENERATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp at which the card was projected.

EXPIRES_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp after which a consumer re-projects
from the profile rather than serving this card. Empty means no expiry.

TAGS.description: `namespace:value` facets, sorted and deduplicated. See TAG GRAMMAR above.

NOTES.description: Publisher note about this card; never a substitute for a field.

propagatorConfig.description: Propagator configuration structure to describe propagation settings

uvwSigmas.description: UVW Sigmas (Covariance matrix in UVW frame)

VCMAtmosphericModelData.description: VCM Atmospheric and Perturbation Model Data

COVARIANCE.description:
Covariance matrix as flat array (6x6 lower triangular = 21 elements).
Order: [CX_X, CY_X, CY_Y, CZ_X, CZ_Y, CZ_Z,
CX_DOT_X, CX_DOT_Y, CX_DOT_Z, CX_DOT_X_DOT,
CY_DOT_X, CY_DOT_Y, CY_DOT_Z, CY_DOT_X_DOT, CY_DOT_Y_DOT,
CZ_DOT_X, CZ_DOT_Y, CZ_DOT_Z, CZ_DOT_X_DOT, CZ_DOT_Y_DOT, CZ_DOT_Z_DOT]
Units: position in km**2, velocity in km**2/s**2, cross in km**2/s

VEPPerformancePoint.description:
One point of the burn-rate table: consumption at a stated regime,
altitude, and speed.

ALTITUDE_M.description:
Altitude the point is stated at, metres above mean sea level. NaN for
surface and subsurface regimes where altitude does not apply.

SPEED_MPS.description: Speed the point is stated at, metres per second.

BURN_RATE_VALUE.description:
Consumption rate at this point, in BURN_RATE_UNITS per second unless
the unit token itself states another time base.

BURN_RATE_UNITS.description:
Units of BURN_RATE_VALUE, verbatim. Required: a rate with no unit is
not publishable.

SPECIFIC_RANGE_M_PER_UNIT.description:
Distance travelled per unit of energy at this point, metres per
CAPACITY_UNITS unit.

GROSS_MASS_KG.description: Gross mass the point is stated at, kilograms.

VEPReplenishment.description: One replenishment option: how the energy store is reset.

FACILITY_ID.description:
`$TFN.ID` of a facility where this replenishment is available. Absent
for a replenishment that is not facility-bound.

DURATION_S.description: Typical duration of the replenishment, seconds.

IN_MOTION.description:
Replenishment happens while the vehicle is underway (aerial
refuelling, underway replenishment).

VEPProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one endurance profile.

Required on every record: a profile whose data source, epoch, and
licence are unstated is not publishable. The standard names no dataset,
provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the dataset or study this
profile was derived from.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this
profile was derived from.

DATASET_CID.description: Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when one exists.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or file selection used.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the vehicle class or type this
profile describes, verbatim.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC instant the source last modified this data, as it
states.

ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this profile record.

VEHICLE_CLASS_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of the vehicle CLASS this profile models.
Required: every profile is at least class-level.

VEHICLE_TYPE_DESIGNATOR.description:
Verbatim vehicle type token refining the class, when this profile is
a per-type refinement.

ENVIRONMENT.description:
Domain the vehicle operates in. The `$TRK` enum reused verbatim;
ordinal 0 is SPACE, so it is defaulted to UNKNOWN explicitly.

CAPACITY_VALUE.description: Usable energy store capacity, in CAPACITY_UNITS.

CAPACITY_UNITS.description:
Units of CAPACITY_VALUE, verbatim. The same unit keys
SPECIFIC_RANGE_M_PER_UNIT and the replenishment transfer rates.

RESERVE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of capacity [0-1] held as reserve; endurance computations
spend down to the reserve, never through it.

PERFORMANCE_POINTS.description:
The burn-rate table, keyed regime x altitude x speed. Required, and
never a single collapsed scalar.

INTERPOLATION.description: How a consumer interpolates between the points.

MAXIMUM_ENDURANCE_S.description: Maximum endurance, seconds, as the source publishes it.

MAXIMUM_RANGE_M.description: Maximum range, metres, as the source publishes it.

SERVICE_CEILING_M.description: Service ceiling, metres above mean sea level.

REPLENISHMENT.description: Replenishment options available to this class or type.

REFINES_ID.description:
`$VEP.ID` of the parent profile this one refines — the class-to-type
specialization chain. Absent for a class-level root profile.

WKSQuery.description: One saved FlatSQL query belonging to a workspace.

A reference to one parameter, with the dependencies that make it evaluable.
This is what a request, a stopping condition and a report column all name.

Component of a vector or matrix parameter, zero-based and row-major.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system this evaluation is expressed in; resolves against

Absent means the context default.

Ephemeris body code of the central body, when the parameter is

SECOND_OBJECT_ID.description: Second object, when the parameter is SECOND_OBJECT_DEPENDENT.

One roster entry as a named publisher implements it. The catalog is the

REQUIRED_ORIGIN_KIND.description:
The one origin kind this parameter is defined for, when it is defined

The value changes with the time system it is asked for, independently of

epoch and coordinate system name.

One parameter's value at one state. STATUS is per value: a request never
fails as a whole because one name is unavailable.

Vector or matrix values, row-major. Absent for scalar types; a scalar is
NEVER also written here.

Unit the value is expressed in, restating the descriptor so a value is

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

PCEParameterCondition.description:
A predicate on a named parameter: the parameter attains GOAL_VALUE, in
DIRECTION, for the OCCURRENCE-th time. This is the ONE spelling of a
stopping condition and of a generic event function; $EVL references it
rather than minting a second one.

GOAL_VALUE.description: Value the parameter must attain, in the parameter's own SI unit.

GOAL_TOLERANCE.description:
Convergence bar on the parameter value at the reported epoch, in the
parameter's own unit. A provider that cannot meet it returns
ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED rather than reporting an unconverged root.

OCCURRENCE.description:
Which attainment satisfies the condition, one-based. 0 and 1 both mean
the first.

PCEStopRequest.description:
Propagate until a condition is attained. The propagator itself is NOT named
here: it is a port the caller supplies, per the pluggable-propagation law.
This record carries only the condition, the interval and the tolerances.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions evaluated together; the run stops at whichever is attained
first in time.

MAXIMUM_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Upper bound on the propagated interval. Reaching it without attaining a
condition is GOAL_NOT_ATTAINED, never a silent stop.

EPOCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on the stop epoch. The same scenario run at different
step sizes MUST land inside this bar.

SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS.description:
Objects propagated in step with the owner and reported at the same stop
epoch.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at the stop epoch, beyond the condition itself.

PCEStopReport.description: Where a propagate-to-condition run actually landed.

ATTAINED_CONDITION_INDEX.description:
Index into PCEStopRequest.CONDITIONS of the condition that stopped the
run; negative when none did.

EPOCH.description: Epoch the run stopped at, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Seconds of propagated time from the initial state to EPOCH; negative for
a BACKWARD run.

ACHIEVED_VALUE.description: Value the condition parameter actually had at EPOCH.

GOAL_RESIDUAL.description:
ACHIEVED_VALUE minus GOAL_VALUE, in the parameter's own unit. This is
the residual a consumer gates on; it is NOT assumed to be zero.

SYNCHRONIZED_STATES.description: States of SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS at the same epoch, in that order.

SAMPLE.description: Parameters evaluated at the stop epoch.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description: Root-refinement work actually done, for the step-independence evidence.

PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

TFNDesignator.description: One designator the facility answers to in a named coding system.

SCHEME.description:
Coding-system token, verbatim (the system's own name). Never a field
name and never normalized by the publisher.

VALUE.description: The designator within that system, verbatim.

TFNOperatingSurface.description:
One operating surface: the arrival/departure geometry of the facility.
A runway and a berth carry the same shape; fields a domain does not use
are absent (NaN), never zero.

SURFACE_ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier of this surface within the facility.

SURFACE_TYPE_CODE.description:
The source's own surface-kind token, verbatim, so a kind outside
tfnSurfaceKind survives a round trip.

DESIGNATOR.description:
Published designator of the surface, verbatim (runway designator,
berth number).

DEPTH_M.description: Available depth of water, metres, for a maritime surface.

SURFACE_MATERIAL.description: Surface material or construction, verbatim as the source states it.

TRUE_BEARING_DEG.description: True bearing of the surface's operating direction, degrees, [0, 360).

THRESHOLD_LATITUDE.description:
Geodetic position of the threshold or reference point of this
surface, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

TFNProvenance.description:

One record asserts that one NORAD-catalogued object belongs (or formerly

by NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID and may join through $CAT.BUS_ID to $BUS; it
does not duplicate catalogue or bus properties.

CONSTELLATION_ID and OPERATOR_ID are publisher-stable identifiers. Display
names and aliases are carried separately so consumers never use branding as
identity. Every emitted record names the independent source assertions used
to establish membership, operator, and catalogue joins.

consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation name

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

RFLObstruction.description:
One obstacle interaction on one sample's path. SPARSE: entries exist only
where an interaction was computed, so a clear path is never encoded as a
row of zeroes.

This is the join that makes an arbitrary 3D object a first-class part of
the link budget: MATERIAL_ID names the `$RFS` record whose permittivity,
conductivity, penetration loss and roughness produced LOSS_DB, and
GEOMETRY_REF_ID names the exact mesh, face set, panel or analytic shape
inside it that was hit.

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this interaction applies to.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface that was hit. An obstruction loss with
no material is an unattributed number: a metal panel and a plasterboard
wall of the same size do entirely different things to a link.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh, when the obstacle is a
reviewed 3D asset.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the obstacle is a catalogued object (an
occulting spacecraft, a structure on another vehicle). 0 when unbound.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle between the incident ray and the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

PATH_LENGTH_IN_MATERIAL_M.description:
Path length travelled INSIDE the material, metres. With
`$RFS.ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M` this is what makes penetration loss
reproducible instead of a stated constant.

EXCESS_DELAY_S.description: Extra propagation delay of a reflected or scattered component, seconds.

FRESNEL_CLEARANCE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the first Fresnel zone still clear [0-1]. 1 means the zone is
untouched.

DISTANCE_FROM_TRANSMITTER_M.description: Distance from the transmitter to the interaction point, metres.

RFLEndpoint.description:
One endpoint of a link. Identity ONLY — position, antenna geometry and band
capability are NOT copied here; they are joined from the standard named by
ENDPOINT_KIND. A copied position silently goes stale against its source.

ENDPOINT_ID.description: Producer-stable identifier for this endpoint within the record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the endpoint is an on-orbit object. 0 when
unbound — never a placeholder catalogue number.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator, `$CAT.OBJECT_ID`.

RFB_ID.description:
`$RFB.ID` — the band specification (frequency, bandwidth, EIRP, gains,
polarization) this endpoint transmits or receives on.

RFE_ID.description: `$RFE.ID` — the parametric emitter description, when one exists.

IQC_ID.description: `$IQC` capture identifier, when the samples were derived from a recording.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel or carrier identifier within the beam.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization actually used on this link. Defaults to UNKNOWN explicitly:
`rfPolarization` ordinal 0 is LHCP, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as a real polarization.

RFLModCod.description:
One modulation-and-coding choice available to a link. The table carries
engineering capability only; catalogue or recommendation names belong in
ID / NAME and provenance data, never in the schema vocabulary.

MODCOD_ID.description: Stable identifier within the containing link's MODCOD_SET.

CODE_RATE.description: Information bits divided by coded bits, in (0,1].

REQUIRED_MARGIN_DB.description: Additional implementation margin required before this entry is selected.

MAXIMUM_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Optional ceiling imposed by framing or implementation, bits per second.

RFLLink.description: One link whose budget is sampled by this record.

LINK_ID.description:
Producer-stable link identifier. Joins `$ACI.ACIInterval.LINK_ID` and
`$LKS.ID` when the same link also has an operational-state record.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Carrier centre frequency actually used, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention, NOT the `$IQC` hertz convention. A consumer joining the two
converts explicitly at the join. Band designation is NOT duplicated here:
it is joined from `$RFB.BAND`.

MODULATION.description: Modulation as the producer states it (e.g. "QPSK", "8PSK", "16APSK").

CODING.description: Forward error correction scheme as the producer states it.

CODE_RATE.description: Code rate as a fraction (0-1].

SYMBOL_RATE_BAUD.description:
Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud — the `$RFB.BAUD`
convention.

DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Information bit rate the budget is stated for, bits per second.

THRESHOLD_TERM.description:
Required threshold this link is evaluated against. THRESHOLD_TERM,
THRESHOLD_VALUE, THRESHOLD_UNITS and THRESHOLD_COMPARISON are meaningful
only together; a LINK_MARGIN_DB column without them states a margin
against an unstated requirement and MUST be refused.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this link belongs to. Links sharing a RECEIVER_GROUP_ID
and CHANNEL_GROUP_ID are mutually interfering and MUST be evaluated
together; a producer that shards a link matrix MUST keep a group intact
within one shard.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation or network this link belongs to.

SERVICE.description: Operator-facing service or mission designation.

MODCOD_SET.description:
Ordered adaptive modulation-and-coding choices. Per-sample
SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX indexes this vector for the sample's selected link.

ACM_ENABLED.description: Whether the producer evaluated adaptive selection for this link.

RFLInterferenceContribution.description:
One interfering contribution to one sample. SPARSE: entries exist only
where a contribution was computed, so a dense matrix is never forced into
existence to say "no interference computed".

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this contribution applies to.

SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ID.description:
Endpoint identifier of the interfering emitter, when it is an endpoint of
this record.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` of the interfering emission.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Interfering object's catalogue number, 0 when unbound.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Received interfering power at the victim receiver, dBW.

TOPOCENTRIC_SEPARATION_DEG.description:
Angular separation between the wanted and interfering paths at the
victim receiver, degrees.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim's bandwidth overlapped by this emission [0-1].

POLARIZATION_ISOLATION_DB.description: Polarization isolation applied to this contribution, dB.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Discrimination applied from the victim antenna pattern, dB.

RFLModelParameter.description:
A named parameter of a model binding, with its unit stated. There is no
encoding for a parameter value without a unit.

TEXT_VALUE.description: Non-numeric parameter value, when the parameter is categorical.

RFLModelBinding.description:
Which model produced one term of the budget. A loss term without a model
binding is an unattributed number: rain attenuation from two different
recommendations differs by decibels, and a consumer must be able to tell
which one it is holding.

TERM.description: The budget term this binding produced.

MODEL_NAME.description:
Model or recommendation identifier as its publisher states it (e.g. an
ITU-R recommendation number with its revision).

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` of the module that evaluated it.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact artifact that produced the values.

RFLProvenance.description: Where this sample set came from, stated once for the record.

SOURCE.description:
The producing system, dataset or measurement campaign. Required: a
budget time series with no stated source is not publishable.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference that regenerates this set.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the propagator that produced the geometry columns. A record
whose METHOD is MODELED or HYBRID and which carries geometry columns MUST
name it: geometry is only as good as the propagator, and the propagator is
a pluggable choice, never an assumed default.

PROPAGATOR_CONFIGURATION.description: Force model or configuration identifier handed to the propagator.

SAMPLING_STEP_S.description: Uniform sampling step, seconds. Absent when SAMPLE_EPOCHS are irregular.

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description:
Weather or environment dataset the atmospheric terms were evaluated
against, when they were not evaluated against a statistical model.

TERRAIN_DATASET.description: Terrain or surface dataset the blockage terms were evaluated against.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this set was computed or recorded.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix ms the upstream inputs were retrieved.

LICENSE.description:
Licence the source imposes on redistribution. An empty LICENSE means
UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a grant to redistribute.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: True when the licence forbids commercial use of this set.

CITATION.description: Attribution the licence requires this record to carry downstream.

MODULE_ID.description:
Primary `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced this record.
MODELS remains the per-budget-term attribution surface.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact producing WASM artifact.

RFL_ID.description: Stable identifier of this sample set.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$ACI` and
`$CVP` products derived from this set.

LINKS.description: Link definitions. SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES index into this vector.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of samples. Every present metric array MUST have exactly this
many entries.

SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES.description: Index into LINKS for each sample.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description:
Sample epochs, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM. Samples
need not be uniformly spaced and need not be grouped by link, but MUST be
non-decreasing within each link.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale SAMPLE_EPOCHS are expressed in. Defaults to UTC explicitly:
`timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as sidereal time.

RANGE_RATE_M_S.description: Range rate, metres per second; positive is opening.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the receiving endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the receiving endpoint, degrees above the local horizon.

TRANSMIT_AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the transmitting endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

TRANSMIT_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the transmitting endpoint, degrees.

DOPPLER_SHIFT_HZ.description:
Doppler shift of the carrier, hertz; positive is closing. Hertz, not the
MHz used for frequencies elsewhere in this record — a shift of a few kHz
on a GHz carrier is destroyed by an MHz encoding.

EIRP_DBW.description: Effective isotropic radiated power toward the receiver, dBW.

TRANSMIT_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain in the direction of the receiver, dBi.

RECEIVE_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain in the direction of the transmitter, dBi.

GASEOUS_ABSORPTION_LOSS_DB.description: Gaseous (oxygen and water vapour) absorption, dB.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS_DB.description:
Total loss from 3D obstacles on the path, dB. The per-obstacle detail —
which object, which material, at what angle, through how much of it — is
in OBSTRUCTIONS.

TOTAL_PATH_LOSS_DB.description:
Total of all path terms actually applied, dB. Published as its own column
rather than left to the consumer to sum: a producer that applied a term
this schema has no column for MUST still report an honest total, and the
discrepancy against the itemised columns is then visible.

RECEIVED_POWER_DBW.description: Received carrier power at the receiver input, dBW.

GAIN_TO_NOISE_TEMPERATURE_DB_PER_K.description: Receiving system figure of merit G/T, dB/K.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_DB.description: Carrier-to-noise ratio C/N in the occupied bandwidth, dB.

ENERGY_PER_BIT_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Energy per bit to noise density Eb/N0, dB.

BIT_ERROR_RATE.description:
Bit error rate as a probability [0-1], NOT an exponent and NOT a
percentage. 1e-6 is encoded 1e-6.

LINK_MARGIN_DB.description:
Link margin against the link's stated threshold, dB. Meaningless without
RFLLink.THRESHOLD_TERM / THRESHOLD_VALUE / THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY_BPS.description: Achievable channel capacity, bits per second.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Aggregate received interfering power, dBW.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_PLUS_INTERFERENCE_DB.description: Carrier to noise-plus-interference ratio C/(N+I), dB.

OBSTRUCTIONS.description:
Per-interaction obstacle detail, sparse. Each entry names the `$RFS`
material it went through, reflected off or was blocked by.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS.description: The single condition that bound the link at each sample.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description required when a LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS entry is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of the whole set. Required: an unattributed budget is not
publishable.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over the size-prefixed
FlatBuffer projection with both 64-byte signature payloads zeroed while
preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over canonical JSON with IDL
field order, IDL capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both
signature fields omitted.

SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX.description:
Index into the selected link's RFLLink.MODCOD_SET for each sample.
SELECTED_MODCOD_VALID distinguishes index 0 from no selection.

SPECTRAL_EFFICIENCY_BPS_HZ.description: Spectral efficiency delivered by the selected entry, bit/s/Hz.

ACHIEVED_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Delivered information rate after adaptive selection, bits per second.

ACM_MARGIN_DB.description: Margin above the selected entry's threshold, dB.

ENERGY_PER_SYMBOL_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Symbol energy to noise spectral density, dB.

RFSFrequencySample.description:
The material's electromagnetic properties at ONE frequency. A table of
these beats the power-law fit wherever it covers the frequency.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Frequency this sample is stated at, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention. A join to `$IQC` (hertz) converts explicitly at the join.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_REAL.description: Real part of the relative permittivity.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_IMAGINARY.description:
Imaginary part of the relative permittivity (loss term), stated as a
POSITIVE magnitude.

RELATIVE_PERMEABILITY_REAL.description:
Real and imaginary relative permeability. 1.0 and 0.0 for non-magnetic
materials — stated, not assumed.

REFLECTIVITY.description: Power reflected at normal incidence as a ratio [0-1].

REFLECTION_LOSS_DB.description: Reflection loss at normal incidence, dB (positive).

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through the material at THICKNESS_M, dB (positive).

ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M.description: Attenuation inside the material, dB per metre.

RFSReflectionEntry.description:
Reflection and transmission at one incidence angle and polarization. The
angular dependence of a real surface cannot be carried by a single
normal-incidence number.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description: Frequency this entry is stated at, megahertz.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle from the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

REFLECTION_COEFFICIENT_MAGNITUDE.description: Magnitude of the field reflection coefficient [0-1].

REFLECTION_COEFFICIENT_PHASE_DEG.description: Phase of the field reflection coefficient, degrees.

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through the material at this angle, dB (positive).

SCATTERING_LOSS_DB.description: Power removed from the specular direction by surface roughness, dB.

RFSGeometryRef.description:
Where and what this material is attached to. A material record with no
geometry describes a substance; a material record WITH geometry describes
an obstacle a solver can intersect.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity, copied VERBATIM including the byte hash so the
material can never drift onto a different revision of the mesh.

MESH_NAME.description: Mesh and primitive inside the asset.

GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME.description:
glTF material slot the properties apply to, matching the
`$OPP.OPPSurface` join fields.

FACE_INDEXES.description: Explicit face indexes, when the material covers part of a mesh.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT` identity, when the obstacle is a catalogued object. 0 when
unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID`, when the obstacle is a structure at a terrestrial site.

FEATURE_ID.description: Producer's own feature identifier for a building, wall or terrain patch.

ANALYTIC_SHAPE.description:
Primitive and its dimensions in metres, when GEOMETRY_KIND is
ANALYTIC_SHAPE. The dimension order is the primitive's own convention and
MUST be stated in SHAPE_DIMENSION_NAMES.

LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Geodetic placement of a fixed obstacle, degrees and metres. Absent for
an obstacle whose position is joined from `$CAT`, `$TBS` or `$VAM`.

HEIGHT_M.description: Height above ground of a fixed structure, metres.

NORMAL_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Orientation of the surface normal, degrees east of north and above the
horizon. A wall that faces the wrong way blocks the wrong link.

SOURCE.description:
The measurement campaign, published table or model. Required: an
unattributed permittivity is not publishable.

SOURCE_REFERENCE.description: The specific table, recommendation or dataset entry within SOURCE.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query that retrieves the source value.

MEASUREMENT_TECHNIQUE.description:
How it was measured (e.g. "free-space transmission", "coaxial probe",
"resonant cavity").

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced modelled values.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_SIGMA.description:
1-sigma uncertainty of the permittivity and conductivity values, in the
units of the quantity they qualify.

LICENSE.description:
Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a
grant to redistribute.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
Stable identifier of this material. Joined by
`$RFL.RFLObstruction.MATERIAL_ID` and `$CVP.CVPObstacleRef.MATERIAL_ID`.

NAME.description: Name as its source states it, verbatim.

DESCRIPTION.description: Free-text description of the surface, not of its vendor.

FREQUENCY_MIN_MHZ.description:
Frequency range over which this record's parameters are valid,
megahertz. A solver MUST refuse to evaluate outside it rather than
extrapolate.

REFERENCE_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Frequency the scalar values below are stated at, megahertz. Without it
they are uninterpretable.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_IMAGINARY.description: Loss term, stated as a POSITIVE magnitude.

RELATIVE_PERMEABILITY_REAL.description: 1.0 and 0.0 for non-magnetic materials — stated, not assumed.

REFLECTIVITY.description: Power reflected at normal incidence as a ratio [0-1].

REFLECTION_LOSS_DB.description: Reflection loss at normal incidence, dB (positive).

THICKNESS_M.description:
Thickness the transmission and penetration losses are stated for, metres.
A transmission loss without a thickness cannot be rescaled.

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through THICKNESS_M at normal incidence, dB (positive).

ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M.description: Attenuation inside the material, dB per metre.

ABSORPTION_COEFFICIENT.description: Fraction of incident power absorbed at normal incidence [0-1].

SURFACE_ROUGHNESS_RMS_M.description:
RMS surface roughness, metres. Roughness is what decides whether a
surface is a mirror or a scatterer at a given wavelength.

ROUGHNESS_CORRELATION_LENGTH_M.description: Correlation length of the roughness, metres.

DIFFUSE_SCATTERING_COEFFICIENT.description: Fraction of non-absorbed power leaving diffusely [0-1].

TEMPERATURE_K.description: Temperature the properties were evaluated at, kelvin.

MOISTURE_CONTENT_FRACTION.description:
Volumetric moisture content [0-1]. Wet concrete and dry concrete are
different materials at RF.

SALINITY_PSU.description: Salinity, practical salinity units, for water surfaces.

FREQUENCY_SAMPLES.description:
Per-frequency samples. Where present and covering the frequency, these
take precedence over the power law.

GEOMETRY.description:
Geometry this material is attached to. A record may attach one material
to several obstacles.

PROVENANCE.description: Provenance. Required.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM`.

EMCEndpointRef.description: Stable reference to one endpoint of the assessment.

EMCIntermodulationTerm.description:
One signed integer coefficient in an intermodulation product. The product
frequency is the exact sum of COEFFICIENT * SOURCE_FREQUENCY_HZ terms.

INTERMODULATION_ORDER.description:
Order of the active or passive intermodulation product. 0 when the
mechanism is not intermodulation.

EMISSION_MASK_ID.description: RFEEmissionMask.MASK_ID used for an emission-limit comparison.

RFS_MATERIAL_ID.description: `$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` and class used for structural coupling.

EXCEEDANCE_DB.description: Positive when the victim limit is exceeded.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

BAND.description: Operating band (e.g., C, Ku, Ka, L, S, X)

UPLINK_FREQ_MIN.description: Uplink frequency range minimum in MHz

UPLINK_FREQ_MAX.description: Uplink frequency range maximum in MHz

DOWNLINK_FREQ_MIN.description: Downlink frequency range minimum in MHz

DOWNLINK_FREQ_MAX.description: Downlink frequency range maximum in MHz

MISSION.description: Primary mission (e.g., FIXED_SAT, BROADCAST, MOBILE, RELAY, MILSATCOM)

EPOCH.description: Epoch of element set (ISO 8601)

RA_OF_ASC_NODE.description: Right ascension of ascending node in degrees

EVENT_EPOCH.description: Event epoch that spawned the manifold (ISO 8601)

SOURCE.description: Source of detection (sensor ID or method)

ORIG_SEMI_MAJOR_AXIS.description: Original pre-event semi-major axis in km

ETM.description:
Entity Metadata — generic queryable metadata for a host-local entity.
Participates in shared FlatSQL/WASM runtimes where multiple plugins
cross-query the same entity collection.

NAME.description: Human-readable entity name used for shared query/search surfaces.

SUBTYPE.description: More specific runtime subtype or class name.

PARENT_ENTITY_ID.description: Optional parent entity id for hierarchy / linkage queries.

WASM_HANDLE.description: Collection-scoped WASM handle used for batch visibility application.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Optional NORAD catalog id for standards-backed entities.

OBJECT_NAME.description: Primary object name surfaced by attached standards metadata.

OBJECT_ID.description: Primary international / object designator surfaced by attached standards metadata.

CAT_OBJECT_NAME.description: Secondary CAT object name when different from the primary object name.

CAT_OBJECT_ID.description: Secondary CAT object id when different from the primary object id.

FACILITY_TYPE.description: Ground / facility subtype metadata for non-space entity search.

SEARCH_TEXT.description: Pre-normalized phrase-search text for collection-wide shared queries.

LAUNCH_YEAR.description: Launch year derived from launch date.

MEAN_MOTION.description: Mean motion in revolutions per day.

HAS_GP.description: Whether GP / OMM state is present for the entity.

QUERY.description: Host-specific query string (for example a FlatSQL or DSL expression).

MAX_COUNT.description: Upper bound on the number of rows / indices to return (0 = unbounded).

ENTITY_COUNT.description:
Expected number of entities in the catalog at the time the request was
issued, used to size visibility masks.

MASK.description: Populated when KIND == VISIBILITY_MASK (one byte per entity).

VISIBLE_COUNT.description: Number of visible (masked-in) entities in MASK.

ROW.description: Single matched row when KIND == CATALOG_ROW.

CAQ.description: Catalog query envelope — carries either a request or a result payload.

ROOT_TYPE.description: Optional root type name within the schema.

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Optional schema hash bytes for stronger compatibility checks.

Optional port identifier for frames that route to/from a named
input or output port on a method (maps to
`PLG.PLGPortManifest.PORT_ID`). Empty for arena frames that carry
no port routing hint.

INPUTS.description:
Input frames. Each TAB.TYPE_REF names the payload schema and each
TAB.WIRE_FORMAT selects FLATBUFFER or ALIGNED_BINARY. TAB.OFFSET
is arena-relative into PAYLOAD_ARENA (or an absolute pointer when
PAYLOAD_ARENA is empty).

PAYLOAD_ARENA.description:
Optional arena backing the INPUTS payload bodies. Empty means the
caller manages arena state out-of-band.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace identifier for request correlation.

OUTPUT_STREAM_CAP.description:
Optional yield-budget hint. Plugins MAY pause queued work after
draining this many output frames and return YIELDED for the caller
to resume. 0 = no hint.

STATUS_CODE.description: Method-specific status code. Zero conventionally indicates success.

YIELDED.description: True when the method yielded before fully draining queued work.

BACKLOG_REMAINING.description:
Outstanding frame count remaining after this response. Non-zero
only when STATUS == YIELDED.

OUTPUTS.description: Output frames. Each TAB carries schema identity and wire format.

PAYLOAD_ARENA.description: Optional arena backing OUTPUTS payload bodies.

ERROR_CODE.description: Stable machine-readable error code when STATUS == FAILED.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Human-readable diagnostic when STATUS == FAILED.

TRACE_ID.description: Echo of the request's TRACE_ID for correlation.

PIV.description:
Envelope — carries either a request or a response. Either REQUEST or
RESPONSE is populated per message; both populated is undefined.

MDSEncounter.description:
One body encounter along a candidate trajectory.

Encounter-indexed rather than leg-indexed on purpose. A search implementation
typically emits leg-indexed arrays: for nE encounters there are nL = nE - 1
legs, the departure v-infinity of leg i is the OUTGOING vector at encounter
i, and the arrival v-infinity of leg i is the INCOMING vector at encounter
i + 1. Carrying both vectors on the encounter they physically occur at
removes that off-by-one from every consumer.

BODY_NAIF_ID.description:
Body encountered, NAIF integer ID (normative). A barycenter is not the
body: 4 is the Mars barycenter, 499 is Mars.

EPOCH_ET_S.description:
Encounter epoch as ephemeris time, seconds past J2000 TDB. This is the
form solvers work in and is carried verbatim to avoid a lossy round trip.

EPOCH_UTC.description:
Same epoch in ISO 8601 (UTC), for consumers that do not carry an
ephemeris time implementation. Advisory; EPOCH_ET_S is normative.

INCOMING_V_INFINITY_X_KM_S.description:
Incoming hyperbolic excess velocity vector, km/s. Absent at the first
encounter.

OUTGOING_V_INFINITY_X_KM_S.description:
Outgoing hyperbolic excess velocity vector, km/s. Absent at the final
encounter.

TURN_ANGLE_RAD.description: Turn angle between incoming and outgoing asymptotes, radians.

PERIAPSIS_RADIUS_KM.description: Flyby periapsis radius measured from the body's center, km.

POWERED_FLYBY_DELTA_V_KM_S.description:
Delta-V applied at periapsis for a powered flyby, km/s. Zero for an
unpowered (ballistic) flyby.

LAMBERT_SOLUTION_INDEX.description:
Index of the Lambert solution selected for the leg DEPARTING this
encounter, as reported by the solver.

FLYBY_SOLUTION_INDEX.description:
Index of the flyby solution branch selected at this encounter, as
reported by the solver.

MDSDeepSpaceManeuver.description: One deep-space maneuver on a transfer leg.

LEG_INDEX.description:
Zero-based leg the maneuver occurs on. Leg i connects encounter i to
encounter i + 1.

ARC_FRACTION.description: Position along the leg as a fraction of its flight time, in [0, 1].

EPOCH_ET_S.description:
Maneuver epoch as ephemeris time, seconds past J2000 TDB, when the solver
reports it directly.

DELTA_V_X_KM_S.description: Maneuver vector when the solver reports one, km/s.

MDSCandidate.description: One candidate trajectory on the front.

CANDIDATE_ID.description: Solver-assigned trajectory identifier, unique within the set.

DEEP_SPACE_MANEUVERS.description: Deep-space maneuvers, ordered by LEG_INDEX then ARC_FRACTION.

TOTAL_FLIGHT_TIME_DAYS.description: Total flight time from first to last encounter, days.

ARRIVAL_V_INFINITY_KM_S.description: Hyperbolic excess speed at arrival, km/s.

ESCAPE_DELTA_V_KM_S.description: Reference escape delta-V from the departure body, km/s.

INSERTION_DELTA_V_KM_S.description: Reference insertion delta-V at the arrival body, km/s.

NON_DOMINATED.description:
True when this candidate is non-dominated within the set. A set MAY carry
dominated candidates for context; a consumer plotting a front MUST filter
on this rather than assume every member is non-dominated.

MDS.description:
Mission Design Solution Set — a set of candidate trajectories produced by
solving a mission design broad search, typically a Pareto front over
competing objectives (total delta-V against total flight time).

SDS had no multi-candidate container of any kind before this record. The
closest existing carrier for a single planned burn is OCM.Maneuver, whose
payload is untyped DATA:[string] with MAN_UNITS:[string] and which has no
v-infinity, turn angle, flyby periapsis radius, or C3.

SOLUTION_SET_ID.description: Stable identifier for this solution set.

PROBLEM_ID.description:
PROBLEM_ID of the $MDP this set solves. A solution set whose problem
definition is unknown is not reproducible.

OBJECTIVES.description:
Objectives the front is expressed over, e.g.
["TOTAL_DELTA_V_KM_S", "TOTAL_FLIGHT_TIME_DAYS"]. Names MUST be field
names of MDSCandidate.

SOLVER.description: Solver identity and version that produced the set.

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description: Ephemeris source used, e.g. a SPICE kernel set identifier.

CREATION_DATE.description: When the set was generated, ISO 8601.

FlatBufferTypeRef.description: Payload-schema identity for a stream frame or an accepted port type.

ROOT_TYPE.description: Optional root type name within the schema.

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Optional schema hash bytes for stronger compatibility checks.

ACCEPTS_ANY_FLATBUFFER.description: True when this port/type set accepts any FlatBuffer frame.

WIRE_FORMAT.description: Logical wire format for this accepted type.

BYTE_LENGTH.description: Byte length for fixed-size aligned-binary records, when applicable.

REQUIRED_ALIGNMENT.description: Required start alignment for aligned-binary records, when applicable.

OFFSET.description: Byte offset of the payload body within the arena.

SIZE.description: Byte length of the payload body.

ALIGNMENT.description: Required start alignment of the payload body (in bytes).

Optional port identifier for frames that route to/from a named
input or output port on a method (maps to
`PLG.PLGPortManifest.PORT_ID`). Empty for arena frames that carry
