CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer
from inventing its own wording for the same code.

CODE.description: The ratified category code. This is the join key every consumer uses.

DISPLAY_NAME.description:
Canonical human-readable label, rendered verbatim. MUST equal the display
name stated in the CODE member's doc comment.

SUMMARY.description: One-sentence description shown on browse rows and category headers.

SLUG.description:
Route-safe identifier: the CODE identifier lowercased with `_` replaced by
`-`. Published explicitly rather than derived so every surface routes
identically.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer editorial description for a category landing page.

PARENT.description:
Parent category for hierarchical browse. UNSPECIFIED means this is a
top-level category. A category MUST NOT name itself as its parent.

SORT_ORDER.description:
Presentation order within its parent, ascending. Ties break on
DISPLAY_NAME.

KEYWORDS.description:
Search synonyms and alternate phrasings that resolve to this category.
Feeds type-ahead; never rendered as the category label.

ICON_KEY.description:
Key of a self-hosted icon or capsule asset for this category. A KEY, not a
URL: consuming node surfaces load zero external-origin bytes, so the
consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

CODE.description: Category being counted.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

PLGAcceptedTypeSet.description:
Accepted schema family for a port. When a port accepts multiple wire
formats (canonical FlatBuffer + aligned-binary), each ALLOWED_TYPE
entry carries its own TAB.FlatBufferTypeRef with the schema identity,
and the enclosing PLGPortManifest advertises both wire formats via
ALLOWED_WIRE_FORMATS. Per SDK contract: a port that advertises
aligned-binary MUST also advertise the canonical flatbuffer fallback
for the same schema and file identifier in the same set.

SET_ID.description: Stable type-set identifier within the port.

ALLOWED_TYPES.description: Specific FlatBuffer types accepted by the set.

ALLOWED_WIRE_FORMATS.description:
Wire formats this set accepts. If ALIGNED_BINARY is present,
FLATBUFFER MUST also be present for the same schemas.

DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable explanation of the accepted schema family.

PLGPortManifest.description: One input or output port on a method.

PORT_ID.description: Stable port identifier within the method.

DISPLAY_NAME.description: Human-readable name for UIs.

ACCEPTED_TYPE_SETS.description: Type sets accepted on this port.

MIN_STREAMS.description: Minimum number of streams that must be connected.

MAX_STREAMS.description: Maximum number of streams that may be connected.

REQUIRED.description: Whether the port must be connected for invocation.

PLGHostCapability.description: One host capability dependency (richer form of PluginCapability).

PLGTimerSpec.description: Timer entry declared by a plugin.

PLGProtocolSpec.description: Protocol handler declared by a plugin.

PLGBuildArtifact.description: Build artifact emitted by the plugin toolchain.

NAME.description: Function name as exported from WASM

PLGFlowNode.description:
One node in a composed flow graph. A degenerate flow IS a module: a leaf
module leaves the flow-graph fields on PLG empty; a composed flow populates
them. This is how flows reuse the module schema rather than a separate one.

NODE_ID.description: Stable node identifier within this flow

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin id of the module this node invokes

METHOD_ID.description: Method id invoked on the module

DISPATCH_MODEL.description:
Dispatch model: empty = linked-direct (in-wasm), "isomorphic" = an
independently instantiated signed WASM node, and "host-capability" = a
generic host adapter.

CONFIG.description: Opaque per-node configuration (FlatBuffer or raw bytes; never JSON)

CANONICAL_TYPE.description:
Canonical SDS identity carried by the edge. NOT `required`: an edge may
be opaque by design (see OPAQUE), and a signer must never be forced to
invent an identity to satisfy the schema. A contract MUST carry exactly
one of CANONICAL_TYPE or OPAQUE = true; a contract with neither, or with
both, is invalid and MUST be rejected by the compiler that signs the flow.

OPAQUE.description:
The edge carries bytes with no SDS identity BY DESIGN — an
application-blind host-capability adapter (an HTTP body, a raw file
chunk) or a timer TICK frame with no payload at all. This is a deliberate
signed assertion of opacity, which is why it is an explicit flag rather
than an absent CANONICAL_TYPE: a missing type must stay distinguishable
from a declared-opaque one. An opaque edge is ineligible for the aligned
route, so ALIGNED_ELIGIBLE MUST be false when OPAQUE is true.

PLGFlowEdge.description: One directed edge wiring a producer output port to a consumer input port.

CONTRACT.description:
Exact identity/layout and compile-time representation policy. NOT
`required`: marking a NEW field of an EXISTING table required makes the
FlatBuffers verifier reject every $PLG buffer written before 1.0.13,
which is a breaking change to a ratified standard. Presence is enforced
where it belongs — the flow compiler MUST refuse to SIGN a flow whose
edges lack a CONTRACT, and a verifier MUST reject a signed flow edge
without one. Buffers predating 1.0.13 stay readable and stay unsigned.

PLGFlowTrigger.description: One flow trigger (e.g. a host timer or HTTP route) that starts a drain.

DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS.description: Default firing interval in milliseconds (timer triggers)

PLGFlowTriggerBinding.description: Binds a trigger to the node + input port it delivers its frame to.

PLG.description: Plugin Manifest - canonical signed storefront and WASM distribution record

TAGLINE.description: Short marketing summary shown in storefront listings

SUPPORT_URL.description: Support or helpdesk URL for this plugin

TAGS.description: Search and categorization tags for discovery

FEATURES.description: Short feature bullets highlighted in storefront listings

SCREENSHOT_URLS.description: Screenshot URLs showing the plugin in use

BANNER_URL.description: Optional hero/banner image URL for the listing

WASM_HASH.description: SHA256 hash of the decrypted WASM binary

WASM_SIZE.description: Size of decrypted WASM binary in bytes

WASM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the encrypted WASM binary

ENCRYPTED_WASM_HASH.description: SHA256 hash of the encrypted delivery artifact bytes

ENCRYPTED_WASM_SIZE.description: Size of the encrypted delivery artifact in bytes

ENTRY_FUNCTIONS.description: Entry point functions exported by the plugin

REQUIRED_SCHEMAS.description: FlatBuffer schemas required by this plugin

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the plugin provider

PROVIDER_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of provider's EPM (Entity Profile Message)

ENCRYPTED.description: Whether the WASM binary is encrypted

REQUIRED_SCOPE.description: Canonical required scope for grant issuance

KEY_ID.description: Provider-local identifier for the module content key

MAX_GRANT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum grant timeout allowed for this module publication

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when plugin was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when plugin was last updated

CHANGELOG_URL.description: URL to plugin changelog or release notes

LICENSE.description: License identifier (SPDX format)

PAYMENT_MODEL.description: Commercial model used for storefront purchase flows

PRICE_USD_CENTS.description: Price in USD cents for one-time purchase or subscription period

SUBSCRIPTION_PERIOD_DAYS.description: Subscription billing period length in days

LISTING_STATUS.description: Storefront publication state for this manifest version

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider over manifest

INVOKE_SURFACES.description:
Canonical invoke surfaces this artifact exposes. A single plugin
MAY list both DIRECT and COMMAND when it supports both.

METHODS.description:
Rich per-method invoke manifests (port shape, drain semantics,
accepted wire formats). ENTRY_FUNCTIONS retains the slim
name+input_schemas+output_schema summary; METHODS carries the full
invoke-surface detail including aligned-binary advertisement.

HOST_CAPABILITIES.description:
Enum-typed host capability dependencies (richer than CAPABILITIES,
which is string-tagged metadata).

SCHEMAS_USED.description: FlatBuffer schemas this plugin depends on at the invoke surface.

BUILD_ARTIFACTS.description: Build artifacts emitted by the toolchain (WASM, bindings, etc.).

ALLOWED_XPUBS.description:
Allowed requester xpub identities (BIP-32 account xpubs) for module grants:
a requester whose verified EPM binds an xpub in this list is granted (PKI
identity authorization). Empty list = no xpub allowlist gate.

FLOW_NODES.description:
Composition graph (a degenerate flow is a module): the nodes this flow
invokes. Empty for a leaf module; populated for a composed flow. The flow
definition is this PLG FlatBuffer, not a bespoke JSON graph.

FLOW_EDGES.description: Composition-graph edges wiring node output ports to input ports.

FLOW_TRIGGERS.description: Flow triggers (timer/http) that start a drain.

FLOW_TRIGGER_BINDINGS.description: Bindings from triggers to the node + input port they deliver to.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified $CCT category this module is shelved under. This is the
category a storefront capsule, a library shelf and a breadcrumb show when
exactly one must be chosen. UNSPECIFIED means the publisher did not
classify the module; a consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

This supersedes PLUGIN_TYPE for all storefront, library and search
surfaces. PLUGIN_TYPE remains on the wire and is not removed, but its
`pluginCategory` vocabulary mixes capability families with node-internal
plumbing, carries a legacy vendor-derived member, holds a real family at
ordinal 0, and admits only one value. Canonical migration, applied by a
publisher rewriting an old manifest:
Sensor->SENSORS_AND_COVERAGE, Propagator->PROPAGATION,
Renderer->VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING,
Analysis->MISSION_DESIGN_AND_ANALYSIS,
DataSource->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST, EW->ELECTRONIC_WARFARE,
Comms->RF_AND_COMMUNICATIONS, Physics->SPACE_ENVIRONMENT,
Shader->VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING, Parser->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST,
Validator->DATA_VALIDATION_AND_QUALITY, Interpolator->PROPAGATION,
Exporter->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST, Foundation->FOUNDATION_AND_MATH,
Infrastructure->NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE, Licensing->COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING,
Storefront->COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING, Publisher->NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE,
Basilisk->PROPAGATION, Maneuver->MANEUVER_PLANNING,
Flow->FLOW_AND_COMPOSITION, Unspecified->UNSPECIFIED.
The mapping is one-way: PRIMARY_CATEGORY is never back-derived into
PLUGIN_TYPE.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified $CCT category this module belongs to, for browse, filter
and per-category counting. A module MAY carry several. If nonempty it
MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat. An empty list with
a set PRIMARY_CATEGORY means the module belongs to that one category.

SIGNAL.description: Signal type code (e.g., L1C, L2P, L5Q, E1B)

VALUE.description: Observation value (units depend on type: m, cycles, Hz, dB-Hz)

GNSS_SAT_ID.description: GNSS satellite identifier (e.g., G01, R24, E05, C03)

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation

EPOCH.description: Observation epoch (ISO 8601)

ALTITUDE.description: Receiver altitude in meters above WGS-84

TRPAsset.description: Asset admitted by a value or token predicate.

CHAIN_ID.description:
CAIP-2 style chain identifier, e.g. "eip155:1" or
"solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp". Vendor and organization names
are forbidden; a chain is named only by its identifier.

TOKEN_ADDRESS.description: Chain-local token address, or empty for the chain's native asset.

TOKEN_SYMBOL.description: Published token symbol used for display and matching.

DECIMALS.description: Number of decimal places used by the smallest-unit integer balance.

TRPPredicate.description: One independently measurable predicate in a trust rule policy.

PREDICATE_ID.description: Stable identifier unique within the policy.

MIN_VALUE.description: Minimum qualifying value expressed as a uint64 in the smallest unit.

VALUE_CURRENCY.description: Currency or unit used to compare normalized values.

MIN_HELD_SECONDS.description: Minimum continuous holding duration in seconds.

REQUIRED_COUNT.description: X, the number of named trusters that must match.

TRUSTER_IDS.description: The N named `$TRE` trusters considered by a trusted-connections predicate.

MIN_EDGE_WEIGHT.description: Minimum accepted `$TRE.WEIGHT` for a matching trust edge.

TRPGroup.description: Recursive boolean group for a compound trust rule set.

GROUP_ID.description: Stable identifier unique within the policy.

COMBINATOR.description: Boolean operation applied across direct predicates and child groups.

PREDICATES.description: Predicates evaluated directly within this group.

GROUPS.description: Nested groups used to express compound rule sets.

TRP.description: Trust Rule Policy - Signed compound criteria for evaluating one subject.

ROOT.description: Root of the compound rule tree.

EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS.description:
Periodic evaluation cadence in milliseconds. The 10000 default is the
0.1 Hz baseline and is configurable by the policy author.

EVENT_SOURCES.description:
Event names that may trigger evaluation, e.g. "trust-edge", "trust-node",
"entity-profile", or "chain-balance".

ACTIVE.description: Whether evaluators should currently apply this policy.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this policy was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this policy was last updated.

EVALUATOR_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the evaluator that issued this policy record.

EVALUATOR_SIGNATURE.description: Evaluator signature over the policy record.

TRVBondEvidence.description: Chain evidence supporting a value-based predicate result.

CHAIN_ID.description: Chain identifier using the same identifier-only convention as TRPAsset.

ADDRESS.description: Chain-local address whose balance was evaluated.

TOKEN_ADDRESS.description: Chain-local token address, or empty for the chain's native asset.

BALANCE.description: Observed uint64 balance expressed in the asset's smallest unit.

DECIMALS.description: Number of decimal places used by BALANCE.

VALUE_CURRENCY.description: Currency or unit used for normalized valuation.

HELD_SINCE.description:
Unix timestamp in milliseconds from which the balance is proven to have
been continuously held, established from chain history.

OBSERVED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the balance was observed.

BLOCK_REFERENCE.description: Chain-specific block identifier anchoring the observation.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or query description used to obtain the evidence.

TRVPredicateResult.description: Outcome and evidence for one policy predicate.

KIND.description: Predicate operation copied from the evaluated policy.

REQUIRED_VALUE.description: Threshold required by the evaluated predicate.

BOND_EVIDENCE.description: Chain evidence used by value and duration predicates.

TRUSTER_IDS_MATCHED.description: Named `$TRE` trusters whose qualifying edges matched.

TRV.description:
Trust Rule Verdict.

A TRV records one reproducible evaluation of a `$TRP` policy for a subject.
This record replaces ad-hoc trust status events.

SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the subject evaluated by the policy.

PREVIOUS_PASSED.description: Pass state produced by the immediately preceding evaluation.

PREVIOUS_SCORE.description: Score produced by the immediately preceding evaluation.

TRIGGER.description: Evaluation trigger: "interval" or an event source name.

EVALUATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the evaluation completed.

EVALUATOR_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the evaluator that issued this verdict.

EVALUATOR_SIGNATURE.description: Evaluator signature over the verdict record.

SNWBatchRequest.description:
Batch target detection request.

Sensor position and orientation are passed inline (not via an arena
offset) because they are small and uniform across a batch. The target
stream lives at INPUT_OFFSET as a tightly packed array of `targetState`
structs from SDR; the output detection stream is written to
OUTPUT_OFFSET as a tightly packed array of SDR `detectionResult` structs.

SENSOR_ID.description: Sensor-configuration identifier assigned during sensor registration.

SENSOR_ORIENT_W.description: Sensor orientation as a unit quaternion (W, X, Y, Z).

INPUT_OFFSET.description: Byte offset in the arena where the targetState[] input stream begins.

TARGET_COUNT.description: Number of target records at INPUT_OFFSET.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description:
Byte offset in the arena where the detectionResult[] output stream
will be written.

EPOCH.description: Current time as a Julian date.

COUNT.description: Number of detection records written to OUTPUT_OFFSET.

DETECTED_COUNT.description: Number of targets whose SNR met the detection threshold.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Byte offset where the detectionResult[] stream starts.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error message when ERROR_CODE != OK.

SNW.description:
Sensor Runtime Wire envelope — carries either a batch request or a batch
response across the runtime boundary.

COVERAGE_ID.description: Stable identifier of this coverage computation

GRID_SCHEME.description: Grid scheme identifier; "H3" for the H3 hexagonal hierarchical grid

CELL_INDEXES.description: Grid cell indexes (H3 cell ids); all metric arrays align to this order

WINDOW_START.description:
Epoch window start (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since
1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC]

WINDOW_STOP.description:
Epoch window stop (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since
1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC]

STEP_SIZE.description: Sampling step in seconds used to compute access intervals

SENSOR_IDS.description: Sensor identifiers contributing to the coverage set

ASSET_IDS.description: Asset (satellite) identifiers contributing to the coverage set

ACCESS_COUNTS.description: Per-cell number of access intervals in the window

ACCESS_TOTAL_S.description: Per-cell total access duration in seconds

REVISIT_MEAN_S.description: Per-cell mean revisit interval in seconds

REVISIT_MAX_S.description: Per-cell maximum revisit interval in seconds

RESPONSE_MEAN_S.description: Per-cell mean response time in seconds

RESPONSE_MAX_S.description: Per-cell maximum response time in seconds

GAP_MAX_S.description: Per-cell maximum coverage gap in seconds

COVERAGE_FRACTION.description: Per-cell fraction of the window with at least one access [0-1]

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this coverage set was computed

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM`

SIZE_IN_BITS.description: Number of bits for this integer

ENCODING.description: Integer encoding type
Float encoding format
Character encoding

MAX_SIZE_IN_BITS.description: Maximum size in bits (for variable length)
Maximum size in bits (for variable length)

LEADING_SIZE_BITS.description: Leading size field bits (for variable length)

PolynomialCalibrator.description: Polynomial calibrator - converts raw to engineering using polynomial

COEFFICIENTS.description: Polynomial terms (index is power, value is coefficient)

POINTS.description: Spline points ordered by raw value

MathOperation.description: Mathematical operation for math operation calibrator

MATCH_CRITERIA.description: Match criteria for selecting this calibrator
Match criteria for this alarm context

USE_CALIBRATED_VALUE.description: Use calibrated value (true) or raw value (false)

EPOCH.description: Reference epoch

SIZE.description: Fixed size of this dimension

ARRAY_TYPE_REF.description: Reference to the array element type

OFFSET_IN_BITS.description: Offset in bits from reference location

ContainerEntry.description: Container entry list item (union of entry types)

RateInStream.description: Rate specification for container in stream

ArgumentRefEntry.description: Argument reference entry in command container

CONTAINER_REFS.description: Container references provided by this service

COMMAND_REFS.description: Command references accepted by this service

CLASSIFICATION.description: Classification level

XTC.description:
SpaceSystem - Root element for XTCE document
A SpaceSystem defines the telemetry and command configuration for a space
vehicle or subsystem. SpaceSystems can be nested hierarchically to represent
the structure of a spacecraft (e.g., spacecraft -> subsystem -> payload).

PRWInit.description:
Propagator initialization request — assigns TLE / OMM / Keplerian /
polynomial inputs to entity handles.

The actual per-entity source record is carried inline as raw bytes
tagged with SOURCE_KIND and, where useful, a SDS file_identifier.
Callers encode `OMM`, `OCM`, or a one-off Keplerian set and pass the
bytes verbatim; the propagator uses SOURCE_KIND to decide how to
consume them.

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to assign results to (same order as SOURCES[]).

SOURCES.description: Per-entity source records, encoded as SDS FlatBuffers.

MU.description: Gravitational parameter of the central body (km^3 / s^2).

RAAN.description: Right ascension of the ascending node (radians).

EPOCH.description: Epoch as Julian date.

NORAD_ID.description: NORAD catalog number parsed from the TLE.

BYTES.description: Encoded source record as a FlatBuffer (consumed per KIND).

KEPLERIAN.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == KEPLERIAN.

TLE.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == TLE.

PRWBatchRequest.description:
Batch propagation request — propagate every entity in ENTITY_HANDLES[] to
EPOCH and write the result StateVector stream to OUTPUT_OFFSET in the
shared arena.

EPOCH.description: Target epoch as a Julian date (TIME_SYSTEM is configured on the host).

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to propagate (empty = all initialized entities).

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Output buffer offset in the arena where the StateVector stream begins.

MAX_COUNT.description: Maximum entities to process in this call (0 = unbounded).

TARGET_FRAME.description:
Target reference frame for the output state stream. Matches enum
values in SDS `RFM`. If zero, the propagator chooses its native frame.

PRWBatchResponse.description:
Batch propagation response header — describes the stream written to
OUTPUT_OFFSET and reports errors. The stream itself is
`STATE_VECTOR_SIZE`-tuple rows in the SDS `OCM` STATE_DATA layout.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Offset in the arena where the state-vector stream begins.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description: Components per state vector (6 = PV, 9 = PVA). Mirrors OCM.STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the stream (SDS `RFM`-compatible string tag).

FLAGS.description: Per-entity status flags (same cardinality as COUNT).

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error message when ERROR_CODE != OK.

PRW.description:
Propagator Runtime Wire — envelope that carries either an init request,
a batch request, or a batch response across a runtime boundary.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

NAME.description: Display name of the owner or source the code stands for.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer description of the owner or source.

ACTIVE.description: True while the code is in current use by the publishing catalogue.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the reference table the row was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the reference table was retrieved.

OBJECT_ID.description: International Designator (YYYY-NNNAAA)

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD Catalog Number

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Object type (Payload, Rocket body, Debris, Unknown)

RCS.description: Radar Cross Section [meters2]; blank if no data available

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type (Orbit, Landing, Impact, Docked to RSO, roundtrip)

MANEUVERABLE.description: Indicates if the object is maneuverable

SIZE.description: Size [meters]; blank if no data available

MASS.description: Mass [kilograms]; blank if no data available

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

OBJECT_1.description: Satellite name for the first object

DSE_1.description: Days since epoch for the first object

OBJECT_2.description: Satellite name for the second object

DSE_2.description: Days since epoch for the second object

TCA.description: Time of closest approach as a Unix timestamp

TCA_RANGE.description: The distance or range between the two objects at TCA

TCA_RELATIVE_SPEED.description: The magnitude of the relative velocity at TCA

DILUTION.description: Standard deviation that produces the maximum probability

GPXLink.description: GPX link to an external resource

GPXWaypoint.description: A waypoint, point of interest, or named feature

ELEVATION.description: Elevation in meters above WGS84 ellipsoid

GEOID_HEIGHT.description: Height of geoid above WGS84 ellipsoid in meters

SAT.description: Number of satellites used for fix

AGE_OF_DGPS_DATA.description: Age of DGPS data in seconds

GPXTrackSegment.description: Track segment (continuous span of track points)

POINTS.description: Ordered track points in this segment

GPXRoute.description: Route (ordered list of waypoints for navigation)

AUTHOR_NAME.description: Person or organization who created the file

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

FRMStateVector.description:
A state in a named element set at a named epoch. ELEMENTS is the element
set's own 6 values in the order documented on frmStateRepresentation.
POSITION and VELOCITY are the Cartesian projection of the same state and
are populated when REPRESENTATION is CARTESIAN or when the provider can
supply them; a consumer MUST NOT infer velocity from POSITION alone.

ELEMENTS.description: The 6 element values of REPRESENTATION, SI units and radians.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Name of the coordinate system these elements are expressed in; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this state, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter, m^3/s^2, of the origin body when the element
set requires one. Absent means the provider's default for the origin.

SOURCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the request's state is expressed in.

TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the result is required in.

SOURCE_STATE.description:
The full input state, carrying velocity as well as position. POSITION
above is position-only and remains the input for operations 1-4.

TARGET_REPRESENTATION.description: Element set the result must be expressed in.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the transform is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for every
time-dependent axis chain.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires
the provider to use. A provider that cannot honour it returns
MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than substituting another table.

TARGET_STATE.description:
The transformed state, with velocity, in TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM and
TARGET_REPRESENTATION.

ROTATION_DCM.description: Rotation from the source axes to the target axes at EPOCH.

ROTATION_DCM_RATE.description:
Time derivative of ROTATION_DCM, per second. Required for a velocity
transform between relatively rotating axis sets.

ANGULAR_VELOCITY_RAD_S.description:
Angular velocity of the target axes with respect to the source axes,
radians per second, expressed in the source axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_EPOCH.description: Epoch of the Earth-orientation data set actually used, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterRef.description:
A reference to one parameter, with the dependencies that make it evaluable.
This is what a request, a stopping condition and a report column all name.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_INDEX.description:
Component of a vector or matrix parameter, zero-based and row-major.
Negative selects the whole value.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system this evaluation is expressed in; resolves against
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME in PCEEvaluationContext.COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.
Absent means the context default.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code of the central body, when the parameter is
CENTRAL_BODY_DEPENDENT and the context default is not wanted.

SITE_ID.description: Site the parameter is evaluated from, when it is SURFACE_SITE_DEPENDENT.

SECOND_OBJECT_ID.description: Second object, when the parameter is SECOND_OBJECT_DEPENDENT.

OWNER_OBJECT_ID.description: Owning object, when the request evaluates more than one.

OWNER_HARDWARE_NAME.description:
Owning hardware item, when the owner class is THRUSTER, FUEL_TANK or a
burn.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system for an EPOCH-typed parameter, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name. Absent means the context default.

PCEParameterDescriptor.description:
One roster entry as a named publisher implements it. The catalog is the
authority a consumer resolves a name through BEFORE it asks for a value.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_NAME.description: REQUIRED when PARAMETER is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_UNIT_SYMBOL.description: REQUIRED when UNIT is PROVIDER_DEFINED, absent otherwise.

ELEMENT_COUNT.description:
Number of values for REAL_VECTOR, and rows times columns for
REAL_MATRIX. Absent or 1 for a scalar.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

REQUIRED_AXIS_TYPE.description:
The one axis set this parameter is defined for, when it is defined for
only one: planetodetic quantities require BODY_FIXED. UNSPECIFIED means
any axis set the request names.

REQUIRED_ORIGIN_KIND.description:
The one origin kind this parameter is defined for, when it is defined
for only one. UNSPECIFIED means any origin the request names.

TIME_SYSTEM_DEPENDENT.description:
The value changes with the time system it is asked for, independently of
the frame.

STATE_REPRESENTATION.description:
The element set this parameter is a member of, when it is a member of
one; UNSPECIFIED for a derived scalar that belongs to no set.

UNAVAILABLE_REASON.description:
REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DECLARED_UNAVAILABLE: what is missing,
stated as a capability, so a consumer can report the refusal.

SUPERSEDED_BY.description: REQUIRED when AVAILABILITY is DEPRECATED: the parameter to migrate to.

SUPPORTS_STOPPING_CONDITION.description:
The publisher can bracket and refine a root of this parameter, so it may
be used as a stopping condition or a generic event function. A parameter
that is not continuous in time MUST declare false.

IS_SETTABLE.description:
The parameter can be written as well as read, so it may be a targeting
variable.

IS_CYCLIC.description: The value wraps: a goal crossing must be tested modulo the cycle.

CYCLE_LOWER_BOUND.description:
Inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound of the cycle, REQUIRED when
IS_CYCLIC is true.

DESCRIPTION.description: One sentence, capability language, no product or organization names.

PCEParameterCatalog.description:
The roster a named publisher offers, resolved as a whole. A consumer
caches this and resolves every later name against it.

PROVIDER_ID.description: Identifier of the publisher that evaluates these parameters.

PUBLISHED_AT.description: ISO 8601 instant this catalog was published.

PCEEvaluationContext.description: Everything an evaluation needs besides the state itself.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the object the parameters are evaluated on.

HARDWARE_NAME.description: Hardware item, when the owner class names one.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the default central body.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter of the central body, m^3/s^2. Absent means the
provider's own value for CENTRAL_BODY_ID.

EQUATORIAL_RADIUS_M.description: Shape of the central body, REQUIRED for planetodetic parameters.

COORDINATE_SYSTEMS.description:
Fully specified coordinate systems, each named through
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

DEFAULT_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description: Which of COORDINATE_SYSTEMS a parameter reference falls back to.

DEFAULT_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system a parameter reference falls back to, named by the $TIM
timingStandard member name.

REFERENCE_EPOCH.description: Zero of ELAPSED_DAYS and ELAPSED_SECONDS, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires.
A provider that cannot honour it returns MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than
substituting another table.

ILLUMINATING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the illuminating body for lighting parameters.

PCEEvaluationRequest.description:
Evaluate these parameters on these states. One state is a point query; a
run of states is a report or a plot series, and carries the same shape.

STATES.description:
States to evaluate at, in chronological order. Each carries its own
epoch and coordinate system name.

PCEParameterValue.description:
One parameter's value at one state. STATUS is per value: a request never
fails as a whole because one name is unavailable.

VALUE.description: Scalar, integer or boolean value. Absent for vector and matrix types.

VALUES.description:
Vector or matrix values, row-major. Absent for scalar types; a scalar is
NEVER also written here.

ROW_COUNT.description: Matrix shape, REQUIRED when the descriptor's DATA_TYPE is REAL_MATRIX.

UNIT.description:
Unit the value is expressed in, restating the descriptor so a value is
self-describing when it travels without its catalog.

MESSAGE.description: Why STATUS is not OK, in capability language.

PCEParameterSample.description: The evaluated parameters at ONE epoch.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of this sample, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

SAMPLES.description: One sample per requested state, in the requested order.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

PCEParameterCondition.description:
A predicate on a named parameter: the parameter attains GOAL_VALUE, in
DIRECTION, for the OCCURRENCE-th time. This is the ONE spelling of a
stopping condition and of a generic event function; $EVL references it
rather than minting a second one.

GOAL_VALUE.description: Value the parameter must attain, in the parameter's own SI unit.

GOAL_TOLERANCE.description:
Convergence bar on the parameter value at the reported epoch, in the
parameter's own unit. A provider that cannot meet it returns
ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED rather than reporting an unconverged root.

OCCURRENCE.description:
Which attainment satisfies the condition, one-based. 0 and 1 both mean
the first.

PCEStopRequest.description:
Propagate until a condition is attained. The propagator itself is NOT named
here: it is a port the caller supplies, per the pluggable-propagation law.
This record carries only the condition, the interval and the tolerances.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions evaluated together; the run stops at whichever is attained
first in time.

MAXIMUM_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Upper bound on the propagated interval. Reaching it without attaining a
condition is GOAL_NOT_ATTAINED, never a silent stop.

EPOCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on the stop epoch. The same scenario run at different
step sizes MUST land inside this bar.

SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS.description:
Objects propagated in step with the owner and reported at the same stop
epoch.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at the stop epoch, beyond the condition itself.

PCEStopReport.description: Where a propagate-to-condition run actually landed.

ATTAINED_CONDITION_INDEX.description:
Index into PCEStopRequest.CONDITIONS of the condition that stopped the
run; negative when none did.

EPOCH.description: Epoch the run stopped at, ISO 8601.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Seconds of propagated time from the initial state to EPOCH; negative for
a BACKWARD run.

ACHIEVED_VALUE.description: Value the condition parameter actually had at EPOCH.

GOAL_RESIDUAL.description:
ACHIEVED_VALUE minus GOAL_VALUE, in the parameter's own unit. This is
the residual a consumer gates on; it is NOT assumed to be zero.

SYNCHRONIZED_STATES.description: States of SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS at the same epoch, in that order.

SAMPLE.description: Parameters evaluated at the stop epoch.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description: Root-refinement work actually done, for the step-independence evidence.

PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

OCCULTING_BODY_IDS.description:
Ephemeris body codes of the bodies allowed to occult, in the order they
are tested. More than one is normal.

ILLUMINATING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the illuminating body.

REPORT_UMBRA.description:
Which shadow regions to report. A model that cannot distinguish a region
MUST refuse the request rather than fold it into a neighbour.

MINIMUM_DURATION_SECONDS.description: Events shorter than this are not reported. 0 reports every event.

ABERRATION_CORRECTION.description: Correct the illuminating-body direction for signal travel time.

OBSERVER.description: The observing point, normally a GROUND_SITE origin.

SENSOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the observing site or sensor; resolves against $SEN.ID
when the observer is an instrumented site.

MINIMUM_ELEVATION_RAD.description: Elevation the target must exceed, radians, when no mask is supplied.

AZIMUTH_ELEVATION_MASK_RAD.description:
Horizon mask as azimuth and minimum-elevation pairs, radians, in
ascending azimuth: [az0, el0, az1, el1, ...]. Present, it supersedes
MINIMUM_ELEVATION_RAD. An odd length is INVALID_INPUT.

OCCULTING_BODY_IDS.description: Bodies allowed to block the line of sight.

MINIMUM_DURATION_SECONDS.description: Events shorter than this are not reported.

SENSOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the sensor whose field of view is tested; resolves against
$SEN.ID. The sensor's site data is NOT restated here.

BORESIGHT_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system BORESIGHT is expressed in; resolves against
RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME on the request context.

CONE_HALF_ANGLE_RAD.description: Half-angle of a CONIC field of view, radians.

RECTANGULAR_HALF_ANGLE_X_RAD.description: Half-angles of a RECTANGULAR field of view about the boresight, radians.

CUSTOM_MASK_RAD.description:
Boundary of a CUSTOM_MASK field of view as clock and cone angle pairs
about the boresight, radians: [clock0, cone0, clock1, cone1, ...]. An
odd length is INVALID_INPUT.

INTRUDING_BODY_IDS.description: Ephemeris body codes of the bodies tested for intrusion.

INTRUDING_OBJECT_IDS.description: Identifiers of the tracked objects tested for intrusion.

USE_APPARENT_BODY_RADIUS.description:
Test the intruder's apparent disc rather than its centre, so an event
begins when the limb enters the field of view.

CENTRAL_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code the radius is measured from. The apsis is the root
of the RADIAL_VELOCITY parameter about this body, NOT an extremum of
geodetic height; the two differ by tens of degrees of true anomaly on an
oblate body.

REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Coordinate system whose reference plane defines the node line; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME on the request context.

EVLParameterConditionConfiguration.description: Configuration for PARAMETER_CONDITION, the generic locator.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions on $PCE catalog parameters. The predicate vocabulary is
PCEParameterCondition and is NOT restated here.

REPORT_AS_INTERVAL.description:
True reports the interval BETWEEN a satisfying crossing and the next
unsatisfying one; false reports each crossing as an instantaneous event
with equal start and stop epochs.

EVLEventSample.description: Parameter values captured at one instant inside an event.

EVLEvent.description:
One located event. An instantaneous event has STOP_EPOCH equal to
START_EPOCH and DURATION_SECONDS equal to 0.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of the epochs, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

DURATION_SECONDS.description:

TARGET_OBJECT_ID.description: The object the event happened to.

OCCULTING_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body that occulted or intruded, when one did.

OBSERVER_ID.description: Identifier of the observing site or sensor, when the class has one.

OBSERVED_OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the observed body or object, when the class has one.

EXTREMUM_EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the event's extremum, ISO 8601: deepest obscuration, peak
elevation, closest approach. Absent when the class has no extremum.

EXTREMUM_VALUE.description: Value at EXTREMUM_EPOCH, in the unit of EXTREMUM_PARAMETER.

EXTREMUM_PARAMETER.description: Which catalog parameter EXTREMUM_VALUE is a value of.

CONDITION_INDEX.description:

SAMPLES.description: Requested parameters, evaluated at the instants of this event.

EVLEventLocationRequest.description: Locate events of one class over one interval.

TARGET_OBJECT_ID.description: Object the events are located for.

CONTEXT.description:
Bodies, coordinate systems, epoch reference and Earth-orientation data

caller supplies and is NOT named here.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:

SCAN_STEP_SECONDS.description:
Coarse step the event function is sampled at before refinement. A
provider MAY choose its own step when this is absent, and the located
epochs MUST NOT depend on it beyond REFINEMENT_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.

REFINEMENT_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on a located epoch. A provider that cannot meet it
returns ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED.

MAXIMUM_EVENTS.description: Upper bound on reported events. 0 means no bound.

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at each event's instants.

ECLIPSE_CONFIGURATION.description:
Exactly the configuration matching LOCATOR_CLASS is present; any other

EVLEventReport.description: The events found, and the interval they were actually searched over.

SCAN_START_EPOCH.description:
Interval actually searched, ISO 8601. A BUDGET_EXCEEDED run reports the

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of the epochs, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EVENTS.description: Events in chronological order of START_EPOCH.

FUNCTION_EVALUATION_COUNT.description:
Event-function evaluations actually performed, for step-independence
evidence.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

EVL.description:
Event Locator

One request and one report for every class of located event: shadow
passage, site visibility, sensor-field-of-view intrusion, apsis passage,
node crossing, and the generic condition on any $PCE catalog parameter.
Every class is the same pair of an event function and a refined root, so a
new class is a configuration table and a vocabulary member, never a new
record. Entry and exit epochs, duration, the occulting or observed body and
the parameter values captured at each event's instants are reported in one
shape, and the predicate of the generic class is $PCE's
PCEParameterCondition rather than a second spelling of the same idea.

Angles are radians, durations seconds, epochs ISO 8601 in a named time
system.

CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer
from inventing its own wording for the same code.

CODE.description: The ratified category code. This is the join key every consumer uses.

DISPLAY_NAME.description:
Canonical human-readable label, rendered verbatim. MUST equal the display
name stated in the CODE member's doc comment.

SUMMARY.description: One-sentence description shown on browse rows and category headers.

SLUG.description:
Route-safe identifier: the CODE identifier lowercased with `_` replaced by
`-`. Published explicitly rather than derived so every surface routes
identically.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer editorial description for a category landing page.

PARENT.description:
Parent category for hierarchical browse. UNSPECIFIED means this is a
top-level category. A category MUST NOT name itself as its parent.

SORT_ORDER.description:
Presentation order within its parent, ascending. Ties break on
DISPLAY_NAME.

KEYWORDS.description:
Search synonyms and alternate phrasings that resolve to this category.
Feeds type-ahead; never rendered as the category label.

ICON_KEY.description:
Key of a self-hosted icon or capsule asset for this category. A KEY, not a
URL: consuming node surfaces load zero external-origin bytes, so the
consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

CODE.description: Category being counted.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified `$CCT` category this listing is shelved under, using the
same vocabulary and semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY and
APP.PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Before this field existed a listing carried no
capability category at all — only DATA_TYPES and TAGS — so a storefront
shelf and a library shelf were grouped by two unrelated systems. A
consumer MUST group listings by this field and MUST NOT re-derive a
category from DATA_TYPES, TAGS or TITLE, none of which are a controlled
vocabulary.

Distinct from LISTING_KIND, which is the delivery kind (data stream vs
module artifact), and from ACCESS_TYPE, which is the commercial access
model. UNSPECIFIED means the provider did not classify the listing; a
consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified `$CCT` category this listing belongs to, for browse,
filter and per-category counting. A listing MAY carry several. If
nonempty it MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.

One constraint in a maneuver-targeting problem and how well the converged

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for this instant.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.
