RFLObstruction.description:
One obstacle interaction on one sample's path. SPARSE: entries exist only
where an interaction was computed, so a clear path is never encoded as a
row of zeroes.

This is the join that makes an arbitrary 3D object a first-class part of
the link budget: MATERIAL_ID names the `$RFS` record whose permittivity,
conductivity, penetration loss and roughness produced LOSS_DB, and
GEOMETRY_REF_ID names the exact mesh, face set, panel or analytic shape
inside it that was hit.

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this interaction applies to.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface that was hit. An obstruction loss with
no material is an unattributed number: a metal panel and a plasterboard
wall of the same size do entirely different things to a link.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh, when the obstacle is a
reviewed 3D asset.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the obstacle is a catalogued object (an
occulting spacecraft, a structure on another vehicle). 0 when unbound.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle between the incident ray and the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

PATH_LENGTH_IN_MATERIAL_M.description:
Path length travelled INSIDE the material, metres. With
`$RFS.ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M` this is what makes penetration loss
reproducible instead of a stated constant.

EXCESS_DELAY_S.description: Extra propagation delay of a reflected or scattered component, seconds.

FRESNEL_CLEARANCE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the first Fresnel zone still clear [0-1]. 1 means the zone is
untouched.

DISTANCE_FROM_TRANSMITTER_M.description: Distance from the transmitter to the interaction point, metres.

RFLEndpoint.description:
One endpoint of a link. Identity ONLY — position, antenna geometry and band
capability are NOT copied here; they are joined from the standard named by
ENDPOINT_KIND. A copied position silently goes stale against its source.

ENDPOINT_ID.description: Producer-stable identifier for this endpoint within the record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the endpoint is an on-orbit object. 0 when
unbound — never a placeholder catalogue number.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator, `$CAT.OBJECT_ID`.

RFB_ID.description:
`$RFB.ID` — the band specification (frequency, bandwidth, EIRP, gains,
polarization) this endpoint transmits or receives on.

RFE_ID.description: `$RFE.ID` — the parametric emitter description, when one exists.

IQC_ID.description: `$IQC` capture identifier, when the samples were derived from a recording.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel or carrier identifier within the beam.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization actually used on this link. Defaults to UNKNOWN explicitly:
`rfPolarization` ordinal 0 is LHCP, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as a real polarization.

RFLModCod.description:
One modulation-and-coding choice available to a link. The table carries
engineering capability only; catalogue or recommendation names belong in
ID / NAME and provenance data, never in the schema vocabulary.

MODCOD_ID.description: Stable identifier within the containing link's MODCOD_SET.

CODE_RATE.description: Information bits divided by coded bits, in (0,1].

REQUIRED_MARGIN_DB.description: Additional implementation margin required before this entry is selected.

MAXIMUM_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Optional ceiling imposed by framing or implementation, bits per second.

RFLLink.description: One link whose budget is sampled by this record.

LINK_ID.description:
Producer-stable link identifier. Joins `$ACI.ACIInterval.LINK_ID` and
`$LKS.ID` when the same link also has an operational-state record.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Carrier centre frequency actually used, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention, NOT the `$IQC` hertz convention. A consumer joining the two
converts explicitly at the join. Band designation is NOT duplicated here:
it is joined from `$RFB.BAND`.

MODULATION.description: Modulation as the producer states it (e.g. "QPSK", "8PSK", "16APSK").

CODING.description: Forward error correction scheme as the producer states it.

CODE_RATE.description: Code rate as a fraction (0-1].

SYMBOL_RATE_BAUD.description:
Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud — the `$RFB.BAUD`
convention.

DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Information bit rate the budget is stated for, bits per second.

THRESHOLD_TERM.description:
Required threshold this link is evaluated against. THRESHOLD_TERM,
THRESHOLD_VALUE, THRESHOLD_UNITS and THRESHOLD_COMPARISON are meaningful
only together; a LINK_MARGIN_DB column without them states a margin
against an unstated requirement and MUST be refused.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this link belongs to. Links sharing a RECEIVER_GROUP_ID
and CHANNEL_GROUP_ID are mutually interfering and MUST be evaluated
together; a producer that shards a link matrix MUST keep a group intact
within one shard.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation or network this link belongs to.

SERVICE.description: Operator-facing service or mission designation.

MODCOD_SET.description:
Ordered adaptive modulation-and-coding choices. Per-sample
SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX indexes this vector for the sample's selected link.

ACM_ENABLED.description: Whether the producer evaluated adaptive selection for this link.

RFLInterferenceContribution.description:
One interfering contribution to one sample. SPARSE: entries exist only
where a contribution was computed, so a dense matrix is never forced into
existence to say "no interference computed".

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this contribution applies to.

SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ID.description:
Endpoint identifier of the interfering emitter, when it is an endpoint of
this record.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` of the interfering emission.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Interfering object's catalogue number, 0 when unbound.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Received interfering power at the victim receiver, dBW.

TOPOCENTRIC_SEPARATION_DEG.description:
Angular separation between the wanted and interfering paths at the
victim receiver, degrees.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim's bandwidth overlapped by this emission [0-1].

POLARIZATION_ISOLATION_DB.description: Polarization isolation applied to this contribution, dB.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Discrimination applied from the victim antenna pattern, dB.

RFLModelParameter.description:
A named parameter of a model binding, with its unit stated. There is no
encoding for a parameter value without a unit.

TEXT_VALUE.description: Non-numeric parameter value, when the parameter is categorical.

RFLModelBinding.description:
Which model produced one term of the budget. A loss term without a model
binding is an unattributed number: rain attenuation from two different
recommendations differs by decibels, and a consumer must be able to tell
which one it is holding.

TERM.description: The budget term this binding produced.

MODEL_NAME.description:
Model or recommendation identifier as its publisher states it (e.g. an
ITU-R recommendation number with its revision).

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` of the module that evaluated it.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact artifact that produced the values.

RFLProvenance.description: Where this sample set came from, stated once for the record.

SOURCE.description:
The producing system, dataset or measurement campaign. Required: a
budget time series with no stated source is not publishable.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference that regenerates this set.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the propagator that produced the geometry columns. A record
whose METHOD is MODELED or HYBRID and which carries geometry columns MUST
name it: geometry is only as good as the propagator, and the propagator is
a pluggable choice, never an assumed default.

PROPAGATOR_CONFIGURATION.description: Force model or configuration identifier handed to the propagator.

SAMPLING_STEP_S.description: Uniform sampling step, seconds. Absent when SAMPLE_EPOCHS are irregular.

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description:
Weather or environment dataset the atmospheric terms were evaluated
against, when they were not evaluated against a statistical model.

TERRAIN_DATASET.description: Terrain or surface dataset the blockage terms were evaluated against.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this set was computed or recorded.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix ms the upstream inputs were retrieved.

LICENSE.description:
Licence the source imposes on redistribution. An empty LICENSE means
UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a grant to redistribute.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: True when the licence forbids commercial use of this set.

CITATION.description: Attribution the licence requires this record to carry downstream.

MODULE_ID.description:
Primary `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced this record.
MODELS remains the per-budget-term attribution surface.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact producing WASM artifact.

RFL_ID.description: Stable identifier of this sample set.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$ACI` and
`$CVP` products derived from this set.

LINKS.description: Link definitions. SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES index into this vector.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of samples. Every present metric array MUST have exactly this
many entries.

SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES.description: Index into LINKS for each sample.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description:
Sample epochs, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM. Samples
need not be uniformly spaced and need not be grouped by link, but MUST be
non-decreasing within each link.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale SAMPLE_EPOCHS are expressed in. Defaults to UTC explicitly:
`timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as sidereal time.

RANGE_RATE_M_S.description: Range rate, metres per second; positive is opening.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the receiving endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the receiving endpoint, degrees above the local horizon.

TRANSMIT_AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the transmitting endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

TRANSMIT_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the transmitting endpoint, degrees.

DOPPLER_SHIFT_HZ.description:
Doppler shift of the carrier, hertz; positive is closing. Hertz, not the
MHz used for frequencies elsewhere in this record — a shift of a few kHz
on a GHz carrier is destroyed by an MHz encoding.

EIRP_DBW.description: Effective isotropic radiated power toward the receiver, dBW.

TRANSMIT_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain in the direction of the receiver, dBi.

RECEIVE_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain in the direction of the transmitter, dBi.

GASEOUS_ABSORPTION_LOSS_DB.description: Gaseous (oxygen and water vapour) absorption, dB.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS_DB.description:
Total loss from 3D obstacles on the path, dB. The per-obstacle detail —
which object, which material, at what angle, through how much of it — is
in OBSTRUCTIONS.

TOTAL_PATH_LOSS_DB.description:
Total of all path terms actually applied, dB. Published as its own column
rather than left to the consumer to sum: a producer that applied a term
this schema has no column for MUST still report an honest total, and the
discrepancy against the itemised columns is then visible.

RECEIVED_POWER_DBW.description: Received carrier power at the receiver input, dBW.

GAIN_TO_NOISE_TEMPERATURE_DB_PER_K.description: Receiving system figure of merit G/T, dB/K.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_DB.description: Carrier-to-noise ratio C/N in the occupied bandwidth, dB.

ENERGY_PER_BIT_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Energy per bit to noise density Eb/N0, dB.

BIT_ERROR_RATE.description:
Bit error rate as a probability [0-1], NOT an exponent and NOT a
percentage. 1e-6 is encoded 1e-6.

LINK_MARGIN_DB.description:
Link margin against the link's stated threshold, dB. Meaningless without
RFLLink.THRESHOLD_TERM / THRESHOLD_VALUE / THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY_BPS.description: Achievable channel capacity, bits per second.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Aggregate received interfering power, dBW.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_PLUS_INTERFERENCE_DB.description: Carrier to noise-plus-interference ratio C/(N+I), dB.

OBSTRUCTIONS.description:
Per-interaction obstacle detail, sparse. Each entry names the `$RFS`
material it went through, reflected off or was blocked by.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS.description: The single condition that bound the link at each sample.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description required when a LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS entry is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of the whole set. Required: an unattributed budget is not
publishable.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over the size-prefixed
FlatBuffer projection with both 64-byte signature payloads zeroed while
preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over canonical JSON with IDL
field order, IDL capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both
signature fields omitted.

SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX.description:
Index into the selected link's RFLLink.MODCOD_SET for each sample.
SELECTED_MODCOD_VALID distinguishes index 0 from no selection.

SPECTRAL_EFFICIENCY_BPS_HZ.description: Spectral efficiency delivered by the selected entry, bit/s/Hz.

ACHIEVED_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Delivered information rate after adaptive selection, bits per second.

ACM_MARGIN_DB.description: Margin above the selected entry's threshold, dB.

ENERGY_PER_SYMBOL_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Symbol energy to noise spectral density, dB.

EPFContributor.description: One source's contribution to one sample.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Pattern discrimination applied in the victim direction, dB.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim measurement bandwidth overlapped [0-1].

EPFVerdict.description: FlatSQL-queryable compliance verdict consumed directly by `$RPT`.

MARGIN_DB.description: Worst margin to the applicable limit, dB. Positive means compliant.

SAMPLE_MARGIN_DB.description: Positive means the sample complies with its limit.

CDF_VALUES.description:
Empirical distribution values and their percent-time exceedance. Arrays
are index-aligned and ordered as stated by provenance.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

SENSOR_ID.description: Sensor identifier

MULTI_SOURCE.description: True if fused from multiple sources

TRACK_COMPONENTS.description: Number of components per point (default 3 for X, Y, Z)

ECEF_POS.description: ECEF position as flat array [X0, Y0, Z0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]

ECEF_VEL.description: ECEF velocity as flat array [VX0, VY0, VZ0, VX1, VY1, VZ1, ...]

ECEF_ACC.description: ECEF acceleration as flat array [AX0, AY0, AZ0, AX1, AY1, AZ1, ...]

LC_POS.description: Local coordinate position as flat array

LC_VEL.description: Local coordinate velocity as flat array

LC_ACC.description: Local coordinate acceleration as flat array

COV.description: Covariance data (21 elements per point for 6x6 lower triangular)

ERR_ELLP.description: Error ellipse data (6 elements per point)

TRE.description:
Trust Edge Record - Durable directed trust assertion for an SDN trust graph.

A TRE records one directed truster -> trustee assertion. The current trust
graph is a projection over the latest TRE records by EDGE_ID, with deleted
records acting as tombstones. Implementations must still validate the
projected graph for acyclicity before accepting it.

WEIGHT.description: Truster-assigned edge weight in the range [0, 1].

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this edge was last updated.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the edge from the current graph.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the node/provider that issued this trust edge record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the trust edge record.

START_TIME.description: Observation start time (ISO 8601)

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Observation reference frame

CHANGE_DETECTED.description: True if change detected from baseline

BRIGHTNESS_VARIANCE_CHANGE_DETECTED.description: True if brightness variance change detected

SOLAR_PHASE_ANGLE_BRIGHTNESS_CHANGE_DETE.description: True if solar phase angle brightness change detected

EPOCH.description: Observation epoch (ISO 8601)

SENSOR_ID.description: Sensor identifier

HIGH_ZENITH_AZIMUTH.description: True if high zenith angle observation

CESObjectVector.description: One catalog object's dense embedding row.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Joins to CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID / OMM.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator. Joins to CAT.OBJECT_ID.

VECTOR_INT8.description:
Row values when the parent CES.ENCODING is INT8. Length equals
CES.DIMENSIONS.

SCALE.description:
Per-row dequantization scale: original value ~= VECTOR_INT8[i] * SCALE.
Unused when ENCODING is FLOAT32.

VECTOR_FLOAT32.description:
Row values when the parent CES.ENCODING is FLOAT32. Length equals
CES.DIMENSIONS.

CES.description:
Catalog Embedding Shard.

One CES publishes the dense semantic-search vector table for one dataset
update: one row per catalog object, alongside that update's $OMM shard and
$DPM manifest (DPMAsset.ASSET_KIND = EMBEDDING_SHARD). Vectors are
L2-normalised at the encoder's output; similarity between two rows, or
between a row and a query vector produced by a paired $QEM, is dot
product (equivalent to cosine similarity for unit-norm vectors).

A consumer MUST compare MODEL_ID, MODEL_VERSION, MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256,
POOLING_METHOD and TEMPLATE_VERSION against a QEM record before trusting
cross-encoding similarity between a query vector and CES rows; a mismatch
on any one field means the two vector spaces are not comparable.

DATASET_ID.description: Joins to DPM.DATASET_ID for the publication this shard belongs to.

UPDATE_ID.description:
Joins to DPM.UPDATE_ID for the specific update this shard was computed
against.

DIMENSIONS.description: Fixed embedding dimensionality shared by every row (e.g. 384).

ENCODING.description: Row element encoding used across ROWS.

SIMILARITY.description: Similarity function rows are intended to be compared with.

MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the encoder weights, lowercase hex. Same convention as
DPMAsset.BYTE_SHA256.

POOLING_METHOD.description: Sentence/document pooling method the encoder used.

TEMPLATE_VERSION.description:
Version of the text template documents were rendered from before
encoding. Must match a QEM's TEMPLATE_VERSION for compatible retrieval.

QEMTokenVector.description: One pruned-vocabulary token's static embedding row.

TOKEN.description: WordPiece token text, verbatim including any ## continuation marker.

TOKEN_ID.description:
Vocabulary row index. Row order in TOKENS is not guaranteed stable
across MODEL_VERSION; look up by TOKEN_ID, not array position.

VECTOR_INT8.description:
Row values when the parent QEM.ENCODING is INT8. Length equals
QEM.DIMENSIONS.

SCALE.description:
Per-row dequantization scale: original value ~= VECTOR_INT8[i] * SCALE.
Unused when ENCODING is FLOAT32.

VECTOR_FLOAT32.description:
Row values when the parent QEM.ENCODING is FLOAT32. Length equals
QEM.DIMENSIONS.

IDF.description: Inverse document frequency weight for this token.

QEM.description:
Query Encoder Model.

One QEM publishes the pruned static token-embedding table a lightweight
client (e.g. a browser) loads to encode a search query into the same
vector space a paired $CES shard's rows live in, without shipping a full
transformer. A consumer pools the rows of the query's tokens (per
POOLING_METHOD) into a query vector, then dot-products it against
CES.ROWS.

A QEM is compatible with a CES only when MODEL_ID, MODEL_VERSION,
MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256, POOLING_METHOD and TEMPLATE_VERSION all match; a
mismatch on any one means the two vector spaces are not comparable.

MODEL_ID.description: Encoder model identifier/name. Compared verbatim against CES.MODEL_ID.

MODEL_VERSION.description: Encoder model version. Compared verbatim against CES.MODEL_VERSION.

MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the encoder weights, lowercase hex. Same convention as
DPMAsset.BYTE_SHA256. Compared verbatim against CES.MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256.

POOLING_METHOD.description:
Sentence/document pooling method the encoder uses. Compared verbatim
against CES.POOLING_METHOD.

TEMPLATE_VERSION.description:
Version of the text template documents were rendered from before
encoding. Compared verbatim against CES.TEMPLATE_VERSION.

DIMENSIONS.description: Fixed embedding dimensionality; must equal the paired CES.DIMENSIONS.

ENCODING.description: Row element encoding used across TOKENS.

VOCAB_SIZE.description: Number of tokens in the pruned vocabulary.

TOKENS.description: One row per pruned vocabulary token.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation name

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for this instant.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional caller trace/correlation identifier.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

RFLObstruction.description:
One obstacle interaction on one sample's path. SPARSE: entries exist only
where an interaction was computed, so a clear path is never encoded as a
row of zeroes.

This is the join that makes an arbitrary 3D object a first-class part of
the link budget: MATERIAL_ID names the `$RFS` record whose permittivity,
conductivity, penetration loss and roughness produced LOSS_DB, and
GEOMETRY_REF_ID names the exact mesh, face set, panel or analytic shape
inside it that was hit.

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this interaction applies to.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface that was hit. An obstruction loss with
no material is an unattributed number: a metal panel and a plasterboard
wall of the same size do entirely different things to a link.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh, when the obstacle is a
reviewed 3D asset.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the obstacle is a catalogued object (an
occulting spacecraft, a structure on another vehicle). 0 when unbound.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle between the incident ray and the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

PATH_LENGTH_IN_MATERIAL_M.description:
Path length travelled INSIDE the material, metres. With
`$RFS.ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M` this is what makes penetration loss
reproducible instead of a stated constant.

EXCESS_DELAY_S.description: Extra propagation delay of a reflected or scattered component, seconds.

FRESNEL_CLEARANCE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the first Fresnel zone still clear [0-1]. 1 means the zone is
untouched.

DISTANCE_FROM_TRANSMITTER_M.description: Distance from the transmitter to the interaction point, metres.

RFLEndpoint.description:
One endpoint of a link. Identity ONLY — position, antenna geometry and band
capability are NOT copied here; they are joined from the standard named by
ENDPOINT_KIND. A copied position silently goes stale against its source.

ENDPOINT_ID.description: Producer-stable identifier for this endpoint within the record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the endpoint is an on-orbit object. 0 when
unbound — never a placeholder catalogue number.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator, `$CAT.OBJECT_ID`.

RFB_ID.description:
`$RFB.ID` — the band specification (frequency, bandwidth, EIRP, gains,
polarization) this endpoint transmits or receives on.

RFE_ID.description: `$RFE.ID` — the parametric emitter description, when one exists.

IQC_ID.description: `$IQC` capture identifier, when the samples were derived from a recording.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel or carrier identifier within the beam.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization actually used on this link. Defaults to UNKNOWN explicitly:
`rfPolarization` ordinal 0 is LHCP, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as a real polarization.

RFLModCod.description:
One modulation-and-coding choice available to a link. The table carries
engineering capability only; catalogue or recommendation names belong in
ID / NAME and provenance data, never in the schema vocabulary.

MODCOD_ID.description: Stable identifier within the containing link's MODCOD_SET.

CODE_RATE.description: Information bits divided by coded bits, in (0,1].

REQUIRED_MARGIN_DB.description: Additional implementation margin required before this entry is selected.

MAXIMUM_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Optional ceiling imposed by framing or implementation, bits per second.

RFLLink.description: One link whose budget is sampled by this record.

LINK_ID.description:
Producer-stable link identifier. Joins `$ACI.ACIInterval.LINK_ID` and
`$LKS.ID` when the same link also has an operational-state record.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Carrier centre frequency actually used, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention, NOT the `$IQC` hertz convention. A consumer joining the two
converts explicitly at the join. Band designation is NOT duplicated here:
it is joined from `$RFB.BAND`.

MODULATION.description: Modulation as the producer states it (e.g. "QPSK", "8PSK", "16APSK").

CODING.description: Forward error correction scheme as the producer states it.

CODE_RATE.description: Code rate as a fraction (0-1].

SYMBOL_RATE_BAUD.description:
Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud — the `$RFB.BAUD`
convention.

DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Information bit rate the budget is stated for, bits per second.

THRESHOLD_TERM.description:
Required threshold this link is evaluated against. THRESHOLD_TERM,
THRESHOLD_VALUE, THRESHOLD_UNITS and THRESHOLD_COMPARISON are meaningful
only together; a LINK_MARGIN_DB column without them states a margin
against an unstated requirement and MUST be refused.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this link belongs to. Links sharing a RECEIVER_GROUP_ID
and CHANNEL_GROUP_ID are mutually interfering and MUST be evaluated
together; a producer that shards a link matrix MUST keep a group intact
within one shard.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation or network this link belongs to.

SERVICE.description: Operator-facing service or mission designation.

MODCOD_SET.description:
Ordered adaptive modulation-and-coding choices. Per-sample
SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX indexes this vector for the sample's selected link.

ACM_ENABLED.description: Whether the producer evaluated adaptive selection for this link.

RFLInterferenceContribution.description:
One interfering contribution to one sample. SPARSE: entries exist only
where a contribution was computed, so a dense matrix is never forced into
existence to say "no interference computed".

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this contribution applies to.

SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ID.description:
Endpoint identifier of the interfering emitter, when it is an endpoint of
this record.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` of the interfering emission.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Interfering object's catalogue number, 0 when unbound.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Received interfering power at the victim receiver, dBW.

TOPOCENTRIC_SEPARATION_DEG.description:
Angular separation between the wanted and interfering paths at the
victim receiver, degrees.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim's bandwidth overlapped by this emission [0-1].

POLARIZATION_ISOLATION_DB.description: Polarization isolation applied to this contribution, dB.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Discrimination applied from the victim antenna pattern, dB.

RFLModelParameter.description:
A named parameter of a model binding, with its unit stated. There is no
encoding for a parameter value without a unit.

TEXT_VALUE.description: Non-numeric parameter value, when the parameter is categorical.

RFLModelBinding.description:
Which model produced one term of the budget. A loss term without a model
binding is an unattributed number: rain attenuation from two different
recommendations differs by decibels, and a consumer must be able to tell
which one it is holding.

TERM.description: The budget term this binding produced.

MODEL_NAME.description:
Model or recommendation identifier as its publisher states it (e.g. an
ITU-R recommendation number with its revision).

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` of the module that evaluated it.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact artifact that produced the values.

RFLProvenance.description: Where this sample set came from, stated once for the record.

SOURCE.description:
The producing system, dataset or measurement campaign. Required: a
budget time series with no stated source is not publishable.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference that regenerates this set.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the propagator that produced the geometry columns. A record
whose METHOD is MODELED or HYBRID and which carries geometry columns MUST
name it: geometry is only as good as the propagator, and the propagator is
a pluggable choice, never an assumed default.

PROPAGATOR_CONFIGURATION.description: Force model or configuration identifier handed to the propagator.

SAMPLING_STEP_S.description: Uniform sampling step, seconds. Absent when SAMPLE_EPOCHS are irregular.

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description:
Weather or environment dataset the atmospheric terms were evaluated
against, when they were not evaluated against a statistical model.

TERRAIN_DATASET.description: Terrain or surface dataset the blockage terms were evaluated against.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this set was computed or recorded.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix ms the upstream inputs were retrieved.

LICENSE.description:
Licence the source imposes on redistribution. An empty LICENSE means
UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a grant to redistribute.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: True when the licence forbids commercial use of this set.

CITATION.description: Attribution the licence requires this record to carry downstream.

MODULE_ID.description:
Primary `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced this record.
MODELS remains the per-budget-term attribution surface.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact producing WASM artifact.

RFL_ID.description: Stable identifier of this sample set.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$ACI` and
`$CVP` products derived from this set.

LINKS.description: Link definitions. SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES index into this vector.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of samples. Every present metric array MUST have exactly this
many entries.

SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES.description: Index into LINKS for each sample.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description:
Sample epochs, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM. Samples
need not be uniformly spaced and need not be grouped by link, but MUST be
non-decreasing within each link.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale SAMPLE_EPOCHS are expressed in. Defaults to UTC explicitly:
`timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as sidereal time.

RANGE_RATE_M_S.description: Range rate, metres per second; positive is opening.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the receiving endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the receiving endpoint, degrees above the local horizon.

TRANSMIT_AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the transmitting endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

TRANSMIT_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the transmitting endpoint, degrees.

DOPPLER_SHIFT_HZ.description:
Doppler shift of the carrier, hertz; positive is closing. Hertz, not the
MHz used for frequencies elsewhere in this record — a shift of a few kHz
on a GHz carrier is destroyed by an MHz encoding.

EIRP_DBW.description: Effective isotropic radiated power toward the receiver, dBW.

TRANSMIT_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain in the direction of the receiver, dBi.

RECEIVE_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain in the direction of the transmitter, dBi.

GASEOUS_ABSORPTION_LOSS_DB.description: Gaseous (oxygen and water vapour) absorption, dB.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS_DB.description:
Total loss from 3D obstacles on the path, dB. The per-obstacle detail —
which object, which material, at what angle, through how much of it — is
in OBSTRUCTIONS.

TOTAL_PATH_LOSS_DB.description:
Total of all path terms actually applied, dB. Published as its own column
rather than left to the consumer to sum: a producer that applied a term
this schema has no column for MUST still report an honest total, and the
discrepancy against the itemised columns is then visible.

RECEIVED_POWER_DBW.description: Received carrier power at the receiver input, dBW.

GAIN_TO_NOISE_TEMPERATURE_DB_PER_K.description: Receiving system figure of merit G/T, dB/K.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_DB.description: Carrier-to-noise ratio C/N in the occupied bandwidth, dB.

ENERGY_PER_BIT_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Energy per bit to noise density Eb/N0, dB.

BIT_ERROR_RATE.description:
Bit error rate as a probability [0-1], NOT an exponent and NOT a
percentage. 1e-6 is encoded 1e-6.

LINK_MARGIN_DB.description:
Link margin against the link's stated threshold, dB. Meaningless without
RFLLink.THRESHOLD_TERM / THRESHOLD_VALUE / THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY_BPS.description: Achievable channel capacity, bits per second.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Aggregate received interfering power, dBW.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_PLUS_INTERFERENCE_DB.description: Carrier to noise-plus-interference ratio C/(N+I), dB.

OBSTRUCTIONS.description:
Per-interaction obstacle detail, sparse. Each entry names the `$RFS`
material it went through, reflected off or was blocked by.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS.description: The single condition that bound the link at each sample.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description required when a LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS entry is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of the whole set. Required: an unattributed budget is not
publishable.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

ACM_MARGIN_DB.description: Margin above the selected entry's threshold, dB.

ENERGY_PER_SYMBOL_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Symbol energy to noise spectral density, dB.

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"compact"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM
(raw-ed25519 for ed25519, compact for secp256k1)

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

KEY_PATH.description: BIP-44 derivation path (e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0")

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description: Signature encoding format (e.g., "compact", "raw-ed25519")

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —
the EPM-record mirror of the DNS TXT wire form (which is deliberately
NON-SDS: a base64 FlatBuffer would not fit a 255-byte TXT record). The
canonical statement is 6 fixed LF-terminated lines prefixed
"sdn-domain-proof/1", and it verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim
SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof precedent) — never by JCS.

DOMAIN.description: Fully-qualified domain name the proof binds (e.g., "node.example.org")

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of the proving key. The signer is the
Ed25519 EPM/publication key at m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed, verbatim (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format. ABSENT means the canonical encoding of
ALGORITHM (raw-ed25519 for ed25519)

GIVEN_NAME.description: Given name or first name of the person

ADDITIONAL_NAME.description: Additional name or middle name of the person

KEYS.description: Cryptographic keys associated with the entity

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Multiformat addresses associated with the entity

SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the EPM was signed

CHAIN_PROOFS.description: Chain binding proofs linking blockchain keys to the same HD wallet

ENTITY_TYPE.description: Type of entity represented by this profile

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm that produced SIGNATURE (e.g., "ed25519",
"secp256k1"). ABSENT means ed25519 — this single default is what keeps
every EPM signed before this field existed verifying unchanged, so the
field MUST NOT be made required. The signing key is the first CryptoKey
in KEYS with KEY_TYPE Signing whose ALGORITHM matches this declaration
(an absent CryptoKey.ALGORITHM likewise means ed25519)

DOMAIN_PROOFS.description:
DNS domain binding proofs linking domains to the same HD wallet —
symmetric with CHAIN_PROOFS

only and is never the machine key.

Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the

RANGE.description: Line of sight range in km. Reported value should include all applicable corrections.

RANGE_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight range, in km.

RANGE_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight range bias in km.

RANGE_RATE.description: Range rate in km/s. Reported value should include all applicable corrections.

RANGE_RATE_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight range rate, in km/sec.

RA.description: Right ascension in degrees. Required metric reporting field for EO observations.

RA_RATE.description: Line of sight right ascension rate of change, in degrees/sec.

RA_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight right ascension angle, in degrees.

RA_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight right ascension bias in degrees.

DECLINATION.description: Declination in degrees. Required metric reporting field for EO observations.

DECLINATION_RATE.description: Line of sight declination rate of change, in degrees/sec.

DECLINATION_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight declination angle, in degrees.

DECLINATION_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight declination angle bias in degrees.

LOSX.description: X-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOSY.description: Y-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOSZ.description: Z-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOS_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line-of-sight direction vector components.

LOSXVEL.description: X-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

LOSYVEL.description: Y-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

LOSZVEL.description: Z-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

SENLAT.description: WGS-84 latitude in decimal degrees at the time of the observation.

SENLON.description: WGS-84 longitude in decimal degrees at the time of the observation.

SENALT.description: Sensor height in km relative to the WGS-84 ellipsoid at the time of the observation.

SENX.description: Cartesian X position in km at the time of the observation.

SENY.description: Cartesian Y position in km at the time of the observation.

SENZ.description: Cartesian Z position in km at the time of the observation.

FOV_COUNT.description: Total number of satellites in the field of view.

FOV_COUNT_UCTS.description: Number of uncorrelated satellites in the field of view (JCO).

EXP_DURATION.description:
Image exposure duration in seconds. For observations performed using frame stacking or synthetic tracking methods,
the exposure duration should be the total integration time. This field is highly recommended / required if the
observations are going to be used for photometric processing.

NET_OBJ_SIG_UNC.description: Net object signature uncertainty = counts uncertainty / EXP_DURATION.

MAG.description: Measure of observed brightness calibrated against the Gaia G-band.

GEOLAT.description:
Computed estimate of the latitude, positive degrees north. It should be computed based on the assumed slant range
and corresponding viewing geometry. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEOLON.description:
Computed estimate of the longitude as +/- 180 degrees east. It should be computed based on the assumed slant range
and viewing geometry. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEOALT.description: Computed estimate of satellite altitude in km at the reported location. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEORANGE.description: Computed estimate of the slant range in km. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

SKY_BKGRND.description:
Average Sky Background signal, in Magnitudes. Sky Background refers to the incoming light from an apparently
empty part of the night sky.

PRIMARY_EXTINCTION.description:
Primary Extinction Coefficient, in Magnitudes. Primary Extinction is the coefficient applied to the airmass
to determine how much the observed visual magnitude has been attenuated by the atmosphere. Extinction, in general,
describes the absorption and scattering of electromagnetic radiation by dust and gas between an emitting astronomical
object and the observer.

PRIMARY_EXTINCTION_UNC.description: Primary Extinction Coefficient Uncertainty, in Magnitudes.

SOLAR_PHASE_ANGLE.description:
The angle, in degrees, between the target-to-observer vector and the target-to-sun vector. Recommend using the
calculation listed in the EOSSA documentation, pg 106 of the EOSSA spec.

SOLAR_EQ_PHASE_ANGLE.description:
The angle, in degrees, between the projections of the target-to-observer vector and the target-to-sun vector
onto the equatorial plane. The convention used is negative when closing (i.e., before the opposition)
and positive when opening (after the opposition).

SOLAR_DEC_ANGLE.description: Angle from the sun to the equatorial plane.

RAW_FILE_URI.description: Optional URI location in the document repository of the raw file parsed by the system to produce this record.

INTENSITY.description: Intensity of the target for IR observations, in kw/sr/em.

BG_INTENSITY.description: Background intensity for IR observations, in kw/sr/um.

DESCRIPTOR.description: Optional source-provided and searchable metadata or descriptor of the data.

ORIGIN.description:
Originating system or organization which produced the data, if different from the source.
The origin may be different than the source if the source was a mediating system which forwarded
the data on behalf of the origin system. If null, the source may be assumed to be the origin.

DATA_MODE.description: Indicator of whether the data is EXERCISE, REAL, SIMULATED, or TEST.

CREATED_AT.description: Time the row was created in the database, auto-populated by the system.

CREATED_BY.description: Application user who created the row in the database, auto-populated by the system.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: EO observations are assumed to be topocentric J2000 coordinates ('J2000') as defined by the IAU, unless otherwise specified.

SEN_REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
The sensor reference frame is assumed to be the International Terrestrial Reference Frame (ITRF),
unless otherwise specified. (ITRF is equivalent to Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed (ECEF) for this purpose).
Lat / long / height values should be reported using the WGS-84 ellipsoid, where applicable.

UMBRA.description: Boolean indicating that the target object was in umbral eclipse at the time of this observation.

PENUMBRA.description:
Boolean indicating that the target object was in a penumbral eclipse at the time of this observation.
This field is highly recommended if the observations will be used for photometric processing.

ORIG_NETWORK.description: The originating source network on which this record was created, auto-populated by the system.

SOURCE_DL.description: The source from which this record was received.

AZIMUTH_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if azimuth is reported.

ELEVATION_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if elevation is reported.

RANGE_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if range is reported.

RANGERATE_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if range-rate is reported.

RA_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if right ascension is reported.

DECLINATION_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if declination is reported.

NIIRS.description: National Imagery Interpretability Rating Scale (NIIRS). Ranging from 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest).

METERS_PER_PIXEL.description: Ground sample distance in meters per pixel.

IMAGE_SNR.description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the image. Higher values indicate cleaner imagery.

IMAGE_WIDTH.description: Width of the image in pixels.

IMAGE_HEIGHT.description: Height of the image in pixels.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION.description: Compression type used for the image, e.g., "JPEG", "PNG", "RAW", etc.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION_RATIO.description: Compression ratio used (original size / compressed size), if applicable.

PROCESSED_IMAGE_URI.description: URI to the processed image used for this observation.

IMAGE_AUTO_ENHANCED.description: Flag indicating whether the image was auto-enhanced (e.g., contrast stretch, denoise).

MULTI_FRAME_STACKED.description: True if the observation was taken with multiple frames stacked into one image.

SYNTHETIC_TRACKING_USED.description: True if synthetic tracking was used to create the image.

IMAGE_SHARPNESS.description: Sharpness metric of the image based on the Tenengrad method or variance of Laplacian. Higher values indicate sharper images.

IMAGE_NOISE_STDDEV.description: Noise level of the image, estimated via pixel intensity variance in background regions.

IMAGE_CONTRAST.description: Contrast metric of the image, such as Michelson contrast or RMS contrast.

IMAGE_DYNAMIC_RANGE.description: Dynamic range of the image (max pixel value / min pixel value), indicating tonal spread.

IMAGE_ENTROPY.description: Entropy of the image, representing the richness of information content. Higher entropy suggests higher texture detail.

BACKGROUND_UNIFORMITY.description: Background uniformity metric (e.g., mean gradient in background areas). Lower values indicate more uniform background.

BACKGROUND_MEAN_LEVEL.description: Mean background level, computed from non-object regions in pixel units.

SATURATED_PIXEL_PERCENT.description: Percentage of saturated pixels in the image. Indicates overexposure when high.

DEAD_PIXEL_PERCENT.description: Percentage of dead or zero-value pixels in the image. Indicates sensor defects or underexposure.

PSF_FWHM.description: Estimated Point Spread Function (PSF) Full Width at Half Maximum (FWHM) in pixels. Indicates image blur or focus.

CLOUD_COVER_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of cloud cover in the image. Derived using cloud detection algorithms such as Fmask or machine learning classifiers.

CLOUD_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence score of the cloud detection result, from 0 (low confidence) to 1 (high confidence).

HAZE_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of the image obscured by haze or atmospheric scattering effects.

AEROSOL_OPTICAL_THICKNESS.description: Estimated aerosol optical thickness (AOT) at 550 nm, indicating particulate matter in the atmosphere affecting image clarity.

WATER_VAPOR_CONTENT.description: Estimated water vapor content (e.g., total column precipitable water) at the time of imaging, in mm.

SUN_ELEVATION.description: Sun elevation angle at the time of image capture, in degrees above the horizon.

SUN_AZIMUTH.description: Sun azimuth angle at the time of image capture, in degrees from true north.

VIEW_ZENITH_ANGLE.description: View zenith angle (sensor line-of-sight angle from nadir), in degrees.

VIEW_AZIMUTH_ANGLE.description: View azimuth angle (direction of sensor relative to north), in degrees.

OFF_NADIR_ANGLE.description: Off-nadir angle of the sensor at the time of image capture, in degrees.

SWATH_WIDTH_KM.description: Ground coverage width of the image swath in kilometers.

MEAN_TERRAIN_ELEVATION.description: Mean terrain elevation in the image footprint, in meters above sea level.

TERRAIN_ELEVATION_STDDEV.description: Standard deviation of terrain elevation in the image footprint, in meters.

SHADOW_COVER_PERCENT.description: Percentage of the image affected by shadows, derived via topographic or object shadow detection.

SUNGLINT_PRESENT.description: Flag indicating whether sunglint is present in the image (true if high reflectance from water surface due to sun geometry).

SUNGLINT_PERCENT.description: Percentage of image affected by sunglint.

SNOW_ICE_COVER_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of snow or ice coverage in the image footprint.

VALID_DATA_AREA_KM2.description: Total area covered by valid data (non-masked, usable imagery) in square kilometers.

RCS.description: Radar cross-section (dBsm)
