OD_BATCH_BASELINE_RMS.description:
Post-fit residual RMS of the batch baseline, for direct batch-vs-filter
comparison.

TRAJ_TYPE.description:
Trajectory state representation type.
Determines how orbit state data is parameterized in this message.
For CARTESIAN_PV/CARTESIAN_PVA, use STATE_DATA array.
For POLYNOMIAL_POS/POLYNOMIAL_OE, use the corresponding polynomial record arrays.

TRAJ_TYPE_DESCRIPTION.description:
Legacy trajectory type string for backward compatibility and extended types
(e.g., "PROPAGATED", "ESTIMATED", "FILTERED").

STATE_STEP_SIZE.description: Time interval between state vectors in seconds (required for time-series data).

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)

STATE_DATA.description:
State data as row-major array of doubles.
Layout: [X0, Y0, Z0, X_DOT0, Y_DOT0, Z_DOT0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]
Time reconstruction: epoch[i] = METADATA.START_TIME + (i * STATE_STEP_SIZE)
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

COVARIANCE_DATA.description:
Covariance data as flat array (21 elements per epoch for 6x6 lower triangular).
Time alignment matches STATE_DATA epochs.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial position records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_POS. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for X, Y, Z position (and optionally velocity).
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial orbital element records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_OE. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES.description: Physical properties of the space object.

ACWStateSample.description: Target Cartesian state sample in an Earth-fixed frame.

JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Sample epoch as Julian Date in TT.

AZIMUTH_RAD.description: Azimuth, radians in the TopocentricFrame convention.

ELEVATION_RAD.description: Minimum visible elevation at the azimuth, radians.

ACWRefractionModel.description: Atmospheric refraction model for apparent-elevation access checks.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Interval start as Julian Date in TT.

END_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Interval end as Julian Date in TT.

ACWGroundStation.description: Ground-station geodetic definition and scheduling constraints.

ALTITUDE_M.description: Height above the WGS-84 ellipsoid, meters.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY.description: Number of simultaneous contacts this station can schedule.

TARGET_STATION_ID.description: Optional target station id. Empty means all stations when supported.

MIN_ELEVATION_OVERRIDE_RAD.description: Optional caller override for minimum elevation, radians.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace/correlation identifier.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Access start as Julian Date in TT.

END_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Access end as Julian Date in TT.

MAX_ELEVATION_RAD.description: Maximum elevation sampled or interpolated during the pass, radians.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description: Number of visible input samples contributing to the window.

ACWResult.description: Result for one access-window compute request.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

PNLPanel.description:
One flat panel of a macro model.

The reflection coefficients describe how incident radiation is disposed of:
SPECULAR_REFLECTIVITY + DIFFUSE_REFLECTIVITY + ABSORPTIVITY should sum to
1 for a physically consistent panel. Producers SHOULD state the source of
the optical properties in the parent record's SOURCE field; a panel model
whose coefficients have no provenance is worse than none.

PANEL_ID.description: Stable panel identifier within the model.

NORMAL_X.description: Outward panel normal in the body frame, unit vector.

SPECULAR_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected specularly.

EMISSIVITY.description: Infrared emissivity of the panel surface.

INSTANTANEOUS_RERADIATION.description:
True when absorbed energy is re-radiated instantaneously (no thermal
lag). False means the consumer must model thermal inertia.

DRAG_COEFFICIENT.description: Panel drag coefficient, when the model is used for aerodynamic forces.

MATERIAL_NAME.description: Material name, for traceability back to a materials table.

PNL.description:
Panelled (box-wing) Spacecraft Macro Model — the surface geometry and
optical properties needed to compute non-conservative forces (solar
radiation pressure, atmospheric drag, thermal re-radiation) on one object.

This is deliberately NOT $VAM, $BUS or $PHY. $VAM ranks visual assets for
rendering and a render mesh is not a force model; $BUS/$OOD are descriptive
inventory; $PHY is simulation configuration (integration method, force-type
toggles). None of them carries per-panel area, normal, and optical
coefficients.

OBJECT_ID.description: Object this macro model describes.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Satellite catalog number, when the object is catalogued.

BODY_FRAME.description: Body-fixed frame the panel normals are expressed in, e.g. "SC_BODY".

TOTAL_MASS_KG.description: Total spacecraft mass the model corresponds to, kilograms.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the model is valid at, ISO 8601. Mass and panel configuration
change over a mission; a macro model without an epoch is ambiguous.

REFERENCE_AREA_M2.description:
Reference cross-sectional area used by a consumer that falls back to a
cannonball model, square metres.

SOURCE.description: Provenance of the geometry and the optical coefficients.

FSOTableBinding.description:
One canonical SDS file-identifier to FlatSQL table binding. A configured
node rebuilds these bindings before replaying durable record bytes.

FSO.description:
FlatSQL Operation — generic control, policy, and status record for the
independently packaged FlatSQL WASM node.

Bulk records, query results, snapshots, and WAL chunks travel separately as
FSB frames so operations remain streamable and no host needs to interpret a
database payload. SCHEMA_IDL is canonical SDS/FlatBuffers IDL supplied to
the node for schema-derived table/index construction.

SCHEMA_IDL.description:
UTF-8 FlatBuffers IDL bytes. A byte vector is used because the aligned
compiler intentionally limits fixed inline strings to 255 bytes.

VAMScale3.description: Scale with identity defaults for every component.

VAMTransform.description: Transform from source coordinates into canonical meters. Absent SCALE and omitted scale components mean identity scale; translation and bounds use VAMVector3 zero defaults.

VAMAnnotation.description: Coordinate pin or general structured annotation in canonical model-meter coordinates. POSITION is absent for a general note.

VAMSource.description: Provenance and license metadata for an asset source.

OBSERVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the source was observed.

SOURCE_METADATA_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON source-metadata bytes.

VAMMetrics.description: Geometry, material, texture, and bounds measurements.

VAMValidation.description: Validation result for one asset variant.

VALIDATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when validation completed.

VAMQualityDimension.description: One named quality score and its basis.

VAMVariant.description: One source, optimized, LOD, or alternate visual representation.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: IANA media type of the exact variant bytes.

BYTE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact variant file bytes.

CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact variant file bytes.

GLTF_VERSION.description: MAJOR.MINOR glTF specification version, such as 2.0.

CONVERSION_VERSION.description: CONVERSION_VERSION is the exact version identifier reported by CONVERSION_TOOL without normalization.

INPUT_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact conversion input bytes.

RANK.description: Priority within the VAM; zero is highest priority and ranks must be unique within a VAM.

VAMApprovedAlternate.description: Exact approved alternate asset bytes and reviewed state.

CID.description: Nonempty CIDv1 identifying the exact approved alternate bytes.

BYTE_SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the exact approved alternate bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

VAMReview.description:
Signed binary-backed review decision over a specific candidate. This table exists only for a submitted decision; DECISION NONE and APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY are not accepted VAMReview evidence.
The review-envelope projection contains these uppercase schema field names in schema declaration order: REVIEWER_ID; CAPABILITY_ID when present; DECISION encoded as its unsigned enum integer; CANDIDATE_ID; CANDIDATE_CID when present; CANDIDATE_SHA256; DECIDED_AT; REASONS; COMMENT when present; SIGNATURE_TYPE; PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256 when present; REVIEWER_ROLE encoded as its unsigned enum integer; REPOSITORY; ISSUE_NUMBER; ENTITY_ID; VAM_ID; NONCE; REVIEWED_TRANSFORM when present; CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID when present; ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS; ANNOTATIONS; and APPROVED_ALTERNATES.
Projection order is descriptive; RFC 8785 sorts object keys during canonicalization.
Absent optional fields are omitted and arrays preserve order; nested VAMTransform and VAMAnnotation use uppercase schema field names and numeric enums. Nested VAMApprovedAlternate uses uppercase schema field names, numeric RANK, and transforms normalized by decoding schema defaults. A verifier reconstructs exactly this projection, applies RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), hashes the UTF-8 serialization bytes, compares the digest, then verifies SIGNATURE over the raw 32-byte digest.
Before trusting DECISION, a verifier must enforce binary decision invariants; repository, issue, entity, and VAM equality; nonce single use; role authorization; and exact candidate binding. CAPABILITY_ID, REPOSITORY, ISSUE_NUMBER, ENTITY_ID, VAM_ID, and NONCE MUST be present and nonempty for any new binary-backed signed decision and are required by the binary validation profile; their wire slots are optional only for backward compatibility.
Legacy buffers lacking those six fields remain decodable but are not valid new publication approvals. For these compatibility fields, the projection omits absent optionals only when decoding legacy records; the new validation profile rejects absence before signature trust. APPROVE requires CANDIDATE_CID; every binary decision requires exact CANDIDATE_SHA256.
Under the validation profile, when DECISION is APPROVE, CANDIDATE_CID MUST be present; REVIEWED_TRANSFORM and CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST be present; and CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST equal CANDIDATE_ID. These fields remain optional on the wire for compatibility.
The enclosing VAM.ID MUST equal VAM_ID; the enclosing VAM.ENTITY_ID MUST equal review ENTITY_ID; and the enclosing VAM.CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST equal review CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID.
The referenced VAMVariant.ID MUST equal CANDIDATE_ID; that variant CID and BYTE_SHA256 MUST equal signed CANDIDATE_CID and CANDIDATE_SHA256; and its TRANSFORM MUST be field-for-field equal to REVIEWED_TRANSFORM after decoding schema defaults.
The enclosing VAM.ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS MUST exactly equal signed review ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS, with the same IDs in the same order; empty equals empty.
Each alternate ID MUST resolve to an existing VAMVariant; alternate IDs MUST be distinct and MUST NOT equal CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID. The referenced alternates retain their signed canonical rank ordering as represented by the manifest list.
APPROVED_ALTERNATES MUST correspond one-for-one with ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS in the same order; each descriptor VARIANT_ID MUST equal the corresponding alternate ID. Empty ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS requires empty APPROVED_ALTERNATES.
Each descriptor CID, BYTE_SHA256, REVIEWED_TRANSFORM, and RANK MUST be field-for-field equal to the resolved VAMVariant. BYTE_SHA256 MUST be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and CID MUST be nonempty.
The publication validator rejects any omission or mismatch before signature trust or publication. Any alternate byte, CID, BYTE_SHA256, transform, or rank change requires a new signed review and envelope.

CANDIDATE_CID.description: Optional CIDv1 containing a multihash of exact candidate bytes; metadata-only candidates may not have a CID.

CANDIDATE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of exact candidate bytes, required for every binary-backed decision.

DECIDED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the decision was made.

ENVELOPE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS serialization of the projected review object, excluding ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the raw 32-byte SHA-256 digest represented by ENVELOPE_SHA256.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description: Signature algorithm and profile; initially Ed25519.

PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the prior projected review object's RFC 8785 JCS serialization, excluding its ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE.

REPOSITORY.description: Canonical repository identifier in owner/name form.

ISSUE_NUMBER.description: Positive base-10 issue number digits with no leading zero.

NONCE.description: Unique opaque identifier containing at least 128 bits of entropy.

VAMMetadataOnlyReview.description:
Signed metadata-only review. DECISION validation MUST equal APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY; no candidate binary or CID fields exist.
The metadata-review signed projection contains uppercase schema field names in schema declaration order: REVIEWER_ID; CAPABILITY_ID; REVIEWER_ROLE encoded as its unsigned enum integer; REPOSITORY; ISSUE_NUMBER; ENTITY_ID; VAM_ID; NONCE; DECISION encoded as its unsigned enum integer; CANDIDATE_ID; CANDIDATE_METADATA_SHA256; DECIDED_AT; REASONS; COMMENT when present; ANNOTATIONS; SIGNATURE_TYPE; and PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256 when present.
Absent optional fields are omitted and arrays preserve order. A verifier reconstructs exactly this projection, applies RFC 8785 JCS, hashes the UTF-8 serialization bytes, compares ENVELOPE_SHA256, and verifies SIGNATURE over the raw 32-byte digest. ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE are excluded from the projection.
The verifier must also enforce repository, issue, entity, and VAM equality; nonce single use; role authorization; exact metadata binding; and DECISION equal to APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY before trusting the decision.

CANDIDATE_METADATA_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON VAMSource projection using uppercase field names.
The VAMSource projection always includes SOURCE_RECORD_ID and SOURCE_URL; includes SOURCE_NAME, OBSERVED_AT, LICENSE_NAME, ATTRIBUTION, SOURCE_METADATA_SHA256, and NOTES only when present; and always includes LICENSE_CLASS, REDISTRIBUTION_PERMISSION, and DERIVATIVE_PERMISSION as unsigned enum integers. It contains no other fields.
A verifier reconstructs this projection from the candidate SOURCE and compares the digest before trusting DECISION.

VAM.description: Visual Asset Manifest — ranked visual representations for one stable entity.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 manifest-format version, not a content revision.

CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID.description: Identifies the approved canonical variant; alternate variants preserve their ranks.

VARIANTS.description: MUST be sorted ascending RANK. Ranks must be unique; tie-break bytewise ID only for invalid or legacy duplicate ranks.

CREATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the manifest was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the manifest was last updated.

SUPERSEDES_VAM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact superseded VAM bytes.

DPM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact referenced DPM bytes.

METADATA_REVIEW.description: Mutually exclusive with REVIEW; metadata-only decisions use METADATA_REVIEW.

DPMCompletenessIndex.description: Completeness-capable signed index over a dataset update.

INDEX_NAME.description:
Stable index name, e.g. file_id, norad_cat_id, epoch, source_batch. Every
completeness-verifiable dataset update SHOULD include a file_id index so
subscribers can prove that all returned records belong to the announced
FILE_ID partition. The file_id index is the preferred completeness anchor
for provider-mediated data that is not published as a discoverable file.

CANONICAL_ORDER.description:
Deterministic ordering expression for the index. Providers and
subscribers MUST use this ordering when building or verifying range
proofs. A query is completeness-verifiable only when its predicate can be
expressed against one or more declared indexes.

INDEX_ROOT.description:
SHA-256 or Merkle root of the ordered index, lowercase hex. This root is
signed by the DPM provider signature and is the verifier's commitment for
inclusion and range-completeness proofs. To verify a provider-mediated
response, the subscriber recomputes each returned leaf, walks the supplied
sibling hashes using MERKLE_PROFILE, confirms the root equals INDEX_ROOT,
confirms the leaf material includes the DPM.FILE_ID partition when this is
the file_id index, and confirms any range-boundary proofs required by
CANONICAL_ORDER.

MERKLE_PROFILE.description:
Hash profile for leaves and internal nodes, e.g.
SDN-MERKLE-SHA256-v1. Profiles define domain separators, leaf material,
pair ordering, duplicate handling, and odd-leaf promotion.

SUPPORTS_RANGE_COMPLETENESS.description:
Whether this index can prove that no matching records were omitted for a
supported range query. Inclusion proofs alone prove authenticity, not
completeness.

DPMAsset.description:
One immutable asset or provider-mediated query contract published for a
dataset update.

TRANSPORT_KIND.description:
Transport profile for this asset. CONTENT_ADDRESS assets use CID and
MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS. SDN_QUERY assets use TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL plus the
signed DPM query and root fields; they are not required to be published as
discoverable IPFS files.

CID.description:
Optional IPFS CIDv1/multihash content identifier. This field is required
for CONTENT_ADDRESS assets and SHOULD be empty for SDN_QUERY assets whose
bytes are retrieved through a provider protocol.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description:
Multiformat address. For CONTENT_ADDRESS this is usually /ipfs/{CID}. For
SDN_QUERY this MAY be a provider peer multiaddr, relay hint, or empty when
provider routing is resolved from the DPM provider identity.

FILE_NAME.description: File name or logical artifact name.

FILE_ID.description:
Canonical publication/update partition identity for this asset. FILE_ID is
not a display filename; it is the stable identifier used everywhere this
update is referenced: PNMs, DPMs, assets, manifests, entitlements, query
requests, subscriber caches, replay, audit, and completeness proofs.
Example:
provider-slug:gp:OMM.fbs:2026-05-06T03:00:00Z.

TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL.description:
Provider protocol name/version used to fetch this asset when
TRANSPORT_KIND is SDN_QUERY, e.g. /sdn/dataset-query/1.0.0. The protocol
response MUST be verifiable against DATA_ROOT, INDEXES, QUERY, and the
provider signature in this DPM.

BYTE_LENGTH.description: Byte length of the published object.

BYTE_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the exact published bytes, lowercase hex.

DATA_ROOT.description:
Merkle root over canonical records in this asset, lowercase hex. For
provider-mediated query delivery, subscribers verify returned records and
proof paths against this root before importing data. The proof material is
carried by the provider query response, not by the DPM itself; this field
is the signed root that makes those proofs meaningful.

SCHEMA_NAME.description: SDS schema name for data artifacts, e.g. OMM.fbs, CAT.fbs, SPW.fbs.

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Hash of the SDS schema used to encode this object.

CONTENT_KEY_ID.description: Optional content-key identifier for encrypted artifacts.

DPMSourceBatch.description: Source batch metadata bound into the dataset publication.

SOURCE_URL.description: Original source URL.

SOURCE_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of raw source bytes, lowercase hex.

HTTP_LAST_MODIFIED.description: HTTP Last-Modified value observed during retrieval.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Retrieval timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC.

RECORD_COUNT.description: Number of normalized records emitted from this source.

WARNINGS.description: Warnings or policy notes produced during normalization.

LICENSE.description:
SPDX license identifier governing the source data, e.g. CC-BY-4.0 or
CC-BY-SA-4.0. Machine-readable license provenance is REQUIRED before any
record derived from this batch may be republished; share-alike terms
propagate from this batch to every derived record.

LICENSE_URL.description: Canonical URL of the license text.

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires downstream
republication to carry.

DPMQueryBinding.description: Canonical query metadata that can replay the dataset selection.

CANONICAL_QUERY.description: Canonical query text or canonical JSON representation.

QUERY_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of CANONICAL_QUERY, lowercase hex.

RESULT_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the ordered result bytes, lowercase hex.

QUERY_ENGINE.description: Query engine or profile name, e.g. FlatSQL.

QUERY_ENGINE_VERSION.description: Query engine version or profile version.

CANONICAL_ORDER.description:
Canonical ordering of result records before RESULT_SHA256 or DATA_ROOT is
computed. Providers MUST stream records in this order unless each chunk
includes enough proof material to restore and verify the canonical order.

QUERY_PROTOCOL.description:
Query protocol name/version for provider-mediated retrieval, e.g.
/sdn/dataset-query/1.0.0. A subscriber verifies the PNM and DPM, opens this
protocol to the provider, submits the signed query or a permitted subset,
and imports only responses that verify against the signed roots. Responses
MUST include enough Merkle proof material for each returned record and, for
completeness-verifiable range queries, the declared range-boundary proofs.

SCHEMA_NAMES.description: SDS schema names selected by the query.

PROVIDER_IDS.description: Provider peer IDs selected by the query.

SOURCE_NAMES.description: Source names selected by the query.

BATCH_IDS.description: Batch IDs selected by the query.

WINDOW_START.description: Inclusive query window start in ISO 8601 UTC.

WINDOW_END.description: Inclusive query window end in ISO 8601 UTC.

DPMEncryptionBinding.description: Encryption metadata for protected dataset artifacts.

ENCRYPTED.description: Whether any artifact in this manifest is encrypted.

POLICY_ID.description: Policy or listing identifier bound as AAD.

AAD_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of canonical encryption AAD, lowercase hex.

DPM.description:
Immutable signed publication contract for one dataset update. DPM records
are the authoritative product manifests consumed by subscribers, pinning
nodes, archive nodes, and query gateways. A valid DPM answers: who published
this update, which dataset and FILE_ID it represents, which source batches
produced it, which exact bytes or provider-mediated query responses are
authorized, how those bytes are addressed, how records and indexes are
hashed, whether content-key metadata applies, and which provider signature
commits to the manifest. PNM announces the current DPM; DPM defines what
must be fetched, verified, imported, pinned, or archived.

DATASET_ID.description: Stable dataset identifier.

FILE_ID.description:
Canonical publication/update partition identity. FILE_ID is the key used
everywhere a subscriber, provider, PNM, asset, entitlement, cache, audit
log, or query protocol refers to this exact update. It is not merely a
human filename and it is not the FlatBuffer file_identifier. For
completeness-verifiable streams, all returned records MUST belong to this
FILE_ID and prove inclusion under this DPM's signed roots, normally through
a declared file_id completeness index. Use this field for all update
addressing instead of inventing per-protocol IDs; provider responses,
Merkle leaves, proof paths, PNM.FILE_ID, and DPMAsset.FILE_ID must all bind
to the same value.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Provider peer ID.

ASSETS.description: Published shard, index, and auxiliary artifacts.

SOURCES.description: Source batches used to build the dataset.

INDEXES.description:
Signed completeness-capable indexes. Inclusion proofs prove that returned
records are authentic members of DATA_ROOT. Range-completeness proofs also
prove that no matching records were omitted, but only for predicates
expressible against these declared indexes.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the canonical manifest bytes or manifest digest.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation name

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for this instant.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: Optional TAI-UTC override in seconds for the source instant.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional caller trace/correlation identifier.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

RFLObstruction.description:
One obstacle interaction on one sample's path. SPARSE: entries exist only
where an interaction was computed, so a clear path is never encoded as a
row of zeroes.

This is the join that makes an arbitrary 3D object a first-class part of
the link budget: MATERIAL_ID names the `$RFS` record whose permittivity,
conductivity, penetration loss and roughness produced LOSS_DB, and
GEOMETRY_REF_ID names the exact mesh, face set, panel or analytic shape
inside it that was hit.

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this interaction applies to.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface that was hit. An obstruction loss with
no material is an unattributed number: a metal panel and a plasterboard
wall of the same size do entirely different things to a link.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh, when the obstacle is a
reviewed 3D asset.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the obstacle is a catalogued object (an
occulting spacecraft, a structure on another vehicle). 0 when unbound.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle between the incident ray and the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

PATH_LENGTH_IN_MATERIAL_M.description:
Path length travelled INSIDE the material, metres. With
`$RFS.ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M` this is what makes penetration loss
reproducible instead of a stated constant.

EXCESS_DELAY_S.description: Extra propagation delay of a reflected or scattered component, seconds.

FRESNEL_CLEARANCE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the first Fresnel zone still clear [0-1]. 1 means the zone is
untouched.

DISTANCE_FROM_TRANSMITTER_M.description: Distance from the transmitter to the interaction point, metres.

RFLEndpoint.description:
One endpoint of a link. Identity ONLY — position, antenna geometry and band
capability are NOT copied here; they are joined from the standard named by
ENDPOINT_KIND. A copied position silently goes stale against its source.

ENDPOINT_ID.description: Producer-stable identifier for this endpoint within the record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the endpoint is an on-orbit object. 0 when
unbound — never a placeholder catalogue number.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator, `$CAT.OBJECT_ID`.

RFB_ID.description:
`$RFB.ID` — the band specification (frequency, bandwidth, EIRP, gains,
polarization) this endpoint transmits or receives on.

RFE_ID.description: `$RFE.ID` — the parametric emitter description, when one exists.

IQC_ID.description: `$IQC` capture identifier, when the samples were derived from a recording.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel or carrier identifier within the beam.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization actually used on this link. Defaults to UNKNOWN explicitly:
`rfPolarization` ordinal 0 is LHCP, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as a real polarization.

RFLModCod.description:
One modulation-and-coding choice available to a link. The table carries
engineering capability only; catalogue or recommendation names belong in
ID / NAME and provenance data, never in the schema vocabulary.

MODCOD_ID.description: Stable identifier within the containing link's MODCOD_SET.

CODE_RATE.description: Information bits divided by coded bits, in (0,1].

REQUIRED_MARGIN_DB.description: Additional implementation margin required before this entry is selected.

MAXIMUM_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Optional ceiling imposed by framing or implementation, bits per second.

RFLLink.description: One link whose budget is sampled by this record.

LINK_ID.description:
Producer-stable link identifier. Joins `$ACI.ACIInterval.LINK_ID` and
`$LKS.ID` when the same link also has an operational-state record.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Carrier centre frequency actually used, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention, NOT the `$IQC` hertz convention. A consumer joining the two
converts explicitly at the join. Band designation is NOT duplicated here:
it is joined from `$RFB.BAND`.

MODULATION.description: Modulation as the producer states it (e.g. "QPSK", "8PSK", "16APSK").

CODING.description: Forward error correction scheme as the producer states it.

CODE_RATE.description: Code rate as a fraction (0-1].

SYMBOL_RATE_BAUD.description:
Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud — the `$RFB.BAUD`
convention.

DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Information bit rate the budget is stated for, bits per second.

THRESHOLD_TERM.description:
Required threshold this link is evaluated against. THRESHOLD_TERM,
THRESHOLD_VALUE, THRESHOLD_UNITS and THRESHOLD_COMPARISON are meaningful
only together; a LINK_MARGIN_DB column without them states a margin
against an unstated requirement and MUST be refused.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this link belongs to. Links sharing a RECEIVER_GROUP_ID
and CHANNEL_GROUP_ID are mutually interfering and MUST be evaluated
together; a producer that shards a link matrix MUST keep a group intact
within one shard.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation or network this link belongs to.

SERVICE.description: Operator-facing service or mission designation.

MODCOD_SET.description:
Ordered adaptive modulation-and-coding choices. Per-sample
SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX indexes this vector for the sample's selected link.

ACM_ENABLED.description: Whether the producer evaluated adaptive selection for this link.

RFLInterferenceContribution.description:
One interfering contribution to one sample. SPARSE: entries exist only
where a contribution was computed, so a dense matrix is never forced into
existence to say "no interference computed".

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this contribution applies to.

SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ID.description:
Endpoint identifier of the interfering emitter, when it is an endpoint of
this record.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` of the interfering emission.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Interfering object's catalogue number, 0 when unbound.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Received interfering power at the victim receiver, dBW.

TOPOCENTRIC_SEPARATION_DEG.description:
Angular separation between the wanted and interfering paths at the
victim receiver, degrees.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim's bandwidth overlapped by this emission [0-1].

POLARIZATION_ISOLATION_DB.description: Polarization isolation applied to this contribution, dB.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Discrimination applied from the victim antenna pattern, dB.

RFLModelParameter.description:
A named parameter of a model binding, with its unit stated. There is no
encoding for a parameter value without a unit.

TEXT_VALUE.description: Non-numeric parameter value, when the parameter is categorical.

RFLModelBinding.description:
Which model produced one term of the budget. A loss term without a model
binding is an unattributed number: rain attenuation from two different
recommendations differs by decibels, and a consumer must be able to tell
which one it is holding.

TERM.description: The budget term this binding produced.

MODEL_NAME.description:
Model or recommendation identifier as its publisher states it (e.g. an
ITU-R recommendation number with its revision).

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` of the module that evaluated it.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact artifact that produced the values.

RFLProvenance.description: Where this sample set came from, stated once for the record.

SOURCE.description:
The producing system, dataset or measurement campaign. Required: a
budget time series with no stated source is not publishable.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference that regenerates this set.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the propagator that produced the geometry columns. A record
whose METHOD is MODELED or HYBRID and which carries geometry columns MUST
name it: geometry is only as good as the propagator, and the propagator is
a pluggable choice, never an assumed default.

PROPAGATOR_CONFIGURATION.description: Force model or configuration identifier handed to the propagator.

SAMPLING_STEP_S.description: Uniform sampling step, seconds. Absent when SAMPLE_EPOCHS are irregular.

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description:
Weather or environment dataset the atmospheric terms were evaluated
against, when they were not evaluated against a statistical model.

TERRAIN_DATASET.description: Terrain or surface dataset the blockage terms were evaluated against.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this set was computed or recorded.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix ms the upstream inputs were retrieved.

LICENSE.description:
Licence the source imposes on redistribution. An empty LICENSE means
UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a grant to redistribute.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: True when the licence forbids commercial use of this set.

CITATION.description: Attribution the licence requires this record to carry downstream.

MODULE_ID.description:
Primary `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced this record.
MODELS remains the per-budget-term attribution surface.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact producing WASM artifact.

RFL_ID.description: Stable identifier of this sample set.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$ACI` and
`$CVP` products derived from this set.

LINKS.description: Link definitions. SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES index into this vector.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of samples. Every present metric array MUST have exactly this
many entries.

SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES.description: Index into LINKS for each sample.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description:
Sample epochs, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM. Samples
need not be uniformly spaced and need not be grouped by link, but MUST be
non-decreasing within each link.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale SAMPLE_EPOCHS are expressed in. Defaults to UTC explicitly:
`timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as sidereal time.

RANGE_RATE_M_S.description: Range rate, metres per second; positive is opening.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the receiving endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the receiving endpoint, degrees above the local horizon.

TRANSMIT_AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the transmitting endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

TRANSMIT_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the transmitting endpoint, degrees.

DOPPLER_SHIFT_HZ.description:
Doppler shift of the carrier, hertz; positive is closing. Hertz, not the
MHz used for frequencies elsewhere in this record — a shift of a few kHz
on a GHz carrier is destroyed by an MHz encoding.

EIRP_DBW.description: Effective isotropic radiated power toward the receiver, dBW.

TRANSMIT_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain in the direction of the receiver, dBi.

RECEIVE_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain in the direction of the transmitter, dBi.

GASEOUS_ABSORPTION_LOSS_DB.description: Gaseous (oxygen and water vapour) absorption, dB.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS_DB.description:
Total loss from 3D obstacles on the path, dB. The per-obstacle detail —
which object, which material, at what angle, through how much of it — is
in OBSTRUCTIONS.

TOTAL_PATH_LOSS_DB.description:
Total of all path terms actually applied, dB. Published as its own column
rather than left to the consumer to sum: a producer that applied a term
this schema has no column for MUST still report an honest total, and the
discrepancy against the itemised columns is then visible.

RECEIVED_POWER_DBW.description: Received carrier power at the receiver input, dBW.

GAIN_TO_NOISE_TEMPERATURE_DB_PER_K.description: Receiving system figure of merit G/T, dB/K.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_DB.description: Carrier-to-noise ratio C/N in the occupied bandwidth, dB.

ENERGY_PER_BIT_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Energy per bit to noise density Eb/N0, dB.

BIT_ERROR_RATE.description:
Bit error rate as a probability [0-1], NOT an exponent and NOT a
percentage. 1e-6 is encoded 1e-6.

LINK_MARGIN_DB.description:
Link margin against the link's stated threshold, dB. Meaningless without
RFLLink.THRESHOLD_TERM / THRESHOLD_VALUE / THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY_BPS.description: Achievable channel capacity, bits per second.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Aggregate received interfering power, dBW.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_PLUS_INTERFERENCE_DB.description: Carrier to noise-plus-interference ratio C/(N+I), dB.

OBSTRUCTIONS.description:
Per-interaction obstacle detail, sparse. Each entry names the `$RFS`
material it went through, reflected off or was blocked by.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS.description: The single condition that bound the link at each sample.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description required when a LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS entry is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of the whole set. Required: an unattributed budget is not
publishable.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over the size-prefixed
FlatBuffer projection with both 64-byte signature payloads zeroed while
preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over canonical JSON with IDL
field order, IDL capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both
signature fields omitted.

SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX.description:
Index into the selected link's RFLLink.MODCOD_SET for each sample.
SELECTED_MODCOD_VALID distinguishes index 0 from no selection.

SPECTRAL_EFFICIENCY_BPS_HZ.description: Spectral efficiency delivered by the selected entry, bit/s/Hz.

ACHIEVED_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Delivered information rate after adaptive selection, bits per second.

ACM_MARGIN_DB.description: Margin above the selected entry's threshold, dB.

ENERGY_PER_SYMBOL_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Symbol energy to noise spectral density, dB.

GELObservationRef.description: Trace from a solution row back to one `$DOA` observation or `$IQC` capture.

DOA_ID.description:
At least one of DOA_ID or IQC_ID is required. When both are present, the
`$DOA` observation must have been derived from the named `$IQC` capture.

GELConvergenceDiagnostics.description: Numerical convergence diagnostics for the fused estimator.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

QUANTITY.description: Number of thrusters of this type

PROPELLANT.description: Propellant type (e.g., HYDRAZINE, XENON, KRYPTON, MMH_NTO, N2, GN2)

RCS.description: Radar cross-section (dBsm)

PGMMetadataEntry.description: String metadata key/value attached to a peer group.

DEFAULT_TRUST_LEVEL.description: Default trust level for peers in this group.

MEMBERS.description: libp2p peer IDs that belong to this group.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this group was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this group record was last updated.

METADATA.description: Additional group metadata as string key/value entries.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the group from the current registry.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the node/provider that issued this group record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the peer group record.

CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer
from inventing its own wording for the same code.

CODE.description: The ratified category code. This is the join key every consumer uses.

DISPLAY_NAME.description:
Canonical human-readable label, rendered verbatim. MUST equal the display
name stated in the CODE member's doc comment.

SUMMARY.description: One-sentence description shown on browse rows and category headers.

SLUG.description:
Route-safe identifier: the CODE identifier lowercased with `_` replaced by
`-`. Published explicitly rather than derived so every surface routes
identically.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer editorial description for a category landing page.

PARENT.description:
Parent category for hierarchical browse. UNSPECIFIED means this is a
top-level category. A category MUST NOT name itself as its parent.

SORT_ORDER.description:
Presentation order within its parent, ascending. Ties break on
DISPLAY_NAME.

KEYWORDS.description:
Search synonyms and alternate phrasings that resolve to this category.
Feeds type-ahead; never rendered as the category label.

ICON_KEY.description:
Key of a self-hosted icon or capsule asset for this category. A KEY, not a
URL: consuming node surfaces load zero external-origin bytes, so the
consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

CODE.description: Category being counted.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

GrantFieldStreamPolicy.description: Field-level stream policy bound into protected delivery and grants.

ProtectedDeliveryBinding.description: Immutable encrypted artifact/window metadata for protected delivery.

ProviderReputation.description: Provider reputation summary surfaced in marketplace listings.

OBJECT_IDS.description: Specific NORAD IDs or catalog numbers

MIN_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Minimum altitude in kilometers for altitude-bounded offerings

MAX_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Maximum altitude in kilometers for altitude-bounded offerings

GEO_BOUNDS.description: Bounding box as [min_lat, min_lon, max_lat, max_lon]

DataCoverage.description: Data coverage combining spatial and temporal

PRICE_AMOUNT.description: Price in smallest unit (cents, satoshis, etc.)

RATE_LIMIT.description: Rate limit in requests per hour

FEATURES.description: List of features included in this tier

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the data provider

PROVIDER_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of provider's EPM (Entity Profile Message)

DESCRIPTION.description: Detailed description of the data offering

ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED.description: Whether encryption is required for data delivery

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when listing was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when listing was last updated

ACTIVE.description: Whether the listing is currently active

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider

LISTING_KIND.description: Listing category: data stream or WASM module

SAMPLE_RECORD_COUNT.description: Number of records in sample data, when available

PROTECTED_DELIVERY.description: Protected delivery metadata for encrypted artifacts or streams

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the listing expires, or 0 for no expiry

LICENSE.description: License label or SPDX-style identifier

SOURCE_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID this listing was sourced from when discovered remotely

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified `$CCT` category this listing is shelved under, using the
same vocabulary and semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY and
APP.PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Before this field existed a listing carried no
capability category at all — only DATA_TYPES and TAGS — so a storefront
shelf and a library shelf were grouped by two unrelated systems. A
consumer MUST group listings by this field and MUST NOT re-derive a
category from DATA_TYPES, TAGS or TITLE, none of which are a controlled
vocabulary.

Distinct from LISTING_KIND, which is the delivery kind (data stream vs
module artifact), and from ACCESS_TYPE, which is the commercial access
model. UNSPECIFIED means the provider did not classify the listing; a
consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified `$CCT` category this listing belongs to, for browse,
filter and per-category counting. A listing MAY carry several. If
nonempty it MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.

RECOMMENDED_RETENTION.description:
Retention rule the publisher recommends to subscribers of a dataset
listing: ReplaceCurrent when each publication is a complete current set,
ArchiveAll when publications accumulate history.

ACL.description: Access Control Grant - Permission to access purchased data

LISTING_ID.description: ID of the listing this grant applies to

BUYER_ENCRYPTION_PUBKEY.description: Buyer's encryption public key for encrypted delivery

TIER_NAME.description: Name of the pricing tier purchased

GRANTED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when access was granted

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when access expires (0 = never expires)

PAYMENT_TX_HASH.description: Transaction hash or reference proving payment

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider

KEY_ALGORITHM.description: Key algorithm for buyer encryption public key

TOTAL_REQUESTS.description: Total requests made under this grant

TOTAL_RECORDS.description: Total records delivered under this grant

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the grant record was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the grant record was updated

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Provider peer ID

FIELD_STREAM_POLICY.description: Field-level stream policy bound to this grant

CELL_TYPE.description: Solar cell type (e.g., SILICON, GAAS, MULTI_JUNCTION, THIN_FILM, PEROVSKITE)

QUANTITY.description: Number of solar arrays of this type

AREA.description: Total array area in square meters

POWER_BOL.description: Beginning of life power output in Watts

POWER_EOL.description: End of life power output in Watts

DEGRADATION_RATE.description: Degradation rate per year as fraction

POS_UNC_FLAG.description: True if position uncertainty is flagged

PM_UNC_FLAG.description: True if proper motion uncertainty is flagged

MULT_FLAG.description: True if star is in a multiple system

NEIGHBOR_FLAG.description: True if nearest neighbor is within confusion radius

SHIFT_FLAG.description: True if position shift detected between catalogs

RBKVector3.description: Three-vector used for MRP, Gibbs, PRV, angular rate, and related attitude math values.

RBKQuaternion.description: Scalar-first Euler parameter/quaternion record, ordered (q0, q1, q2, q3).

RBKRigidBodyKinematicsRequest.description: Request for one rigid-body kinematics utility operation.

RBKRigidBodyKinematicsResult.description: Result for one rigid-body kinematics utility operation.

PNM.description:
Publish Notification Message.

PNM is the compact network announcement for a published record, manifest, or
dataset update. For dataset updates, FILE_ID is the complete canonical
identity for the published update and CID usually points to a small DPM
manifest or digest. The DPM carries the full verification contract:
provider identity, retrieval protocol, canonical query, result hash, Merkle
roots, completeness-capable indexes, file_id partition key, and signature.
Large or paid dataset updates do not need to be published as globally
discoverable IPFS files; a PNM may instead advertise a provider-mediated SDN
query protocol. In that mode the PNM is only the announcement. The DPM is
the signed commitment, and each provider response carries records plus
Merkle proof material that the subscriber verifies against the DPM roots and
the announced FILE_ID before import.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description:
Multiformat Address
As specified by the multiaddr specification.
A universal address format for representing multiple network protocols. Examples include:
- /ip4/192.168.1.1/tcp/80 for an IPv4 address with TCP protocol
- /ip6zone/x/ip6/::1 for an IPv6 address with a zone
- /dns4/example.com for a domain name resolvable only to IPv4 addresses
- /ipfs/bafybeiccfclkdtucu6y4yc5cpr6y3yuinr67svmii46v5cfcrkp47ihehy/README.txt -IPFS address w/CID and path to `README.txt`.

PUBLISH_TIMESTAMP.description: Publish Time OF THE Publish Notification Message

CID.description:
Concatenated Content Identifier (CID)
This field is a unique ID for distributed systems (CID).
The CID provides a unique identifier within distributed systems, as
detailed in the multiformats CID specification.
For dataset-update PNMs this SHOULD identify a compact DPM manifest,
manifest digest, or other small verification object, not necessarily the
full dataset bytes.

FILE_NAME.description:
File ID
This field is the Name

FILE_ID.description:
File ID
Canonical publication/update partition identity. For dataset-update PNMs,
this MUST match DPM.FILE_ID and is the stable key used everywhere an SDN
component refers to the update: PNMs, DPMs, assets, entitlements, provider
query requests, subscriber caches, replay, audit, and completeness
verification. Provider-mediated query requests and responses MUST bind
their Merkle leaves and proof paths to this FILE_ID, and subscribers MUST
reject responses whose DPM, records, or proofs bind to a different FILE_ID.
Example: provider-slug:gp:OMM.fbs:2026-05-06T03:00:00Z.

SIGNATURE.description:
Digital Signature of the CID
This is the digital signature of the CID, signed using the specified cryptographic method.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE.description:
Timestamp Signature
Digital signature of the publish timestamp, using the specified cryptographic method for timestamp verification.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used
Specifies the type of cryptographic signature used for the SIGNATURE field, indicating the specific blockchain technology, such as Ethereum or BTC.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used for Timestamp
Specifies the type of cryptographic signature used for the TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE field, indicating the specific blockchain technology, such as Ethereum or BTC.

DESCRIPTION.description: Description of why object is of interest

SplitRecipient.description:
Recipient of an on-chain revenue split. The identity binds to an `$EPM`
via CHAIN_PROOFS so a payout address is provably the recipient's.

EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the recipient's Entity Profile Message (`$EPM`)

ADDRESS.description: On-chain payout address (EVM 0x / SOL base58 / BTC address)

XPUB.description: Account xpub the address derives from

SCX.description:
Chain Settlement / Smart-Contract Descriptor. The forward description of the
exact established splitter contract/program a buyer's wallet targets so
payment and platform commission settle atomically on-chain. Referenced by
`$CMT.CONTRACTS` and echoed into a store `checkout` quote. Commission is
realized by the splitter contract itself when the buyer pays it; there is no
off-chain or manual settlement step.

SPLITTER_STANDARD.description:
Established split standard id, e.g. "0xsplits.v2" (ETH) or the SOL
splitter program name. An audited off-the-shelf standard, not a custom
contract.

SPLITTER_ADDRESS.description:
Deployed splitter contract address (ETH) or splitter program id (SOL) the
buyer's payment routes into

SPLIT_CONFIG_ID.description:
The specific split configuration (recipient set + basis points) registered
with the splitter

TOKEN_ADDRESS.description: ERC-20 / SPL mint address for stablecoin settlement; empty = native asset

SPLIT_RECIPIENTS.description:
The recipient set the split configuration encodes (platform + publisher…),
mirrored here for independent verification

MIN_CONFIRMATIONS.description: Confirmations required before the payment is accepted

MEMO_SCHEME.description: How the order reference is bound on-chain for replay-safe matching

RevenueSplit.description: One recipient's share of a sale, expressed in basis points.

BPS.description:
Share in basis points (1/100 of a percent); all splits plus the platform
commission sum to 10000

CMT.description:
Commission Terms / Revenue Split. Binds a listing, store, or publisher to a
platform commission and the on-chain split that enforces it. This record
makes "the platform earns on every transaction" auditable and portable
across store deployments. Commission is realized purely by the buyer's
payment routing through the on-chain splitter contract described in
CONTRACTS — never by a manual or off-chain settlement step.

TARGET_ID.description: The `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / store id / publisher xpub the terms apply to

SPLITS.description: Recipient splits; each in basis points, summing with the commission to 10000

PLATFORM_RECIPIENT.description: The platform's per-chain payout identity (the commission recipient)

ENFORCEMENT.description: How the split is enforced (on-chain splitter vs provider-attested)

CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer
from inventing its own wording for the same code.

CODE.description: The ratified category code. This is the join key every consumer uses.

DISPLAY_NAME.description:
Canonical human-readable label, rendered verbatim. MUST equal the display
name stated in the CODE member's doc comment.

SUMMARY.description: One-sentence description shown on browse rows and category headers.

SLUG.description:
Route-safe identifier: the CODE identifier lowercased with `_` replaced by
`-`. Published explicitly rather than derived so every surface routes
identically.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer editorial description for a category landing page.

PARENT.description:
Parent category for hierarchical browse. UNSPECIFIED means this is a
top-level category. A category MUST NOT name itself as its parent.

SORT_ORDER.description:
Presentation order within its parent, ascending. Ties break on
DISPLAY_NAME.

KEYWORDS.description:
Search synonyms and alternate phrasings that resolve to this category.
Feeds type-ahead; never rendered as the category label.

ICON_KEY.description:
Key of a self-hosted icon or capsule asset for this category. A KEY, not a
URL: consuming node surfaces load zero external-origin bytes, so the
consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

CODE.description: Category being counted.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified `$CCT` category this listing is shelved under, using the
same vocabulary and semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY and
APP.PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Before this field existed a listing carried no
capability category at all — only DATA_TYPES and TAGS — so a storefront
shelf and a library shelf were grouped by two unrelated systems. A
consumer MUST group listings by this field and MUST NOT re-derive a
category from DATA_TYPES, TAGS or TITLE, none of which are a controlled
vocabulary.

Distinct from LISTING_KIND, which is the delivery kind (data stream vs
module artifact), and from ACCESS_TYPE, which is the commercial access
model. UNSPECIFIED means the provider did not classify the listing; a
consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified `$CCT` category this listing belongs to, for browse,
filter and per-category counting. A listing MAY carry several. If
nonempty it MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.

RECOMMENDED_RETENTION.description:
Retention rule the publisher recommends to subscribers of a dataset
listing: ReplaceCurrent when each publication is a complete current set,
ArchiveAll when publications accumulate history.

MEMErrorModel.description:
Noise, bias and editing rules for one observable. Standard deviations and
biases use the observable's SI unit. ANGLE observables use radians.

MEMEditingDecision.description:
One deterministic editing decision. The observation identity is carried
from the tracking-data input so rejected sets can be compared exactly.

MEMAttestation.description:
Dual-form signature. Presence means both signatures are required and both
MUST verify independently; an invalid member rejects the record rather
than downgrading it to unsigned.

MEM.description:
Measurement Error Model. JSON projections preserve these IDL-capitalized
field names exactly. The FlatBuffer signature covers the size-prefixed
buffer with both signature vectors zeroed; the canonical-JSON signature
covers RFC 8785 canonical JSON with both signature fields omitted.
